tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling gi lo rgyus

tei:div.tei:p: trerta 9trī ci tre snye ji tsho shāci— — ri ༷ /3byā bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa'i li sku byin can/ tremiza chirnyi5 ci ci sdu bam̐ ri cho rīsde ri k+ṇi tshortselo 1/ rdoXlho ṅka ————tse——ri— ci —kro sto d+ngha rkaskunespu ri—/ka ka — rtsesdo sgo — —sko+o bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang / mi pham mdun sa byams khang chen mo/

dā dzā 3 ṇa 7 ci — ༷rmebye : ci ring ne+e ci—(rijilha ci rngo bye ( ri the snoprepe 6 chi —— ཿci — tsho ci k+ko ci— nyi cho3 /tsho 4 rte sna54 rta ri7 ༷ rdo shu ji ) rkasmoru/ — — sku‘ / ‘ rngo sgo 5 4 4sko treri —— — ci k+ṣepho ra 4 lam̐ sgo sna chi sgro ri ci ri rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo blo bzang grags pa'i li sku byin can/

ri mi— snye 4 cirtswa— rtsa— nu ṇa༈ ji pyi lha lke 4 rī nica kasnye sku ga ṭ+wāṃ sgyu 3 rtsi — — rjo—ri tre tsho ske ’ snyestorgyu 7 duni/ khyu/ nya richos sgyu sna sto sdi dī 7 sti ji (cici / sni ri ci kau / 4 snashing dzi kyi trī teri — 4 ci snaglu 4 ci — — shāci — ci ri ldesto cho snye4 d+kusnye sgo skepha chi wazhem ri'adren lnga pa byabyecas sku mthong ba don ldawa/— — sto snyo tshomeci

2 k+ṣetsha ’ zlo ziX/ tsho cici snyertse 1snyi— rgya chilhone sko rte cho sdu tre zhe rte tsho cho ṭ+wāṃ ma'i — ri ṣ+ṭi : mo snyi rme tsho hūṃ su ri tsho dzi nolja cho‘spre dzomyu/sgo / 8 tsā thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi li sku/

sgrub pa'i dga' tshal dam pa rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling gi lo rgyus dad pa'i rol mtsho rgyas pa'i zla zer bzhugs so//blo bzang dge 'dun gyis brtsams/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /2002 zi ling /

dkar chagamachod par brjod pa/ (1)rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten du ji ltar dar tshul mdo tsam bshad pa/ (7)'phags bod du gtsug lag khang sogs ji ltar bzhengs tshul cung tsam bshad pa/ (15)skabs bab kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bsgrubs tshul rgyas par bshad pa/ (21)sde 'dir bstan pa yang dar gyi rabs bshad pa/ (112)'du khang chen mo ji ltar bzhengs tshul (116)byams khang ji ltar bzhengs tshul/ (154)lha mo khang dang chos 'khor khang sogs bskrun tshul/ (225)sde 'dir bzo rig byung 'phel/ (249)sgyu rtsal phun tshogs lha bzo'i skor/ (251)bzo rig par rko'i skor/ (265)1

bzo rig rdo rko'i skor/ (268)bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon skyes chen dam pa rim byon rnams kyi mdzad rjes rags tsam brjod pa/ (271)chos sde gzhan nas phebs pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi mdzad rjes/ (273)chos sde rang nas 'khrungs pa'i skyes chen rnams kyi rtogs pa mdo tsam gleng ba/ (457)phan yon dang mdzad byang / (515)

mchod par brjod pa/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig/ snyiblo bzang zla shel 'dab stong 'dzum grol bar//rgyal kun gsang gsum sbrang rtsi'i bcud rdzogs pa//grags pa'i cod pan srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan du//mtshungs med gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa mchod//don gnyis chu skyes dkar po'i phreng ba tshogs zung lha yi 'khri shing rtser smin bcom ldan mnyam med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhi ba myang 'das dga' tshal yangs por zag med dga' bder rol ba'i dpyid gyur lung rtogs chos kyi nam mkha'i mdzod/ /rig grol yon tan stong gi 'od rlabs gur kum snye ma'i tshal du sbar ba 'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /bslu med mchog gsum bden pa'i stobs kyis rka sar 'dus bzang chos kyi gling gang dge legs me tog char du snyil/ /mi zad tshogs chen chu gter las 'ongs stobs bcu'i cha shas rab rdzogs sku/ /sku mchog legs bshad 'od dkar ga bur zhun ma'i sdug kun drungs 'byin gsung / /gsung mchog snyan dgus 'gro la rjes chags dmigs pa med pa'i brtse 1

ldan thugs/ /thugs mchog rgyu skar bye ba'i gtsug rgyan thub dbang smra ba'i zla bar mchod/ /de yi zab rgyas legs bshad mdzod 'dzin 'dzin mkhas snying stobs rmad po che/ /che ba'i mchog gyur bla med thugs gsang gsang chen rgya mtshor spel ba'i sras/ /sras chen mi pham mgon dang lha mchog mchog thun 'dod 'jo'i 'jam dbyangs lha/ /lha mi'i skyabs gcig zhabs rdul dge legs legs par 'bar bas ring du skyongs/ /mdo dang sngags kyi chos tshul sgo mo brgya/ /bde blag 'byed pa'i legs byas sprin sgra yis/ /rgyal bstan shis par mdzad pa'i 'dzam gling rgyan/ /shing rta chen po klu thogs rnam gnyis rgyal/ /mdo smad gser ljongs skrul bzang 'bras smin zhing / /dag dang ma dag 'jig rten las rgyal bar/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba snri masto'i 'phrin las kyis/ /skyong mdzad yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /mkhas btsun dbang phyug rgyal kun mdzad pa'i khur/ /mtha' dag thugs bskyed mthu dpung bla med par/ /ngal gso bsten pas lung rigs gser ldan mar/ /dbang bsgyur dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag pos skyongs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug mngon bzhengs legs byas dpal/ /mi pham dge legs 'chi med lam yangs las/ /lhug par bzhad pa'i snyan pa zla ba'i zer/ /sa gsum g.yo ba'i skyes phreng rnams la 'dud/ /rdzogs byang chub ces snyan pa'i yid bzhin mtshor/ /lung rtogs yon tan rab mdzes ngang ba mo/ /lung rigs snyan 'gyur gsal ba'i rol rtsed 2

kyis/ /gdengs can bdag por skyengs ster gang de rgyal/ /thub pa'i bstan pa srung la ma g.yel bar/ /gang 'dul zhi khro sgyu ma'i rol gar gyis/ /ma rungs bstan 'gro'i gshed gyur ḍā ki'i gtso/ /srid gsum rgyal mos 'phrin las rnam bzhis skyongs/ /dge legs mi zad 'dus pa'i lang tsho sngon med 'jig rten kun dga'i dpyid/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i ral ba'i dog par mnyam med stobs kyis lhur blangs nas/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos srid 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i dpag bsam 'khri shing stong / /ci yang 'dzin pa'i zol gyis legs par brgyan pa'i bkra shis dpal ldan gling / /de yi bkod pa mtshar sdug lha dbang khang bzang la yang co 'dri zhing / /'jig rten ma lus ya mtshan bskyed pa'i rten gsum nam mkha'i nor bu 'bum/ /sde 'di'i dbang phyogs sa 'dzin phrag nas 'dzum pa'i rtse dgas skal ldan kun/ /yid kyi pad+mo rnam par bzhad pa'i dpal 'di srid zhi'i bla na mtho/ /'di na rgud pas ma drangs par/ /gang gi gzi byin lam yangs por/ /mngon du phyogs pa'i dge ba'i gshis/ /tshur mthong gzhan gyis mtshon nus min/ /de phyir ngag las yang dag gtam/ /shis byed sprin gyi me tog ni/ /dus su thigs pa'i 'phrul rtsed kyis/ /'di yang bstan 'gror dpyid du dbab/ /mkhyen rab nam mkha'i dga' tshal du/ /gzu bor gnas pa'i rta ljang can/ /dad 'dun gar gyis rab rtsen kun/ /ma smad don 'dir dgyes dgur rol//

de la 'dir dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul ba'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhing 'dir chu zla ltar ci yang 'char ba las/ bdag cag gi me tog phog pa'i lha skal rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo yul mdo smad kyi sgrub pa'i shing rta ba chen po/ rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho zhes mtshan snyan nyi zla ltar rab 'byams zhing na yongs su grags pa'i rje de nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul zhing dam pa re skong gser mo ljongs kyi 'dzin ma'i khyon kun dge legs su byed pa'i rgyan phun sum tshogs pa/ shrī nā len+d+ra gnyis pa chos kyi sde chen po rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen phyogs las rnam rgyal bde chen chos 'khor gling gtsos bshad sgrub kyi sde rnams kyi ya gyal/'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba yab rje bla ma'i 'phrin las 'od snang gis nye bar 'khyud pa/ dran dbang gtsug gi cod pan/ nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla bas phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i gdan sa dam pa/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon rje btsun dam pa rka sar lha ris pa byang chub rab gsal zhes mtshan snyan gyi rnga gsang 'og min bar du ldir ba gang gi 'khrungs gzhi/ sgrub pa'i sde rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling du kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lha chos dri ma med pa'i lugs bzang ji ltar dar ba'i tshul brjod pa la gsum/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig 4

rten du ji ltar dar bab tshul mdo tsam bshad pa/ 'phags bod kyi yul du gtsug lag khang sogs ji ltar bzhengs pa'i tshul cung zad bshad pa/skabs bab kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad pa'o//de yang mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dge legs dang phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig pu ni bcom ldan bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid can de'i bstan pa rin po che nyid yin la/ de rim gyis dar zhing rgyas par byed pa'i rkyen/ 'phags bod kyi chos rgyal lo paṇa sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi bka' drin las gzhan du dmigs su ma mchis pas de dag gi lo rgyus dang / sgos su'ang mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan pa bzhin/ thugs rje'i gter chen 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mos gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul ba'i bkod pa dpag tu med pas 'gro ba thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad cing / bye brag tu 'phags pa'i thugs sprul chos rgyal chen po srong btsan sgam po la sogs pa chos rgyal rim byon rnams dang / gzhan yang lo tsā ba dang paṇ+ḍi ta gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu rim par byon pa dag gis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin byed dbang bo rnam dpyod shing rtas kun gsal bu mo'i rgyan du nye bar drangs te/ 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzi 'od kyis 'jig rten mtha' dag dus 5

gcig nyid la snang bar byas shing / dam pa'i chos kyi dpal la 'dod dgur longs su spyod pa'i bskal pa bzang po mig mthong lag zin du gyur pa bsub tu med pa'i bka' drin shin tu lci ba ni/ gser gyi blo gros ma yang ma bzod par zla ba'i ma mar bying bar dogs so/ /yin na'ang 'dir sngon byung srid zhi'i gtsug lag sogs kyi 'byung khungs ji ltar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i rnam thar mdo tsam brjod par spro 'o//

rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten du ji ltar dar tshul mdo tsam bshad pa/ji skad du/ gang gis 'ching rnams yang dag rab bcad cing / /mu stegs tshogs rnams thams cad rab bcom ste/ /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud ni rab btul nas/ /byang chub mchog brnyes de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'ching ba thams cad yang dag par bcad cing bdud dang mu stegs pa'i tshogs rnams lhag ma med par bcom ste smra ba bla na med pa'i chos kyi rgyal bor bzhengs pa/ rnam 'dren stong gi nang na pad+ma dkar bo lta bur bsngags pa'i bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i rgyal bo de nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas rgyal ba dbang bo'i tog gi ngo bor sangs rgyas zin na'ang ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs pa de srid du dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su sprul ba'i bkod pa sgyu ma dang mig 'phrul bzhin du ston par mdzad pa las/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'od gsal lha las chad pa 7

mang bos bkur ba'i rgyal bo'i gdung rgyud du yangs pa'i 'jig rten chos bzhin skyong ba'i rgyal bo sa ya chig 'bum nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya bcu bzhi zam ma chad par byon pa'i 'dzam bu gling ba'i tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus su 'khor los sgyur rgyal mchog sbyin gyis 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshe na sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig rgya gar du byon nas dam pa'i chos gsungs/ tshe lo sum khri thub pa'i dus su rgyal bo chen po tsanadhas sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshe sangs rgyas gser thub rgya gar du byon/ tshe lo nyi khri thub pa'i dus su rgyal bo kri kris 'dzam gling skyong ba'i tshe sangs rgyas 'od srungs 'jig rten du byon/ rtsod ldan gyi mtha' 'dzam bu gling ba tshe lo brgya ba'i dus su rgyal bo zas gtsang mas 'jig rten chos bzhin skyong ba'i tshe bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya thub pa ni dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ tha ma nges pa'i don du 'og min du sangs rgyas/ drang ba'i don la dga' ldan lha'i yul du lhan bu dam pa tog dkar bor gyur pa'i tshe/ sems can rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ dga' ldan du rje btsun byams pa mgon po rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te grong khyer dang / yab yum gyi rigs la gzigs/ glang chen mche ba drug ldan gyi tshul du grong khyer ser skya'i rgyal bo zas gtsang dang yum sgyu 'phrul lha mo'i lhums su/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te zhugs so/ /der zla ba bcu lon pa na lum bi 8

nī'i tshal du yum gyi phyag byang chub kyi shing la 'jus te mchan khung g.yas pa'i rtsib ma'i bar nas 'khrungs ma thag tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis kā shi ka'i ras kyis blangs dga' bo dang nye dgas sku khrus gsol lo/ /de'i tshe sras kyis phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun bor bas me tog pad+ma bdun re dang bkra shis pa'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung ba na/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir byon pa'i bstod pa dang bo la yab kyis/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ /sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas/ /nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs/ /de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod de mtshan la rgyal bu don kun grub par grags so/ /de nas phyag bdun 'das nas yum mya ngan las 'das pa nas skye dgu'i bdag mo la sogs pa ma ma sum cu rtsa gnyis la gtad nas bskyed bsrings so/ /de nas rgyal bu cher skyes nas yi ge dang rtsis la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing / stobs dang sgyu rtsal gyis skye bo dregs pa can thams cad tshar bcad nas 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad de/ grags 'dzin ma sogs kyi btsun mo 'khor rgyas rol ba sogs khyim na bzhugs pa'i skabs kyi mdzad pa rnams bdag gir bzhes rjes 'khor ba'i bya ba la thugs phyung ba'i tshul gyis dgung lo nyer dgu bzhes tshe rgyal srid dor nas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du byon nas rang byung gis rab tu byung / de nas chu bo nai rañdza na'i 'gram du lo drug dka' ba spyad de rdo rje gdan gyi spo 9

la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i mdzad pa bstan pas skye dgu mtha' dag bla na med pa'i mgon dang bcas par gyur to/ /de nas dam pa'i chos la dkon pa dang don che ba sogs kyi 'du shes bskyed pa'i phyir/zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smra nags kyi tshal du gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs nas zhag bdun phrag bdun gyi bar thugs las chung ngur bzhugs pa na/ tshangs pa chen pos gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa dang / brgya byin gyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dpag tshad lnga bcu ba dang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs phul nas chos 'khor skor bar gsol ba btab pa na yul wā rā ṇa sī'i drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su 'khor lnga sde bzang bo la sogs pa la bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor dang / yul dbus bya rgod phung bo'i ri bor 'khor rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya grangs med pa la bka' bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor dang / grong khyer yangs pa can li tsā byi'i gnas su 'khor byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags la sogs par bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor dang /dpal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa sogs gnas sna tshogs su 'khor rgyal sras phyag na rdo rje sogs la rgyud sde rab 'byams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo rdzogs par bskor bas lhar bcas 'jig rten mtha' dag phan bde'i snang 10

ba chen pos skyong bar mdzad do/ /ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i 'og tu rgyal bo mthong ldan gyis sbyin bdag byas te 'od srungs chen pos mngon pa dang / kun dga' bos mdo sde dang / nye bar 'khor gyis 'dul ba'i sde snod bsdus te bka' bsdu dang po mdzad/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun gyis bstan pa yun ring du bskyangs shing / ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu tsam na rgyal bo mya ngan med kyis sbyin bdag bgyis te dgra bcom pa grags pas bka' bsdu gnyis pa mdzad/ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya tsam na rgyal bo ka ṇiṣ+kas sbyin bdag byas te kha che'i yul du dgra bcom pa dang byang sems lnga brgya phrag re re/ ser skya'i paṇ+ḍi ta khri dang drug stong 'dus te bka' bsdu gsum pa mdzad/ de nas 'dzam gling mdzes byed rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / zung 'jug mngon byas grub chen brgyad cu sogs bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu zam ma chad par byon pa dag gis bshad sgrub ya ma bral bas rgyal ba'i lugs bzang 'phags yul nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon la rdzogs ldan gyi dpal ma nyams par byas so/ /de yang / 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bos/ kai la sha yi mdangs 'phrog pa'i/ /sa 'dzin dkar bos phyogs rnams kun/ /bar mtshams med par dkrigs na yang / /mi shes smag rum 'thibs pa 'dir/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gangs can gyi ljongs dbus gtsang 'dir thog mar chus gang ba rim gyis bri ste/ stod g.ya' dang gangs la 11

glang chen dang gcan gzan/ bar brag dang spang la bya dang ri dwags/smad rtsi shing nags tshal la spre'u dang brag srin gyis gang bar gyur pa las nam zhig na 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam sprul spre'u byang chub sems dpas sgyu ma'i mdzad pa mig 'phrul bzhin du bstan te mi'u gdong drug la sogs pa'i mi'i 'gro ba spel/ mang bkur gyi gdung rgyud las byung ba shākya li tsā byi'i rigs kyi rgyal bo gnya' khri btsan po zhes bod rgyal gyi thog mar bkur ba/ de nas bzung rgyal rabs nyer bdun pa kun tu bzang bo'i sprul ba lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes / rgyal rabs so gnyis pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod/ rgyal rabs so bdun pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam sprul chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa sogs bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su chos rgyal rim byon dang / kha che sogs nas byon pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mang bo dang / skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā pa ka cog zhang gsum sogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul du mas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad do/ /de nas chos rgyal ral ba can gyi gcen glang dar mas rang gi gcung chos rgyal chen po bkrongs nas rgyal srid bzung / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa phal cher bsnubs pas gangs can gyi ljongs 'di re zhig bar mun pa'i gling du gyur/de'i tshe dmar g.yo gtsang 12

gsum mdo smad dan tig tu bzhugs pa las bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs/ de las klu mes sogs dbus gtsang gi mi bcu rab tu byung bas bstan pa phyi dar gyi rmang gzhi mdo smad nas gso bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / de'i dbon po byang chub 'od sogs kyis 'phags yul paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa lha gcig dri paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dpal bzang po dka' ba dpag tu med pas spyan drangs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma mtha' dag ma lus par bsal te mdo sngags kyi bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du 'jug pa'i shing rta'i lam srol yangs por phye'o/ /gzhan yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su slob dpon chen pos gsang sngags kyi chos bstan pa la brten nas grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i bstan 'dzin mang du byung ba sogs kyis bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i rnam thar ni bsam brjod las 'das pa sha stag tu snang / khyad par du 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs lung bstan rtsod med rnams las mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid khams gsum bla ma rnam 'dren chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis bstan pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang khyad par du dbu sngags gnyis ya ma bral ba'i gnad sngar bod kyi mkhas pa su'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa rnams 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgo nas 13

gsal bar bkral te 'khrul bral lam srol bzang po dkar 'jam yug gcig gis 'dzin ma'i khyon ma lus pa khyab par mdzad pa dang / 'brog ri bo che dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab pa la brten nas ri bo dge ldan pa zhes grags snyan gyi rnga bo che 'og min bar du ldir ba 'di nyid byung /'jam mgon bla ma'i 'khor slob nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu las mched de stod dzā ti'i me tog skyes pa'i sa nas shar rgya mtsho chen po la thug gi bar dge 'dun gyi sde dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pas gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i rang lugs rdzogs ldan gyi dpal las mi nyams par mdzad pa yin no//14

'phags bod du gtsug lag khang sogs ji ltar bzhengs tshulacung tsam dashad pa/'phags bod nor 'dzin lha'i rdzing ring / /thub pa'i srol bzang bcu gnyis dbang / /bstan 'dzin rnam dpyod skya rengs kyi/sa/ /nyer drangs dge legs 'dzum dkar phye/ /sgos su 'jam mgonajirgyal ba'i dbang / /gangs ri las babs dge ldan pa'i/ /'khrul bral lugs bzang gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /rlabs phreng 'phyur ba'i sgeg nyams mtshar//spyir btang zhing 'dir rten gsum gyi thog ma ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la sogs pa mang dogs pas gzhan du gsal ba ltar la/ 'dir skabs dang 'brel ba 'phags bod kyi yul du mchog gsum gyi rten sogs grags che ba ji ltar bzhengs pa'i phyogs tsam mtshon par 'dod do/ /de la sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bcom ldan 'das 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i dus nyid na drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su wā rā ṇa sī'i khyim bdag dge bzang gis dge bzang gi gtsug lag khang dang / 'od ma'i tshal bya 15

ka lan+ta ka gnas pa'i tshal du rgyal bo gzugs can snying bos 'od ma'i tshal gyi kun dga' ra ba dang / mnyan yod rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du khyim bdag bzang sbyin gyis rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba dang / ser skya'i skye yod dang / bya gro rnya dang / tshangs pa'i gnas kyi skyed tshal gsum du rgyal bo zas gtsang gis de gsum gyi kun dga' ra ba sogs rgyal bo dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis gtsug lag khang dpag tu med pa bzhengs par mdo sde rnams las rgya cher 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gzhan yang lha chen po tshangs pas chos sku'i rten du ba lta bu'i mchod rten bzhengs/ khyab 'jug gis longs sku'i rten gangs can mtsho rgyal bzhengs/ brgya byin gyis sprul sku'i rten ston pa dngos kyi sku dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i rten rnams bzhengs/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das rjes su yul ma ga dha'i bram ze mo dzaḥ sa'i bu gsum gyi che ba rgyal bas wā rā ṇa sīr ston pa'i sku gzugs kyi lha khang bzhengs pa dang / 'bring bo legs rgyal gyis rgyal bo'i khab 'od ma'i tshal du ston pa'i sku gzugs kyi lha khang bzhengs pa dang / chung ba dge bas rdo rje gdan du ston pa'i sku gzugs byang chub chen po garnyo la dang bcas pa bzhengs pa sogs paṇa grub rgyal blon bstan la sri zhu byed pa rim byon rnams kyi nang na gtsug lag khang sogs rten re ma bzhengs pa med pa lta bur yod do/ /bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po 16

dang bal bza' khri btsan gnyis kyis 'o thang gi mtshor ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / chos rgyal de dang rgya bza' kong jos ra mo cher ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang dang / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis mkhan slob chos gsum gdan 'dzoms pa'i dus na o tan+ta pu rir dpe blangs te bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du ār+ya ba lo'i gling sogs dang / mnga' bdag ral ba can gyis pho brang 'on cang du lha khang rdo'i rgya phibs dgu thog ma bzhengs pa sogs mang du yod la/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal gyis mdo smad du ri bo dan tig gi gtsug lag khang dang / gzhan yang 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams bstan pa'i zhal gsos su gtsug lag khang dang lha rten sogs bzhengs ci thub byed pa la thugs mos che stabs gong ma tshos gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa che phra bzhengs pa grangs kyis mi zin pa dang /gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i rang bstan 'di la yang / rje thams cad mkhyen pas rdzing phyi'i byams pa gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa zhig gsos dang / rgyal tshab dang 'dul 'dzin lag gi blar bskos nas dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi 'du khang ka bar bdun cu ba/ sgrub mchod lha khang blos bslang dang bcas pa/ sras chen rnams kyis 'jam mgon bla ma'i dngul gdung rin po che'i gtsug lag khang rnams dang /17

mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dang bdag po rab brtan pa mchod yon nas rgyal rtse'i mchod rten chen mo dri gtsang khang can dang / dpon nam mkha' bzang po khu dbon gyis khur bzhes te 'jam dbyangs chos rjes 'bras spungs 'du khang dang sngags khang / byams chen chos rjes se ra'i 'du khang sogs dang / rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyis bkras lhun 'du khang chen mo ka bar zhe brgyad pa sogs rgyal dbang yab sras gnyis kyi sku'i phreng pa rim byon dang / bod kyi chos rgyal na rim dang / dgongs blon chen po rnams kyis gtsug lag khang dang rten gsum bzhengs pa da lta'i bar du zam ma chad pas mtha' dag brjod par ga la nus/ mdo smad 'dir yang rje thams cad mkhyen pa gang du 'khrungs pa'i gzhir tsan dan gyi ljon pa 'khrungs pa snying bor byas te gser sdong chen mo sogs gtsug lag khang dang rgya phibs dang gañdzir bzhengs mkhan mang du byung ba dang / rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtshos bya khyung gser gdung khang dang / smin grol sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos gser khog jo khang / lcang skya ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis chu bzang jo khang thar lam gsal byed gling gsar du bzhengs pa sogs byang rgyud dang / rang re'i ljongs 'dir yang rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo ngur smrig gar du rtsen pa yab rje skal ldan rgya mtshos bshad sgrub kyi sde gnyis ka'i 'du khang dang grub chen chos pa rin po ches 'jam dbyangs kun 18

gzigs chen mo dang / byams sku mthong ba don ldan gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa bzhengs pa dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gtsug lag khang sogs dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos gser khang rten dang brten par bcas pa dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mchod rten mthong grol chen mo dri gtsang khang can bzhengs pa dang / zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos sangs rgyas stong sku'i gtsug lag khang bskrun pa sogs lho rgyud du gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bzhengs pa bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa zhig go /nang sgos su 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i bu chen/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba'i dpral ba'i mig gcig pu bstan pa'i dar chen phyogs mthar skyong ba grub dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho dbyangs can mngon par dga' ba'i sde sku phreng rim byon/ srid skyong sku dpon na rim/ 'phrin las skyong ba'i bstan 'dzin gus mchod lhur len byed pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis rong bo dgon chen bde chen chos 'khor gling phyogs las rnam rgyal gtsos re skong stod smad bar gsum du chos sde che chung mang du bskrun pa dang / sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs pa ni rtogs pa brjod pa'i yi ge ris su 'khod pa dag tu gsal bar ma zad mngon sum gyis mjal du'ang yod pa 'di bzhin no//19

sam rtsen gnas sa gser mngal can gang gis/ /spyi gtsag nor ba'i ༄ ༄ sto ༄gdengs kar ma zin pa/ /dri gtsang khang dang rten gsum rin chen 'bru/ /thang mar brdal bas sa gsum dge bar byas/ /de lta'i ya mtshan gzhon nu'i bzhin ras gang / /'dren byed yul gyi a mṛ tar son pa'i/ /dga' ston gsar bas brtan pa rab 'phrog pa'i/ /tshangs chen dpal yang chu skyes tshul du snyems/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//20

skabs bab kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ji ltar ba3gribs thosal zu1sa par bshad pa/skabs bab kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni/ chos sde 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad nas ji ltar bskyangs tshul rgyas par bshad pa ste/ mdzad pa po'i rtogs pa cung zad brjod dang / gnas ngos bzung nas phyag 'debs mdzad tshul bshad pa/dang po ni/ mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i gtsug lag rnyog pa dang bral ba'i zil dngar phyogs su 'grem pa la smon lam gyi mthu phul du son cing /rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar son pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje btsun ngag dbang mi pham zla ba zhes grags snyan gsar ba'i ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor g.yo ba/rgyal ba'i sras po 'di nyid gang du sprul ba'i zlos gar bsgyur ba'i yul ni/mdo smad nor 'dzin gyi bu mo'i lang tsho mchog tu rgod pa'i char gtogs pa/gnam sngon bzhus pa'i rang mdangs yongs su rdzogs shing yan lag brgyad kyi yon tan mnga' ba'i rma klung dal gyis 'bab pa'i nye 'gram skye dgu'i dri 21

'dzin dbang bo rab tu 'phrog pa'i bsung zhim ngad kyi dud pa lhan skyes su mnga' ba'i margad gsar ba'i nags tshal phyogs su dkrigs pa/ chu skyes sna tshogs g.yur du za ba'i sman gyi phreng ba dang spang ljongs nyams su dga' ba/ chu bo'i rgyun bzang phyogs su 'bab pa/ 'bru drug snye ma'i phon po dus su smin cing skyed tshal dang bza' shing gi ra ba tshar du dngar ba'i dbus na rab tu mdzes pa'i khang brtsegs kyi bkod pa rmad du byung ba dang / grong dang yul ljongs sna tshogs kyis nye bar mdzes shing / yul mi rnams chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas te rigs rus cho 'brang gtsang ma'i ri mo kun nas bkra ba/ ya rabs kyi las la brtson cing bsnyengs pa med pa'i lus sems kyi stobs rdzogs pa sogs snod bcud kyi phun tshogs rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus ston gsar du bzhad pa lta bu'i gnas su gyur pa mar nang bis thang zhes grags pa'i zegs ma ring nas 'phro ba de ni 'khrungs yul yin no/ /dam pa 'di'i yab ni/ mkhas shing mdzangs la dpa' zhing rtul phod pa sogs ya rabs kyi spyod tshul mtha' dag lhan skyes su ldan pa'i mi'i khyu mchog 'ja' mo'i dpal lo zhes bya ba dang / yum ni sems rgyud dul zhing brtse ba dang ldan pa sogs bud med phal ba'i spyod tshul las 'das pa klu mo dpal du 'bod pa de gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i bgrang bya nyer gcig pa me phag sgeg mo'i rang zhal mngon par bzhad pa'i dus tshes dge bar ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang bcas sku bltams 22

so/ /de ltar gzhon nu de nyid ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ gzhon yang rgan po'i nye bar zhi la dga'/ /mkhas par gyur kyang shes pa'i nga rgyal med/ /gzi brjid che yang bzod cing des pa dang / /je mthor phyin kyang nga rgyal dregs pa med/ /ces pa ltar/ yon tan lhan skyes su mnga' ba zhig go /de nas dben gnas dam pa sges steng dga' ldan chos 'phel gling du yang dag pa'i mgon la bsten te phral klog dang sbyar klog gshar ma dang dbu can sogs la tshul bzhin sbyangs te ring bo ma lon par tshegs med du thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i dus su mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i 'phags bod gzhung brgya'i rgya mtsho thos bsam gzings kyis bcal te dgongs don rin chen gyi bang mdzod bdag gir bzhes pa'i thugs 'dun rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas/ ji skad du/rnam 'dren dam pa zhwa dmar dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/chos dang srid kyi 'byor ba rgya che'i rlabs/ /rdzogs la mkha' la 'phyo ba'i dpal yon can/ /bde chen chos 'khor zhes grags mkhas 'dus gling / /rgyal byed tshal gyi dpe zlar 'os pa byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar don dang ldan pa'i rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling zhes grags pa dkar bo'i lbu phreng srid pa gsum na 'dzum pa'i gdan sa chen po/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal lho rgyud 'dzin ma'i rgyan du 'phos pa lta bu gang der zhabs sen gyi pad+mo nye bar bkod de mkhas mang gdengs can bye ba'i 'byung gnas gang gi chos 23

grwar zhugs nas mkhyen rab 'phrul gyi sgo 'phar mtha' dag cig car 'byed pa'i thabs tshul dam pa ngo mtshar bsdus sbyor gyi rigs pa dri ma med pa'i lam srol yangs po rnams dang / gzhung po ti lnga la sbyangs brtson chen pos 'ol spyi tsam ma yin pa'i go ba gting tshugs pa'i sgo nas mthar phyin par mdzad/ gzhan yang gnas lnga gzigs pa'i dbang phyug bde chen pa shes rab 'od zer gyi drung nas lañdza dang / wartu/ dbu can dang dbu med sogs yig rigs mi 'dra ba rnams ji ltar 'bri ba'i tshul dang sum rtags sogs la mkhas par sbyangs/ mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i shing bza' paṇ+ḍi ta blo bzang dar rgyas kyi zhal snga nas las/ ka tsān sogs dang sdeb sbyor gyi rigs la zhib mor sbyangs pas skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā pa chen por gyur/ khyad par du rmad byung legs bshad kyi mdzod 'dzin mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa a khyung sprul ba'i sku ngag dbang mkhyen rab pa slob dpon du bsten nas/ dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs gsan bsam bla na med pa gnang ba dang / gzhon dus nas dbyangs can lha mo'i bsnyen sgrub la yun ring 'dris par byas pas lhag pa'i lha mo'i dgyes 'dzum zhal gyi snang ba mngon sum du bstan pa'i mthu las rab 'byams shes bya'i dngos po mtha' dag snyan ngag dam pa'i rgyan du 'khyer ba'i sngon med pa'i daṇ+ḍi chen po zhig lho rgyud 'dzin ma'i rgyan du byung ngo zhes bya ba'i grags snyan nor bu'i rgyud mangs mtha' dbus kun tu 24

rang sgra rgod pa na mtho ris kyi slob dpon drang srong lha'i bla ma dang /ngag gi dbang phyug chen po dpal ldan dpa' bo sogs lha dang mi'i snyan ngag gi rol mo 'dzin pa mtha' dag nga rgyal gyi ri bo cig car bsnyil nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyis dus 'da' ba la nye bar zhugs par gyur te/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung sgros las/'gran zla med pa'i snyan ngag mkhan du bsngags pa dang / ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad mkhyen pa saṃ gha'i mtshan can gyi zhal nas/ mdo smad lho byang gi rgyud 'dir bis pa mi pham lta bu'i snyan ngag mkhan byon ma myong zhes bstod bsngags kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mar sgrogs pa dang / gzhan yang mkhas bya'i gnas kun mkhyen rab kyi me long gcig gi nang du rdzogs par mdzad pa ni/ rgyal ba mi pham pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid 'thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gyi don phyag len du thebs par mdzad pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pa'i mkhas dbang chen po thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ skye dgu'i 'dren mchog khri chen 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun bstan 'dzin/ mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i dgongs don ji bzhin gzigs pa khri chen dge 'dun mkhyen rab sogs nges pa don gyi mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs pad spyi bos bsten te/ mdo sngags rig gnas kun la phyogs med 25

du sbyong ba'i thugs 'dun rtsol med rang shugs kyis mnga' ba zhig yin stabs thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa la yang tshul bzhin du sbyangs tshul yang / bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa yan lag dang bcas pa'i man ngag mtha' dag legs par gsan nas thugs kyi yol gor yongs su gtams pas/ rig sngags pa thams cad kyi gtso bo/ gzhan dang mi mnyam pa'i grub pa'i khyu mchog chen por gyur to/ /de'i phyir/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas/ gung thang sprul ba'i sku dang / bis pa sprul sku lta bu mdo sngags rig gnas kun la mkhas pa deng dus shin tu dkon zhes gsungs pa thugs gzu bor gnas shing de nyid thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung du 'dug go zhes rdo rje 'chang a bh+ya zhabs kyis lan du mar bsngags so/ /dgung lo nyer gsum pa zhi ba zhes pa sa mo bya'i lor/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam par rol ba/ 'phrin las zla ba gsar ba'i 'od ris 'gog med mkha' khyab tu bzhad pa/ skye dgu'i dpung gnyen chen po rnam 'dren skal ldan dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas dpal bzang pos mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad de/ dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su gsol bzhi'i las kyis dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs pa nas bzung ste sdom gsum dag pa thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad par ma zad/ so so thar ba'i mdo las/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu/ /lang tsho yol ba rnams kyis gnas pa bde/ /zhes gsungs 26

pa ltar thun dang thun mtshams su bcad de nyams len rdo rus thug pa gnang bzhed kyis/ ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan gyi mu tig gi dra ba dang dra phyed gzhan dang mi mnyam pa'i dben gnas dam pa/ dga' ldan chos 'phel gling sogs drang srong dka' thub pa rnams kyi bste gnas su gyur pa'i dben gnas phul du son pa 'bigs byed kyi ri bo gyen du bslangs pa lta bu brgya phrag du mar/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa lam gyi srog tu byas te/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi bar lam thun mong ba dang / smin byed bskyed pa'i rim pa nas sku thugs zung 'jug gi bar gyi lam thun mong ma yin pa rnams thun bzhir nyams su bstar ba dang / lhan cig byed rkyen tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi rigs mtha' yas pa dang / gzhan gegs sel bogs 'don snyan brgyud zhal shes las 'byung ba thams cad ma tshang ba med par phyag len la thebs par mdzad pas sngon med pa'i nyams rtogs mtha' dag thugs rgyud la spungs pa bzhin gyur te/ sgrub 'bras rtogs pa'i ye shes gzhan phan 'phrin las shugs 'byung du rgyas pa na grags dkar zla thal dkar bos shes ldan snying gi pad+mo dad pas bsdams shing / thugs rje kun snang 'od dkar gyis nye bar skyong ba'i dus la bab par dgongs te/ dus grwa gsang sngags dar rgyas gling gi gdong lngas bteg pa'i rin chen khri la zhabs sor bskyod de phyi dus kyi 'khor lo snod bcud kyi rnam gzhag de gtan la 27

'bebs byed ri mo'i go don dang bcas pa'i lag len/ nang dus kyi 'khor lo phung khams rtsa rlung gi rnam gzhag de gtan la 'bebs byed sbyor ba yan lag drug 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag rgya cher ston pa'i 'grel ba mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas yi ger bkod pa ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba cha lag dang bcas pa 'doms par mdzad de gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam bzang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal bar mdzad/rgyud grwa gsang chen chos kyi bang mdzod du dpal ldan rgyud kyi gnad don glu dbyangs su gyer ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba'i sde'i rtogs ldan ral ba'i nyag mas btegs pa'i khri la lha dbang bzhin phebs te/ gsung rab rin chen gling la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rgyal sras stong gi re ba kun nas skong / /gsung rab kun gyi rtse mor gang son pa/ /de ni dpal ldan rgyud rgyal 'dus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal bo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud sgron gsal dang / dkyus zur gyi mchan bsdus don dang bcas pa sbrags nas mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i bshad pa rgyas par mdzad pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang sgrub pa snying bor mdzad pa'i rig pa 'dzin pas sa steng khyab pa byung ngo//mdor na yon tan gyi tshogs de lta bus mngon par mtho ba'i rgyal ba'i sras po smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po 'dis legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos chen po gang spel/ brjod bya bden bzhi dang bslab gsum 28

lam lnga dang thabs shes zung dang rim gnyis sogs mdo sngags ci rigs kyi dbang du byas pa'i gzhi lam 'bras pa'i rim pa mtha' dag gtan la 'bebs shing / rjod byed dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rig pa'i gsang tshig las 'ongs pa'i tshigs bcad dang / lhug pa dang / tshig bcad lhug spel ma gang rung gi rgyan gyi nyams yongs su rdzogs pa'i chu skyes gsar ba'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba/ dgos pa grol ba don gnyer ba'i mchog dman bar ma sus kyang nyams su blangs kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don ngos gtsang ba zung 'jug nor bu'i pho brang du tshegs med du bgrod pa'i thabs tshul kho nar gyur pa dang / rtsom lugs lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad 'dril la ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi dri ngan spangs te ma bshad log bshad nyog bshad kyi skyon gsum dang bral ba/ blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis brtags na gzhung gi thad gang du yang sa bcad kyi khog spub/ spyi don gyis gnad bsdus/ dka' gnas kyi dogs pa bcad/sgrub byed kyi rigs pa dang rgyab rten gyi lung dang / gsal byed kyi dpe bcas dngos shugs ci rigs kyis thon yod pa dpog nus pa dang / tha na gsung ris phra mo tshun chad kyang brjod bya rjod byed gang gi thad nas sngon med pa'i legs bshad kyi gter chen po rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo'i ring lugs dam pa'i rgyan du gyur pa'i bstan bcos po ti gsum lhag gsungs pa dang / de nas dgung grangs bzhi bcu bzhes pa sa ga zla ba'i 29

yar tshes mngon du bzhad pa na bstan srid kyi 'phrin las mkhas btsun bzang bo'i rlung shugs kyis btegs te che las che ba mtha' dag gi bla nas blar 'phags pa zung 'jug grub pa'i dpa' bo 'bum gyi zhabs zung nyi zla'i 'od kyis bran pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang nam mkha' las mtho ba'i steng du che dgu dregs ldan kun gyi ral ba'i me tog gi phreng ba'i them skas las 'dzegs te zhabs skyes bkra shis kyi ri mo nye bar bkod/ li khri'i chu gter gyi rlabs phreng mkha' la 'phyo zhing gur kum sar ba'i lbu phreng do shal gyis ci yang dkrigs pa'i tshul du rgyas pa sde snod smra ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde chu gter chen po nor 'dzin ma'i lto bar 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ 'og min bar la 'gag med du ldir ba'i sar spyod lha'i rnga bo brdungs pas mdo sngags legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad par bsgrags/ gtong ba mi zad pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye nas dgos 'dod nor gyis ci yang bskyangs so/ /gzhan yang phyogs ris med kyi legs bshad don gnyer ba'i gdul bya sa'i dreg pa lta bu'i blo kha dang 'tsham par dbang khrid man ngag sogs lung chos kyi rgyun gang bzhugs mi nub pa'i legs 'doms dbyar rnga ci dgar ldir bas mdo khams bdag por snyems pa sde dang bcas pa'i rgyal mtshan ni phyis mi slong bar bsnyal te/ 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag yang dag pa'i chos kyi 'od snang dkar bos khyab par mdzad/ re zhig na skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi mthu bri ba'i dbang gis 30

rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me yos la re zhig zhi dbyings rgyal ba'i pho brang du ngal gsor byon nas kyang bstan 'gro'i don rgyun ma chad par mdzad de/rgyal ba mi pham mgon pos/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid par/ /las ni rgyun mi chad par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lags pas yon tan gyi tshogs de rnams slar yang tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas mādo tsam ngo sprod byed pa la/ kha ba'i rdul brtsegs mdzes pa'i zhing khams su/ /rin chen bang rim tshom bur legs rgod pas/ /'jig rten gzhan kun snod bcud brjid chags dang / /'chi med dga' tshal rang sar yib kyis dogs/ /de 'dra'i yul gru'i khyad par gang / /yid 'ong ngo mtshar rdzogs pa'i grong / /kun gyi dpal du chags pa'i yul/ /bis thang zhes grags snyan pa 'phur/ /de ru rigs rus cho 'brang dang / /rab gtsang gang rigs legs gzigs nas/ /tshogs zung shar ri'i phrag pa las/ /byang sems zla gsar zhing 'dir shar/ /lang tsho ma smin 'khri shing gsar/ / rnam dpyod lo 'dab rab rgyas te/ /yon tan 'bras bu g.yur za bas/ /mkhas dgu'i brtan pa dbang med 'phrog /kun dkris dri ma yongs btang ba/ /gang gi yid kyi man shel ngos/ /rab 'byams shes bya'i ri mo 'bum/ /mngon sum sna bas phyogs kun dge /mkhas grub blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/ /gsar bskrun dge mtshan rdzogs pa'i gnas/ /dga' ldan chos 'phel gling zhes byar/ /yid 'ong zla gzhon 'od ris gsal/ /skal bzang 31

gnyis skyes 'bum rol cing / /lung rigs rlabs phreng mkha' la 'phyur/ /chos sde dbyig nor 'khyil ba'i klung / /gang der zhabs sen rgyan du bkod/ /dpyad gsum gyis dag lung gi rgyun/ /sa gsum ldir ba'i chos kyi grwar/ /bsdus grwa'i 'phrul gyi lde mig gis/ /mkhyen rab mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phye/ /de nas rnam 'grel phar phyin dang / /dbu ma mdzod 'dul gzhung lugs la/ /legs sbyangs mkhyen rab nam mkha'i mtha'/ /nyid dang mtshungs zhes mkhas pas gleng / /bcu phrag rig pa'i rgya chen gzhung / /sbyangs pa'i springs yig rab spel ba'i/ /khur bzhes drang srong gzhon nu zhig /lho rgyud 'dzin ma'i thig le ru/ /'phos tshe 'dren pa gzhan dag la/ /bstod pa'i 'dun pa glo bur yal/ /de lta'i yon tan bye ba brgya'i/ /mnyam med khyad mtshar bsam las 'das/ /de yang snyog bral rdzing bu ru/ /rgyu skar tshom pa'i gzugs brnyan dang / /gang gi thugs gsang sgrib med ngor/ /rig gnas gtsug lag phra mo yang / /e ma dge byed bcud len gang / /snying gi thig ler yongs smin pas/ /dus mthar rig byed bcud len gang / /spel ba'i grags snyan mkha' la ldir/ /mtshungs bral bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs/ /gus rtag sbyor bas nyer brten nas/ /'o mtsho ji bzhin zab chos kun/ /ngang ba'i rgyal bo bzhin du spyad/ /gser ljongs skyabs mgon nyag gcig pu/ /ma smad brtan mkhas yon tan mdzod/ /dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas zhes/ /mtshan snyan nyi 32

zla ltar gsal ba/ /gang gi spyan sngar bsnyen rdzogs kyi/ /sdom pa gaṅgā'i rgyun bzang bo/ /ngoms med hub kyis legs bzhes te/ /tshul bzhin sgrub la rtse gcig gzhol/ /yangs pa'i mkhyen rab mkha' ltar rgyas/ /rnam dag bslab gsum ri dbang brjid/ /bstan srid khur gyis mi ngal bas/ /mkhas dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam par ngom/ /gang tshe ka na ka yi khrir/ /zhabs sen mu tig phreng bkod de/ /chos srid dpal gyis nyer bskyangs pa'i/ /chos sde 'dzam gling rgyan du lham/ /re zhig rtag 'dzin can gang dag /chos la bskul phyir thol byung du/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal tshul bstan/ /de ni rgyal ba kun gyi gshis/ /mang mang yid kyi rdzing bu gang / /de der gang 'tsham zla gzugs 'bum/ /lhag lhag 'char ba tshangs pas kyang / /yang yang dpyad pas ji ltar gzhal/ /zhes snyan tshig ngag gi gling bu yud tsam du bsgyur to/ /de lta bu'i yon tan gyi rigs kyis ches cher mngon par mtho ba'i rgyal sras ngag gi dam pa 'di'i legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos rin chen dag ni/ blo gzu bor gnas shing rnam dpyod dang ldan pa/ mdo sngags rig gnas chos tshul kun la sbyangs shing don gyi gnad mkhyen pa dag gis yun du gzigs na rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar dam pa 'di'i legs bshad rnams chos du mas khyad par du 'phags na yang sku dbon sogs bzang po ma byung ba'i stabs kyis par du ma 'khod par ma zad reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi chos 'byung chen mos 33

mtshon pa'i gsung rigs du ma phyogs 'khyar gyis chud zos su gyur/ nye char mkhyen rab nor bu'i 'khri shing mkha' la bsnyegs shing dge ldan ring lugs 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba/ bsod nams kyi phung bo klong du brdol cing tshul khrims kyi brtul zhugs mig 'bras bzhin srung ba'i rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po/ rang cag gi skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol zhing lugs gnyis skyong ba'i nyi ma chen po rje blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ dad gshin gyi rdzas rnams chud mi 'dza' bar bsod nams rlabs chen sdud pa'i thabs su bsgyur pa dang / mang thos mkhas pa'i bya bar mngon dga' ba rnams la phan gdags pa dang /ljongs 'di'i bstan srid kyi la rgya dgung du 'degs pa'i thugs bded kun+da gsar ba'i phon po gtsug tu bcings te rab tshes bgrang bya zhe brgyad pa kun dga' zhes pa shing pho stag gi lor par du bskrun pa'i thugs 'dun btang nas sbyor ba brtsams/ shing yos gnam lo'i 'dzum dkar mchog tu gas la ba nas par gyi 'go btsugs te dus kyi pho nyar grags pa sa pho rta'i yan la ma phyi gang rnyed kyi gsung rnams phyogs bsgril gyis par du bskrun pa'i bzhugs byang ni/ 'di ltar/ ka bar rje btsun chos kyi rgyal bo dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gser gyi rtsibs stong bkra ba'i dbang gi 'khor lo/ rje btsun bla ma khri chen 34

rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gtam pad+ma dkar bo'i chun po/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal bo ngag dbang dge 'dun zla ba grags pa'i 'khrungs rabs dang 'brel ba'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gser gyi sgo mang las sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs blo gros yan gyi rtogs brjod/ kha bar 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal bo ngag dbang dge 'dun zla ba grags pa'i 'khrungs rabs dang 'brel ba'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gser gyi sgo mang las rje de nyid kyi rtogs brjod/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhal lung lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi gdams pa'i don rgya cher bshad pa dmigs khrid dang bcas pa ngo mtshar zhing du bgrod pa'i myur lam 'jam dpal snying bo dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ byang chub sems sbyong gi gdams pa gzhan phan me tog bcud len/ legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i snying bo/ bslab bya sbrang rtsi'i snying bo'i rang 'grel sbrang rtsi'i za ma togaphyag chen gaṅgā ma'i 'grel ba/ dge ldan phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar lta ba'i me long / phyag chen nyams mgur dri med rdo rje'i gsung gi dka' 'grel zab gsal me long / lta ba'i gsung mgur gyi ṭīk+ka legs bshad mthong ba don ldan/ zab mo de kho na nyid kyi don la dpyad pa rnam par rtog pa'i 'gyu 'khril/ bslab nga/ gsum gyi dka' gnas rnam par bshad pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog dam pa'i chos la skul ba'i bslab bya mdor bsdus bdud rtsi'i yang zhun/ zin bris nyin byed 'dren pa'i skya 35

rengs/ stag ge mchog sprul bstan pa rab rgyas kyi bka' 'dri'i lan mkhas pa dgyes pa'i rol mo/ nye gnas rgyal mtshan pas dri ba mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig snga phyir byas pa'i lan gyi tshigs su bcad pa rigs pa'i rgyud mangs/ dri lan don gsal me long / 'phrin yig gi rnam gzhag dper brjod dang bcas pa pad+ma dkar po'i phreng mdzes/ 'phrin yig gi rnam par gzhag pa blo gros sgo brgya 'byed pa'i legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig phyogs bsgrigs kyi skor/ ga bar byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i zin bris snyan brgyud rdo yi ri mo/ gsung rab rin chen sil ma sogs zin tho'i skor/ rgyal ba kun gzigs kyi sku brnyan byin rlabs 'dod 'jo'i bsngags pa las brtsams pa'i gtam dge legs rgyud mangs bzhad pa'i rol mo/dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten gyi dkar chag byin rlabs rin chen 'dren pa'i gter mdzod skal bzang 'dod 'jo/ rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba bde chen chos 'khor gling gi gnas kyi rang bzhin mdo tsam bsngags pa dbyangs can 'dzum pa'i rol mo/ chos sde chen po bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi bsngags pa brjod pa me tog g.yo ba'i 'khri shing sogs gnas bstod kyi skor/'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi bla brgyud/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul dngos grub gser gyi 'byung khungs/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs 36

pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga pad dkar dgongs rgyan/ bde ba can du skye ba'i tshogs gsog dag zhing sgo 'byed/ lha mo shram ṇa'i sgrub bsnyen gyi yi ge kun gsal nor bu'i me long / bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil chog gsal bar bkod pa zab don gser gyi shing rta/ grub dbang dpal mo'i lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang skur ba'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ tshe rta mgon gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul dge legs 'od 'bar/ 'bum khang gi srog shing dang gnod sbyin tshogs bdag 'khor lo bum gter rnams lhan gcig tu sgrub tshul rab gnas dang bcas pa/ sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dbyangs can dgyes pa'i mchod sprin sogs gsung thor bu'i skor/ rtsis kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i snying nor gyi dkar chag legs par bshad pa chos dung g.yas 'khyil/ skyes bu dam pa rnams la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i skor/yi dam chos srung rnams la mchod gtor 'bul tshul gyi skor/ yul lha chen po rnams kyi bsang gi skor bcas bzhugs/ de ltar bka' 'bum rin po che legs bshad gser gyi phreng mdzes dag phyi rabs rjes 'jug pa rnams la mdzes rgyan dam par legs skyes su gnang ba dag lhur bzhes mdzod 37

dang mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi bag chags zab mo zhig 'jog nges pa dpyod ldan rnams kyis dgongs 'jags 'tshal lo/ /lung rigs nyag phran phas rgol snying la gzan/ /kun rmongs mgrin bcu'i gtsug tor sar bcings te/ /lnga rig si tā cig car 'dzum grol bar/ /spyod pa'i dpa' bo mi pham zla ba yis/ /nyams 'gyur tshig gi kho lag kun nas rdzogs/ /don ldan bzang po'i lam ni lhag ger gsal/ /rin chen nor gyis khug min legs bshad mang / /bskrun pas 'jig rten skal bzang nyid du byas/ /de 'dra'i sar gnas rgyal sras gzhon nu gang / /gser ljongs zhing gi mgon du nye bar bzhengs/ /khyad par 'duṅge bzang chos gling zhes bya ba/ /bdag gir bzhes pa'i dge mtshan 'di ci zhig / 'di na byang chub snying bo thob kyi bar/ /bar med gtsug gi rgyan du mtshan ldan mgon/ /mgon du bsten nas dbu sngags lam gyi don/ /don mthun spyod pa'i skal bzang mngon gyur shog /khams gsum chu skyes 'dab ma'i sbubs yangs su/ /rigs drug bung bas zlos gar sgyur de srid/ /'jig rten mig gyur legs bshad dbyig nor gang / /nyams med gong 'phel zhing 'di'i rgyan du smon/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /srid gsum dpal yon stong gis mtshon min pa/ /shar gyi gru 'dzin nor bu'i gur khyim las/ /rig 'byung zhing 'dir thugs rje nyi gzhon 38

'bum/ /mngon bzhad rong ston yab rje bla ma rgyal/ /shes nyon dri mas mi pham dpal yon 'dzin/ /gzhung lugs lang tsho rab dregs dbyangs can gdangs/ /'gro khams dga' ba'i dge mtshan stong gi phul/ /dpal ldan bla mas blo gros mchog stsol cig /gang gi mtshan snyan 'og min bar mched pas/ /srid pa'i dregs ldan lha brgya'i cod pan yang / /sa la bsnyal te ngo mtshar bstan 'gro'i dpyid/ /mdzad chen rgyal ba rnams kyang brjod la ngal/ /'di na 'dus sde bla na med pa yi/ /'phrin las bzang bos gcig tu legs smin pa/ /chos srid dpal mo'i lang tsho'i 'jig rten kun/ /yid rab 'phrog pa'i rtse dga' gling 'dir rtsen/gnyis pa ni/ gnas ngos bzung nas ji ltar phyag 'debs mdzad tshul la/ de yang rgyud las/ 'dzam bu gling ba legs skyes pa/ /las kyi sa bar rab tu grags/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar mdo sngags kyi lam mtha' dag gi snod du rung ba'i rten khyad par du 'phags pa rnams 'khod pa'i zhing gi mchog tu bsngags pa dang / sprul ba'i zhing khams chen po lnga dang / gnas nyer bzhi la sogs pa'i grub pa'i gnas bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan pa'i 'dzam bu gling 'di nyid ni/ mdzod las/ 'dzam bu gling ste ngos gsum la/ /stong phrag gnyis so shing rta'i dbyibs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shing rta'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i dbus na bskal bzang 39

5/ma 'dren stong sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ston pa'i gnas byang chub chen po yod la/ de'i byang ngos su phyin pa na ji skad du/ shing rta'i dbyibs 'dra 'dzam gling gi /bye brag brjid ldan gangs ri'i byang / /lo hi ta 'gram rin chen khungs/ /kha ba can zhes gsungs pa ltar chu klung chen po lo hi ta'i 'gram du gtogs par kha ba can gyi ljongs yod do/ /de la bod dang bod chen po gnyis las bod chen por grags pa/ mdo khams kyi ljongs la mdo stod dang mdo smad gnyis yod pa las mdo smad mgyogs 'gro'i chol kha zhes chos srid kyi dge mtshan dgung du 'phyur ba/ bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du 'jam mgon bla ma'i rang bstan rdzogs ldan bzhin du dar zhing rgyas pa'i yul gru 'di la gaṅgā'i sring mo rma klung dal 'bab kyi phyogs las lho byang gi cha gnyis su grags pa'i nang nas lho rgyud sa'i thig le/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho dbyangs can mngon par dga' ba'i sde zhes mtshan snyan ba dan dkar bo srid pa gsum na g.yo ba/ 'gro ba'i sgron me/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pur gyur pa gang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul zhing dam pa/ phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor g.yang du chags pa/ snod bcud kyi bkod pa yang kun gsal gyi mkha' la rgyu skar gyis 'phra btab pa ltar ci yang mdzes pa/ mi ni chos la dad pa dang / /lha ni dkar phyogs skyong ba dang / /sa la dge bcu tshang ba yi/ /gser gyi yul ljongs zhes su 40

grags/ /zhes bka' gdams glegs bam las ji ltar bsngags pa ltar lha dang bla ma'i lung gis zin pa/ sum rtsen lha'i snod bcud kyi bkod pa yang zhing 'di'i nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i lto bar mngon sum du 'phos pa ltar snyan pa'i rlabs phreng phyogs su 'phyo ba/ chos srid kyi lang tsho kun nas rgyas pa'i re skong gser mo ljongs zhes pa 'di'i stod g.ya' ri dang gangs ri brag ngos sogs la chags pa'i bya rgod dang ri dwags tshogs dal bar rgyu ba/ bar spang ljongs nags tshal sogs kyi dbus su bya bye'u sna tshogs kyi skad snyan sgrog pa dang gcan gzan mang bo bag yangs su rgyu ba/ smad ri thang klung gi lto bar 'bru drug gi snye ma g.yur du za ba'i zhing sa 'jam zhing mnyen pa'i 'khri shing g.yu lo bser bus dal bar bskyod pa dang chabs cig dkar dmar gyi mdangs ldan me tog sna tshogs spang ljongs yangs pa'i khor yug 'dzum pa dang rgod pa'i nyams sna tshogs dang / mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i phun sum tshogs shing dri ngad phyogs su ldang bar rkang drug bung ba'i khyu yis 'phur lding gar gyi snyan 'gyur glu yi pi wang ci yang rdung ba'i skyed tshal/ mdangs bkra'i kha dog sna tshogs dang dri ro nus palongs su rdzogs pa'i bza' shing gi ra bas yongs su bskor cing ngo mtshar ba'i snod bcud kyi bkod pa mthun snang du grub pa la tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis don gyi bsngags brjod pad+ma dkar bo'i phreng ba ci yang spel ba'i gnas chen/ sa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad lhug par bzhad pa'i ze'u 41

'brur chags pa/ gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phub pa'i 'og rol dang / phyogs thams cad du rin chen sna bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbyibs lta bu'i sa bkra legs pa/ stod smad bar gsum du sa 'dzin dang gangs ri'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba ni rtse drug dang snying bdun te rtse lha bcu gsum/ g.yu mtsho phyug mo sogs thog lha spun gsum/gnyan ri dang dpal ri/ yul gur dang khams pa thung rtse/ stag lung dang gyo mo/ gnyan dmar dang khrab chen/ gong mo dang sra lung / ri chen sogs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams ljongs 'di'i phyogs skyong dang byang skyong gi tshul du gnas pa'i sa 'dzin du ma dang / stod na ka rong ya rong bde rong gsum/ bar na tsha rong ba rong bse rong gsum/ smad na the'u rong no'u rong dgu rong ste rong dgu'i chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan gyi lha chab sngon mo dal bar 'bab pa/ bar mtshams rnams su nags tshal ljon bzang gi rtse mo dgung la snyegs pa'i tshul gyis nags rdzong brtsan pos ku/na nas bskor pa sogs thun min gyi khyad chos mang du ldan pa'i skye bo sus kyang sa der song na snang ba bsgyur zhing yid sems dbang med du 'phrog pa'i dge mtshan cir yang snang ba'i khyad chos rnams smra bsam las 'das pa zhig go /ljongs 'di'i me tog phog pa'i lha skal rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i thun min gyi gdul bya yang skye bo rang ga ba zhig gis ji ltar dpag nus te mi nus mod/ 'on kyang sngon ring mo nyid nas mi 42

chos su grags pa la khang ba skya leb can gyi khri sde/ sbra rog rog can gyi khri sde/ gur dkar can gyi khri sde/ smad rgya nag nas 'ong ba'i stong sde/byang hor nas chad pa'i stong sde/ gtsang la stod nas chad pa'i lha bzo'i sde zhes grags pa ltar dang / nang gshog bcu gnyis/ phyi gshog bco brgyad/ smon gshog nyer gcig gam/ yang na gshog chen steng 'og bcu gnyis dang gshog chung drug ste bco brgyad kyis bsdus pa'i mi sde dang lha sde dkar bo'i tshom bu phyogs su brdal ba/ stod smad bar gsum thams cad du 'khor lo gsum gyis mdzes pa'i chos kyi sde che chung dang / sde bzhi'i nor gyis phyug pa'i rong 'brog bar gsum gang la mtshon na'ang ya rabs la dad cing spyod bzang bsgrub pa la ngang gis gzhol ba/ shes rig dang lo rgyus kyi dge thon pa sogs brtan pa snod dang g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can gyi bkod pa bsam brjod las 'das pa'i gser ljongs dge ba'i 'byung gnas mkha' dbyings su thog mar dge mtshan mi zad pa'i chu bo bri gang med par 'byung ba'i gzhi rten bla na med pa bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che rta bdun dbang bo gang gi thugs bskyed khyung sngon skyes kyis ji ltar drangs pa'i tshul ni/ spyir sangs rgyas byang sems kyis thugs rjes ma gzigs pa'i yul dus gnas skabs ma mchis kyang / rang cag gdul bya thun mong snang ngor/ snang mtha'i thugs sprul rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la bod du phebs te/ gsang chen rdo rje 43

theg pa'i nye lam gyi gdams pa char du bsnyil pas gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob gangs kyi seng chen lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang du byon nas bstan 'gror sman pa'i bya ba bla lhag tu mdzad pa sogs gzhan du gsal/ 'dir yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sku nyid dngos su phebs te lha 'dre mi gsum dam la btags shing rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ci rigs bstan byin gyis brlabs te sems can bde la bkod/ chos kyi bya ba mang du mdzad do/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i drang srong grub dgu'i mes po rnam pa brgyad byon nas ljongs 'di nyid rtogs ldan bag yangs su rgyu ba'i zhing khams su gyur pa sogs rgyal bstan rin po che dar bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bla lhag tu che/ de rjes thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas/ nges don zab mo'i bdud rtsis cher myos pas/ /gnyug ma 'od gsal don dam gshis kyi ngang / /lding 'jug spros pa med par rtag mnal ba/ /bka' brgyud pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'bri gung 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi bu slob rnams kyi nang nas sras kyi thu bo bla ma rin chen bzang po dang 'gar dam pa chos sdings rnam gnyis bla ma lha yis lung bstan pa bzhin du bu slob bcas ljongs 'dir byon nas bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba'i sgo nas mi'i 'gro ba la phan pa'i bya ba rlabs gang che mdzad pa sogs bstan pa snga dar gyi rnam gzhag ni 'dir mangs kyis dogs so/ /de rjes su grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa lha rje brag sna bas 44

dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gdung rgyud dang gser chos ji ltar spel tshul sogs ni ljongs 'dir bstan pa bar dar gyi rabs sogs pa'i gzhan du gsal na yang / rang gi pha mes kyis zhing 'di ji ltar dka' spyad kyis bskrun pa sogs phyi rabs pa rnams la nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir du zur tsam zhu na/khong ni 'od gsal lha las chad pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi rigs zhes gzhan las mtho bar grags pa'i rigs yin par ma zad/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che'i 'phrin las kyi 'od dkar skyong ba gzhan las khyad du 'phags shing thugs sras dam par gyur pa na/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen smra ba zla med rgan rin po che rje dge 'dun bstan 'dzin gyi zhal snga nas/ gangs ljongs dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams nas/ / sngags 'chang grub pa brnyes pa'i dpa' bo zhig /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa chen gong ma yis/ /phyogs 'dir mngags pa'i gtam gyi phreng ba spel/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spel ba'i thugs bskyed dang sngon gyi smon lam dus bab dang bstun te 'gro mgon 'phags pas/ a myes rong chen lha rje la khyed nyid mi ring bar myur du a mdor song dang sa rdo rje'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i rked par khyod kyi rigs rgyud kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin pa'i dgos pa yod do gsungs par/ lha rje nas/ des na bdag la 'phral phugs kyi blo gtad chog pa'i bstan srung zhig gnang na bka' bzhin bgyid 'tshal lo 45

zhes zhus par/ yi dam chos skyong dbyer med pa dpal ldan rdo rje gur gyi mgon po gnang ste/ sku'i rten la sa skya'i gser mgon/ gsung gi rten la man ngag be'u bum/ thugs rten la gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu ba/ bcu drug lhag sprad kyi ḍa ma ru/ ru mtshon tsan dan dkar bo'i yu ba can/ rje nyid kyi phyag 'khar bcas gnang ste da khyod mdo smad du song la/ lha mchog gur la blo gtod/ ri bo che la rgyab gtod/ gdong ring sna nas gzhi zungs/ de ltar byas na 'phral phugs kyi don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub tshul sogs kyi bslab bya dang lung bstan mang du stsal pa ltar/ rab byung lnga ba'i stod kyi char 'khor dang bcas a mdor byon te/ re skong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi sa'i thig le rgyal thang dang / hor snyan bzang gnyis su bla ma'i lung gis bstan pa bzhin gzhi phab/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar bo'i glegs bam zhig bzhengs par brten sras mdo sde 'bum 'khrungs/de la yang bu dgu dang bu mo gcig 'khrungs pa las 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul dang bo gsum ni/ rong bo bla ma bsam gtan rin chen dang / kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ tā kau shri blo gros seng ge rnams yin/ phu bo mkhas grub chen po rong ston bsam gtan rin chen ni/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste dge slong gi sdom pa mnos shing zab rgyas chos kyi bgo skal zad mi shes pa bzhes/ sa dkyil tā be+e hu dang mchod yon du 'brel nas rgyal thang gi dbus kyi gnas gzhi dang 46

nye ba dgon khug tu rab byung drug pa'i chu rta spyi lo1342lor rong ston phyag na pad+mo rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho sku phreng snga phyi'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul zhing dam pa re skong gser mo ljongs zhes lha'i grong khyer sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i lte ba/ bya rgod phung bo'i ri bo chen po dge bsnyen se ku bya khyung gi lha zhol/ rang gi pha mes grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rong chen lha rje la lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa'i gnas/ sa rdo rje 'dra ba'i lte ba dgon khug tu rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi dpal nā len+d+ra chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gi thog ma'i gzhi 'ding bar mdzad pas/ bla ma nyi thang bas mdo smad rong ba'i chu gter du/ /thos bsam nor bus phyug pa'i gling / /sprul byed bsam gtan rin chen zhes/ /yongs 'dzin mchog gi zlos gar bsgyur/ /ces gang gsungs pa ltar ro/ /khong gis thog mar sa 'dzin lha khang du dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan bzhengs te/ rab byung dge 'dun gyi sde gsar du btsugs pa sogs la brten nas phyogs 'dir rgyal bstan bla lhag tu rgyas pa'i cha rkyen ches cher bskrun pas/ hrīḥ dkar thugs rje lang tsho khu ba'i khams/ /skal ldan mig gi bdud rtsir lhang nge ba/ /gur kum gar gyi mdzes khyod ma la yar/ /lag 'gro'i dbang bo ji bzhin gzhan las lhag /mgon de'i byams brtse 'khri shing gzhon nu yis/ /ljongs 'di'i skye dgu'i nags kyi mdzes ma la/ /lhag par mi phyed 47

mdza' ba yongs bzung bas/ /'jig rten yongs kyi yon gnas 'di bskrun to/ /zhes bsngags pa ltar ro/ /de nas rim bzhin sku mched gnyis pa kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / mkhas shing grub pa'i 'a/khor sgyur tā kau shri blo gros seng ge sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu dag ljongs 'dir byon te chos srid gnyis char gyis bskyangs pa'i bka' drin ni dpag par dka' ba'i gnas yin pas brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir rnying ma pa'i grub mtha' dang /'bri gung / bka' brgyud pa/ bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha' sogs chos lugs kyi srol ga mi 'dra ba du ma zhig dar rgyas che na'ang gzhan du gsal bas 'dir yi ger 'jigs so/ /khyad par du/ thugs rje chen po kun tu sbas pa'i bu/ /'jig rten khams rnams rgya mtsho 'di yis gang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo smad gser ldan mar mkhas btsun bzang ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug sa'i dreg pa lta bur byon pa'i nang na/ mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya mtha' dag la sbyangs pa phul phyin bgyis pas grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo/ gsang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i 'bras bu g.yur du za zhing / mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyi legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs phyogs su sgrog pa'i thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag dben pa'i gnas gangs khrod ri sul kun tu sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng ba la 48

mtshungs zla ma mchis pa'i drang srong dbang bo/ lhag par du mdo smad bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spyi dang sgos su blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mdo sngags bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi bstan pa rin po che dus mthar spel ba la gong na med pa'i shing rta ba chen po/ phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba rnam 'dren bla ma yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho dbyangs can mngon par dga' ba'i sde dpal bzang po nyid ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rje chos sku tha snyad bral na yang / /las skal ldan mang po'i bsod nams las/ /rje rgyal ba mang bo der lhags te/ /gnas byin gyis rlob pa kho bos 'tshal/ /gsungs pa ltar dang / bod byang gi phyogs nas byang phyogs su/ /mi khyod kyi sprul ba dam pa zhig /'bangs mgon med mang po 'dul du 'gro/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rong chen lha rje'i rigs la bsam bzhin dpal bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rnam pa'i gar dang bcas te/ lo ke shwa ra kā ya wa kā tsi t+ta trīḥ zhes rdo rje glu dbyangs gsung bzhin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te yum sgyu ma lha mdzes ma gnyis pa gang gi lhums su zhugs/ rab byung bcu ba'i me lug lor nam mkha' nas e ma ho/ a la la ho/ zhes sogs kyi sgra mthun snang du sgrog bzhin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang bo dang bcas sku bltams pa sogs gzhan du gsal/de nas khu bo grub chen chos pa rin po ches lugs gnyis kyis spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin bskyangs shing dgung lo bcu gcig pa'i tshe dbus gtsang 49

chos kyi zhing khams su phebs te mdo sngags kyi gzhung mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mthar phyin tshul dang / dgung lo nyer bzhi'i steng gser ljongs zhing gi bla na med pa'i mchod gnas rang gi gdan sa chen po rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling du grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal pa'i gling gsar 'dzugs gnang ste lugs gnyis kyis sgo kun nas 'khor lo gsum gyis bskyangs tshul/ de rjes dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang rtogs ldan gangs seng srab med du 'phyo ba'i rdo rje'i zhing khams chen po gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyil gtsor byas nas rig 'byung zhing du sgrub pa'i sde chen po ji snyed cig bskrun tshul sogs dang / lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dbyig nor gyi bang mdzod zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe gcig lus gcig la mngon du mdzad nas lhun grub dang rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las mkha' khyab tu 'gog pa med par spros pas don gnyis phun tshogs 'bad med du grub par brten mdo smad yongs rdzogs mdzad bzang ba dan dkar bo yug gcig gis mtha' dbus kun la khyab pa sogs kyi phyag rjes bla na ma mchis pa dang dpag tu med pa rnams 'dir brjod mtha' bral bas rtogs brjod gsang gsum snang ba'i sgron me sogs na gsal zhing der gzigs par mdzod cig ces zhu'o/ /gzhan yang der brten rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho mchog nas sku phreng brgyad pa mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu bstan 'dzin 'jigs med skal 50

ldan mchog gi bar gyis rong bo'i gdan sa chen po gsum dang / sgrub sde bco brgyad/ dgon ma lag so lnga sogs bstan 'gro'i dpal du legs par bskrun te bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi legs mdzad dam pas nye bar bskyangs pas gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob 'gro ba'i 'dren par gyur pa'i bla sprul/ chos kyi gdan khris mtho ba'i mkhan chen/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bya btang / grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i rtogs ldan/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis mdzes pa'i mkhas pa/ lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i bshes gnyen/ rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa'i paṇa chen sogs dang / gzhan yang bsod nams kyis mngon par mtho ba'i sa skyong che chung / bstan la sri zhu bgyid pa'i dad gtong nor gyis brgyan pa'i sbyin bdag sogs dngos slob dang yang slob bgrang gis mi lang ba phyogs 'dir ma lus par khyab ste sde bzhi'i lang tsho'i dpal yon dbyar gyi dpal mo dang 'grogs pas chos srid kyi cha gang nas kyang srid na zla dang bral ba'i re skong gser mo ljongs gang gi bde ba'i 'byung gnas/ shrī nā len+d+ra rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gang gi byang ngos su dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis kyi mtshams su gtogs pa/ skye dgu'i 'dren pa rka sar lha ris pa byang chub rab gsal gtsos mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa zam ma chad par byon pa/ dad gtong nor bu'i rba rlabs dgung du 'phyur ba'i khre tse bzhi'i ya gyal rka sar zhes bya ba'i grong sde 'di nyid chags yod do/ /51

de yang sde 'di'i rang bzhin cung zad brjod na/ yul de'i snod bcud kyi bkod pa yang / sa gzhi yangs shing khod snyoms pa spang ljongs dang dri bsung 'thul ba'i me tog dang yal 'dab dud pa'i nags tshal kun tu dkrigs pa/ 'bru drug gi snye ma g.yur du za zhing / yab rje bla ma'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam/ dad ldan rnams kyi bsod nams las kyi bdag 'bras su/ rig 'byung zhing ma gtogs yul gru gzhan dang gzhan la ha cang brin pa kha dog dri ro nus pa khyad du 'phags pa'i bcud ldan 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i bza' shing gi rigs sna tshogs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba dang / chu skyes sna tshogs khra lam mer bzhad pa'i nyams dga' ba'i skyed tshal gyis mdzes pa dang / rgyab tu lha chen bya khyung gi rdza rgyud rta 'gying zhes pa rgyab ri'i tshul du brjid pa dang / mdun du yan lag brgyad ldan gyi lha chab dgu chu sngon mo dal gyis rgyu ba/ sngo ljang lo 'dab kyis spras pa'i rkang 'thung tshar du dngar ba'i sa'i char yul mi rnams kyi rang bzhin bzang zhing dge la 'dun pa/ chos srid kyi dpal dang 'byor ba'i chu bo g.yas su 'khyil zhing rigs rus gtsang ma'i dge mtshan kun nas 'phro ba dang / skye dgu yongs kyi zhe rgyud 'jam zhing rgan la bkur ba dang dman la brtse sems ldan pa/ skye gzugs legs pa/ blo rig gsal ba/ rtser son pa'i lha bzo dang 'bag bzo/ dpar rko/dngul mgar/ rdo yig bzo ba/ shing bzo sogs bzo rig la gzhan du 'gram chu ldang mi dgos par 52

rang chas su mnga' ba zhig yin no/ /des na sde 'di'i rigs rus ngos gtsang ji ltar mched ce na/ sde 'di'i rigs rus kyang mes po sgo dmar tshang las mched pa yin pas/ de yi rigs rus ni bod rigs ngos gtsang yin pa sogs kho bos bris pa dkar chag gdung sel sman gyi myu gur mdo tsam bkod yod pas der blta bar bya'o/ /'o na ming la ci'i phyir rka sar zhe na/ stong dpon chen po sgo dmar shing klu bla ma rab brtan bya ba la bu gsum las gcig ni rab tu byung bar mdzad/ tha chung ni gzhi 'dzin dang /che ba la mi khyim bco brgyad dang bcas sprad de khyod kyis sa der song la gzhi bzung bar gyis zhes bka' bsgos pa ltar/ sa 'dir rim par gzhi chags te so nam sogs kyi las mtha' rgyas byed kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo mngon par 'du byas te mya ngam gyi thang der/ sgo dmar gyi sa thog nas chu rka gsar du brkos nas chu drangs pa las rim bzhin 'bru drug smin pa'i zhing sa dang skyed tshal/ bza' shing gi ra ba/ btsugs sdong sogs mtshar du bskrun pa la brten nas dpal dang 'byor ba ches cher bdo bas sde 'di'i ming la rka sar zhes thogs pa yin no zhes yab mes kyi ngag rgyun rnam dag sde 'di'i skye dgu'i kha na 'brug ltar grags so/ /gzhan yang chu'i yur ba la rkyen ngan byung ba na sa de ga nas chu rka gsar du brkos te chu 'dren chog pa'i lugs srol yod par ma zad de ltar gtan phab byung ba'i yi ge'i ris su 'khod pa yang nga brgyad gnam sa mgo mjug ldog pa'i 53

skabs med par bzos pas da lta mi snang ngo / /der brten sgo dmar dang rka sar gyi sde phan tshun gang la mtshon na'ang gna' snga mo nas chos 'brel dang las 'brel ha cang dam zab che ba'i chos sde 'di'i grwa btsun rnams kyang sgo dmar dgon pa'i tshogs gral du zhugs dgos pa sogs yab mes ring la srol bzang de btsugs te yun ring zhig la ma nyams par yod na'ang phyis su rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling 'di btab pa nas bzung grwa btsun rnams rang dgon du 'tshogs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang mdo smad gser mo ljongs pa rnams kyi yul srol lam mi'i goms spyod thun min khyad chos dag ni/ mi rigs gzhan pa ltar srid don kho na dang g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyis tshe 'di'i lto rgyab la don gnyer shi sbar byed pa zhig gtan nas ma yin zhing / mchog gsum gyi zhing la bkur sti bla na med pa dang ya rabs kyi spyod pa la ngang ngam shugs kyis 'jug pa yangs pa'i sgo nas las 'bras dpang bzhag gis 'du byed kyi las la brtson te 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la rim bgrod dang / phan tshun gcig mthun gyi mdza' brtses rtsed 'jo la dga' bas mtshon/ yul gru 'di'i kha dpe ltar rgya lo'i tshes gcig ma gtogs zas mi za/ drug pa'i glu rol ma gtogs gos mi gon zhes zer sgros ltar/ lo 'khor gcig gi ring skye bo pho mo byings kyis gzab spros dang bcas ha cang rtsed 'jo la mngon par rol pa'i dus ston chen mo ni drug pa'i glu rol yin zhing / de ni 54

dmangs khrod du dar khyab che bas rgan gzhon pho mo tshang mas dga' ba'i bro dang skyid pa'i glu len gar rtse byed pa'i dga' ston khyad par can zhig go /spyir na drug pa'i glu rol zhes pa de la dbye sgo gsum ste lha rtse dang glu rtse dmag rtse rnams yin zhing sgo dmar dang rka sar gyi sde gnyis gang la mtshon na'ang rol rtsed phyi mar gtogs so/ /'di'i phyogs la 'gro gron gyi nyer bsdogs rgyan gos dang bza' btung gi rigs ha cang rgya chen bsgrigs pas dar khyab che bar mngon/ sde gnyis ka'i stag shar na gzhon tshos dga' ba'i mdangs dang mdzum pa'i nyams bcas rtsed 'jo'i dga' ston la rol ba'i tshe/ rka sar ni sgo dmar gyi bu che ba yin pa dang / de'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha'am skyes lha yang sgo dmar gyi yul lha'i phu bo yin pa'i cha nas thog mar sgo dmar dud khyim stong rur grags pa'i pho gsar stag shar tshos rgyan gos gzab spros rgya chen po dang bcas rka sar gyi skyes lha'i gnas khang chen mor mchod me dang snyan dar/ dkar gtor/dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi bsangs mchod kyis yul lha dgyes par byas te 'phyor sgeg ldan pa'i skye bo pho mo kun tshogs nas dmag rtse dang glu len gar rtse'i dga' ston tshad med pa la rol te/ phyi nyin lha phu bo sogs sgo dmar du bsus nas snga ma ltar rtsed 'jo'i dus ston la rol ba dang /yang de'i phyi nyin phar bskyal te rka sar gyi lha phu bo'i mdun nas dmag rtse la rol nas mi dga' dang lha dga'i ngang grol ba'i srol rgyun bzang bo de 55

gna' nas da lta'i bar ma nub par brten/ phan tshun mdza' sems dang mthun sgril je drag tu song gshis snga mo nas bag ma gtong len sogs kyi sgos gnyen rtsa 'jing ha cang je zab dang je rgyas su song ba dang / chos srid kyi cha gang nas kyang sngon gyi pha lugs kho nar brten pa mngon gsal du grub pa dang / der ma zad sgo dmar a pha tshang dang rka sar bu tshang zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang bsnyon med du sde 'di'i skya ser kun la mthun snang du grags pa des kyang 'khums so/ /des na sde 'dir 'bangs chos bzhin skyong ba'i sa skyong ngam dpon rabs 'bangs 'khor rnams ji ltar yod ce na/dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i dpon rabs ni da lta'i bar bdun du rtogs par bya ste/ dpon rabs dang po bsod nams dar rgyas dang / gnyis pa blo bzang rab brtan/ gsum pa klu 'bum/ bzhi pa dar rgyas/ lnga pa rta mgrin/ drug pa rgya rgya/ bdun pa da lta'i dpon po lha rtse rgyal rnams so/ /de'i mnga' 'bangs su gtogs pa tsho chen gnyis dang / tsho chung lnga yod pa'i 'bangs mi rnams kyi blo rig gsal zhing ngang rgyud bzang ba/'jig rten gyi rabs la mkhas pa'i skye bo mang ba dang / rgan la tshe ring zhing ya rabs kyi lugs bzang spel ba dang / mkhas mdzangs can gyi na gzhon stag shar rnams rgan la bkur zhing lugs gnyis zung 'brel gyis pha mes kyi spyod bzang kho na la ngang gis gzhol ba sogs khyad chos du ma ldan pa'i grong brdal zhig rang yin no/ /sde 'di'i dpon rabs snga phyi 56

gang la mtshon na'ang 'jig rten mi chos dang lha chos kyi dge thon zhing thabs mkhas kyi spyod pa lhur len pa dag dang / khyad par du 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam par rol ba/ bslab gsum rin chen gsum gyis thugs kyi bang mdzod yongs su gtams pa/ 'phrin las zla ba gsar ba'i 'od ris 'gog med mkha' khyab tu bzhad pa'i gtam snyan me tog star la rgyus pa'i phreng ba dag mkhas dgu'i rna ba'i rgyan du 'phyang ba/ rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba dpal bzang po nyid gdan drangs te/ gdan sa 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad nas rgya bskyed du 'jug pa po/ bsod nams kyi dpal kyis mngon par mtho ba'i dpon po blo bzang rab brtan zhes ming don mtshungs pa gang gi thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa la brten nas g.yon ru'i nyin lung dpon po dang 'brel mna' bcad bsgrigs te mdzangs mi'i bya ba rnams yar ldan du 'phel/ rjes mar g.yon ru nyin lung dpon po'i bzhed pa ltar rgyal ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo yum dum pa bcu gnyis gser bris shig bzhengs te gdan drangs pas/ nyin lung dpon pos sngon bsu dang bcas rka sar dpon po 'khor dang bcas par dga' ston rgya cher mdzad de blu yon du nor dgos sam ci dgos zhes pa la/ nga la rgyu nor dgos te yum gdan zhu byas pa min tshul bsnyad nas phan tshun sngar las blo 57

sems gcugs par gyur/ rka sar dpon pos sems yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i ngang rang gi 'bangs mi'i gnas tshul dang 'brel phyugs zog 'tsho sa dang / bud shing len sa'i rgyu mtshan rnams gleng slong mdzad par brten/ nyin lung dpon pos des na khyod la rdo thog lab tse man chad dang / ge sar rta phur man chad/ 'gab pha bong nag ris yan chad dang /ra mang nyag kha yan chad khyed kyis longs spyad chog ces rka sar dpon por sprad pa dang / der ma zad de ltar chog par yi ge'i ris su phab pa'i mjug tu rgyas btab pa can nga brgyad bar du yod kyang thams cad med par bzo ba'i skabs lags pas yi ge yang shul med du song / de nas da lta'i bar lo ltar sa de ga nas bud shing len pa dang / phyugs zog 'tsho ba bcas kyi sgo nas sde phan tshun gyi 'brel ba je zab dang / mthun sgril je brtan du song ba dang / khyad par du bslab gsum rin chen mdzod la dbang ba'i lhag bsam can/ spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas khu dbon gyi bka' drin la brten nas rjes sor g.yon ru dang mchod yon du 'brel bar brten/ chos 'brel las 'brel ha cang dam zab tu gyur nas sngon nas da lta'i bar chos sde 'di la g.yon rus rgyu nor zas gsum gyis 'brel thogs ci thub dang dad gus lhod med kyi ngang nas bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa mdzad/ der brten g.yon ru'i shi gson gang gi ched du'ang cis kyang rka sar dgon pa'i grwa btsun rnams gdan 'dren zhu ba'i phyag srol 58

bzang po tshugs te spyi tshogs gsar bar sngar las chos srid kyi 'brel ba bla na med par gyur/ der ma zad bstan pa'i sbyin bdag g.yon ru ni sngon chos srid kyi lang tsho dar la bab pa'i 'brog sde chen po zhig yin yang 'jig rten dar rgud kyi dbang gis skabs shig la sde phan tshun bar rtsod gleng byung ba'i rkyen gyis dud khyim phal cher mtsho sngon por gnas spar te/gzhi chags pas da lta mtsho sngon g.yon ru gong zhol dang rmog ru zhes sde tsho mang du gyes te 'phel bas/ btsan phyug dpal gsum 'dzoms shing ya rabs kyi lugs srol bzang por gus 'dud lhur len byed pa'i 'brog sde chen por gyur/ de dag gis kyang chos sde 'dir dad dam gtsang ma'i ngos gang 'byor gyi mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog cha tshang spyan drangs pa sogs kyi sgo nas bkur sti bla na med pa dang bcas chos sde 'di la mi skya pho mo byings kyis 'di phyi'i skyid sdug legs nyes bcol te gtan gyi skyabs gcig pur bkur/ ya rabs kyi dpal kun nas 'bar ba'i gzhi byes kyi g.yon ru dad ldan mang tshogs rnams nas kyang shi bo'i chos rgyun dang / gson po'i dge rgyun rnams chad pa mthud de nyams pa gso ba'i sgo nas chos sde 'di la blo phugs gtad nas sri zhu bla na med pa dang bcas rgyal ba'i gsung rab sde dge bstan 'gyur chen mo yod dgus blu yon sbyar te phul ba sogs mtshungs med kyi chos 'brel snga na med par gyur to/ /gzhan yang rka sar grong brdal 'di dang nye logs su yod 59

pa ri stag ces pa yang snga ma zhig la ri stag tā be hus khyim gzhi bzung nas longs spyod mnga' thang ha cang rgyas pa dang / mi khyim brgya phrag la nye bar 'phel mod/ 'on kyang 'jig rten mtha' dag mi rtag pa 'jig pa'i chos can las ma 'das stabs/ phyis su las kyis nongs te rang zhig tu song nas shul ma stong tsam du zad kyang da gzod slar yang dud khyim bcu phrag zung la nye ba'i tshod du gda'/ 'di'i rigs rus kyang bod ngos gtsang zhig yin te/ sngon rong chen mdo sde 'bum la nang phyogs kyi mnga' 'bangs phyogs khag bcu gnyis yod pa'i ya gyal 'jam rag rgya gsum du grags pa ni/ 'di ltar lung bo mdo nas 'jam sogs chags/ dgu chu'i 'gram na ri stag chags/ lho ri'i ri na rgya brag chags zhes lo rgyus rnams su gsal ba ltar lags la/ gzhan yang deng dus kyi mkhas blun mang bos dpyad khul byas te gzhan du bshad pa mang mod/ de yang yin rgyu ni sngon chen po jing gur hor gyi rgyud 'dzin pa zhig gis hor sgang zhes pa'i nor 'dzin yangs par gzhi btings te mkhar chen bskor/ stobs dang 'byor ba ha cang rgyas nas mkhar sgo yang zangs dmar gyis bzos pa/ mi khyim yang stong phrag lhag bdo bar grags/ de nas sa srung bod dmag rnams kyi stobs dang dpung rtsal rgyas te rang rang gi sa tshigs srung mtshams gang 'os su gzhi bzung ste rang sa rang bdag gis kho bo rnams thu med la rgol pa'i tshe/ ring zhig nas rgyud 'dzin stong dpon chen po 'das zin kyang /60

'khor 'bangs rnams ci bya btol med du gyur pa dang / jing mkhar yang zhig 'thor du 'gro ba'i tshe/ rong chen mdo sde 'bum gyi tsha bo pha rong bo blon che nas brgyud pa ri stag tā be hus bza' zla hor stong dpon de'i sras mo dang 'brel te dgu chu'i 'gram gyi hor sgang dang nye ba'i ri stag ces bya ba'i ri zhol du gzhi khyim brtsigs pa na/ der byed rtsol la ma brten par shing kyal ta'am kya rta'i 'khri shing gzhon nu zhig gsar du smin pa lo rgyus can de yang da lta rtse tsam yang ma nyams par sa brtol bzhin du 'phel bar grags/ ming la ri stag ces pa yang sde 'di'i rgyab ri rgya stag dpa' bo zhig 'gying stabs kyis nyal 'dra'i mtshon pas de skad du ming chags par mngon/ de nas phyogs der mnga' dbang bsgyur te tā be+e hu'i cho lo thob pa sogs ngag sgros khungs thub dag dang lo rgyus sogs na gsal bas 'dir mi spro'o/ /gzhan yang rab 'byams rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos chos pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sras kyi thu bo ri stag dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ tā be hu'i khyim du sku 'khrungs pa dang lhan du seng ldeng gi rkang 'thung gsar ba zhig kyang skyes pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus mang bar grags/ lo brgya phrag du ma 'das pa'i ljon shing zung ni da lta'ang ma nyams par sa brtol bzhin du gzhi shul der mched par snang / rting mar a lags rgya nag pa sogs chos srid kyi dpal gyis mngon par mdzes pa'i skye rgyud 'phel bar mngon/61
