gang ltar na ri stag dge ba'i bshes gnyen khong tshang ni/ chung ngu'i dus nas sngon gyi bag chags sad stobs kyis bag yod la dga' bas rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen du zhugs/ mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas rim gyis phral sbyar gyi klog dang 'don chos spyod bsdus grwa sogs la sbyangs pas blo stobs gsal bas blo skyed gzhan las khyad du thon/de nas yab rje chos pa rin po che gtan gyi skyabs su bsten gzhung pod lnga la gsan sbyong legs par gnang ste mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thob/ nang thugs sras gcig pur gyur pas rong bo'i 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs lha khang rten brten pa bzhengs pa'i tshe bla slob zung 'brel gyis nang rten gzungs gzhug dril sgrub dang gzungs 'bul sogs kyi 'gan bzhes te/ bla ma'i thugs bzhed ltar rten bzhengs kyi phyokas la legs cha snga na med par gyur/ phyis su bla ma'i lung gis bstan pa ltar ri stag gi rgyud khang du rten gtso jo sku mi 'greng tsam las brgal ba zhig bzhengs te nang rten la rong bo 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi rten sna cha tshang ba rten skal du thob pa rnams phul pas 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs dang byin rlabs mtshungs zhes sngon nas da lta'i bar sde 'di'i rgyus yod dad ldan yongs la bsnyon med du grags pa zhig go /gzhan yang rgyud khang der sku'i rten gyi rigs mang tsam dang / gsung gi rten rgyu rin chen gser las grub pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang /62

mtshal par ting 'phags bskal gsum sogs bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod rten brgyad dang / ri stag dge ba'i bshes gnyen mya ngan las 'das nas sku gdung bzhu skabs nyi zla rang byon bab pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas bzang mang du byung ba/ khong gi sku gdung nyi zla rang byon du grags pa yang bzhugs/ gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi 'khor lo dung phyur can sogs ma ṇi 'khor lo che chung du ma bzhugs na yang phyis mi rabs rjes ma'i skabs su 'jig rten gyi chos nyid kyis mtho ba thams cad dma' ba dang / dar ba mtha' dag rgud pa'i dbang gis grong brdal de nyid zhig 'thor du song bas/ byin ldan khyad mtshar jo sku sogs sku gsung thugs rten phon che ba rnams chos sde 'dir gdan zhu mdzad par brten/ bstan 'gro'i gshed gyur nga brgyad bar du bzhugs yod pa rnams gleng jin su zhig gi snying rlung mi ldang / gang ltar yang yab mes kyi rig pa'i 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa'i gna' rdzas 'gangs che ba rin chen gser las kyang shin tu dkon pa phal cher rkyen dbang gis bsdubs pas da lta mthong thos dran reg gi gnas su yang ma son to/ /gzhan yang sde 'di nyid la mtshon na nga brgyad yar sngon la dud khyim gsum tsam las ma mchis kyang sngon gyi srid khrims kyi zhing khral sogs dang/ chos phyogs kyi dkar thigs dang smon lam gshog pa sogs gang la mtshon na hor snyan bzang gi sder gtogs pas/ rka sar dpon po'i mnga' khongs su min par bshad/63

rjes su spyi tshogs kyi mgo rting slog pa'i nga brgyad skabs rka sar sde ba'i khongs su sbyar/ de nas bzung chos phyogs 'jig rten gang la mtshon pas rka sar gyi sder gtogs te 'bud na sgang gcig dang / lhung na khug gcig zer ba ltar mthun sgril ha cang bla lhag tu gyur/ gna' snga mo nas kyang grong tsho gcig lta bu'i mthun sgril chen po'i ngang drug pa'i klu rol la yang yul lha'i shing shing yul lha spun che chung gis ri stag khu bo shing shing yul lha'i mdun nas rka sar nu bo shing shing lhas bkur nyir mtshon pas/rgyan gos kyis spras pa'i rka sar stag shar lhan 'dzoms kyis bskor ba gsum brgyab ste dmag rtse dang glu len gar rtse la rol ba sogs bod kyi khyad chos gang sa nas snga na med pa ltar yar ldan du mchis/ chos sde 'di nyid ni sde phan tshun gyis gtsug gi rgyan du bkur te rang gi mchod gzhis su gyur/ gzhan yang rka sar ri stag gi nye 'dabs sa'i char/ spyi lo1966lor chags pa'i byang yang hos sde nas ri stag la ngan rkyen slong skabs/ rka sar sde ba'i na gzhon rnams khros te hos hos khyed cag srid jus dang 'brel nga'i sa char bab nas 'tsho ba rol bas ma tshims par tshur rgol byed kyi yin nam zhes gzhil bar rtsom pa na/ kha rgan bsam shes rnams kyis bar bshol te kho bo cag gis kyang phyin chad de 'dra byed mi chog par byas/ rka sar gyis rong bo cho 'phrul smon lam spyi lo1986lor bskol ba'i tshe yang bying yang hos sde'i mgo 'dzin hos rgan ha dri grong gis 64

bsdus te smon lam gyi nang du dkar thigs sgor sum brgya brgyad cu lhag rka sar sde dpon rdo rje la sprad de sde 'di'i 'gros dang bstun pa las 'os med du gyur/ gzhan yang hor nag khyung bo man da zer ba'i ring la chos sde 'dir khyung bo sde bas skyabs bcol te mi la na tsha bde sdug dang / 'di phyi'i skyabs 'jug zhu bar ma zad mi zhig tshe las 'das pa'i tshe thog mar chos sde 'dir bsngo smon zhus te dge 'dun gyi sde dum zhig gang 'byor gyis gdan zhu byas nas lho sgo'i cho ga'i sgo nas gshin chos bsgrub pa las chos sde gzhan zhig zhus mi rung ba dang / bdun tshan gnyis dang gsum la'ang gshin chos sgrub tshe chos sde gzhan gyi grwa ba bdun tshan gcig las zhus mi chog pa'i bkas bcad phyag len da lta'i bar gnas bzhin mchis/ 'on kyang rka sar sog rgya zhes pa yang sngon zhig la sde 'di'i sa g.yar bo byas nas gnas te gzhi chags par bshad kyang smad pa sde bdun gyis tho gya'i sog rgya shul med du btang ba'i mjug tsam la kho tsho yang skyabs med mgon med yin pas sdod ma tshugs par rang zhig la 'thor ba yin no/ /da lta'ang hos rigs khro yang zhes pa dud khyim bcu phrag ma longs tsam zhig spyi lo1976lor sde 'di'i 'gab tu chags so/ /des na phun tshogs sde bzhi'i lang tsho mchog tu dar ba'i khre tse bzhi'i ya gyal rka sar grong brdal 'di'i gong zhus kyi lo rgyus rnams ni pha mes yang mesabyā kyi ngag rgyun rnam dag gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dag las bshus pa ma gtogs/65

'di'i lo rgyus yi ger phab pa ma mthong bas gcig tu kha tshon chod pa dka' mo zhig yin kyang / bskal pa stong gi mi med kyang bskal pa stong gi tshig yod ces mi chos kyi kha dpe ltar pha mesbu kyi lugs srol bzang po dang lo rgyus/ gna' snga mo zhig nas dar ba'i bod mi'i goms srol rnams yi ge'i ris su phab pa'i lo rgyus/ chos 'byung / deb ther sogs nas bshad pa dang / 'gro ba mi'i ngag nas ngag tu brgyud pa'i gtam khungs ma dag la yid brton te/ rang rigs kyi skad dang yi ge yul srol goms 'dris rnams bod mis che chung su zhig yin rung / rang la rtsal ci yod kyis 'dzin spel gyi phyogs la skem gang sngon spos gyis spyi tshogs steng sngon thon gyi mi rigs bzang po'i gral du tshud de/ bsam spyod bzang po ya ma bral bar de gnyis zung 'brel gyi sgo nas rang gzhan kun la 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam nas bde rtsa kho na bskrun pa la lus srog longs spyod gang la yang bltas pa med par ci nus kyis rlabs chen gyi spyod par 'bad dgos pa las gzhan du min par snyam/ de min gzhan dag gi 'grig 'grig gsar bshad rtog bzo dag la tshad mar bzung nas chu sna gar 'khrid kyi dpe ltar gar 'gro 'dir 'gro med par gang sa gang la 'jug na mdun ma nyes par gdon mi za'o/ /de phyir bag med le lo'i dbang du ma btang bar lo rgyus kyi phyogs la blos 'jug pa yangs pa'i sgo nas rang gi yab mes kyi rigs rgyud dang srol rgyun/ skad yig sogs la gang ci'i thad nas nges nges byas 66

te lam la 'jug par rigs so/ /gzhan yang sngon gyi lo paṇa rnams dang /lhag par du deng dus kyi lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhas dbang dag gis rgya bod sogs kyi lo rgyus dang chos 'byung gang mdzad mtha' dag gcig tu ma nges par rang phyogs kyi zhen pas bslad pa'ang mang dag mchis pa dang / der ma zad rang rang gi sa khul gyi lo rgyus khag gi gnas tshul yang rtswa bal ba dza ltar 'dzings pa dag la gzhigs na ha cang yid rton pa dka' bar snang bas 'di'i phyogs la mkhyen dpyod mi dman pa rnams kyis blo gros zhib mos sgo nas 'dor len byed pa gal che'am snyam mo/ /gzhan yang bod kyi yul khams stod smad bar gsum kun la gna' ches ring ba nas lha mchod dang bsangs mchod ni dmangs khrod du dar khyab ha cang che bas/ de la dkar bsangs dang dmar bsangs gnyis las/ dmar bsangs zhes pa ni/ ra lug sogs gson por mer bsregs te mchod pa'am/ yang na de'i sha tshil sogs mchod pa'i lta ngan zhig red/ de ni ji ltar dar zhe na/bod pa ba rnams kyis chos srid kyi cha gang la mtshon na'ang dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung khungs rgya gar yin tsa na/ phal cher legs nyes kyi tshul la ma brtags par rgya gar phyi rol mu stegs pa'i lta ba ngan pa de lhur blangs pa zhig yin pas/ de dag gis dmar mchod ni ha cang gal che ba'i mchod par brtsi ba zhig yin par gsungs/ chos rgyal mes dbon sogs kyis kyang bod du dar ba'i lta ba ngan pa de'i rgyun gcod pa la nan cher mdzad 67

kyang / yul gru kha shas su rgyun 'byams su lus pa'i dbang gis mdo smad kyi phyogs su'ang lta ba ngan pa der re ltos 'cha' ba'i grong sde 'ga' re yod do/ /'on kyang da gzod phal cher gyis de'i rgyun spel mi rung bar rtogs te srol ngan de nyid rang 'gags su gyur to/ /lta ngan de dag sngar nas kyang bod kyi skyes chen rnams kyis rang srog la yang ma 'dzem par 'gog ci thub la 'bad pa yin te/ rab byung dang po'i smad tsam la bde ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la dag ther ram slad skyon bsal ba'i phyir du bdag nyid chen po rngog blo ldan shes rab mchog gis dka' ba dang du blangs nas 'phags yul du byon te/ sde snod gsum la sbyangs pa phul phyin bgyis mthar bod du bstan pa la phan rlabs che ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig spyan 'dren par dgongs pa na/ de dus su grags che ba mu stegs rgyal bo skal ldan zhes pa sngon mu stegs par gyur kyang / rjes nas nang ba'i bstan pa la dad nas zhugs pas nang ba'i paṇa chen zhig tu gyur te skad grags ha cang che bas chos 'brel zhus/ bod du phebs dgos tshul zhus pas khong gis kyang zhal lan mdzad/ slad mar bdag nyid chen pos mu stegs rgyal bo skal ldan gyis phyi rol ba'i shan zhugs pa'i dbang gis rgyun par dmar bsangs mchod par mthong ba na/ thugs dgongs la paṇ+ḍi ta bod du gdan drangs kyang bod pa rnams kyis dmar bsangs mthong na de'i rjes su 'brang nges pas/ bod du phyi rol ba'i shan zhugs nas lta ngan dar ba 68

las paṇ+ḍi ta bod du gdan ma drangs na dga' snyam du bstan 'gro'i don kho na thugs la btags te phyir bod du phebs pa na/ paṇ+ḍi ta kho khros4 nas rngog blo ldanashes rab gyir+sā nga bslus par gyur to zhes dmod bor te mthu btang ba la brten nas/ bdag nyid chen po'i sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ba'i lo rgyus rnams dam pa gong ma'i gsung las thos/ gzhan yang phyis su yul khams 'ga' rer de 'dra'i shan shugs ngan pa thebs pa yod srid kyang shugs mi che'o/ /'o na 'dir de 'dra'i lta ngan la zhen te spel ba yod dam zhe na/ sngon las 'bras la rmongs pas dmar bsangs phul ba mchis kyang da lta bla ma'i bka' dang du blangs te lta ngan kyi rgyun ma lus par bcad do/ /de ltar na mchod yul la 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis las/ phyi ma ni gzhan du gsal bas 'dir mangs kyis dogs so/ /dang po mchod yul 'jig rten pa ni/ de yang ring mas bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu dang smon lam gyi stobs kyis/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i gdul zhing gangs can bod kyi rgyal khams skyong phyir yul gru mtha' dbus kun la gnas shing rgyu ba'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag gnas bdag gter bdag rnams dang / khyad par du ched gnyer tshe ring mched lnga brtan ma bcu gnyis srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu rje yi mgur lha sogs bod khams srung zhing skyong ba'i lha srung gnyan po 'khor bcas rnams mchod yul spyi dang / bye brag tu rang rang gi sa khul du 69

dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha mthu po che sogs mang du mchis kyang / rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i thun min gyi gdul zhing reb gong gser mo ljongs 'dir mtshon na/ mdo smad kyi yul khams skyong ba'i gzhi bdag dge bsnyen chen po a myes rma chen dang / se ku bya khyung sogs dkar phyogs pa rnams la reb gong stod smad bar gsum kun gyis mchod pa dang /gzhan yang sger chos kyis sa gnas so sor rang gi skyes lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi lha khang re brtsigs te/ yul lha'i snang brnyan sogs bzhengs/mchod pa'i yo byad gya nom pa tshar du bsgrigs nas lha mchod dang bsangs mchod bar ma chad par byed pa la rtsi mthong ha cang che bar snang / sde 'dir yang gzhi bdag ri lang bcu gnyis su grags pa'i ya gyal yul lha gnyan po ban than btso shi ri lang zhes pa skyes lha'i tshul du brten cing mchod de/ de'i lha khang gyan sna bcu lhag can zhig bzhengs par gyan dbus mar yul lha de'i snang brnyan mi 'greng tsam las brgal ba dang /g.yas kyi gyan rnams su lha chen bya khyung dang gnyan chen sogs dang /g.yon phyogs kyi gyan la gza' mchog ra hu la'i sku brnyan sogs bzhengs par brten/ ha cang bka' gnyan par brtsi/ des na sde 'di'i yul lha'i lha khang du gza' mchog ra hu la'i sku brnyan ci'i phyir bzhengs te bsten zhe na/ bshad par bya ste/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i stod tsam la sngags 'chang klu 'bum rgyal zhes pa sngags nus can zhig yod pa des chos skyong ma 70

gza' rdor gsum sogs bsten te mchod pas/ sde 'dir phan rlabanu/ rgya cher byung bar brten kun gyis sngags pa nus mthu can zhig red ces tshad mar bzung ba zhig yin no/ /rting mar yar skor 'tsho ba'i sngags 'chang de'i khyim rgyud kyi bzhin bzang ma rdo rje mtsho zhes pa des/ sde 'di'i nye 'dabs klu sdong nas bud shing bcad de khres po zhig khur nas rang khyim du lhags pas mtshan mor bud shing gi gseb nas me stag 'phro bas dogs gzhir gyur pa/ phyi nyin bltas pas gza' shing zhig bcad pa mthong bar brten/ kun gyis ltas bzang por brtsis te yul lha'i khang der gza' mchog chen po de'i sku brnyan che legs shig bzhengs nas chos skyong gi tshul du bsten cing mchod par ma zad/ de'i sku rten zhig kyang khyim rgyud de'i pho gsar zhig la rang bab tu song bas/ gza' shing de nyid snying bor byas te na bza' kha dog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa mgo thod du bcings pa'i tshul gyis sku rten 'bab pa zhig yin/ de nas bzung sde 'di'i skye bo phal mo ches shin tu bka' gnyan pa'i srung mar bkur te mchod pa dang / sde gzhung nas kyang sngags khang zhig bzhengs te rten gyi gtso bor ma gza' rdor gsum sogs kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa dang / lo re dang zla re dus bzang tshes bcu bzung ba dang / sku rim rnam gsum lo ltar rgyun mi chad par sgrub rgyun btsugs/ de nas da lta'i bar de 'dra'i phyag len tsam yod kyang da lta sngar gyi srol rim gyis 'grib te dad ldan pho gsar gzhon nu 71

tshos tshes bcu sogs dus tshes dge bar gdugs dkar khri 'don dang shes rab snying bo sgrol ma sogs mang du bsgrub pa'i srol bzang tshugs/der brten sde 'di'i skye bo rgan gzhon pho mo byings kyis rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyi sgo nas/ sngar yab mes ring la bsod nams kyi zhing gi mchog rten gsum bla na med pa 'bor chen bzhengs te mchod yul du gyur pa phal cher dus kyi 'pho 'gyur gyis rkyen dbang du song ste med par bzos pa rnams da lta slar gso bgyi ba'i phyir spyi lo1980— 2001gi bar lo grangs nyer gnyis ring la yod dgu bton nas ci 'byor gyis sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bzhengs dang bzheng bzhin pa dang / phyag dang mchod pa skor ba sogs la lus gang lcogs kyis 'bad 'bungs byed pa dang / bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa la gnas te sgo gsum bag yod la sbyar ba'i sgo nas mi'i 'gro ba la phan ci thogs kyis ya rabs kyi bya ba rnams lhur len byed pa la rangs par mchis pa'i skabs yin no//de lta bu'i lugs gnyis kyi dpal yon kun nas rgyas pa'i grong brdal 'di'i gnas kyi snying bo'am mdun phyogs gong rol tu sgrub pa'i sde chen po rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling zhes bya ba 'di nyid chags so/ /des na de ni dus nam gyi tshe gang zag gang gis bdag gir bzhes te rgya bskyed ce na/rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnam 'dren skal ldan rgya mtsho khong dgung lo don gcig pa/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sbrul/72

spyi lo1677lor mya ngan las 'das pa nas brtsis pas lo brgya dang bcu gcig 'das pa/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje btsun ngag dbang mi pham zla ba khong dgung lo nyer gcig bzhes pa/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i bgrang bya zhe gcig pa me lug spyi lo1787lor phyag btab ste rgya bskyed/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa nas da lta rab rgyan bgrang bya bco lnga ba lcags sbrul bar lo grangs nyis brgya dang bcu bzhi 'das nas bco lnga'i steng du khel yod do/ /ji ltar chags pa'i rim pa ni gna' snga mo zhig nas da lta'i dgon gzhis su bya btang ba bkra shis tshe ring sogs tshe 'di'i 'khri ba btsan chod kyis dge ba la gcig tu gzhol ba mtshams pa brgyad tsam gyis khang chung re brtsigs te 'dod pa chung ba dang don nyung bas ya rabs kyi las la dus 'da' ba byung / skabs shig la mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rje'i mthus rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa'i bya btang ba zung gis par brko rgyu'i bzo rig la sbyangs te bstan bcos chen mo ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi par gyi 'phrul 'degs su gsar du ngos gtsang bskrun pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis zhi dul bag yod kyi las la brtson pa'i thugs mthun khrims gtsang ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel ba dang / dgon grong gang du'ang gsung rab par du rko ba'i las la brtson pa rtser son pa dag byung ngo / /de'i phyis gang gi tshe nges pa don gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba dpal bzang po nyid pha yul nas rong bo dgon chen du phebs skabs shig la thul mo'i 73

cha ka nas sku ngal bsos te phar rka sar gyi mtshams khang la gzigs zhib yang yang gnang ste phebs shul du dbu zhwa bsnyel nas bor/de nas dgon chen nas mngags gzhug pa gnang ste des phyir phul skabs/ 'o da cha bzang rka sar sgar 'di ri khrod kyi dgon pa'i tshul du kho bos bdag gnyer byed pa'i rten 'brel red ces gsungs/ rjes sor rka sar gyi sde dpon blo bzang rab brtan dang mtshams rgan bkra shis tshe ring rnam gnyis kyis rje btsun dam pa gang gi zhabs la gtugs te/ dgon pa 'debs dgos tshul sogs las brtsams zhu ba nan cher phul nas dgon mgo btags pas/ rje nyid kyis kyang zhal bzhes gnang zhing mi ring bar rka sar gyi gros la dbang ba rnams dang bka' bgros kyis thabs gang mkhas kyi sne mo ba rnams bsko bzhag mdzad/ de nas yar tshes bkra shis pa'i nyin sngon gyi mtshams khang de rmang gzhir bzung nas bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i grwa btsugs te thog mar sa 'dzin lha khang bzhengs rgyu'i ljags bkod kyis khyab par mdzad/ rjes nas lha khang gi phyi dbyibs mdzes khyad thon pa pa tras brgyan pa zhig thugs bkod ltar grub pas thugs gang dges kyis dga' ston bshams te rten 'brel gyi sgo brgya bsgrigs/ de nas rim par sa 'dzin lha khang de'i dbus su byams sku thog tshad tsam bzhengs pa la khri drug 'gyogs kyi rgyab yol gyis brgyan pa rje nyid kyi phyag bzor grags/de'i g.yas phyogs khri'i steng du bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa shākya'i rgyal 74

bo'i sku brnyan dang / g.yon phyogs su gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa rje rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i sku brnyan mi 'greng tsam las brgal ba re dang / mdun phyogs su rgyal dbang lnga ba rje ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sku brnyan dang / khong rang nyid kyi 'dra sku che tshad tsam re bzhengasag /sa/tso sku'i khri'i g.yas g.yon gyi grwar rngam brjid kyi gangs seng re bzhengs yod do/ /thang ga'i skor la rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i stong thang / 'dra thang byon legs can zung / gtso thang dang bcas gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi thang ga ngo mtshar can/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i nag thang byin khyad can/ mgon po chos rgyal lha mo gsum gyi thang ga bzo bo 'bur thon can re/ gnam rgyan du rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ dbus su dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bzhengs yod pa dang / thugs kyi rten bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod rten che tshad khru do can rgyu shug pa las grub pa'i mdzes khyad can/ gsung gi skor ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang ting 'phags bskal gsum/ sher phyin nyi khri lnga ba/ skal ldan mgur ma sogs gsung 'bum gyi skor mang du bzhugs/phyi'i khyams kyi log ris la yang rgyal chen bzhi sogs bzhengs bkod phun sum tshogs pa'i skal ldan dag gi mig gi bdud rtsi bla na med par gyur/de ltar sa 'dzin lha khang rten brten pa bzhengs grub legs par byung bas phyogs 'dir dge mtshan mang du byung / de nas lo snga phyir grwa btsun bsdus 75

nas rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa la bkod de dge 'dun gyi sde gsar 'dzugs gnang / phyogs 'di'i gdul byar gang la gang 'tsham gyi bslab ston dang chos bka' mang du gsungs/ bslab khrims mig 'bras ltar srung ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde rnams chos srid gnyis char gyis legs par bskyangs/ gang ltar rka sar grong ri dgon gnyis kyi 'dod mos bzhin dbo/sa chos dang 'jig rten mi chos kyis mtshon pas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa'i 'bel gtam lhug par stsal pas dge mtshan mang du 'phel/ chos sde 'dir chos spyod bcu'i bya ba rnams yar zla'i rjes su bsnyegs pas phyogs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad nas skye dgu mtha' dag bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dpal la ngoms med du rol ba byung ngo / /gzhan yang chos sde 'dir mchod rdzas yo chas kyi skor bzo grwa legs shing gya nom pa mang du mchis so//des na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang mi gnyis pa rje bis pa mi pham zla ba'i sku phreng rim byon rnams kyi mdzad rjes dang 'brel ngo sprod rags tsam brjod pa la/khong gi sku phreng dang po ni bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen bla na ma mchis pa rje bstan 'dzin shes rab khong pa yin la/ de ni rong bo sde bdun gyi ya gyal bis sa zhes pa'i grong tshor sku 'khrungs/ khyim nas khyim med par rab 76

tu byung ste gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam phul phyin bgyis pa/ra brten/ mkhas pa'i snyan pa mi dman zhing zhi dul bag yod kyi spyod pas mkhas dgu'i brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog pa dang /sku tshe gang bor bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen bdag gir bzhes pa sogs kyi mdzad rnam dag ni gzhan du gsal bas 'dir re zhig bzhag go/sku phreng gnyis pa dran dbang yongs kyi gtsug rgyan nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bis pa rje btsun ngag dbang mi pham zla ba dpal bzang po nyid ni/ skyes stobs kyi shes rab dang sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan gnam gyis sa bkab pa ltar gang cha nas brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig tu nges pa rnams las brtsams te gong du mdo tsam bkod pa der gzigs shig khri rabs nyer gnyis pa lags so//sku phreng gsum pa dge ldan bstan pa'i srog shing skye dgu'i gtsug gi nor bu rje btsun don yod bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen gyi khri rabs so drug pa yin la/ khong ni lugs gnyis kyi dpal yon kun nas rgyas pa'i grong brdal chu bzang zhes par sku 'khrungs/rje a rol blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho las rab tu byung ste rje de nyid gtan gyi skyabs gcig pur bsten/ thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa phul phyin mdzad de bstan la mdzad rjes mang du 77

bzhag rje de nyid sogs las chos bka' mang du gsan/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas thugs mnyes par mdzad pa sogs bsam brjod las 'das/ gser khri lo gsum gyi bar bskyangs shing khri zur nas rka sar dgon 'dus bzang chos gling sku gong ma ngag dbang mi pham zla ba'i mdzad pa ltar khur du bzhes te gtsug lag gnyis kyis tshul bzhin bskyangs/ sde 'dir bslab gsum nor gyis ci yang phyug pa'i grwa tshogs dpyid dpal ltar rgyas par brten/ sngar gyi 'du khang de chung skyon gyis gsar ba zhig bzhengs dgos pa byung / de nas sngon gyi de bla ma'i gzim khang du bsgyur te 'du khang gsar ba che legs shig bzhengs rgyu'i grwa btsugs nas thugs 'dun bzhin grub/ sngar las rgyu cha phun sum je tshogs su song gshis lha rten chos gsum gyi rigs kyang bzhengs bkod bla na med par gyur/ chos srid kyi dpal 'byor sna gang thad nas dge mtshan gyi phung bo g.yang du chags shing srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag las ring du brgal ba'i rnam dag bslab khrims g.yag rnga bzhin gus mchod lhur bzhes mdzad pa'i dge 'dun gyi sder rje nyid gtsor mdzad rka sar bya btang ba mtshams rgan tshang nas grogs dam bgyis te gzhi gsum gyi phyag len ngos gtsang btsugs par ma zad bca' yig kyang mdzad/ ji ltar ngang ba'i rgyal bo pad mtshor 'jug pa'am legs bris gzhon nu'i tshogs rnams dga' ba'i tsha la du chas pa ltar chos sde 'dir ngang gis zhugs pa'i grwa btsun rgan gzhon gang 78

bzhugs la bsla ba gsu me nor bu'i mdzod la mnga' dbang sgyur byed mkhyen rab 'phrul gyi sgo 'phar mtha' dag cig car 'byed pa'i thabs tshul tshomachog la 'god pa'i mdzad bzang rkang 'thung gsar ba'i snye ma nye bar dud pa'i thabs rnams bdag gir bzhes te/ rgyun ldan tshogs 'don chos spyod kyi rim pa dang / tshes brgyad bco lnga nyer lnga nyer dgu bcas dus tshes bzang por rim pa ltar sman bla gsang 'dus/ kun rigabaskang gsol rnams rgyu chags su gtan khel sgos ched 'dzugs gnang ngo / /bu ram shing ba'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang bo'i mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa la gnod kyang 'tshe bar byed ba'i bdud rigs kun drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod pa la rngams pa'i gshin rje chos kyi rgyal bo sogs chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes spyan ldan rnams la mchod gtor dang / 'phrin bcol nyer bskul sgos gdugs lnga'i ring bod lo sku rim du grags pa'i dam rgya can yang btsugs/ gzhan yang skya ser kun la rang rang gi blo kha dang 'tsham par chos bka' mang du gsungs te chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam nas legs par bskyangs pa'i bka' drin ni gzhal mtha' ma mchis so//sku phreng bzhi pa bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag mtshungs med bis pa rje btsun blo bzang don yod rgya mtsho ni/ chos srid kyi lang tsho kun nas rgyas pa'i khre tse bzhi'i ya gyal seng ge gshong rgya tshang mar sku bltams/ snying rje'i rang 79

gzugs skyabs rje dam pa blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho las rab tu byung zhing rje de nyid kyis bis pa sprul skur thag bcad de dge tshul bsgrubs/rje'i rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma'i lung dang / rje'i thang ga bstan rgyas ma'i phyag dpe bcas gnang ste dbu sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa'i bdag por byin rlabs kyi sgo brgya bsgrigs/ khri rgan 'jam pa'i dbyangs bla ma'i gtso bor bsten te mdo sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa phul phyin mdzad/ khong la brten nas legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba tshugs shing don gnyis phun tshogs 'egrub pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye ste dad 'dun rtse gcig pas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas thugs mnyes par byed pa sogs kyi lo rgyus rje de nyid kyi rnam thar du gsal/ gdan sa'i khri rabs nga drug pa yin/ rje nyid khri las thog pa'i skabs su grwa tshang 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi sbyor ba la gnas pa'i sgang du song / sngar 'du khang zhig gso byas skabs yab rje skal ldan rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i gur mgon gyi logs ris ni khri rgan grub chen 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun bstan 'dzin pas sba dbyug gis rtags gnang ba ltar blangs pas ma nyams par phebs stabs 'di skabs su khong gis kyang khri rgan rdo rje 'chang la bka' drin skyong dgos zhus pa ltar phyag rtags gnang mtshams nas ma gron par phebs pas kun ngo mtshar bar grags so/ /gser khri'i skabs chos srid gnyis char gyis grwa tshang legs par bskyangs pas 'phrin las ha 80

cang rgyas te kun gyi smon yul du gyur/ de nas khong gis kyang sku phreng gong ma rnams kyis sgrub pa'i sde 'di nyid ji ltar bskyangs pa ltar mdzad de bzhugs sa'i mthil du mdzad/ 'di'i skabs su sde 'di'i chos srid kyi yo lang sngar las rgyas te gur kum dga' tshal gsar du bzhad pa'i lang tsho dar la bab pa'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde rnams 'phel rgyas su song bas gang cha nas sngon thon du gyur/ khong gis rka sar sgar grong gi re 'dun bzhin sngon gyi 'du khang de par khang du bsgyur te/ rab byung bco lnga ba bgrang bya bcu bdun pa'i chu lug spyi lo1883lor yang bskyar 'du khang chen mo gsar du bskrun rgyu'i mgo brtsams te snga na ma mchis pa zhig legs grub byung bas dgyes sor dpe med mdzad/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi bzhengs bkod kyang ches cher bla lhag tu 'phel te lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams gsog pa'i bkur sti'i zhing sa bla na med par gyur/ bcar bzhugs kyis dad ldan skye 'gro yongs la brtse gzigs kyis 'dod mos bzhin chos bka' mang du stsal pa dang / lhag par du bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims las brtsams te skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs shing / 'dul ba'i bcas khrims dang bslab bya rnams ngo sprod gsal bor mdzad pa sogs kyis bstan 'gror sman pa'i bya ba rlabs gang che mdzad/ gzhan yang sde 'di'i ser skya kun la las dkar nag gi khyad par dang ya rabs kyi bya ba la brtson dgos tshul sogs kyi sgo 81

nas 'di phyi gnyis kar phan pa'i bslab bya dang snying gtam lhug par stsal pas re ba'i bang ba dgos 'dod nor gyis yongs su bkang bar mdzad/de ltar sde 'di'i dad ldan byings la bka' drin shin tu che bas 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas mthar thug 'gran gyi do med mtshungs med bla ma gcig pur bkur to/ /sku phreng lnga ba lugs gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo bis pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs don yod rgya mtsho ni/ sku phreng snga ba'i sde tshor sku bltams/ 'di ba'i sku ring la yang 'du khang chen mo gzhi nas bslangs te gsar du bzhengs rgyu'i shing cha sogs legs par bsgrigs te 'du byed kyi las la brtson kyang / de'i steng du ma 'khel bar rgyu cha sogs gtan brlags chud zos su gyur to/ /gzhan yang yab rje bla ma'i gdan sa nas dus grwa gsang sngags dar rgyas gling nas sngags 'chang mtsho byung rgyas pa'i dpal lam mkhas dbang rje blo bzang dpal ldan khong rnam gnyis kyis hor zla dang por sgrub mchod dang / hor zla gsum pa nag zla'i nya la kun rig bdag 'jug dang de'i sgrub mchod ngos gtsang btsugs pa dang / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa/ khams gsum bla ma chos kyi rgyal bo mnyam med shar tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang rgyal bo'i dbang bo nyid kyang thugs dgongs zab mo yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir du zhing 'dir yongs su grags pa'i dge ldan lnga mchod chen mo zhes pa 82

lo ltar rgyun 'dzugs gnang zhing / gzhi byes kyi grwa btsun rnams bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa la bkod/ chos sbyin rnam dag gis kun yid tshim par byas te sde 'dir dge ldan gtsang ma'i ring lugs nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa sogs kyi bka' drin mchog tu che/ de yang sngon gyi sa 'dzin lha khang du gtso sku rgyal ba byams pa'i sku dang/ g.yas su ston pa'i sku sogs byin can rnams dang / khyad par du paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi 'bral spangs thub sku byin can/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung /'phags pa chos 'phags kyi tshems gyi cha shas/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i phyag tsha a tham ma sogs nang rten du bzhugs pa'i g.yon gyi rje sku byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar zhing dus tshes dge bar dri bsung dang gzi 'od 'phro ba'i rang byon du grags pa can rnams bzhengs pa'i mthus chos sde 'dir mdo sngags kyi las yongs su rdzogs pa'i sar gnas kyi sems dpa' chen po lha rams pa re rgyun mi chad par 'byon nges zhes lha dang bla ma'i lung gis bstan yod pa ltar byon pa/ ngo mtshar can gyi skyes bu lha rams pa rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang / yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po rka sar klu 'bum lha ris pa rje byang chub rab gsal sogs skyes chen dam pa gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu du ma rim par byon pa rnams dkyus gcig tu brjod na bde bas 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar shes par bya'o/ /mdor na masmo rab dbang phyug rje btsun 83

brtan pa'i 'khor lo ngur smrig gar du rtsen pa/ nges pa don gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba'i sku phreng rim byon gyis chos sde 'di nyid chos srid gnyis char gyis legs par bskyangs te yongs su skyong ba'i bka' drin ni srid na 'gran zla dang bral zhing / bskal pa'i bar du mchod kyang cha tsam yang bsab par mi nus pa'i tshod du gda' 'o//gzhan yang gang gi bla na med pa'i gsang gsum nyi 'od drod kyis bskyangs pa'i sgrub pa'i sde chen po 'di'i 'du khang chen mo sogs kyi nang rten 'chi med dga' tshal lhug par grol ba dang / byin rlabs kyi dri bsung phyogs su ldang ba'i 'jig rten gyi rgyan du che ba rnams phal cher da lta mthong thos dran reg gi yul las 'das nas dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba phra na yang / snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir bsod nams kyi zhing gi mchog rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mi 'dod pa'i ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag 'joms par gsungs pas/ 'dir yang sngon gyi bzhengs pa bkod pa mchog gsum gyi rten gzi 'od 'bar ba rnams rjes su dran pa dang /skal ldan las 'phro can dag dga' ba bskyed de bsod nams rlabs chen sdud pa'i 'phrul 'degs su rags tsam ngo sprod bya ba la mngon par phyogs so/ /des na 'du khang chen mo'i rten gtso ni/ de'i 'og shod gral mgor rje mi pham zla ba'i phyag bzor grags pa'i byams sku mthong ba don ldan byis 84

pa lo brgyad can gyi sku brnyan byon gtsang byin ldan/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa mnyam med shākya seng ge'i sku brnyan khyad mtshar can/ rje rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i sku brnyan mi tshad las 'das pa khri drug 'gyogs can/bde ldan zhing mgon rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan/ khri rgan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gzungs 'bul gnang ba'i kun rig rnam par snang mdzad gyi sku brnyan khri drug 'gyogs can de la dkar chag kyang yod/thub pa rdor gdan mar grags pa'i gso sbyong ston pa dzhaispya las grub pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'phro ba'i lo rgyu5 can/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dngos slob bya btang ba zhig gis rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas spyan drangs pa'i rten rnying 'od dpag med kyi sku byon legs can/ sman 'dam gyi rigs las grub pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ 'od dpag med/ jo sku sogs kyi sku brnyan/ g.yas g.yon gyi kun rar che tshad mkhyid gang can gyi sangs rgyas stong sku byon gtsang can/ dpal yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi li sku rgya nag nas drangs pa byon gtsang khri do can/ la mo zhabs drung dkar bo'i dbu sngas kyi rten khrod nas byon pa dzhaispya las grub pa'i seng khri can gyi 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pa'i sku brnyan 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig byon gtsang che legs can/ g.yer gshong sngags 'chang rje 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyis gnang ba'i rje sku mthong ba don ldan rdor khri can/ chos rgyal chen po srong btsan sgam po'i khrus gzhung las grub pa 85

rigs gsum mgon po'i sku brnyan khru gang can/rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i phyag tsha'i mchod rten brgya dang brgyad can khru gang ma/ bis pa don yod bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung mchod rten che tshad can/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis thugs dam gyi rten ston pa'i sku brnyan khyad mtshad can lcang skya tshang la gnang ba khong gis bzo bo rtser son pa lcags byams la rten skal du gnang ba byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba can/ kun rig gi rnal 'byor bar grags pa'i sgo dmar a khu rin chen gyis bzhengs pa'i kun rig gi blos bslangs gyan gang can brkos grub phul du phyin pa/ lha rams pa dkon mchog rgya mtshos lha ldan nas spyan drangs pa'i mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag tsha yi dam 'jigs mdzad rdo rje la mgon chos sogs kyis bskor ba'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba can/sar gnas sems dpa' chen po rka sar klu 'bum lha ris pa byang chub rab gsal gyi phyag bzo jo bo'i thang ga ri stag dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bzhengs pa'i jo sku rong bo'i 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi rten sna tshang bar grags pa can/ ri stag dge ba'i bshes gnyen khong gi sku gdung mchod rten nyi zla rang byon bab pa can/bla mchod tshogs zhing / skyabs 'gro tshogs zhing / rje tsong kha brgyad cu/paṇa chen 'khrungs rabs/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams kyi gyan thang / sgo dmar lha bzo blo gros kyis bzhengs pa'i g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing thang /86

sgrol ma'i stong thang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa/ dpa' gcigaseng gdong gtso 'khor gsum pa sogs kyi thang ga rnams bzhugs/mthongs skor du rje tsong kha brgyad cu'i thang ga bco lnga/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi thang ga gsum/ gzhan yang thang ga byon legs can che chung du ma bzhugs/ steng shod du gsung gi rten yum 'bum pa/ nyi khri/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa tshar brgya tham pa/ gser bris dngul bris kyi ting 'phags bskal gsum/ mdo phal bo che/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs chos bka' pod mang du bzhugs/ston pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi gyan thang gsum/ sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal bo gtso 'khor lnga can gyi gyan thang /gtso sku thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong can la sgrol ma nyer gcig gis bskor ba'i gyan thang / 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod kyi gyan thang /kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi gyan thang sogs bzhugs/ 'og shod kyi kha yar 'khor logs ris la mgon chos lnga/ lcam sring / dpal mgon bram gzugs/ glo sgo'i thad du khro bo sme brtsegs/ don yod zhags pa/'dzam nag 'du khang gi phyi'i khyams su rgyal chen bzhi/ srid pa'i 'khor lo/ sham bha la'i zhing bkod/ rma chen sbom ra/ lha chen bya khyung rnams mthar gyis bzhengs yod/ garnyo la'i steng du rgya nag nas drangs pa'i gser tog spus legs mdzes khyad can/rgyal mtshan bzhi/ spen rgyan sogs mdzes pa'i khyad chos 'bur du thon pa can mang bos spras te ser 87

lam mer yod pas sum rtsen khang bzang la yang co 'dri ba ltar lhag ger gsal/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad gya nom pa li ting che ba bdun tshar du ma/ mchod rkong gi rigs kyang dngul rkong tshe 'bar che chung du ma/gser rkong che chung sogs mang du mchis/gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rnga sbub dung chen dung dkar che chung la sogs pa mchod rdzas kyi rigs bgrang gis mi lang ba dag yod do/spar khang chen mor/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i par gsar rnying gnyis/ sher phyin gyi mdo rgyal ba'i yum par 'phro can/ mdo ting— nge 'dzin/ mdo sde bskal bzang / nyi khri/ gzungs 'dus/ gser 'od sa bcu ma/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa/ kun rig sman bla/ bla mchod/ bzang spyod/ byams smon/ spyod 'jugathog mtha' bar/ bde smon/ mgon chos lnga bo sogs par che chung mang du bzhugs/chos 'khor khang ni/ snga sor skya ser kun la klu'i gnod pa'i dbang gis sa grib byung ste mi 'ga' zhig la nad tshabs chen phog pa na/ sku phyogs chen mo rje blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal— bzang po'i zhabs la gtugs te skyabs su song bar brten/ thugs rje bdag nyid chen pos brtse gzigs kyis rjes su bzung ste/ khong tshang gi phyag 'khor/ sku gzan/ dbu lo bcas gnang nas rten 'di dag snying 88

bor byas te bla na med pa'i rgyud dpal gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi gzungs dung phyur can gyi 'khor lo zhig bzhengs shing nyin mtshan kun tu bar ma chad par skor dang phan thogs rgya chen po yod ces gsungs par ltar/ chos 'khor khang bzhengs te khong gis gnang ba'i rten rnams dang /gzhan yang khri rgan sku gong ma'i dbu ljon/ rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i dbu ljon/ ther sham/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ba'i dbu skra/ dbu zhwa sogs rten sna 'gangs che ba rnams snying bor byas te gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi 'khor lo bzhengs te skya ser mang bos bar ma chad par bskor ba dang / gyan g.yas g.yon du 'bur sku gsang bdag 'khor chen/ na ga rak+ṣa/ rje btsun seng ge sgra'i sku brnyan rnams mi tshad tsam re bzhengs pa dang / rten rnying byams sku dus tshes bzang por bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i byin rten bla na med pa bcas la skyabs rje dam pa rnams dngos phebs kyis rab tu gnas pa'i mdzad sgo spel ba nas bzung rim gyis klu'i nad byung ba rnams nad las grol te char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa sogs bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan mig mthong lag zin du gyur to// mgon khang ste lha mo khang ni/ chos sde 'di'i rten gtso bstan srung ni lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo ste li sku gzi 'od 'bar ba'i shin tu bka' gnyan can khri gang ma dang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i gyan thang /89

mgon po chos rgyal rnam sras sogs mgon chos lnga bo'i sman sku che tshad re bzhengs yod pa dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bzor grags pa'i 'dod khams dbang mo'i sku brnyan thang ga byin can/ zhal khebs 'gyed mi rung pa'i dam rgya can gyi lha mo'i thang ga lha mo'i gyan thang sogs sku brnyan che chung rigs mang ba dang / lha mo'i be'u bum/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod cha'i skor gya nom pa mang du mchis so//dge 'dun gyi ja khang ngam rung khang ni/ thog brtsegs can gyan nyi shur longs pa'i rung khang tshad ldan zhig yin/ der tshogs zangs che 'bring chung gsum dang / ja zangs dang thug zangs bcas rgyu spus legs pa can rnams dang / gzhan yang ja rdze'u thug rje'u sogs mkho dgu'i yo chas rnams cha tshang bar yod do //rje btsun mi pham zla ba'i gzim khang bkra shis nyams dgar kun dga' ra ba mdzes khyad 'bur du thon pa dang po'i 'du khang du bsod nams kyi zhing gi dam pa mchog gsum rin po che'i rten gyi gtso bo ma 'ongs tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus kyi mgon po/ rnam 'dren lnga ba rje btsun byams pa'i sku brnyan gong zhus ltar dang / gzhan yang bdag cag gi bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa rnam 'dren zas gtsang gi sras po gzhon nu don kun grub pa'i sku brnyan sogs sku'i rten gyi rigs mang bo dang / yum 90

'bum pa dang lam rim sngags rim sogs gsung 'bum gyi skor mang lo bcas chos po ti mang du bzhugs pa dang / bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod rten sogs thugs kyi rten dang / gzhan yang gyan thang dang thang ga che chung sogs sku gsung thugs rten 'gangs chen phon che ba bzhugs so//rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi sras po bshad pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa blon chos blo bzang chos grags kyi yang sprul sku phreng bdun pa/ skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan rje blo bzang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho khong tshang yang chos sde 'dir phebs bzhud gnang ste dgos dbang gis nga brgyad yar sngon du gzim khang bzhengs pa dang / der yang phyag yul gyi mchod khang du sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs yod do//gzhan yang chos sde 'di'i grwa shag gi khrod na gyo thog can gyi byams khang bdun yod pa dang / de re rer yang rje tsong kha brgyad cu/ paṇa chen 'khrungs rabs/ tshe dpag med stong thang / ltung bshags lha so lnga/sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ grub chen brgyad cu sogs kyi sku brnyan dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum dus 'khor gsang bdag 'khor chen bcas kyi gyan thang dang / logs ris thang ga sogs mang du bzhugs pa'i sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan rnams ljongs 'di'i dad ldan bye ba'i gtsug na gzi byin dang bcas lham mer mdzes pa lha'i bzo pa'i sor rtse las thon pa'i khyad chos rang bzhin ldan zhing / sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam 91

chos skyong sogs dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i byin rlabs mtshungs pa'i rten sna rtsa chen 'jig rten na rnyed par dka' ba gzhal du med pa'i rigs mang du bzhugs pa dang / shar gyi phyag mdzod chen mo rka sar a khu ye shes grags pa'i gzim spyil ni/ kha lho ltar nyis thog can gyan sna nyer brgyad la rkos pa tra dgu brtsegs dang ldan pa'i dbus kyi steng gi gyan la mchod khang bzhengs te sku'i rten jo bo shākya mu ne gtsor mdzad nas sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan du ma dang / skyabs mgon gyis rten skal thub pa rdor gdan ma zhig gnang bas rten gyi gtso bor gyur na yang / phyis su dgon gzhung la phul te gso sbyong gi ston par mdzad/ nga brgyad lor dus kyi 'pho 'gyur gyi dbang gis kyang ma 'jig par da lta zhal bzhugs pa ni e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang ngam snyam/ gzhan yang mchod khang der thang ga 'gangs chen du ma dang / gsung rten chos po ti mang du bzhugs/ de'i mur thog so'i gyan gsum la skyabs mgon rin po cher gzim khang bzhengs te gzim mal sogs cha tshang bar bsgrigs pas/ skyabs mgon rin po che'i sku snga phyi gang yin na'ang chos sde 'dir phebs skabs gzim spyil gyi mthil du mdzad de bcar bzhugs mdzad pa yin/ gzhan yang sku phyogs chen mo tshang dang / mar nang rdo rje 'chang abh+ya zhabs/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ba sogs kyang gzim khang gi mthil du mdzad nas dgyes sor dpe med mdzad pa yin/ gzim khang de'i shar lta dang byang lta 92

nub lta sogs khyon bsdoms gyan bzhi bcu lhag bzhengs yod pa rnams bzo dbyibs dang bkod sgrig rgyu cha sogs sna gang thad nas rtse mor son pas chos sde 'di'i gzim spyil gyi mchog tu brtsi/ rjes su mi yi sha tshugs dud 'gro'i brtul zhugs can mtshan mo rgyu ba'i dpung tshogs kyis lha rten chos gsum ril mid bgyis skabs gzim khang phar zad chos sde 'di'i 'du khang dang byams khang sogs rten brten pa rnams shul lus med par bzos na yang / mchog gsum dam pa'i mthus da lta slar yang 'du khang sogs legs par bzhengs grub byung ba'i rim pa rnams 'chad 'gyur ltar ro//gna' ches snga mo nas bzung rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi dbang gis reb gong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer 'dir mdo las gsungs pa ltar/ chos sde che chung dang grong brdal grong gseb grong gang gi lam srang sum mdo'am bzhi mdo/ skye bo mang bo 'du sar ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi las brtsams te rten sna phun sum tshogs pa rnams bsgrigs nas mchod pa'i rten bla na med pa rgya che chung gang 'byor gyis bzhengs/ der phyag dang bskor ba sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor bas legs par bshams te mchod pas yul phyogs der nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod 'khrug long sogs rang zhi nas lo phyugs rtag tu 'phel zhing bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po 93

yod par brten/ sgrub pa'i sde chen po 'dir yang ya rabs kyi phyag srol bzang po ma nyams par rgyun gnas ltar byang skyor du gna' snga rol tu bzhengs pa'i mchod rten ni rnying skyon gyis 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas zhig ral du song bas slar gso cis kyang byed dgos pa byung / de nas grong ri dgon gnyis kyi gros la dbang ba rnams kyis gros mol bgyis pa ltar/'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo rong ston skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen por gsol te skya ser kun gyi re 'dun bzhin rje nyid nas kyang dgyes nyams gyis ljags bkod lhu things pa stsal pa ltar/ rab rgyal bgrang bya nyer bzhi pa lcags stag lor/ mchod rten gyi srog shing dang gzungs gzhug dril sgrub 'dzam pho mo sogs nang rten gyi rigs gang dgos rnams yar ldan du tshags su chud par byas te skya ser kun gcig mthun gyis dad pa dang 'byor ba yod dgu bton nas ci 'byor gyis legs par bzhengs grub byung / rab gnas kyi tshe yang skyabs mgon rin po cher zhus pas khong rang nyid 'dir chibs bsgyur te rab gnas kyi mdzad sgo spel pas thugs gang dges kyis tshe 'di phyi gnyis las brtsams te grong ri dgon gyi skya ser pho mo kun gyi sems la phan pa'i snying gtam bslab bya brjed du phangs pa dag stsal pas kun gyi re ba'i bang ba yongs su bkang ste rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon bla lhag tu bskrun pa'i skal bzang thob bo//gzhan yang chos sde 'di'i rten gtsor gyur pa byams khang rten dang brten pa'i rnam 94

gzhag gi dkar chag ni/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra dha ra a bh+ya zhabs kyis mdzad pa 'dir ngo sprod kyi phyir dgod par spro'o/ /des na 'di ltar/ rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho zhes/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal ba bzhin/ /snyan pa'i ba dan btsugs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /bdun pa chen po skye dgu'i gtsug na mdzes/ /bu ram shing ba'i rgya chen spyod pa'i gtam/ /srid mthar skyong ba'i sras su dbang bskur ba/ /mi pham bla ma gang gi dgyes pa'i zhal/ /mngon sum lta bar 'tshal lo rjes brtses skyongs/ /phan bde'i gru char zad med 'jo ba'i nor/ /rgyal bstan 'jig rten kun tu skyong ba la/ /zla bral bstan pa 'dzin pa'i legs mdzad can/ /gang gang dad pa'i ngang mo rol ba'i zhing / /las nyon chu yi srin po khros pa'i khyim/ /sdug bsngal rlabs phreng bar med 'khrigs pa'i gnas/ /srid pa'i nyam nga'i mtsho las brgal ba'i thabs/ /bsod nams gru gzings sbyor las gzhan ci zhig /de phyir byams mgon snang brnyan gtsor bzhugs pa'i/ /gtsug lag khang bzang gsar du bskrun pa'i gtam/ /chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi gsang mthor sgrogs pa gang / /bsod nams tshul la gus rnams rtse gcig nyon/ /de yang bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen po'i rigs kyi cod pan rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ byams brtse'i bdag nyid rnam 'dren skal ldan rje'i/ /rlabs chen 'phrin las nyi 'od kyis phye ba'i/ /95

bshad sgrub pad+ma'i tshal rab rgyas pa'i sde/ /rig grol bsung zhim 'thul ba grangs mtha' yas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgrub brgyud 'khor lo bcu ba'i shing rta bsnyengs pa med par 'dren pa'i byed po/gangs can lha gcig phyag na pad+mo'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rol ba/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho sku 'phreng rim byon gyi 'phrin las la brten nas mdo smad lho rgyud re skong gser mo ljongs zhes grags pa'i 'jig rten 'dir bshad pa'i gdan sa chen po rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen dang / sgrub pa'i gdan sa chen po gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyil gnyis gtsor bzhugs kyis khrims ldan 'dus pa'i dga' tshab dpag tu med pa nam mkha' la rgyu skar dang / sa gzhi la dpag bsam bzhin du bkra ba'i nang tshan rka sar dgon 'dus bzang chos gling zhes bya ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'dir snga phan byams khang zur ba med par brten skya ser kun la byams khang gsar bzhengs kyi mos 'dun shin tu che ba'i steng /gser ljongs yul gyi skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i rigs bdag 'gran zla med pa rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho nas ljags bkod mthil phyin stsal don ltar las byed pa dge slong ye shes rgya mtsho ngo g.yog bzhi gsar bskos bgyis pa ltar rab tshes15shing byi spyi lo1927lo'i tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po nas gtsug lag khang gi rmang btings te/ shing bzo kin zhi zer bas gyang dpon dang 96

shing dpon gcig 'thus su bgyis thog rang sde'i skya ser tshang mas zho sha yod dgus gtsug lag khang nyis thog gi gyang sra brtan du brdungs/shing glang cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes nas shing bzo kin zhi ngo g.yog nyer gcig gis gtsug lag khang gi shing las gang dgos rtsod shad kyis bsgrubs par 'dzugs sgang grol gsum gyi ston mo/ phog dar du grags pa'i ster cha sogs shing bzo spyi lugs kyi las ka rgya chen la gang dgos 'tshems med du byin pa dang / shing yon kha bcos sogs bsgril bar srang nyis stong brgya dang lnga bcu thob/ gyo bzo rta mgrin tshe ring ngo g.yog drug gis byams khang la nyer mkho'i so phag bsregs bsgrigs gang dgos rtsol thon byas shing / byams sku gsar bzhengs kyi las byed dge slong blo bzang nor bu ngo g.yog bzhis gang ci'i 'gan g.yo zol med par bzung ste me stag nag pa'i nya nas seng ge'i gshong 'bur bzo rtser son dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin ngo g.yog lngas byams sku nyis thog ma khri drug 'gyogs can gtso 'khor bcas byon gtsang du bzhengs par ster cha zas 'dod bcas srang stong dang chig brgya skor song / gser tshon 'bul ba'i nyer spyad gang dgos tshags su chud bstun rab byung bcu drug pa'i bgrang bya brgyad pa shing khyi'i zla tshes nas gser tshon 'bul ba'i las kyi sne mo ba dge slong blo bzang rab rgyas ngo g.yog drug dang / lha bzo dge slong dge 'dun rab rgyas ngo g.yog bcus 'bad rtsol thang lhod med par bsten te bcu 97

pa'i bcu gnyis la grub par 'gro sgo gang song dngul phab rdo tshad so brgyad thob po/ /de ltar gtsug lag khang 'di'i rten gtsor byams sku thog so gnyis pa khri drug 'gyogs can dang / g.yas su phyag rdor dang / g.yon du spyan ras gzigs kyi lder sku che ba re/ byams pa'i rgyab yol gyi steng gi khang bzang du thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi lder sku/ rje sku bcu drug sogs 'bur sku mang bo dang / g.yas g.yon du spyan ras gzigs kyi stong thang gser bsgrubs ma dang / gsang 'dus bde mchog rnams kyi gyan thang / 'og shod gtso bo'i g.yas phyogs su dge slong grags pa bstan 'dzin gyis dngul srang brgya phrag gi rgyu yon sbyar te bzhengs pa'i rje yab sras kyi sman sku che ba dang / gcod pas srang bcu gsum lhag gi rgyu yon sbyar te bzhengs pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sman sku/ dpon tshang tsho bas dngul srang lnga bcus sgrol ma dang sor 'brang gi lder sku bzhengs pa'i nang tshan sgrol sku dang / dge slong ye shes rgya mtshos dngul srang brgya lhag gis rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum gsar bzhengs dang / rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags bya lor sku zhabs rnam pas sde dger phyag dpe sgrub mi mngags gdong bka' bstan gnyis gsar du bzhengs pa'i nang tshan dge slong blo bzang dge 'dun ngo g.yog dang /mog rus sde bas sbyin bdag byas te dngul rdo tshad bcu gsum dang dgon pa'i gzhung nas rdo tshad gcig bcas kyis bzhengs pa rgyal ba'i bka' 98

rin po che 'gyur ro cog thum gdong dar dang bcas pa spus gtsang dang /lha mo'i gyan thang bcas bzhugs/ g.yon phyogs su 'theb gya'i no'u 'ba' dang mog rus g.yang 'bum gnyis kyis dngul srang brgya lhag gi bdog pa sbyar te gsar bzhengs 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku brnyan che ba re/ sha bo thar gyis dngul srang bco lnga lhag gi rgyu yon sbyar te bzhengs pa'i mi 'khrugs pa dang / yar skor tsho bas dngul srang brgya dang nyi shu ri bas bzhengs pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dang / dpon tshang tsho bas bzhengs gras sor 'brang rnams kyi sman sku dang / dge slong ye shes rgya mtsho nas —dngul rdo tshad bdun dang / dgon pa'i grwa ba so so nas dngul rdo tshad drug tsam gyi dkar thigs phul ba bcas rdo tshad bcu gsum gyis bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur thum gdong dar dang bcas pa spus gtsang dang / 'od dpag med kyi gyan thang bcas bzhugs/ khyams su rgyal chen bzhi/ rma rgyal/ bya khyung rnams kyi gyan thang / khor yug la ma ṇi dung phyur gyi 'khor lo rnams bzhugs/ phyi'i gtsug lag khang dang byams sku gtso 'khor rnams kyi bzhengs 'theb tu dngul thon rdo tshad brgya dang gsum gyi tshod dang / sku gzhan rnams dang gyan thang skor la rdo tshad bcu gsum tsam dang / bka' bstan gsar bzhengs thum gdong dar dang bcas pa'i rgyu song la rdo tshad nyer dgu'i tshod song ba las bka' 'gyur gyi thum dngul srang nyer gnyis kyi tshod dge slong blo bzang nor bus phul ba 99

yin/ de ltar gtsug lag khang 'di rten dang brten par bcas pa'i song tho rags rim dngul du phab par rdo tshad brgya dang so bdun lhag bcas thob bo/ /byams pa'i snang brnyan gyi nang bzhugs su ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi las chos sku'i ring bsrel gzungs gzhug rgyas pa tshar brgya/ bla ma'i mtshan sngags chig khri dgu stong nyis brgya/ dmigs brtse ma stong drug brgya nyer lnga/ yig brgya stong gsum bzhi brgya zhe bzhi/ gsang 'dus snying bo khri gsum chig stong drug brgya brgyad cu/ trīḥ ṣ+ṭiḥ khri bzhi stong bzhi nyis brgya/dus 'khor snying bo khri gnyis stong gsum lnga brgya lnga bcu/ rdo rje shugs kyi snying bo khri bzhi stong bzhi chig brgya drug cu/ durga ti stong bzhi dgu brgya nyi shu/ a ra pa tsa sum khri dgu stong bdun brgya don drug yig drug nyis khri sum stong nyis brgya go drug phyag rdor snying bo chigacokhri dgu brgya brgyad cu/'jam dbyangs dam bcas pa'i gzungs stong drug byams pa dam bcas pa'i gzungs dgu stong bdun brgya lnga bcu/ seng ge sgra khri bzhi stong gcig brgyad cu/ sor 'brang nyis khri nyis stong / mgon po'i snying bo khri bdun stong brgyad bzhi brgya/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud tshar bdun/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud tshar lnga/ nyi khri pod bzhi/ ting 'phags bskal gsum tshar gsum re/phal chen pod drug thar mdo tshar gnyis/ gzungs chen sde lnga pod gcig mtshan brjod/ so thar gyi mdo/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing mdo tshar bzhi/ rgyan 'jug tshar gnyis re/ sngags rim tshar gnyis/ lam 100

rim tshar gsum/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ skal ldan rgya mtsho dang / mi pham zla ba/ a rol blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho rnams kyi gsung 'bum/ mar mi sogs kyi rnam thar/bde lam dang blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer sogs dpe sna tshogs dang / dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam tshar lnga bcu sogs dpe sna ring pod lnga bcu dang / sna thung pod bzhi bcu brgal ba bzhugs/yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel la sangs rgyas 'od srungs dang /bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'phel gdung rdog mang bo dang / sku bal dang sku gdung gi ring bsrel la ston pa'i sku rgya gar shar li 'khrul med cig rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i phyag par ston pa'i sku gsum dang /sgrol dkar sku stong tshar gcig tshe dpag med rje'i phyag tsha/ rje phyag nas brgya rtsa ma/ rje 'od zer ma/ byams mgon bla ma rin po che'i phyag par rje sku dang sgrol dkar/ 'jigs byed dbus sku/ rgyal ba bcu gsum pa chen po'i phyag par byams pa/ paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi gdung tshwa las bzhengs pa'i de'i 'dra sku/ chos rje don grub rin chen dang klong rdol bla ma gnyis kyi phyag tsha/ gzhan yang ston pa'i sku chig khri sum stong nyis brgya/byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis kyi sku 'bum ther re/ rje sku drug stong lnga brgya/kun rig sum stong brgyad cu/ gdugs dkar lnga stong brgyad brgya nyer bzhi/ ri bo rtse lnga'i 'jam dbyangs dang / rong bo'i 'jam dbyangs kun 101

gzigs gnyis kyi zhal phyis/ 'od srungs chen po'i phyag rten/ mar ba'i na bza'/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku chos snam sbyar dor bu dbu skra tshems par/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu zhwa/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i na bza' dang dbu zhwa/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku chos/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi sku 'gag rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi sku chos/ kau shrī blo gros seng ge'i dbu zhwa/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi bzhugs gding /rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ rgyal ba lnga ba chen po'i dbu zhwa na bza' gdungagyi tshwa rnams dang / sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs phyags/ shar ka ring dka' bcu phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi gdung rus lo rgyus can/ rgyal sras blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi na bza'/ stong skor mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag phyag phyis/ byang rtse 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims chos 'phel gyi na bza'/ chos pa rin po che'i dbu dom bzhugs gding /skyabs mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gdung rus sku chos sku gzan/ 'phags pa lha rgyal ba rgya mcho'i zhabs phyags/ ba so rje drung ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma'i sku 'gag kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i na bza'/ sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyi dbu zhwa/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seng ge'i sku 'gag skyabs mgon ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi sku chos/ khri chen ngag dbang 102

mchog ldan gyi sku 'gag rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i shangs mtshal sku 'gag dbu zhwa zhabs phyags/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi sku chos snam sbyar bzhugs gding bzhugs gdan/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i sku 'gagarje ngag dbang byams pa'i dbu ljon dbu zhwa/ rnga rgod nam mkha' seng ge'i zhal dkris/ rgyal sras bskal bzang thub bstan 'jigs med kyi dbu zhwa/khri ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku lcug skyabs mgon dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi na bza'/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dbu zhwa/rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku gzan gdung dkris/'jog ri ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi dbu skra/ paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dbu zhwa sku sham/ khri ngag dbang snyan grags kyi dbu zhwa/ dga' ldan gser khri rim byon gyi na bza'/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa sku gzan/rgyal mkhan chen blo bzang nyi ma dang / mog kya 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang /kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo gsum ga'i na bza'/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i dbu skra/ dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang /lcang skya ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang /rgyal ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho rnams kyi na bza'/a rig dge bshes chen mo'i dbu skra/ rje gser khang ba'i sku chos sku gzan sku lcug skyabs mgon chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbu lo sku 'gagargyal ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ paṇa chen dpal ldan chos grags 103

kyi na bza' snam sbyar/ skyabs mgon blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ thar shul dge 'dun chos skyong rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ a rol blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i sku thul sku gzan dbu lo/ grub chen brtsi bzhag pa'i dbu zhwa/ grub pa dung rna ba'i dbu skyes/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag shing bza' blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi dbu skra na bza' gdung dkris/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho'i shangs mtshal dbu skra mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs gnang skabs kyi sin+dha ra/ sgo dmar blo bzang rgya mtsho'i na bza'/rje 'jigs med bsam gtan gyi dbu skra dbu zhwa gdung dkris zhal dkris phyag phur smad g.yogs zhal 'don thum thugs dam sgrol ma'i gong gsham tshe ril phyag phreng phyag shan gyi lung bu rnams dang / bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i phyag mdud smad g.yogs phyag phreng sku gzan gdung dkris rnams dang / skyabs mgon skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra na bza' zheng bdun gdung dkris gdung tshwa sku gdung las babs pa'i bdud rtsi'i phab rgyun rnams dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gi na bza'/ bde thang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dbu ljon/ de dang da lta'i sprul sku'i na bza'/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag la kha blo bzang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ rje ngag dbang bstan dar 104

ba'i dbu skra/ a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi na bza' dbu skra tshe ril/ yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang blo bzang dpal ba'i dbu skra/ phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde dpal bzang bo'i sku sham bubs tshang dbu lo tshogs rdzas shangs mtshal spyan dar/g.yer gshong che ba ngag dbang bstan 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho'i dbu skra dang gnyan khrod du phebs skabs kyi nang mchod phab rgyun/gzhan yang / 'phel gdung brgya'i phab rgyun/ rten 'dus 'dzam gling spyi nor/ snang ba mtha' yas blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi mas bkras lhun byams sku chen mo bzhengs skabs kyi rten 'dus ril bu sogs rten 'dus kyi rigs mang bo/dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i bsnyen ril/ 'jam dbyangs blo 'phel gyi ril bu/ jo bo'i zhal khrus ril bu/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ rnam 'joms khrus ril/ skye bdun ril bu/ bde mchog dkar bo dang / tshe dpag med dang / sgrol dkar tshe ril sogs tshe ril gyi rigs mang bo/ ma ṇi dung phyur 'gro nges kyis bsgrubs pa'i ma ṇi ril bu/ byang chub shing gi lo ma/sku 'bum tsan+dan sdong bo'i cha shas yig 'bru rang byon du phebs pa/ de'i tsan+dan lo ma dang me tog ri bo rtse lnga'i kun bzang me tog bsil ba tshal gyi tsan+dan/ gnas chen mang bo'i gnas shug sde dge'i par khang 105

chen mo'i par glegs bkrus pa'i chab rgyun/ rgyud smad sa sngags dang lo gyon ril bu/ dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje dang / sang tshang sgyung gnas pa'i sa sngags/ dbang sdud me tog gsang chen slob bshad rim byon gyi sin+dha ra dang / brag dkar sprel rdzong gi sin+t+ra ra/ rin chen phye ma/ rgya mtsho chen po/ ma dros pa/ chu bo bzhi/ slob dpon pad+ma brdzus te 'khrungs pa'i mtsho sogs chu chen dang mtsho chen grags pa can phal cher gyi chu sna/ rdo rje gdan byang chub chen po'i pho brang / bya rgod phung bo'i ri/ mchod rten rnam dag bsil ba tshal/ wā rā ṇa sī/ma ga dha/r+ghaṃ ga la/ stag mo lus sbyin/rdo rje gling / bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa/ grub thob brgyad cu'i bzhugs gnas su grags pa/ 'phags pa a ti bzang po/ skyid grong bsam gtan gling / rkyang phug nam mkha' rdzong /rag ma byang chub rdzong / mi 'gyur brag dmar rdzong / brag dkar dbu ma rdzong / khang ba ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ zhing 'khor ma gru gsum/ rkang tshugs phug mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung bzhugs sa/ gangs ti se/ bal bo dza larnya ra/ tsā ri khrag 'dzags gtum mo ri/ shel dkar/sa skya/ snar thang / bkras lhun/rgyang rtse/ rong byams chen/ snye thang / lha sa/ gdan sa gsum/ yer ba/stag lung / rgod tshang / rwa sgreng / 'ol kha/bsam yas/ rtsed thang /byang gi dgon chen bzhi/ nan he/hrang te/ then cin/ pe cin/ zhi nan h+pho'u/ khrun tu h+pho'u/ lan gru/ zi ling sogs kyi sa 106

sna chu sna shing sna 'dzoms che ba dang / seng khrir 'dzam dkar nag gi 'bum khang re re/ tshogs bdag dang / gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ gter bum rnams zhib tshags su bsgrubs pa bzhugs shing / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug nas lo re bzhin yon chab 'bum bzhi re star chags su 'bul ba'i srol bzang bo btsugs pa yar ldan du gnas pa 'di lags so/ /de ltar du mdo las/ grags pa chen po mi pham pa'i/ /yon tan thams cad brjod mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar brjod kyis mi lang ba'i gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan nam mkha' ltar yangs pa'i rgyal ba mi pham pa'i sku brnyan bzhengs pas bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba ni/ mdo las/bsam mi khyab la dad rnams kyi/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /ces gsungs pa'i rigs pa yang dag gis dpog nus par ma zad/dran pa nyer bzhag las/ rten dang brten pa legs bskrun dang / /dge 'dun gnas mal bca' ba sogs/ /dge nas dge bar rtag tu 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba stong du yang / /dge ba yongs su chud mi za/ /zhes gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dang de'i yo byad bsgrubs pas 'phral yun thams cad du dge legs zad mi shes pas 'tsho ba dang / dge rtsa chud mi za ba'i myang 'das 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar gsungs pa sogs mchog gsum gyi rten bzhengs pa la phan yon dpag tu med par mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams 107

las gsungs pas gcig tu yi rang ba'i gnas kho nar zad la/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ de tshe sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun la yang skyabs song zhing / /dge ba'i las kyang byas na ni/ /nga yi bstan la lhag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa 'jig rten 'dir dar ba'i tshe mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas mchog gsum gyi rten la phyag mchod skor ba sogs bsod nams kyi las cung zad cig byas na yang rje btsun byams pa'i bstan pa dang mjal te gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub par gsungs pas zhing khyad par can la mjal ba'i dus su bsod nams kyi phung bo rang rgyud la sdud ci thub byas te dal 'byor la snying bo rnam par dag pa len pa la 'bad par rigs so//smras pa/ rnam dkar dge ba zla ba'i rjes 'gro bas/ /thub bstan spyi dang blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /dus mthar 'gal rkyen sprin gyis mi sgrib par/ /kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma'i dpal 'dzin shog /ljongs 'dir grags pa gsal ldan ma lus pa'i/ /gtsug tor mdzes pa skyed mkhas pad dkar 'chang / /blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho yi/ /zhabs brtan 'phrin las phyogs med rgyas gyur cig /'dus bzang chos gling khrims ldan yangs pa'i sde/ /gang 'dir bshad sgrub bya bas nyin mtshan du/ /brel bas lung rtogs mdzod brgyas mngon mtho ba/ /skal bzang skye bos yongs su gang bar shog /'brel thogs kun kyang tshe rabs pad+mo'i 108

phreng / /dge legs sbrang rtsi'i thigs pas yongs gtams te/ /gtan bde bsnyengs pa med pa chos kyi grong / /ring min longs su spyod pa'i dpal thob shog /mtha' dbus 'jig rten kun gsal yangs pa'i khyim/ /cher snyigs sgra gcan khros pas mi 'dzin par/ /bde skyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ste/ /snang ba dkar bos 'gro rnams skyong bar smon/ /ces rka sar dgon 'dus bzang chos gling gi byams khang gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag rten tho dang bcas pa mdor bsdus par bkod pa mnyan 'os sbrang rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'dus sde de nyid kyi rgan las sne thun mong nas rab dkar lha rdzas dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/chos smra ba mi pham dbyangs can dges pa'i rdo rjes 'phral mar bris pa dge legs su gyur cigade ltar sgrub pa'i sde chen po 'dus bzang chos gling 'dir ngo mtshar brgya yis mtshon mi nus pa'i gzhal med khang rten 'du khang dang lha /lang sogs rjes cher mngon par mdzes pa'i sgeg nyams kyis zur mda' 'phangs pas/ 'jig rten na dregs ldan lha'i khang bzang yang ngo gnong ste rang mal du mnal ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa dang / brten pa mchog gsum rin po che'i rten byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba ston mtshan gyi gza' skar rnams cig car du sa 'dir 'phos pa ltar bgrang gis mi lang ba rten brten pa bcas lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing gi mchog tu da lta 109

bzhugs sam snyam na/ de ni ga la yin te/ 'jig rten na rnyed par dka' bar grags pa'i rin chen nor las kyang ches cher shin tu nas kyang rab tu dkon pa'i mchog gsum dam pa'i rten gyi rigs rnams zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'am shul med du bgyis so/ /ji ltar bgyis na/spyir snyigs ma rnam lnga ha cang bdodheba'i dbang gis lus can rnams ya rabs dam pa'i las la mi dga' bar snying thag pa nas smad pa dang / ma rabs nag po'i las la chu bo thur du rgyug pa ltar 'bad 'bungs lhun grub tu song bas spyi mthun gyi las kyis nongs pa sha stag yin par gsungs pa dang / khyad par du nag po mi dge ba'i las la shin tu rangs shing sems can gyi bde rtsa 'phrog pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa gdug rtsub can gyi las tshe rabs mang bo'i bar du bsags te/ log smon gyi bdag 'bras rang dgar du spyod pa lus med bdag pos dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi'i g.yul bshams te lnga bdo'i mtshon cha ring du byo bas bstan pa bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi sde bcas lo grangs nyer gsum yas ma'i bar lhag med du bcom pas da lta de rnams dran yul tsam du song ba'i skabs 'di gleng na su zhig la phangs sems mi skye zhes go bar bya'o/ /'o na de dag da lta zhal mi bzhugs pas de rnams gleng ba'i dgos pa ci zhe na/ 'u bu cag gi drin ldan pha mes yang mes rnams kyis ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam bde rtsa kho na bskrun ched rang khas shig dang mi 'dra bar dka' ba brgya phrag du ma 110

khyad bsad kyis rang la bdog pa gang 'byor gyis sku gsung thugs rten rnams lo grangs kha shas shig la bzhengs pa ma yin par/ mi rabs mang bo'i bar bskrun pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba'i rten rnying gna' rdzas 'gangs chen da gzod mthong thos dran reg gi yul las 'das pa rnams ngo mtshar ba'i khyad chos rang bzhin ldan par shes shing rang cag rnams la da lta dngos mjal gyi skal ba ches dben yang / dus rtag tu mchog gsum la blo phugs bcol te tshe snga phyi dang las 'bras la yid rton pa'i ngang nas/ mngon lkog med par bsam pa yar sems dang / spyod pa ya rabs rnams lag tu bstar te pha shul bus zin pa la thabs brgya jus stong gis zhum med snying stobs kyi go cha bgos te/ sngon gyi skyes chen gnam gyis sa bkab pa ltar yon tan mi zad pa'i gter du gyur pa rim par byon pa dag gi phyag rjes bla na med pa rnams rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/pha mes kyi srol bzang rnams nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel gyi phyir sgo gsum bag med kyi dbang du ma btang bar brtson pa lhod med cig bya dgos so zhes go bar bya ba'i ched du sngon gyi lo rgyus rnams mgo 'bus tsam dran rten du bris pa lags so//111

sde 'jir bstan pa yang dar gyi rabs bshad pa/tshogs gnyis mi zad yid bzhin nor bu'i 'bru/ /rnam par spungs pa 'dren la 'phrul 'degs cher/ /nye bar sbyor ba'i dge mtshan snang ba'i 'dzum/ /legs par spro ba'i sa mkhan de rnams mchod/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum 'phrin las don zhags rtse/ /dad ldan bye ba'i gser gyi a long la/ /rnam par rtsen pas 'phral yun 'dod pa'i don/ /sgyu ma'i 'phrul du 'char ba dge ba'i gshis/ /dus kyi srin po khros pa'i mche ba gang / /gtsigs pas mchog gsum rten bzang khye'u'i lus/ /ches cher ma bsnad gling 'di'i gser ldan mar/ /til 'bru tsam las phra ba'i skal bar spyod/ /de lta na'ang bsam spyod dge ba can/ /dad gtong rgyan ldan bde gshegs 'phrin las che/ /nye bar 'jug pa'i snod ldan du gyur pas/ /sde 'di'i bstan pa'i me ro nye bar gsos/ /'di lta'i ngang tshul 'di nyid ma 'khrul bar/ / brjod pa'i dkar chag brjod bya snying bo'i lus/ /rnam gsal 'byed pa'i rnam gzhag dgongs mdzod dang / /dge 112

bar byed pa'i dge mtshan srid na thang / /des na bstan pa yang dar gyi rabs bshad pa la/ 'du khang chen mo ji ltar bzhengs tshul dang / byams khang ji ltar bzhengs tshul/ lha mo khang dang chos 'khor khang sogs gsar du bskrun tshul lo// de yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen po'i rigs kyi cod pan rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i gsu/nga las/ byams brtse'i bdag nyid rnam 'dren skal ldan rje'i/ /rlabs chen 'phrin las nyi 'od kyis phye ba'i/ /bshad sgrub pad+ma'i tshal rab rgyas pa'i sde/ /rig grol bsung zhim 'thul ba grangs mtha' yas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgrub brgyud 'khor lo bcu ba'i shing rta bsnyengs pa med par 'dren pa'i byed po/ gangs can me tog phog pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho sku phreng rim byon gyi thun mong min pa'i 'phrin las la brten nas mdo smad lho rgyud re skong gser mo ljongs zhes grags pa'i zhing 'dir bshad pa'i gdan sa chen po shrī nā len+d+ra gnyis pa rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen dang /sgrub pa'i gdan sa chen po gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyil gnyis gtsor bzhugs kyi khrims ldan 'dus pa'i dga' tshal bgrang las 'das pa rab yangs kun gsal ngos la rgyu skar dang nor 'dzin gyi gzhi la dpag bsam bzhin du 113

rnam par bkra ba'i ya gyal rka sar dgon 'dus bzang chos gling zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i sde chen po 'dir garnyo la rten brten pa ji ltar bzhengs pa'i tshul brjod pa ni 'dir las su bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /de bzhengs pa'i tshul ji ltar gleng snyam na/ lung rigs kyi spros pa mang ba dag ni bsdus/ brda snying dang go dka' ba'i rigs kyi nyams ni spangs/ go sla zhing brjod 'os pa'i khungs ldan gtam gyi rgyud dag ni gsal bar byas te brjod par spro'o/ /de la rnam pa du zhig ce na/ sngon rabs kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba dang / da lta ji ltar byung ba dang 'brel ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra dha ra 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ ngag gi dbang bor yongs grub dge ba'i dbyangs/ /mi pham legs byas nam mkha'i ngos yangs las/ /cig car bzhad pa'i grags dkar zla ba'i rlabs/ /srid zhir g.yo ba gang des zhes bsngags pa ltar/gna' snga mo nyid nas mkha' khyab kyi lus can yongs la phan bde zad mi shes pa sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun la bla na med pa'i sri zhu chen pos lhag par bya ba byas pa/shes rab lha gcig ngag dbang lha mo'i byin rlabs 'od dkar gyis nye bar 'khyud pas chung dus nas blo gros kyi kun da'i 'dab stong mngon par grol ba/ mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i gtsug lag rnyog pa dang bral ba'i snying bcud kun tu 'grem pa la legs smon gyi mthu grub cing / khyad par du 114

phul byung snyan dngags la sogs pa rin chen gsum gyi dga' ston spel ba la mtshungs zla ma mchis pa/ gnas lnga kun gzigs bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba zhes grags snyan gsar ba'i bsung zhim sa steng du khyab pa de nyid kyis rab byung bcu gsum pa'i bgrang bya zhe gcig me lug spyi lo1787lo rang lo nyer gcig bzhes tshe chos kyi sde chen po 'dus bzang chos gling phyag 'debs mdzad nas sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba phon che ba sogs bzhengs te bka' drin bskyangs pa nas/sku phreng bzhi ba rje blo bzang don yon rgya mtshos 'du khang rgya bskyed de rten gsum gyi bzhengs bkod rnams gong du bshad zin pa ltar/ phul byin grub pa'i skye dgu'i snying gi gsos sman dang mig gi bdud rtsir gyur te rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston la ngoms med du rol ba'i skabs nyid na/ rab rgyal bgrang bya so gnyis pa sa khyi/ spyi lo1958lor rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la nyams 'grib chen po byung ste/ gangs can bod kyi bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sa bla na ma mchis pa bde ba'i 'byung gnas sku gsung thugs rten phon che ba'i 'phrin las kyi mjug bsdus so/ /de nas yang bgrang bya bzhi bcu me rta spyi lo1966lo la mchog gsum gyi rten la lha 'dre gdon bgegs zhes ming du btags pa'i ngan g.yo gdug rtsub can gyi zing 'tshub bslangs skabs/ sde 'di'i 'du khang chen mo sogs shul med du yid srubs dpung tshogs kyis bgyis so/115

'du khang chen mo ji ltar bzhengs tshul/sngon gyi 'du khang sogs 'jig ste da lta'i 'du khang gsar ba ji ltar byung ba dang 'brel gang zhe na/ de la rnam pa gsum du brtag par bya ste/dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang gi rnam gzhag bshad pas mdor bstan/bya ba bsgrubs tshul bstan pas rgyas par bshad/ bsgrubs pa'i gtsug lag khang bskyangs tshul dang der ji ltar bya ba bshad pas don bsdu ba'o//dang po ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnams su dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang dang spyil khang gi rnam gzhag mang du gsungs na yang 'dir 'dul ba'i mdo las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin en tsam brjod par bya ste/ de yang slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdo rtsa bar/ gtsug lag khang bya'o/ /zhes dang / lag gi blas 'gro ba dang 'ong ba dang ldan pa'i gzhir gtsug lag khang rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rung ba'i gzhi tshad ldan du gtsug lag khang rtsig pa na gru bzhi pa'i ngos gcig gi dbus su dri gtsang khang dang / de'i mdun du sgo khang dang / khyams gsum pa dang / skyed tshal dang / rdzing bu dang / 'chag sa dang bste gnas la sogs pa sbyin bdag gis phul ba'i rgyu chud mi za bar lag gi blar bskos nas tshul mthun du brtsig par bya zhing / de yang dge slong dang dge slong ma'i gtsug lag khang rim par lnga brtsegs sum brtsegs mtho tshad dang / dri gtsang khang dang / sgo khang steng gi bsil 116

khang brtsegs ma gnyis kyis lhag pa bya'o/ /sgo dang / sgo glegs dang /lag bzung dang / yang mig dang / skar khur dang / de'i sgo glegs dang /ba dang / 'khor gtan dang / gnam gzer dang/ 'phred gtan dang /dbyu gu skam kha sogs gtsug lag khang gi yan lag rnams bsgrub pa dang /so phag gi gcal rim pa bdun bkram pa nas mda' yab kyi bar rim par brtsegs pa dang / them skas dang / ya gad dang / so phag bkram pa dang /shing gi spang leb gding ba sogs bya 'os pa de dang der bya ba dang / seng ge'i khri dang / de'i them skas dang / rkang rten dang / bla bre dang / lda ldi dang / 'phyang 'phrul dang / 'phan rnams chos 'chad pa'i don du 'du bya ba dang / gzhan yang bya rgya dang /khyams kyi spang leb sogs dang / 'khor gyi khyams zlum po dang /dpong sa'i khang ba dang / 'chag sa'i khang ba dang /glo 'bur dang / grwa khang dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / gang zag gi gtsug lag khang bya tshul sogs gtsug lag khang ji ltar rtsig pa'i tshul rgyas par gsungs so/ /sngon po la sogs pa zad par gyi mtshan ma mngon du bya ba'i phyir gnas khang gi rtsig pa dag sngon po la sogs pa rnam pa bzhir bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar tshon rtsi gtong ba dang / gtsug lag khang dang dri gtsang khang gi sgo dang / zas khang / bsdo khang /mdzod khang sogs kyi sgor gnod sbyin dang / 'khor ba'i 'khor lo dang /khor yug tu sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang / khyams su skyes rabs dang / dpong sa'i 117

khang bar gnas brtan gyi gral dang / me khang du brul bum sogs dang /chu khang du klu dang / nad pa'i rung khang du bde bar gshegs pas nad g.yog mdzad pa dang / bshang gci'i skyabs su dur khrod sogs ri mo ji ltar 'bri ba'i tshul dang / mchod rten gyi rnam pa gnyis te/ zhes sogs kyis mchod rten gyi rnam gzhag dang / de ji ltar bya tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gtsug lag khang du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs bya ba dang /de la mchod rdzas dang rgyan dang yo byad sogs kyis bkur ste bya ba dang / de la rgyun dang dus so so'i mchod pa bya ba dang / de grong khyer du gshegs pa sogs kyi bya ba rgyas par gsungs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ de la gsum ste/ yul gang du bzhengs pa/ dus nam bzhengs pa/ji ltar bzhengs pa'i tshul lo/ /de la yul gang du bzhengs she na/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing gi mtha' yongs su mi dmigs pa las gzhi dang snying bo me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni mchog gi sprul sku gcig gi 'dul ba'i zhing ngo / /'dzam gling zhes bya ba bye ba phrag brgya'i dbus na gang yod pa'i 'jig rten ni 'o skol gnas sa'i gzhi yin la de las 'dzam gling chung ngu la dum bu drug tu bgos pa'i bod kyi le lag tu gtogs pa na re skong zhes bya ba'i yul chen po yod do/ /yul de'i 'dren pa dam pa snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang ba skyabs 118

mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho zhes mtshan snyan srid zhir g.yo ba gang gi 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa lhun gyis grub pa'i 'od snang gis nye bar 'khyud pa'i yul dang ljongs dpag tu med pa'i nor 'dzin yangs pa'i lto bar khre tse bzhi zhes bya ba'i ming chags pa yod par blta'o/ /de las rka sar du 'bod pa'i grong brdal te/ de'i sa yi snying bor 'dus bzang chos gling zhes bya pa'i sgrub pa'i sde chen po bzhugs pa'i dbus su gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa gang du bzhengs pa'i yul du blta bar bya'o//dus nam bzhengs pa ni/ gangs ljongs tshad ma'i ston pa 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo shar tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal rab byung drug pa'i gser 'phyang me bya spyi lo1357lo la sprul ba'i zlos gar bsgyur nas mi lo drug brgya dang nyer bzhi 'das nas nyer lnga pa/ mdo khams bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyin byed rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho dpal bzang po rab byung bcu pa'i spre'u zhes pa'i me lug spyi lo1607lor sku 'khrungs nas bgrang gzhi sum brgya dang don bzhi 'das don lnga pa gnas lnga kun gzigs ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje btsun bis pa mi pham zla ba dpal bzang po rab me'i thams cad 'dul zhes pa me phag spyi lo1767lor gzugs sku'i nyi ma dang por shar nas bgrang bya nyis brgya dang bcu bzhi 'das nas bco lnga pa lcags bya/ spyi lo1981lor 'du khang bzhengs rgyu'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di nyid gsar du sgrub pa'i dbu 119

btsugs te/rab rgyal bgrang bya nga bdun chu phag la gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas legs par grub zin par bgyis pa yin no//ji ltar bzhengs pa'i tshul gang zhe na/ de la gnyis te/ rten gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / brten pa sku gsung thugs rten sogs bzhengs pa'o/ /dang po/ de yang chos sde 'di'i rten gsum 'gangs chen yod do cog rten dang brten par bcas pa bsreg za'i dpung tshogs kyis khyur mid byas te lo grangs nyer gnyis pa'i lcags sprel la phyag na pad+mo rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ nam mkha'i dbyings na zla ba gcig nyid kyang / /sa yi steng na chu snod ji snyed par/ /grangs bzhin 'char ba'i ya mtshan 'dir ltos dang / /bsam yas rgyal ba'i rol ba yid la 'bab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa lhun gyis grub pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ gzhan phan gyi me tog dkar po mkha' khyab tu bzhad pa la dus las ma yol bar 'jug pa la thogs pa med pas/gzhar yang bstan pa'i nyin byed dbang bo shar ri'i rtse nas re skong gser ljongs 'dzin mar nye bar shar bas mya ngan mun pa'i gdung ba mtha' dag bsal/ bde skyid kyi pad dkar lhug par bzhad de dpal nā len dra gnyis pa rig 'byung zhing gi phan bde'i 'byung gnas rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen bde chen chos 'khor gling gi chos kyi sgo brgya gtan pa med par phyes zin na'ang / chos sde 'dir sna sgor mo nas de 'dra'i mthun rkyen ma 120

'dzoms shing / gong nas chog mchan ma bkod pa'i dbang gis chos sgo 'byed ma thub par lus/ de'i phyis chog mchan thob kyang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i dga' tshal bzhad pa'i sde rnams bzhugs sa'i gtsug lag khang gis phongs pa na/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal sel ba dang / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa kho na'i rjes su 'gro ba yin zhing / rgyal bstan rin po che yun ring du gnas mi gnas kyang chos 'dul ba'i las dang nan tan byed pa po yod med la rag las pa yin te/ lung las/ gang na las kyang yod/nan tan byed pa'ang yod pa de na dam pa'i chos gnas pa zhes bgyi'o/ /gang na las kyang med/ nan tan byed pa'ang med pa de na dam pa'i chos zhig pa zhes bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod gnas mi gnas kyang 'dul ba'i sde snod la 'chad nyan byed pa yod med la ltos shing / 'dul ba la sogs pa'i sde snod gsum la 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas lung gi bstan pa gnas pa'i gzhi ni/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo shar tsong kha pa chen pos/ lha mi'i bsod nams zhing gi mchog /thub pa'i brtul zhugs legs bzung nas/ /lung gi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i 121
