gzhi/ /chos sde chen po/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dge 'dun gyi sde'o/ /de lta bu'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i cha rkyen du garnyo la cis kyang bzhengs dgos par dgongs nas/ chos sde 'di'i ched du sku srog la'ang mi ltos pa'i snying stobs can ri stag blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis/ zla lnga pa'i tshes la 'tsho byed gzhon nu gnyis pa tho gya'i sman pa 'brug byams mkhar nyid kyis/ gong ma'i dbu bla/ rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i rigs kyi cod pan sku phyogs chu bzang rin po che'i yang sprul blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gang nyid rang yul du spyan drangs te 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i dbang stsal skabs/ chos sde 'di'i lo rgyus rnams zhu gsol gyi mthar/ zla re re'i dgu gsum la 'dod khams dbang mor bskang gsol dang 'phrin bcol ma chad par skya ser mang bo'i re 'dod ltar gyis dang don chen 'grub yong zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ zla bcu pa'i tshes la rka sar gyi mdun gros la dbang ba'i che dgu rnams 'dus te 'du khang gsar bzhengs dang chos sgo 'byed phyogs la gros bsdur dgongs 'char gnang skabs/ gcig ni lo nyi shu rtsa lhag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lhag med du byas tshul dang / gnyis de ka'i ring la gzhan shugs kyis rang dbang bral ba dang / gsum sems can la 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal gyis 'byor ba'i nyams dma' ba dang slar yang srid jus 'gyur ldog byung na ci byed snyam pa'i tshom nyi'i dra bar tshud nas sngon gyi shugs rkyen thebs pa na/122

rka sar kyi sde dpon yar skor klu 'bum zhes pa gzhan phan gyi las la brtson pa'i lhag bsam yar zla'i rjes su snyegs pa'i dge ba can gzhan dring mi 'jog pa thabs mkhas rang bzhin ldan pa'i snying stobs can gang nyid kyi 'char sgor/ sngar 'du khang gsar bzhengs phyogs la rang gi phu bos kyang rkyen dbang gis rngo ma thogs par de'i don du 'das/ da cha gtsug lag khang bzhengs rgyu'i bgo skal rang la bab yod snyam ste/ lta ngan lhur len pa'i nag phyogs bdo yang gang la'ang ma 'dzem par dpa' gdeng bskyed de bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i 'gan gtso'i khur chen bla nas blar bteg ste/ gzhan las sne ba mgo 'dug 'tsho ba'i lha 'bum dang /yang gya'i gdugs dkar/ yar skor yi dam/ ser sa nas a khu blo bzang sangs rgyas bcas lag gi blar bsko bzhag mdzad do/ /de nas hor zla bcu gcig pa'i dkar tshes bzang bor srung ma la bskang gsol dang 'phrin bcol btang ste/ rang gi btsugs shing ma sdong gcod sar phyin nas lha bsangs dkar gtor gser skyems bcas phul nas yul bdag gi lha klu la 'phrin bcol byas 'phral/ sdong gcod mi nyi shu rtsa grangs kyis las mgo brtsams/ de nas hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug la gahod mtshams bzhag ste ngal gsos so/ /de nas lcags bya lo'i hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu gsum bkra shis pa'i nyin 'gan len sne mo ba a khu blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis/ ji skad du/ sa rdo rje 'dra ba'i rked pa ru/ /mi 123

khyed kyis sgrub brgyud bstan pa spel/ /zhes bya ba'i lung gis zin pa rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho gang gi chos kyi gdung 'tshob dam pa/ bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bdag cag gi rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po zhes dus kyi mtha' na skye dgu ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/ 'gro ba'i sgron me/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pur gyur pa de ni/ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / de'i dgongs 'grel tshad mar gyur pa'i 'phags bod gyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu dang / thun mong rig pa'i gtsug lag 'bum sde'i don thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul du gra ma nyams par babs pa/ mang du thos don gang ji snyed pa de thams cad lam gyi lus gcig tu dril ba'i bsam pa dang sgom pa la thun dang thun mtshams su bcad nas rtse gcig tu bsgrubs pas mdo sngags kyi nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa klong du brdol zhing /rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las sa chen po'i rgyan du gyur pa che btsan rnam gnon gyi gzi brjid mtshungs zla ma mchis pas yongs kyi brtan pa 'phrog par byed pa la don yod 'phrul gyi zhags pa bzhin du spyod pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la zla dang bral ba'i gsung gi 'od zer gyi dra ba phra mo tsam gyis kyang skal ldan gyi 'dul bya kun gyi blo gros kyi pad+mo legs bshad zil dngar gyi lcid rdzogs par byed pa la dus 'dir blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 124

gdung 'tshob tu gyur pa sogs dpag dka'i yon tan rin po che'i gan mdzod zad mi shes pa mnga' ba sogs chos kyi 'byor ba rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i dngos po rgya chen dkrigs pa'i bang mdzod la dgyes dgur spyod pa'i chos kyi rgyal bo chen po'i mdun sa mchog tu/ chos sde rang gi lugs gnyis kyi bgyi ba gang ci thams cad mi nyams yar rgyas kyi skyabs 'jug dgongs bsnams dgos tshul dang khyad par du gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs la 'gal rkyen bral zhing mthun rkyen rnams bde blag tu 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug nan tan chen pos zhu gsol mdzad de lha dar bcas phul/ de nas thams cad mkhyen pas kyang 'du byed las kyi snga phyi'i rim pa rnams dbang phyug gi ral klong gi rgyun bzhin gang cir ljags bkod kyis khyab par mdzad/ de nas bzhengs rgyu'i dngos chas rnams bsgrigs dgos tshul dang 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi thog ma'i gtam spyi khyab tu bsgrags te/ mdo rtsa bar/ gtsug lag khang bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don phyag len du bstar ba'i dbu btsugs/ gzhan yang bsko bzhag gi rim pa rnams cha tshang bzhag pa na thams cad kyis 'gan blang dang len sgos hur brtson rbad chod kyi sems rgya bskyed de spro dga' dang bcas 'du khang bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen rnams rang sde'i 'byor ba dang bstun te bsgrigs ci thub dang /mdo rtsa bar/ sbyin pa pos rjes su gnang na gtsug lag khang bya ba'i dngos po las de'i bya ba'i spyad bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'du khang 125

bzhengs pa po bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rka sar la yang skabs der 'byor ba ha cang rgyas pa'i dus skabs min pas skye dgu'i srog 'phrog lta ngan rig gsar gyis phung la sbyar bas gcig ni kun gyi bsam pa'i khyer so dman pa dang / gnyis ni zhing las la gnyer dbang bral bas lo ltar lo legs ma byung stabs mi'i lto gos kyang ches zhan pas 'gal rkyen kun tshogs pa'i skabs lags na'ang / rang sde nas 'du khang gser bzhengs la mkho ba'i yo byad gang cha nas yod dgu bton te legs par bsgrigs/ de dang mthun par gegs sel du spyi sger nas rim gro dang bstan srung la 'phrin bcol bla lhag tu bsgrubs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig la rang sde'i yar skor tsho ba'i shing dpon chos skyabs dang / mgo 'dug tsho ba'i shing dpon don 'grub gnyis kyis gtsos shing bzo ngo g.yog bcu gnyis kyis/ 'gan bteg sne mo ba rnams dang kha 'grig gros mthun gyis bslab bkod ji ltar stsal gnang bzhin bcad bzo 'dra gzhog kun la tshegs zhib legs thon bgyis/ de mtshungs su/ mdo rtsa bar/ lag gi blas 'gro ba dang 'ong ba dang ldan pa'i gzhir gtsug lag khang rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /shing ljon pa dang / rdzing bu dang 'chag sa dag kyang ngo / /nyen kor dang ngo / /rgyun lugs dang klag cor dang sgra dang tug rigs chung bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nag zla3tshes10la gyang dpon mgo 'dug dpal ldan dang sde dpon klu 'bum/ shing dpon don 'grub/126

chos skyabs sogs kyis 'du khang bzhengs sa'i go sar sngar gyi 'du khang la bltos na srid zheng la gyan gang re rgya bskyed de thig chen btab pa ltar mkhar las kyi bya ba mtha' dag gi khur 'bogs sa sde dpon gtsos las byed rnams kyis gyang rting gi sa dpangs lag khru gsum lhag dang zheng tshad lag khri phyed dang lnga tsam phyung ste rdo lag skyor 'phrul 'khor che ba lnga bcu lhag phye ma 'phrul 'khor che ba nyer lnga tsam/ ar 'dam rgya ma stong phrag brgyad bcas rim blugs kyis rmang gzhi sra brtan nan chags su bzos te lcags ri ltar mkhregs par gyur/ mdo rtsa bar/ ngos gcig gi dbus su dri gtsang khang bya ba nyid do/ /de'i mdun du sgo khang ngo / /gru bzhi bzang ba nyid do/ /khyams gsum pa yang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa dang phyogs mthun par 'du khang gsar ba gyan bdun can ka ba ring thung brgyad cu sku khang ngam kun dga' ra ba sgo 'phyor dang bcas thig chen btab pa dang bstun rtsig pa gsar bzhengs kyi mgo brtsams te gyang dpon dpal ldan ngo g.yog bcas la las grogs su rang sde'i yar skor tsho ba gsum dang /mgo 'dug gam dpon skor tsho ba/ de de yang gya sogs kyi khyim mi rnams nyin rer ma chad pa dang / de skabs rig gnas gsar brje'i shugs rkyen gyis chos srid kyi gyong gud chen po byung stabs kyis 'byor ba dman zhing gzhan dbang yin pas spyi gzhung nas dga' ston dang ster cha phar zad kun la ja tshun tsam bza' btung yang dkon tshod du gda' na yang /127

mi byings kyis khral dang khrims ma yin par ched gnyer gyis rang rang dga' dad spro gsum 'gran pa bzhin du gsung mchog yi ge drug ma'i gdangs dbyangs dang bcas mkhar las la rim 'khod sgos nyin rer las byed pa brgya dang drug cu lhag 'dzoms te nyin bco brgyad ring legs grub byung / de nyid las/ gzhag pa'i khang ba sbyin no/ /zhes pa dang phyogs mtshungs su/ de dus dgon par grwa shag gcig kyang lus med pas/bzo ba rnams la khang chung gyan gsum bzhi tsam zhig bgyis te shing bzo ngo g.yog bcu gnyis lhag gis shing gzhog gtub dang / shing rko bas gzhu ring gzhu thung gi khar pa tra mtshon don can/ pad+ma chos brtsegs me tog phreng ba sogs rko ba'i bzo grwa btsugs/de las 'du khang rnying ba'i ka ba sogs lus yod pa'i khar sde dpon gyis blon che'i nags las khang la 'brel gtugs byas te shing cha 'phrul 'khor che ba gsum tsam blangs/ sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la sde dpon sogs mi bzhis 'dra shing rnams rong bo'i 'phrul 'khor kha nas dras gtub sogs la nyin du mar brtson/ de nas 'gan bteg pa blo bzang sangs rgyas sogs kyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs par g.yo sgyu sogs rkyen ngan pa'i dbang du ma btang bar rtse gcig pas nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu brtson pa'i skal ba bzang po lag rtser 'byor/'dul ba'i mdor/ so phag gi gcal bdun nam brgyad gzhug go zhes pa dang mthun par/ ka rting so so'i sa dpangs mi tshad tsam phyung ba'i shul 128

sa rim pas bkang ste sra mkhregs su brdungs pa sogs snga na med pa'i 'du byed kyi las la ches cher 'bad/ de nyid las/ de'i steng du ka rten gyi spang leb po/ /de'i steng du ka ba'i rtsar dag go /de dag gi steng du ka gzhu'i 'dab ma dag go /de dag gi steng du gdung ma dag go /de dag gi steng du phyam dag go /de dag gi steng du so phag dag dgram mo/ /de dag gi steng du so phag gi phye ma'i 'jim pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rim par bsgrubs te/ tshes gsum la chu thig 'phen pa dang / ka rdo rnams bzhagade nas lnga pa'i tshes bzhi bkra shis pa'i nyin la ka ba gsar du bslangs par/ gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'gro 'dren dam pa/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho gtsos/mtshungs med skyabs rje kha so blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las dang tshogs chen dge bskos gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang bo gser ljongs bstan pa'i srog shing a khu rin po che dge 'dun bstan 'dzin/ byings 'dren dam pa rdo rje thar sogs che dgu sku 'khor lhan rgyas bcas chos sde chen po rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling nas/ sde 'di'i stag shar rta bsu mang bas sa chen gyi rdul la co 'dri zhing / dad spro'i ngang lha rgyal lo zhes ku co'i sgra skad sa bla 'gengs pa dang /'phyor sgeg can gzhon nu pho mo mang bos snying bo 'bru drug sgra dbyangs kyis tshangs dbyangs kyang dman par byas te dad pa'i mdzes rtsal mig 'phrul bzhin gyur pa sogs rta bsu rkang bsu 129

ser sbong sna sogs kyis bsus te spyan drangs pas/ sngar dus kyis mnar zhing blo pham tshad med thog tu babs nas sdug bsngal mun pa'i dra bar dbang med du tshud pa las nye bar grol te kun la bde dga' zad mi shes pa rjogs ldan gsar ba'i dus ston mig mthong lag zin du grub/ de nas chos sde rang gi dpyod ldan blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis 'khar rnga rdung zhing tshogs chen dge bskos kyis chos gos ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gyis bklubs te chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te gso sbyong la 'tshogs/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i 'du khang gi chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sor bskyod de/gser zhal dung gi tshems bar nas 'phrul gyi ljags bskyangs te dam chos rin po che so sor thar ba'i mdo gsungs nas dge tshul slong grangs tshang pas bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong blangs/ gnas bcu dang sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma sogs smon lam dang shis brjod rab gnas sogs kyis mthar brgyan te bkra shis pa'i 'bras dkar gyi me tog 'thor zhing byin char phab ste dge zhing legs pa'i bshad sgrub 'khor lo'i mdzad bzang sogs gnas 'dir yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo brgya bsgrigs/ de nas sku mdun rin po che nas sde 'di'i lus can yongs la phyag dbang gnang zhing brtse gzigs kyis bsngags brjod dang bcas sgor brgya phrag du ma/ ja lan chen dang ja bag gos yug lha dar sogs mtshams skyes gnang zhing slan chad kyang rten bzhengs sogs la 'bad sgos tshul las brtsams 130

te bkod khyab lhu things pa stsal bas bka' drin bskyangs/ rin po che tshang la 'bru rigs ja bag sgor lha dar sogs dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba bteg kyang phyir slog a lag kha so tshang gis kyang 'du khang gsar bzhengs la ja dang sgor mo sogs gnang ba la phyir dngos rdzas gya nom pa phul yang ma bzhes/ gzhan dge bskos sogs la yang phyag 'gyed mi dman pa phul ba sogs kyi sgo nas mang ma'i re 'dod ltar bde blag tu grubaspus sde 'di'i ser skya pho mo'i yid la bde skyid kyi nyi ma thog mar shar/ de nas bzung dgon 'dir dus 'brel gso sbyong rgyun chags su tshugs/ yongs grags ltar gdung dar dang shing dpon gnyis la dngos skyes dang kha btags la sogs pa dga' ston phun tshogs mdzad kyang / de dag gis kyang lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas kha btags tsam yang ma blangs par slar phul te las la brtson/ sngon gyi 'du khang la ka ring gnyis las med kyang /'dir ka ring bzhi dang bcas thar chags su ka ba rnams bslangs te las byed yongs kyis stobs shugs gcig sgril gyis sla chos dang khral chos su ma song bar dad spro dang blang gis thog 'gebs pa sogs la 'bad de/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes16la las ka phal cher grub zin pas mang mas las mtshams bzhag de nas ston las grub 'phral sde dpon dang shing bzo ba rnams kyis slar yang bya ba'i mgo btsugs te sgo mang la sogs pa'i ngo shing rnams 'grub rag gi bar dka' spyad dang len sgos hur thag mdzad de skye 131

ba'i phreng bar blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mjal ba'i bag chags brtan po 'jog pa'i rmang gzhi gting tshugs pa byung / chu khyi lo'i hor zla dang po'i tshes17la lhag bsam can sde dpon klu 'bum bza' tshos dka' las dang len gyis nags nas spen ma rgyu bzang ba bung bu'i khal do phab 'phral phyi de nyin sde ba'i khyim tsho re res kyang ya rabs kyi las la 'bad de spen ma tshegs med du 'dus/ de nas spen kha dang mda' yab sogs kyi mkho chas rnams bsgrigs te hor zla3tshes5la gyang bzo ba dang shing bzo ba rnams rang rang gi las grwa btsugs/ sngar lo las lo 'di kar 'byor ba cung tsam rgyas te las byed rnams la spyi gzhung na ja kha gcig tsam btung rgyu yod pa byung / spyi dpon klu 'bum dang dpal ldan ngo g.yog gis spen kha bsgrigs pa'i mgo brtsams nas gzhan las byed mang tshogs kyis dad spro'i ngang spen ma bcad dkris tshos bsgyur sogs la rem nas nyin du ma'i ring phyogs bzhi'i spen kha rim gyis bsgrigs te ngos phya le ba dang mdog legs spus bzang sogs gang cha nas khyad mtshar snga na med par grub 'phral/ shing dpon rnams dang 'brel nas mda' yab legs ched du gzhan gtsug lag khang gi mda' yab kyi ring thung mdzes khyad can la ma phyir bltas te kun gyis nus pa gang yod bton te bsgrubs pas legs cha mdzes par thon/de nas gyo mo rtod pa la nye bar sngar gyi 'du khang rnying ba'i gyo mo'i khar sde dpon gyis ka cu nas gyo mo pa tra can stong phrag du 132

ma nyos te mda' yab pu shu dang bcas legs par brtod de bsgrigs pas phul byung ltar grub ste kun la dga' skyed bla na med par gyur/ shing dpon ngo g.yog bcu gnyis kyi khar ka cu'i shing bzo drug bsnan te 'du khang gi 'og shod kyi kun dga' ra ba ste phyogs gsum gyi sku khang dang ngo shing mthil shing sogs phyi nang gi bzo gang legs bgyis shing / gal te mig la mi mdzes pa'i rigs gzhi nas spor ba dang slar bcos chen bgyid pa sogs zhib tshags dpe med btod nas bde blag ngang 'du khang gi skya bzo legs par grub bo/ /'di skabs sde dpon gtsos shing dpon dang gyang dpon las byed yongs rdzogs kyis 'grub ston dang bya dga' lag rtags sogs la ma ltos par snying khong rus pa'i steng nas sha tsha ba dang snying nye ba'i sgo nas 'du khang gsar bzhengs la nyin mtshan khor yug kun tu sgo gsum gus pa'i 'bad pa nan chags su bgyis pas mchog gsum gyi zhing dam par bsngos te mchod pa ni bsam brjod las 'das pa zhig yin no/ /mdo rtsa bar/ rgyal mtshan gzug go /de ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ seṅge'i rgyal mtshan dang / chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / khyu mchog gi rgyal mtshan no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge tshes la 'du khang yang thog tu gser tog lag khru phyed dang bzhi can zhig yar skor bkra shis tshe ring gis sku 'bum nas sgor nyis brgya nyi shus blus/ sgo mang gi steng du sgor stong phrag ri ba che legs shig mgo 'dug o rgyan gtsos mang tshogs la 133

zhabs 'degs pa rnams kyis sku 'bum nas blus pa rnams bzhag go /ri stag mkhar byams kyis sku 'bum nas rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi spen rgyan che legs cha dang tsi mgon cha bcas blus pa rnams spen kha dang sgo chen du legs par brgyan pas gtsug lag khang ches cher mdzes par byas so/ /mdo rtsa bar/ rdzing bu dang sgo khang du rdzab mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir so phag gi gcal gzhug go /de'i steng du so phag gi phye ma'i 'jim pa'o /de'i steng du rdo thal gyis so/ /med na rkang ba bskyab pa'i phyir shing gi spang leb bo/ /yang na bar bar du so phag dag go /zhes dang them skas bya'o/ /'og tu rdo las byas pa/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal bar rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rting mthar zheng 'dom gang lhag gis rdo gcal sgrig pa dang mdun phyogs kyi mthil du ar 'dam gyis bgyis te ngos mnyam zhing mkhregs pa dang gzhan them skas dang bcas pa 'du khang gi chos grwar gcal bsgrigs rdo ba gor ma sha stag gis legs par bgyis/ de nyid las/ sngon po la sogs pa zad par gyi mtshan ma mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ gnas khang gi rtsig pa dag sngon po la sogs pa rnam pa bzhir bya'o/ /rab tu byung ba'i kun dga' ra ba la ri mo bri ba nyid rung ngo / /zhes dang ka ba rnams btsag gis bsku'o/ /rtsig pa dag rgya skyegs kyis bri'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de dang mthun par/ chu phag hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes1 1la lha bzo rtser son ri stag kun bzang dang lha bzo sha 134

bo thar zung gis 'du khang la tshon ris kyi na bza' 'bul ba'i gtso 'gan btegs te gser tshon dang las 'cha' sogs gang 'kho'i rigs nye bar bsgrigs te dbu btsugs nas nor 'dzin pa tra/ tsi pa tra/ shing lo 'dra min sna tshogs/ sprin dang 'brug ris/ mchod lha/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ ka gdugs dang ka rgyan sogs mdzes rtsal can gyi ri mo rnams re re nas logs su shog bu'i ngor zhib thon par bsgrubs nas par thabs su bzhag pa dang / bslab gsum nor gyis ci yang phyug pa rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa'i smyug thogs pa blo bzang 'od zer gyis steng 'og bar shod sogs kyi lañdza dang ka mgo rnams kyi rnam bcu dbang ldan sgo chen ya them gyi sum rkang sogs lañdza gang yod bri tshugs legs shing zhib tshags dang bcas nye bar bsgrubs/ lha dpon sha bo thar ngo g.yog bco lngas zla ba lnga'i ring la dad 'dun rtse gcig pas g.yo sgyus ma bslad par rang rang gi lag bkra gang thon sgos gser tshon legs par phul bas mes po'i sor rtse'i 'du byed las byung ba ltar legs cha phul phyin grub pas dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i dmigs rkyen bla na med par gyur/'dzugs sgang grol gsum gyi dga' ston gyis tshims par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa brten pa sku gsung thugs rten sogs bzhengs pa la/ mdo rtsa bar/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa bar dgongs te gtsug lag khang gi steng shod kyi 135

dbus kyi kun dga' ra bar tshe 'das dge slong 'jigs med kun dga' dang tshe 'das dge slong 'jigs med dam chos/ tshe 'das pha rgan g.yang 'bum gsum gyi dge rtsar dmigs te dad ldan yang gya'i rdo rjes rje gzigs pa lnga ldan dang de'i gtso sku mi tshad las 'das pa byin legs phul phyin can dang de'i g.yas phyogs su rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho dang / bis pa mi pham zla ba/ ston pa'i sku bcas dang / g.yon phyogs su skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho dang / rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rnam snang mngon byang gi sku brnyan rnams lag khru gang gi tshad tsam seng gshong bzo bo sangs rgyas kyis bzhengs/ de'i g.yas kyi kun ra'i dbus su skyabs rje sku phyogs blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i 'dra sku mi tshad las 'das pa tsam yar skor 'od zer dang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zung gis bzhengs/ dbus gyi g.yon phyogs su mar nang rdo rje 'chang gi 'dra sku mi tshad las 'das pa mgo 'dug snying lcags rgyal gyis sgor stong phrag gcig gis bzhengs/ g.yas g.yon gyi kun ra'i dra mig rnams su yang gya'i dad gtong ldan pa 'phags pa rgyal gyis lha sa'i rtse shod bka' 'gyur dpe dkon par grags pa nyid gdan drangs pa rnams legs par bzhugs yod pa dang / spyi rgan a khu blo bzang rgyal dang / mgo 'dug dpal ldan/mgo 'dug 'phags pa skyabs bcas kyis sgor stong phrag lhag gis rje yab 136

sras kyi bka' 'bum bzhengs/ steng shod kyi byang ngos kyi dbus su dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gyan thang gi sbyin bdag yang gya'i byams pa rgyal dang /de'i g.yas kye gyan thang kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sbyin bdag yang sgye+o'i dpal lo/ de'i g.yon gyi 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa ri stag lha bzo kun bzang gis byas so/ /steng shod kyi lho ngos dbus su dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gyan thang ri stag a khu blo bzang sangs rgyas dang mgo 'dug sha bo 'phags pa/ yang gya'i dpal 'byor gsum gyis sbyin bdag byas/de'i g.yas su dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i gyan thang yar skor bu phreng dang / lha ba g.yang 'bum/ mgo 'dug 'phags pa skyabs rnams kyis sbyin bdag byas/ de'i g.yon gyi 'od dpag med zhing bkod yar skor sha bo dang / yar skor kun bzang / yar skor dpa' mo gsum gyis sbyin bdag byas/ gyan thang de rnams bzo bo rtser son pa kun bzang gi sor rtse las thon pas sku tshugs dang mtshon mdog gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas deng skabs de 'dra ha cang dkon par glengs/ rgya mthongs khar bdag cag gi bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa gtso 'khor gsum/ jo 'brom yab sras/ rje yab sras bcas kyi gos drub gnyan thog bzo bo rtser son dpal 'byor gyis bzos pa gos kyi rgyu spus sogs gang cha nas khyad mtshar thon pa de ri stag kun bzang gis skya thig btab ste sbyin bdag byas/chos pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'dra thang g.yon ru'i 'brog pa 1ni7

rka sar ban khos dmangs sgor sum brgya lhag gis bzhengs/ dge slong sangs rgyas bkra shis kyis rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang gtso sku ston pa bcas gos drub thang ga dgu gnyan thog lha bzos bzhengs pa sku nyams dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa mdzes khyad thon pa dag gi sbyin bdag mdzad/ gzhan yang sngar gyi thang rnying lha bris pa rtser son dag gis bzos pa byin rlabs kyi tshan kha phyogs su 'phro ba gnas brtan bcu drug gi thang ga che tshad can bzhi dang gtso sku ston pa'i sku thang gzi byin 'bar ba dang /gna' thang 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod kyi thang ga byon legs can che legs gcig bcas rten rnying grags pa can drug ri stag a khu blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis bzhag yar skor dbang chen rgyal gyis kun rig dkyil 'khor gyi thang ga che tshad thang rnying gcig a khu blo bzang rgyal gyis thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi thang rnying chung tshad gcig phul ba rnams go rim ltar bzhugs so/ /mdo rtsa bar/ skyes pa'i rabs la sogs pa'i ri mo dang sangs rgyas kyi bka'i yi ge dag kyang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ltar/ garnyo la'i 'og shod du/ gyan dbus mar chos sde 'dir 'brel che ba'i bka' drin can mar nang rdo rje 'chang a bh+ya zhabs kyi skyes rabs gyan thang bzhengs na rten 'brel legs tshul gsungs pa ltar lha bris pa chos skyabs kyis gser tshon gyi rgyu song phangs med du btang ste legs par bzhengs/ de'i g.yas phyogs kyi kun dga' ra bar 138

rje sku mi 'greng gi tshad tsam byon gtsang can mgo 'dug o rgyan gyis sbyin bdag byas te seng gshong lha bzo shes rab kyis bzhengs pa dang / de'i kun ra'i dra mig drug tu gnas brtan gyi 'dra 'bag khru gang re/ de'i g.yas kyi kun rar 'od dpag med mi 'greng tsam dang de'i dra khung drug la gnas brtan gyi 'dra sku khru gang re dang bcas yar skor blo bzang gis sbyin bdag bgyis te seng gshong lha bzos bzhengs/ dbus kyi g.yon phyogs su ston pa thugs rje can gyi sku brnyan tshad gong dang 'dra ba dra mig drug las bzhi la gnas brtan bzhi'i 'bag sku dang bcas mgo 'dug bsod nams kyis sbyin bdag byas te seng gshong lha bzos bzhengs/ de'i dra khung steng ma la ri stag mkhyen dpyod yangs pa dge slong blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis sngon gyi rten rnying byin rlabs kyi 'gangs che ba dgon 'di'i rten gtsor gyur pa rje sku a tham mar grags pa nyid/ gang gis ltas ngan dgu bstan te sku gsung thugs rnams gtan nas rlag par byed skabs su lus srog la ma bltos par gang drag gis do dam byas pa'i rten rtsa chen de 'od dpag med khru gang las lhag pa zhig bzhengs pa de'i gzungs gzhug la phul bas bstan pa yang dar gyi tshe dgon 'di'i gsar bzhengs kyi rten thog mar grags pa'i gzi byin can bzhugs/ yang de'i dra mig gcig la thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba yang gya'i pad+ma rgyal gyis bzhengs/ de yang ji skad du/ bstan pa kho na lhar bcas 'gro ba yi/ /bde legs kun gyi rtsa 139

bar yid ches nas/ /lus srog yal bar gyur kyang mi gtong ba'i/ /snying stobs chen pos dam chos 'dzin gyur cig /ces gsungs pa dang sgo kun nas mtshungs pa dad stobs mchog tu yangs shing bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba/ rnam kun tu zlos brjod la brtson pa'i dge ba can spyi rgan ri stag dge slong blo bzang sangs rgyas ni/ gzhon dus nas chos sde 'di la zhabs zhu phun sum tshogs pa zhus par ma zad/ da lta bstan pa yang dar gyi tshe yang dgon 'di chos srid gnyis char gyis bskyangs pa'i bka' drin ni brjod kyis mi lang ste/ nga brgyad lor phyi nang gnyis ka'i ngan rkyen bdo ba'i bstan 'gro'i ched dgon gzhung gi sku gsung thugs rten sbas gsang byed pa phar zad ma mtha' rang rang gi mchod pa'i rten tsam yang mgo ma thon par lag stong yin pa bshad ma dgos so/ /dam pa 'dis rang srog blos btang ste 'dus bzang chos gling gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i lha rten chos gsum phal cher zhig srung skyob do dam gang drag bgyis na yang gnam sa mgo mjug slog pa'i 'pho 'gyur gyi tshe mi bsrun gdug pa can rnams kyis gtan brlags byas pa'i tshul glengs na su zhig la phangs sems mi skye/ gang ltar nyung tsam las ma lus pa ni thams cad kyi bsod nams dang las kyi dbang gis yin pa gdon mi za'o/ /de dang mthun par byings 'dren chen mo blo bzang rab rgyas kyang bstan pa yang dar 'dir lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas sgo gsum gyi spyod pa gang 140

nus kyis chos sde 'dir 'bad pa lhod med bgyis pa'i bka' drin mchog tu che ba dang / gzhan yang rig pa'i gnas lnga la blo gros mchog tu yangs pa lhag bsam rab dkar yar zla'i rjes su snyegs pa'i dge ba can blo bzang 'od zer dang ri stag sangs rgyas rgyal sogs grwa rgan gzhon bar gsum gyis rang rang gi gang nus kyis chos sde 'dir 'dzin skyong spel ba'i nus pa mi dman pa thob pa rnams rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas su che'o/ /'du khang chen mo'i dbus kyi g.yon gyi gnyis pa la kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku che tshad gong dang mtshungs/ de'i kun ra'i dra mig rnams su gnas brtan rnams de de yang gya'i sha bo tshe ring khyim g.yas g.yon gyis sbyin bdag byas te seng gshong sangs rgyas kyis bzhengs/ 'du khang gi g.yas g.yon gyi kun ra'i dbus su rka sar dpon po'i dpon rabs 'dzin pa mgo 'dug lha rtse rgyal gyi rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos 'khor ma byin can zhig bzhengs/ de'i g.yas g.yon gyi dra mig rnams su chos sde 'dir sri zhu mchog tu che ba grwa ba mang ma'i klog gi slob dpon mkhyen dpyod yangs pa ri stag sangs rgyas rgyal gyis sde 'dir sde dge bstan 'gyur zhig gdan 'dren gyi bzhed pa 'khrungs te don gnyer chen pos bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'brog pa g.yon ru nas dmangs sgor chig khri sum stong nye bar bsgrigs te/ sman tshong mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho khong tshang dang 'brel te sde dge nas bde blag tu gdan /41

drangs pa la gdong dar glegs thum glegs thag glegs shing rnams gang cha nas mdzes par bsgrubs te skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig gi bdud rtsi dam par gyur/ de'i 'gab g.yas g.yon kun rar sangs rgyas stong sku bzhengs rtsis kyis sgo dmar dgon pa'i sku par g.yar bo byas te dgon pa'i grwa btsun rnams kyis skya bzo legs par bzhengs/ gser 'bul nye bar 'brog pa g.yon ru sde gzhung nas sgor drug brgya/ sde dpon klu 'bum sgor sum brgya/ de de yang gya'i rta mgrin tshe ring sgor sum brgya/ mgo 'dug don grub sgor sum brgya/ dgon gzhung nas sgor drug stong dang khyon bsdoms sgor bdun stong lnga brgyas gser dmar dang gser skya nyos te lha bzo rtser son grwa btsun bsod nams mkhar dang dge 'dun chos grags zung gis 'gan bteg ste lha bzo ngo g.yog bdun gyis zla ba gcig lhag gi ring brtson pa ma dor bar sangs rgyas stong sku'i sku sha la gser dmar dang na bza' la gser skya bcas phul te mdzes khyad 'bur du thon yod pa zhig legs par grub ste bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo brgya bsgrigs/ g.yon gyi sangs rgyas stong sku bzhugs pa'i dbus su 'phags pa rgyal gyis phul ba'i khru gsum can gyi byang chub mchod rten bzhugs/gzhan yang bslab gsum nor gyis phyug pa gzhan dring mi 'jog pa ri stag sangs rgyas rgyal gyis 'du khang bskyar bzhengs la thugs khur chen pos g.yon ru'i sbyin bdag rnams la gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug 142

nges legs thob pa'i phyir du rang rang gang 'byor gyis rgyu nor gyi 'brel ba 'jog dgos tshul gyi rting bskul bzang po bgyis pas 'du khang gi g.yon phyogs kun dga' ra ba'i 'gab kyi dang bo'i gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong gi gyan thang sde gzhung nas bzhengs/ gnyis pa thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong rdo rje tshe ring sbra che chung gis sbyin bdag byas/ gsum pa sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob ma klu rgyal 'bum sbra che chung gis sbyin bdag byas/ a khu blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis bskul ba la brten nas kha yar 'khor sgo chen gyi g.yas dang po mgon po phyag drug pa g.yon ru'i sde gzhung / sgo chen gyi g.yon dang po chos rgyal gyan thang rdor lo sbra che chung gis sbyin bdag bgyis/ gzhan yang steng gi dus 'khor gyan thang la gser rin sgor nyis brgya/ sgo phyi khyams kyi rgyal chen bzhi'i gser yon sgor chig stong nyis brgya/ chos sgo 'byed skabs su lha mkhar rgyal dang sta bha gnyis kyis sgor nyis brgya re/ sde gzhung nas sgor bzhi brgya tham pa/sngar 'du khang gi rtsig pa bskyar bzhengs tshe sgor chig stong phul/ mdor bsdu na/ spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas khu dbon gyis rang gi lha sde dkar po g.yon ru'i 'brog pa dad gtong nor bu'i rgyan gyis ci yang mdzes pa skyes bu pho mo byings la dge phyogs la bskul ma btang ba'i bka' drin la brten nas 'du khang bskyar bzhengs kyi tshe sku gsung thugs rten snga phyir bzhengs pa'i dkar thig khyon bsdoms sgor nyis khri lnga stong lhag dad 143

'dun rtse gcig pas phul pa la brten nas 'di phyir phan pa'i rtsa ba rmang nas tshugs pa'i rten 'byung bla na med par gyur/ sgo chen g.yas gnyis pa chos sde 'di'i bstan srung 'dod khams dbang mo'i gyan thang de de yang gya'i tshe brtan don 'grub dang yang gya'i ban+de gnyis kyis sbyin bdag bgyis/ g.yas gsum pa lha mo brtan ma'i gyan thang ri stag dge 'dun sbyin bdag byas/ de'i gser lha bzo chos skyabs kyis phul/ sgo chen gyi g.yon gnyis pa rnam sras gyan thang mgo 'dug sha bo thar gyis sbyin bdag mdzad de bzhengs/ glo sgo'i ya them la thugs rje chen po don zhags/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ khro bo rme brtsegs/ 'jam dbyangs nag po/ 'dzam nag gi sku brnyan bcas lha bzo sha bo thar gyis bzhengs/ gzhan yang nang gi gyan thang gnyis ma gtogs phal cher lha bzo bi shwa karma rka sar lha ris pa'i rgyun 'dzin bzo bo rtser son pa kun bzang gi lag rjes yin pas sde 'di'i skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi stobs kyis legs grub byung ba los yin snyam/ 'du khang dbus su/ 'dul ba'i mdor / seng ge'i khri gru bzhi bya'o/ /rkang ba dag la seṅge'i gdong nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'jam mgon blo bzang rgyal ba'i 'khrul bral ring lugs kyi shing rta phyogs mthar sgyur ba la mtshungs zla ma mchis pa bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtshos 'gag med tshangs dbyangs kyis legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed pa'i chos kyi khri chen po 144

gser tshon gyi mdangs bkra zhing gzi 'od 'bar ba zhig bzhengs grub byung ba'i gzi byin can/ 'dul ba tshig ler/ rtsa ba'i sgor ni dbang phyug che/ /kun dga' bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor can/ /lag na be con thogs pa ni/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi bdag po khri/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal bar 'du khang gi khyams g.yas g.yon du/ rgyal chen yul 'khor srung lha bzo chos skyabs kyis bzhengs/ 'phags skyes bo lha bzo sha bo thar gyis bzhengs/ spyan mi bzang lha bzo kun bzang gis bzhengs/ rnam thos sras lha bzo byams pa rgyal gyis bzhengs/ sham+bha la'i gyan thang dgon gzhung nas 'gro gron btang nas kun bzang gis bzhengs/mdo rtsa bar/ sgo khang du 'khor ba'i 'khor lo'i zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ltar/ srid pa'i 'khor lo'i ma phyi 'phags yul nas 'ong ba'i dpe ris zhig la bltos nas lha bzo kun bzang gis bzhengs te gzhung nas 'gro gron btang / me srung 'jam dbyangs ral gri dang mthun pa rnam bzhi zung yang gya'i lha bzo tshe brtan don grub kyis bzhengs/ sgo chen gyi 'gram g.yas g.yon gnyis la tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis yang gya'i g.yang 'bum gyis sbyin bdag bgyis lha bzo bsod nams mkhar gyis bzhengs/ lha chen rma rgyal gyan thang de yar skor lha bzo bsod nams kyis bzhengs/ a myes bya khyung gi gyan thang de de yang gya'i skal bzang rgyal gyis sbyin bdag bgyis te bzo bo bsod nams mkhar gyis nye bar 145

bzhengs pa dag ni lha tshugs dang rus tshugs gser tshon gyi mdangs sogs gang cha nas bltas na gson nyams ldan zhing bzo rtsal 'bur thon byung ba gang dag mig mthong lag zin du grub pa ltar ro/ /'du khang yang thog gi gser tog che ba de sde 'di'i mi dmangs zhabs 'degs pa las byed pa rnams kyis chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling nas gdan drangs te rgyu yon sbyar/ yar skor bkra shis tshe ring gis steng gi gser tog bzhag chos 'khor ri dwags pho mo dang rgyal mtshan gnyis bcas mgo 'dug 'jam dbyangs kyis rgyu rkyen sbyar te phul/ri stag mkhar byams kyis spen rgyan zung dang / gsang bdag dbang chen rgyal/ mkhar byams/ byams pa rgyal/ lha rtse rgyal rnams kyis spen rgyan gnyis dang rgyal mtshan gnyis bcas bzhag sde gzhung nas 'gro gron btang ste 'du khang nang gi mchod rdzas kyi rigs gdugs dang rgyal mtshan che chung mang bo dang /dra ba dra phyed bla bre sogs dang / gral gdan rnams dang / nyer spyod mchod rkong mtshan thub nyer bdun dang sbub dgu rnga brgyad dung chen cha gnyis bcas bzhag gzhan yang spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis sngon gyi tshogs dung che legs can cha dang li theb rnying ba bdun tshar gcigarten rnying ḍā ma ru/ rdo dril rnams bzhag bdun tshar che ba gsum las gnyis ni 'phags pa rgyal dang gcig yar skor 'jam dbyangs kyis bzhagamago 'dug nor bus tung theb lnga brgya phul/rag theb lnga brgya mgo 'dug 146

mgon pos phul/ a khu blo bzang sangs rgyas gyi sku dbon dge 'dun legs bshad kyis maṇ+ḍal lcags ri tog bcas bzhag chos 'jug rigs lnga nyi shu tham pa yar skor rdo rje dbang rgyal gyis phul/ yar skor don grub kyis sgor sum stong ri bas gdugs ser gsum dang rgyal mtshan gnyis ka 'phan gnyis bcas phul/ byams pa don grub kyis gdugs ser gcig phul/ 'khar rnga che ba dpyod ldan blo bzang bkra shis dang dge 'dun 'od zer zung gis bzhag gral gdan khe'u si kha gang ma bcu dbang rgyal gyis phul/ gser rkong nyis brgya tham pa dad ldan g.yang mos phul rbe sogs mchod rdzas yo chas kyi rigs nyer mkho dag dad ldan ser skya pho mo rnams rang rang ci 'byor gyis blu yon sbyar te lhag bsam rnam dag gis nyams pa sor chud bgyis so/ /de ltar mchog gsum gyi rten dang gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i phan yon rnams ni 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar la 'dir bsgrubs pa'i gtsug lag khang bskyang tshul dang der ji ltar bya ba bshad pas don bsdu ba ni/ gtsug lag khang ji ltar bskyang tshul la/mdo rtsa bar/ gtsug lag khang yal bar mi dor ro/ /zhes dang / gtsug lag khang bla gab med pa ma yin par me du ba dang bcas pa bud par yang mi bya bcang bar yang mi bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gtsug lag khang la zhig ral byung na de nas rnyed pa nod pa'i dge 'dun nam gang zag gam lag gi blas yal bar mi 'dor bar bcos pa dang / de'i sbyin 147

bdag bskul ba dang / sbyin bdag ma byung na dge 'dun gyi rdzas kyis bya ba dang / gtsug lag khang nas gzhan du 'gro tshe sgo bcad pa dang srung ma bzhag nas 'gro ba dang / srung mkhan gyis kyang bab col du sgo mi dbye ba dang / zhal bar me dang / bla gab can du me du ba can bud pa dang bcang bar mi bya ba dang / khang skyong gis nyin rer phyag dar bya ba dang / mi nus na'ang mkho ba'i phyogs phyag dar bya ba dang / ma phyags pa'i phyogs kyang dus chen la dge 'dun gyis phyags pa dang / chos 'chad sar chag chag dang lci bas byugs pa dang / phyag dar dang dri ma sogs la 'gom dgos byung na bka'i tshigs bcad bton nas bya ba dang / mal cha dang stan sogs 'ding ba na rdol skyon sogs brtag pa dang / gnas mal du'ang chag chag dang phyag dar dang byug pa sogs bya ba dang / mal cha dri mas gos pa sprugs pa dang bkru bar bya ba dang / gzhi ma phyags par stan sogs mi bsham pa dang / sgo khang dang khyams su gnas mal mi bca' ba dang bcar mi gzhug pa dang / dge 'dun gyi gnas mal la gces spras byas nas de la bgyi 'os thams cad bya ba dang / dge 'dun gyi gnas mal skyabs pa sogs su bskos pas de dag lhag par bya ba dang / dge 'dun gyi rdzas chud za ba nus na zlog pa dang / 'phred gtan dang /gnam gzer dang / 'khor gtan dang /sgo lcags dang / lde mig kyog po sogs bcang ba dang / dgongs kar gtsug lag khang bsdams nas so 148

sor brteg pa dang / mel tshe 'os par mel tshe byed pa dang / snod spyad mkhos su dbab pa dang / rung bar byed pa yod na rtswa sngon sogs 'breg tu gzhug pa dang / dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dang gos sogs la yi ge 'bri ba dang / khri'u rkang ba chag pa bcos pa sogs bzo phran tshegs bya ba ste de dag ni gal che ba'i gnas rags pa tsam brjod par zad kyi rgyas par ni lung sde bzhi dang mdo rtsa ba 'grel ba dang bcas pa las shes par bya'o/ /de la chos dang zang zing gis longs spyod tshul ni/ spyod lam ci 'dod pas lung dbog go /zhes sogs dang/gnas khang dang zas la bsko ba dang thug pa dang bag tshos dang shing thog 'brim pa bsko bar bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar chos 'chad nyan dang / 'dzin skyor sbyangs dang / sgom sgrub sogs kyis gtsug lag khang la chos kyis longs spyod pa dang / gnas mal dang bza' btung sogs la chos bzhin longs spyod pas zang zing gis longs spyod par bya'o/ /gtsug lag khang du ji ltar bya ba ni/ rol mo mkhan gyi gnas dang smad 'tshong ma'i gnas dang chang 'tshong gi gnas dang rgyal bo'i pho brang dang gdol ba'i khyim gyi gnas dag bsten par mi bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gnas ma yin pa spangs te gtsug lag khang du sba ba dang bzhag pa sogs tshul mthun gyis nang na gnas pa'i skabs su ji ltar bya ba dang / shing ljon pa bskyed pa mi rung ba ma yin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar klog tu 'jug pa dang / klog 149

par byed pa dang / bzo rjes su sgrub pa'i skabs rnams tshul mthun du byas nas bya ba'i skabs sgrub pa dang / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa shi ba'i lus la mchod par bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i spur dang / mchod rten dang / sku gzugs sogs la bya 'os pa rnams sgrub pa dang / rab tu byung ba'i gnas su dus ston bya ba chos dang mthun no/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar bkra shis par bya ba'i skabs rnams tshul bzhin bsgrub par bya'o/ gzhan yang chos sde 'di'i stong gsum nor gyis gzhal mi nus pa'i 'du khang chen mo'i rten gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi khrod du/ sngon gyi rten rnying dreg pa can mchod rten rnying ba'i byin rten ston pa shākya seng ge'i li sku byon gtsang che legs gso sbyong ston pa/ la mo zhabs drung mchog gi dbu snga'i rten khrod nas phebs pa'i gser zangasakos grub pa rje sku seng khri can 'jig rten mig gi bdud rtsi/ rin chen rigs las grub pa ston pa'i bzheng sku mtho gang las lhag pa'i gzi byin can/ gser zangs las grub pa thugs rje chen po bzheng sku zhal bcu gcig khru gang las lhag pa can/ sngar gyi byams sku'i gzungs gzhug gser zangs kyis bzos pa rnam rgyal mchod rten che legs/lha ldan nas spyan drangs pa tsan dan las grub pa ston pa'i sku khru gang can/rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho'i bzhugs gding / phyag phyis/ sku lcug bis pa sku phreng lnga ba'i sku 'gag rgya gar rdor gdan gyi 150

thub sku'i chos gos bubs/ rje btsun blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs phyags ya/ na bza'/ sku thul/ rje chu bzang rin po che'i phyag phyis/ rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i na bza'/paṇa chen sku phreng gsum pa'i bzhugs gdan/ lha ldan jo bo shākya mu ne'i na bza'/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza'/ skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen po'i zhabs phyags ya/ phyag phyis/paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i bzhugs gdan/ sku thul/thar shul dge 'dun chos skyong rgya mtsho'i sku gzan bubs/ khri chen 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ rje gser khang ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ rten gsar ba rje yab sras gsum gyi li sku khru gang can byon gtsang / rje btsun sgrol ma'i li sku khru gang las lhag pa can gzi byin 'bar ba'i rten 'gangs che ba 'dzam gling gi rgyan du che ba dag bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang sngar skya ser kun gyis rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyi ngang nas bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang grub 'phral rgyal tshab rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho gtsor mdzad pas rong bo dgon chen gdan sa gsum gyi bla grwa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang / sgrub sde bco brgyad sogs kyi dge 'dun pa rnams gang 'dzoms kyis gdan drangs te/ grub ston bla na med pa dang bcas sde 'di'i chos sgo phyes/dus der dge bskos dang dbu mdzad chab bdag sogs nyin gang bo'i 151

'don chos phyag len rnams dgon chen gyis 'grig bdag mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang gis zhabs sor bkra shis pa'i re khā mi 'jigs khri la nye bar bkod de dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal gang 'tsham gyis sbyin pa sogs kyis ser skya yongs kyi mos 'dun mtha' gcig tu tshims par mdzad do//gsum pa ni/ de ltar rmad du byung ba'i bsod nams rgya chen po yang dag par bsgrubs pa las brtsams te mdo tsam gleng ba'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni skal ldan las 'phro can ya rabs spyod tshul la rab tu gus pa rnams kyis bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir byas pa yin pas na bde legs kyi rtsa ba'am thabs dam par go bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du zhing rnam par dag pa la brten pa'i bsod nams mang du 'du byas pas na mchog gsum la bya ba byas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi garnyo la gsar du bskrun pas na rdzas las byung ba'i legs byas 'du bya ba dang / snying bo med pa'i zang zing gtan bde'i rgyur bsgyur bas na snying bo med pa la snying bo blangs pa dang / ser sna'i dri mas ma gos par bdog pa rgya chen po zhing mchog tu btang bas na gtong ba la dpa' ba'i gtam du yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de thams cad kyang skye rgu rnams 'phrin las don yod zhags pas nam mkha'i mtha' klas par skyong ba rong ston skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas yin pas gong sa mchog sku'i phreng ba rim par byon pa ni 'di ltar mdzad pa dang 'phrin las dpag par 152

dka' ba rgyal ba rnams dang thun mong du gyur pa nyid do zhes bsam par bya ba'i gnas so//ma lus mkhas bya mkhyen pa'i ngos la dge legs cig car 'phrul du rdzogs pas btsun/ /lung rigs bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo mkha' dang mnyam bsgyur bzhin ras ga bur thig le'i gter/ /'phrin las lhun grub mchog tu snyems pa'i grags snyan springs yig klog pa srid zhi'i rgyan/ /yongs smin shed mong btsan po lha mi'i 'jig rten rgya mtsho'i gdengs kar nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid gang gi mdzub rtse ru/ /brten pa lhun po 'degs la dge ba can/ /rgyal bstan mi nub 'jig rten snang byed mchog /phyogs kun yun nas yun du gsal gyur cig /khyad par gser zhun chu skyes legs bzhad pas/ /bya lam ngur ba'i spu sdug sgo byed pa/ /'jam mgon blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs che/ /rtag tu rdzogs ldan dpal mos zin gyur cig /bstan 'gro'i dpal gyur bstan 'dzin gser ri'i phreng / /gang gis ma bstan dge mtshan mi zad pa'i/ /ma smad sngon med mkhas btsun bzang grub dpal/ /bsnyon med thub chen dngos dang mtshungs par shog /rig grol yon tan rin chen mu tig phon/ /nya phyis /bogo/ par tshar du dngar ba yi/ /rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling chu gter cher/ /bstan srid dpal 'byor nyams med rgyas gyur cig /dam chos 'dul ba sprin gyi ba gam ni/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i dbyings su 153

'khrigs pa las/ /nor bu 'bar ba'i bkra shis garnyo la/ /bskyangs pa'i dbyar rnga rgod 'di rna ba'i gsos/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do//byams khang ji ltar bzhengs tshul/rgyal kun byams brtse'i rang mdangs dag pa'i sku/ /gnyen lcug 'khri shing g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /srid gsum gdung ba 'phrog pa'i skyabs kyi phul/ /mi pham mgon des thugs rje lcags kyus zungs/ /sde 'dir byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rten/ /rnam 'dren lnga ba'i gzugs sku'i bkod pa ni/ /mi byed dad pa'i 'du byed 'phang mtho bas/ /gsub tu med pa'i ri mo nyid du byas/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham mgon de ni/ /rang gi zhing la mdza' ba yongs btang nas/ /dpal stug garnyo la 'dir bzhugs min nam/ /e ma mthong ba don ldan 'di ci zhig /de lta'i rgyal ba byams pa'i snang brnyan gtsos/ /gtsug lag khang sogs bskrun pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /don ldan snyan pa'i chos dung g.yas 'khyil sgra/ /ya rabs spyod la dad rnams gus pas nyon/byams khang ji ltar bzhengs tshul ni/ ji skad du/ rgyal ba bden par smra ba'i gsung las/ bsod nams bsags na bde bar 'gyur/ /de phyir mi yis bsod nams bya/ / de yang yang dang yang du bya/ /de nyid la ni 'dun par bya/ /zhes bka' stsal pa de nyid kyi phyir 'phral yun gyi bde ba 154

don du gnyer zhing shes nas smra ba dag gis ni/ bde rtsa'am bsod nams gsog pa'i sgo ji snyed cig mchis pa de thams cad la lus ngag yid gsum gyis ci nus kyis rtse gcig tu 'bad dgos pas na/ mdo smad lho rgyud reb gong gser mo ljongs rka sar dgon 'dus bzang chos gling gi byams khang gsar bzhengs dang / de'i nang rten gtso bo rnam 'dren lnga ba ma 'ongs tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus kyi mgon po/ rgyal ba byams pa mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa lder bzo dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing gi gyan thang sogs gtsor byas nas byams khang rten dang brten pa rnams gsar bzhengs bgyis pa'i dkar chag dgod pa la bzhi/ rten gtsug lag khang ji ltar bskrun pa'i tshul/ brten pa gtso sku ji ltar bzhengs pa'i tshul/ nang rten ji ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul/ gyan thang sogs ji ltar bzhengs tshul lo//dang po ni/ de yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang 'gro ba mi'i phan bde la 'phel 'grib sna tshogs pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba ni gor ma chag pa ste/'gro ba phal mo ches dkar nag 'dres ma'i las dang / sgos su nag po'i las la shin tu dga' zhing yongs su spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /de bas na rka sar du grags pa'i yul gru rnam par dge ba 'dir yang 'jig rten gyi rim pa dag cig byung ngo zhes rnam par brtag go /gang yang dge ba'i las rnams nyams shing 'grib la mi dge ba'i las rnams dar zhing bdo ba'i 155

rkyen gyis/ ji skad du mdo sde rgyan las/ ji ltar chu yi snod chag na/ /zla ba'i gzugs rbernyan mi snang ba/ /de bzhin sems can ngan pa la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyang mi snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rab rgyal bgrang bya so gnyis pa sa khyi la/ zhing 'di'i bshad sgrub kyi sde chen po ji snyed cig yod do cog dang/ mchog gsum gyi rten 'gangs che ba phal cher 'phrin las kyi mjug bsdus nas gdan sa 'di'i rten dang brten par bcas pa nyams chags su byas skabs/ gser gyi ri bo lta bu'i rgyal ba byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan rten brten pa bcas bcom brlags med gsum byas nas shul med du gyur to zhes kyang gleng na shes ldan su zhig la phangs sems mi skye/ yin na yang 'phral du ma bzhengs pa gang zhe na/yul gru 'di yang stobs 'byor mnga' thang gi dpung ba chag krums du gyur pa zhig gtan nas ma yin zhing / reb gong gser mo ljongs 'dir spyilo1980lo'i gnam lo shasar tshes hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu gcig nyin/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa rdzong chung ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje btsun mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i zhabs sor bkra shis pa'i re khā/ dpal nā len+d+ra rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gang gi gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por bkod de chos sgo thog mar phyes pa dang / hor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis lha bab dus chen la bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis thog drangs/ reb gong yar nang mar nang rong 'brog gi ser skya pho mo rnams 156

sprin phung bzhin 'dus nas dga' dad spro gsum bla na med pa'i ngang rta bsu rkang bsu ser sbreng sogs bsu ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas sku phreng bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po zham ring ba khri phrag dang bcas pa bsus te/ yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gdan sa 'du khang chen mo'i chos kyi khri 'phang mthon po rnam bkra'i za 'og gi 'bol stan bcu gsum brtsegs pa'i steng / mi yi khyu mchog bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs sor bskyod de/ tshe dbang sogs dam ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas mdzad bzang yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad pa sogs smra bsam las 'das/ de dang chabs cig tu rim par dgon/ ma lag che chung rnams kyi chos sgo ste/ bshad sgrub gyi bya ba mtha' dag yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong 'phel du gyur tshe/ sde 'dis yod dgu bton te 'du khang chen mo gzhi nas nyams gso bgyis te/ lo bcu phrag gcig gi ring mthu sgril bas cung zad thang chad pa lta bur gyur nas ngal bsos so/ /de nas rab rgyan nyag ma lnga ba lcags lug spyi lo1990lo'i gsar tshes la sde 'di'i dgon grong gi gros la dbang ba rnams kyis gros mol bgyis te/ dgon pa'i spyi rgan blo bzang sangus rgyas gtsos dpyod ldan blo bzang 'od zer/ dge slong sangs rgyas rgyal rnams dang / grong nas mchog gsum la dad stobs bdo ba sde dpon rdo rje gtsos kun bzang / rdo rje dbang rgyal/ rta mgrin rgyal/157

shing dpon don grub/ klu 'bum/ dpal 'byor/ sha bo 'phags pa/rdo rje tshe ring sogs mi nyer brgyad tsam las bzo ba dang sne mo bar bskos te/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes11la rang sde'i btsugs shing las shing gi sbom phra/ring thung sogs gang mkho rnams chud zos su ma btang bar bcad gtub gzhog gsum gyi las kyis bzhengs bya'i rgyu cha'i rigs tshags su chud par byas te skam thag chod phyir chos grwar brtsigs nas las mtshams bzhag go/de nas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes la gtsug lag khang gi ka ring dang /gdung ma sogs kyi ched du sde dpon rdo rje dang shing dpon don grub/ rta mgrin rgyal rnams ka cur phyin te rgyu song la ma ltos par dmangs sgor chig khri lhag gis gang bzang ba'i rgyu cha rnams bsgrigs te bde blag ngang rang dgon du phab/ de skabs g.yer gshong rje 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho khong ba g.yer gshong du bzhugs pa la/ rka sar skya ser gyi sna bo dag gis gsar bzhengs kyi mgo 'don pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ste/ chos kyi phyogs nas nag phyogs bdud kyi sdes tho 'tsham pa dang chos skyong ba dag gis 'khren cha mi 'byung ba dang / 'jig rten gyi phyogs nas zang zing dpal 'byor gyi dngos grub zhus so/ /gang yang khong gis gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa'i rigs thams cad mi 'byung ba'i gegs sel gyi rim gros zil gyis mnan/ skya ser kun la rkyen sel phyogs la 'bad dgos par bskul/ mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i mthun 158

rkyen thams cad dmigs pa dang ljags bkod lhu things pa stsal te grub par bgyis so//1991lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes1 1la/ rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa dad ldan shing dpon don grub gtsos byams khang gsar bzhengs kyi bkod 'don pa dang las bzo ba zung 'brel gyi 'gan khur ba lag gi blar bsko ba(nag mdzad pa mi nyer brgyad kyis gsar bzhengs kyi las mgo brtsams so zhes gleng bslangs pa pos so/ /de nas shing las la blo gros kyi 'jug pa mchog tu yangs shing ngo lkog bral ba/ las la grim zhing g.yo zol med pa/ 'khor rnams las la 'dzud mkhas shing yas phyin gyi bsgo ba nyan pa sogs bzo bo'i yon tan dang ldan zhing skyon dang bral ba'i bzo bo rtser son don grub nas gdan sa 'di gar gros la dbang ba rnams byams khang chen mo gsar bzhengs kyi bzhed pa ji ltar btang ba ltar thig chen btab ste/ mtho tshad da skabs kyi khru tsi bzhi bcu zhe bzhir long ba phun sum tshogs pa'i mdzes khyad 'bur thon can zhig bzhengs rgyu'i las grwa btsugos te/ g.yo zol dang bral zhing lhag bsam rnam dag gis nus shugs yod dgu bton nas las la 'bad do/ /de tshe kho bo cag la lag yon dga' rtags sogs bzo bo mgu nges kyi dngos chas dman pas nyin rer mi re la dmangs sgor lnga re tsam gyi ster cha las med na yang / yon la ma rngam par blo sems rtse gcig pas las la bsgrims so/ /de nas rka sar 159

grong ri dgon gyi ser skya byings kyis bzhengs sa'i gnas rmang gzhi sra brtan mkhregs pa'i ched bde thang dang ka rting rdung ba sogs dang / dgu chu'i 'gram nas ka rdo skyel ba/ der ma zad rka sar gyi dud khyim re res rang sger gyis byams khang la gcam mam rgyug re phul ba sogs kyi sgo nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i bdag rkyen bla lhag tu bsgrigs/ de nas zhing 'dir bdag cag gi bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa shākya seṅges chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus tshes dge ba hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi la lha bsangs dkar gtor gser skyems bcas phul nas chos srung dang yul bdag gi lha klu la 'phrin bcol byas 'phral shing bzo ba rnams kyis ka ring rnams bslangs te gdung ma bzhag tshe da lta phog dar du grags pa'i lugs srol ltar bkra shis pa'i sgo brgya bsgrigs/ de'i mur las bzo ba rnams kyis las la bsgrims te/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gdung khur ba sogs kyi sgos bkod khyab kyis mdzes par bskrun pa ni ha las pa zhig go /mdor na bsngags par 'os pa shing dpon don grub gtsos las byed nyer brgyad skor rogs dang bcas pa dang / mdor na ja ma rig 'dzin don grub dang pad+ma rgyal sogs las bzo ba so sos rang rang gi skal bar 'os pa'i bya ba mtha' dag las 'bras dpang bzhag dang / dad 'dun rtse gcig pas sgo gsum bsgrims te 'bad pa'i lag rjes su zla dang bral ba'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di 160

gegs med bde blag tu grub pa yin no/ /de ltar byams khang chen mo'i skya bzo phyi'i dbyibs grub rjes dgun khar las mtshams bzhag go /de nas1992lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes15la gtsug lag khang nang gi bya ba'i rim pa rnams mngon par 'du byas te sla chos su ma song bar zla ba du ma'i ring las la brtson te mjug grub par bgyis tshe/ kho tshor dgon grong spyi nas 'dzugs sgang grol gsum gyi rim pa rnams ma 'chol bar 'jig rten mi chos dang mthun par 'byor tshod kyi bya dga' dang bkra shis bde legs kyi rten 'brel zhus so/ /gang ltar kyang bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di'i las kyi grwa btsugs pa nas mjug grub pa'i bar chag che nyam nga sogs mi mthun pa'i rkyen ming tsam yang ma byung bar gtsug lag khang bde blag tu grub pa'i mthus ser skya yongs kyis las 'bras dang mchog gsum la snga na med pa'i dad pa dang / khyad par du rgyal ba byams pa'i byin rlabs yin zhes las sne ba rnams gus 'dud kyi rnam pas nyams cher bgyid pa rnam pa gcig tu don gnas kho nar snang ste/ skyes rabs las/ bde legs chen pos 'gro ba 'di/ /yongs su bskyangs par gyur pa na/ /lha yi dbang bo dag gis kyang / /'di dag gtses par mi nus na/ /sha za rnams kyis ga la nus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gro don thugs la bsnams pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyi dgongs pas zin na sems can dang 'byung ba las byung ba'i gnod pa gang kisu/ kyang brdzi bar mi nus pa'i mthu khyad par du 'phags pa'i rnam 161

thar bla na med pa zhig go /de nas zla9ba'i tshes1la shing las ched mkhas bzo bo don grubra dang / lhag bsam can klu 'bum/ kun bzang sogs kyis byams pa'i gtsug lag khang mi pham chos kyi pho brang gi gyo thog brtad bya'i gyo mo rnams tshags su chud par byas te las mgo brtsams/dge bskos las thog pa tshul ldan dge 'dun tshe ring gis grwa ba na gzhon bar shar ba rnams la skul ma btang ste mgo 'jug bar gsum du las grogs bzang bo bgyis pa dang / gyo bzo rnams kyis kyang gyo mo sgrig rtod sogs la thang lhod ma shor ba'i brtson pa bskyed de gyo mo'i las dka' gang yod phyogs la sha tshas phan grogs gang 'gyur byas pas ma 'gyangs par gzhan la 'gram chu ldang ma dgos par legs grub byung bar ser skya yongs kyis rjes su yi rang ste spro dga'i ngang bkra shis pa'i bsngags brjod dang bcas dga' rtags dang ston chung gang legs mdzad do/ /de yang ji skad du/ khams gsum bla ma chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i zhal nas/ 'bad pa chung ngus rlabs chen tshogs sdud la/ /dge la rjes su yi rang mchog tu gsungs/ /khyad par rang gis sngon byas dge ba la/ /rlom sems bral bas dga' ba cher bskyed na/ /sngon byas dge ba gong du 'phel lo zhes/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i don de bsgrub phyir dang / /dgos pa gzhan yang mang du mthong bas na/ /sems khyod dga' ba 'di ltar bskyed na legs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshegs chung ngus sgo nas 162

tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs pa la rang gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba ni ma/ts+tshag yin pa dang / khyad par du rang gis ya rabs rnam dkar gyi las che chung gang bsags pa la nga rgyal rlom sems dang bral ba'i sgo nas dga' ba skyes te rjes su yi rang byas na dge rtsa rnams gong nas gong tu 'phel zhing ha cang stobs che ba sogs kyi phan yon shin tu che ba rnams ngo shes par byas te mi brjed pa'i dran rten tsam du rang rang gang 'byor gyis 'brel ji tsam thogs pa'i ser skya pho mo'i mtshan byang rnams rim par dgod pa la/ bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes shing 'dul 'dzin chen po dge 'dun sbyin pas shog sgor lnga brgya/ dpyod ldan 'jigs med nor bus sgor brgyad brgya/ bzhin bzang dge 'dun tshe ring sgor chig stong lnga brgya/ rnam dpyod can blo bzang dpal ldarno sgor chig stong lnga brgya/ mang thos dge 'dun don grub sgor chig stong dgu brgya/ tshul ldan 'jigs med ye shes sgor chig stong bdun brgya/ lhag bsam can dge 'dun 'jigs med sgor chig stong / gzhung brgya smra ba'i dge 'dun 'od zer gyis mtsho sngon g.yon ru dang skya li/ zla tshang / rmog rus bcas nas byams khang mtha' skor gyi ma ṇi sogs la dkar thigs khyon bsdoms sgor chig khri bdun stong bdun brgya bdun cu/ tshogs dung cha gcig spos phor cha gcig kho dang blo bzang bkra shis zung gis 'khar rnga gcig bcas lo snga phyir phul/ shes ldan dge 'dun dar rgyas sgor chig stong / bzhin bzang 163

blo bzang bstan pa sgor lnga brgya/ lhag bsam can dge 'dun legs bshad kyis g.yon ru dang mtsho sngon mtshams thog sogs nas dkar thig bsdoms pa'i sgor chig khri bzhi stong lnga brgya bslangs te mtha' skor gyi ma ṇi bzhengs/ yar sems can dge 'dun chos bzang sgor chig stong nyis brgya/ dpyod ldan dge 'dun dpal 'byor sgor chig stong bzhi brgya/ shes rab can dge 'dun chos ldan gyis g.yon ru nas byams khang gi shing ris gser tshon la dkar thigs sgor chig khri chig stong lnga brgya/ shes ldan dge 'dun yar 'phel sgor chig stong / ngang tshul bzang pa'i dge 'dun grags pas sgor chig stong / rigs pa smra ba blo bzang nor bus sgor chig stong / tshe yi rig 'dzin spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas dang dgon 'di'i klog gi slob dpon bka' drin can sku dpon sangs rgyas rgyal dpon g.yog zung gis lha sde dkar bo g.yon ru nas byams khang bzhengs ched dad gtong ldan pa'i dge ba can ya rabs kyi las la brtson pa sde dpon ston pa skyabs kyis kun slong rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas rang sde kun la rting skul nan cher gyis ram btegs te bslangs pa'i khyon bsdoms shog sgor chig khri brgyad stong lhag 'dus pa rnams dang / rka sar rang sde nas ming don mthun pa'i dge ba can don grub dang 'phags pa rgyal/ lha lung rgyal/ mkhar byams/ rdo rje/ rdo rje tshe ring / ban+de thar/ don grub chung / sha bo thar rnams kyis sgor chig stong re/ rdo rje dbang rgyal 164

chung sgor chig stong lnga brgya/ kun bzang chig stong nyis brgya/ gsang bdag sgor bdun brgya/ don grub/ lha 'bum rgyal/ klu skyabs/ lcags byams rgyal/ bsod nams/ tshe ring don grub / brtson 'grus/ sha bo tshe ring/ bun phrang / rdo rje dbang rgyal/ klu 'bum mkhar/ kun bzang rig 'dzin/ don grub/ pad+ma rgyal/ a bo skyabs/ klu 'bum/ phur ba/ klu 'bum tshe ring / yi dam/ rta mgrin mkhar/ g.yang 'bum/ ban de/'phags/ pa skyabs/g.yang 'bum che/ 'phags pa tshe ring / bsod nams 'bum/ dpa' 'brug 'brug 'bum/ rab brtan/ don grub rnams kyis sgor lnga brgya re/ dkon mchog dang mgon po/ tshe ring don grub gsum gyis sgor drug brgya re/ rdo rje/ stag lha rgyal/ rdo rje 'bring / rta mgrin tshe ring / 'jam dbyangs/ sha bo thar/ sha bo 'phags pa/ dbang chen rgyal/ snying lcags/dge 'dun rnams kyis sgor bzhi brgya re/ tshe ring /dbang chen/ mkhar byams/ 'jigs byed/ bla ma skyabs/ bkra shis/dpal 'byor/ lha mo/ sangs rgyas bkra shis/ dpal lo/ rdo rje tshe ring /sgrol ma skyabs/ klu 'bum tshe ring / sha bo bsod nams/ klu skyabs/gdugs dkar 'bum/ rta mgrin rgyal/ lha mkhar rgyal/ don grub chung / tshe brtan/ dpa' rtse/ 'jigs med rnams kyis sgor sum brgya re/ lha rtse rgyal/ tshe brtan/ klu bha/ sha bo thar/ skal bzang rgyal/mkhar mo byams/ tshe bha/ klu 'bum/ dbang ldan/ gcod pa rgyal/ blo 165

gros/ blo bzang / bsod nams rgyal/ sgrol ma 'bum/ snying lcags rgyal/tshe dbang / lcags mo/ klu 'bum rgyal/ tshe ring bkra shis/ 'brug skyabs/byams pa tshe ring / bla ma skyabs/ ban de/ lcags mo rgyal rnams kyis sgor nyis brgya re/ 'jam dbyangs kyis sgor nyis brgya lnga bcu/ rig kho dang pad+ma tshe ring / lha mkhar/ klu bha rnams kyis sgor brgya lnga bcu re/ khyi mo thar/ rta mgrin tshe ring chung / 'o mo klu mo/ lo yang rnams kyis sgor brgya re/ sha bo tshe ring nas sgo ra lnga bcu/ snying 'bum byams nas sgor sum cu bcas zho sha yod dgu bton nas blo sems rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas lha sde mi sde kun gyis 'brel che thogs chung thogs bgyis pa dang / gdan sa 'di'i grwa rgan gzhon bar gsum tshang mas kyang dad rdzas gshin rdzas rnams rang 'dod kyis bag med du ma btang bar zon byas te/ snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs ma'i dus 'dir spyir bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par dbu sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / yul gru 'di gtso byas pa'i yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu skye 'gro rnams bde skyid gtsang ma'i dpal la rol pa dang / nang sgos khyad par can du zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren nyin mon byed pa stong / /rim byon snga ma'i bstan la gtan bde'i ro/ /ma myong thar pa 'dod pa'i don mthun rnams/ /phyi mas 'dren pa'i rten 'brel sgo brgya bsgrigs/ /khyad 166

par lnga brgya tha ma'i 'brog dgon par/ — /'khyams pa'i 'gro rnams/ ma 'ongs byams mgon gyis/ /rab zhi bdud rtsis dbugs dbyung sbyin pa'i brdar/ /legs bshad rnam lnga'i skyes bzang ched du bstabs/ /zhes bka' stsal pa ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la bya ba cung zad re byas kyang grol ba'i skal ba can du ma gyur pa rnams ston pa shākya seng ge 'di'i bstan pa la thog mar smin cing grol ba'i skal ba can du gyur pa'i tshul lung tshad ma las mang du 'byung bas mtshon bskal bzang sangs rgyas snga ma'i bstan pa la zhugs kyang gtan bde'i btsan sa ma zin pa rnams phyi mas smin grol la 'god pa'i rten 'brel sgrig cing / bye brag tu bskal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi pa'i bstan pa la bya ba cung zad re byas pa rnams kyang ma 'ongs pa na rgyal ba byams pa'i gdul byar 'gyur bar rgyal bas mdo sde du mar gsungs la/ byams pa mgon pos kyang tshul de mngon sum du gzigs pas da lta nas bdag gir mdzad de ma 'ongs pa na rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel du byams chos sde lnga legs bshad kyi skyes su bskur pa yin no/ /de'i phyir bka' gdams gsar rnying gi dam pa rnams kyis sku tshe 'dir byams chos la bshad sgrub rnam dag mdzad pa'i rten 'brel dang / phyi mar dga' ldan du skye ba bzhes pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na bskal bzang sangs rgyas lnga ba'i bstan pa la smin grol gyi skal ba can du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can gzigs nas rgyal ba byams pa'i sku 167

brnyan zhig bzhengs shing rjes 'jug dad ldan rnams la yang phyag mchod skor ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas de la 'brel 'jog tu 'jug pa'i rnam thar bzang pos yid drangs te/ ji skad du/ mtha' yas mchog gsum rten rnams byin rlabs kyi/ /gter du mnyam yang khya/da 'phags rten 'brel sgo/ /dam pas legs phye'i srol bzhin byang chub tu/ /lung ston byams pa mgon po'i sku 'di bskrun/ /ces gang gsungs pa de lta bu'i dgongs pa mngon du mdzad nas rten byams khang dang brten pa byams chen mthong ba don ldan 'di bzhengs pa la sgo gsum bag zon gyis nyin mtshan kun tu 'bad 'bungs bgyis nas bzhengs so/ /'di lor tshogs chen khri ba las thog pa skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa mdo sngags bstan pa'i srog shing kha so sprul ba'i sku rin po che blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las khong ba sde 'dir chibs bsgyur te byams khang gi bzo lta la gzigs nas thugs la bab pas sde 'dir lha bzo dang shing bzo gyo bzo rdo bzo sogs gang gi phyogs nas kyang gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa red kyis bzo bo rnams la bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor zhing dmangs sgor chig stong dang ja mar gos lha dar bcas bdag rkyen gnang ba sogs kyi bka' drin mchog tu che'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtso sku rje btsun byams pa mgon po yab sras sogs ji ltar bzhengs she na/ dbus su ma 'ongs tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus kyi mgon 168

po rnam 'dren lnga ba rgyal sdi byams pa mgon po thog tshad gsum pa'o/ /mdun gyi g.yas na sa bcu'i dbang phyug lha'i bu nam mkha' dri ma med dang / g.yon na rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo gnyis thog tshad las brgal ba'i tshad do/ /byams pa'i g.yas g.yon du lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mnyam med jo bo a ti sha dang / gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa zung khru tsi bdun gyi tshad tsam bzhengs/ steng 'og bar gsum dang phyi nang gi gyan bar sum cu lhag la ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing dang grub chen brgyad cu/ byams pa'i zhing bkod sogs zhing bkod kyi rigs mang po dang / rje bdag nyid chen po'i 'khrungs rabs tsong kha brgyad cur grags pa dang yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs sogs gyan thang ras bris su bzhengs pa'o/ /de nas gtso sku ji ltar bzhengs pa ni/ 'dus bzang chos gling gi spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas gtsos ser sa nas shes ldan du ma dang / sde dpon rdo rje sogs dgon grong nas spyi sems can gros dbang rnams dang dgongs sdur mdzad rjes gros mthun byung ba'i bzhengs pa po ji lta bu zhe na/ ji skad du mi pham dbyangs can dges pa'i rdo rjes/ gtsug lag pha mtha' med pa dkar bo'i 'bru/ /thang mar brdal ba'i ngo mtshar 'dzam gling na/ /grags pa rin thang med pa'i rol mo can/ /de ni gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'jig rten nyid/ /rig pa kha dog lnga ba dbang po'i gzhu/ /bkram 169

pa seng chen rtsen pa'i gshong ba na/ /mchog gsum rten gyi bkod pa rdzogs ldan bzhin/ /bzhengs pa'i dpung ba rdzogs pa'i grangs ma rig /de lta na yang ring nas lugs gnyis kyi/ /'brel ba mi shigs gser gyi skud pa'i rgya/ /gang la dam du bsgril ba mdud pa'i mtshams/ /mi phyed lhag bsam dge ba 'di nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang dang gzhan gyi mkhas blun phal mo ches rten bzhengs gang legs shig 'ong ba la bzo bo mchog tu gyur pa zhig gal che bas bzo bo phal ba gang byung byung gis mi 'ong zhes 'bag bzo mchog tu gyur pa zhig la snying nas re ba ltar gyi bsam 'khyer dang gtam gleng ba'ang mang dag byung ngo / /de nas lha dang bla ma la lu nga bstan zhus te dgongs bstun ngos gser ljongs yul gyi bzo bo rtser son pa/ ring nas 'dris pa'i bzhin bzang don gyi ched mkhas bzo bo bi shwa karma gnyis pa/ yongs grags rtsod med dus kyi bzo bo seng ge gshong ma mgo rgya mtsho gtsos rang sde'i rnam dpyod can bsod nams mkhar/ dge 'dun chos grags/ mi skya tshe ring don grub bcas la 'dem bsko 'thad pa byung ste1993lo'i dkar tshes bkra ba'i nyin bzo bo sogs spyan drangs te ston chung steng lha bzo'i thu bo la legs skyes kyi ster cha dang / gzhan pa la'ang bkra shis kyi rten mtshon gang dges mdzad de/ bzheng bya'i seng khri la thig chen btab/ dus tshes dge bar sgar grong kun la sha zhen che ba'i phan sems can sde dpon rdo rje dang shing 170

dpon don grub sogs kyis bzo bo rnams kyi bkod 'doms ltar byams pa'i seng khri brtsigs/ lnga/ bzo bsod nams mkhar sogs kyis seng khri'i pad 'dab dang phreng skor rnams zhib tshags sgos phyi'i dbyibs skya bzo grub par bgyis te/ skam thag chod phyir las mtshams bzhag rang sde'i stag shar na gzhon dar ma mang pos sgrub pa'i sde chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi nags su song ste/ dge bskos la lha dar dkar po bcas snyan zhu phul/rka sar 'phags pa rgyal gyis ngo chen zhus nas rus shing rnams bcad de phab/ mi skya pho mo byings kyis dad 'dun rtse gcig pas byams pas dam bca'i gzungs dang gsung mchog ma ṇi yig drug gdangs dbyangs kyis phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin dga' dad spro gsu/ma gyis seng gshong nas sa dmar khur te phab/ pad 'dab dang khri'i nang du gzhug bya'i dzam bha la'i sku'i ched du rnam dpyod yangs pa dge slong 'jigs med ye shes 'gan rang khur gyis bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas dzam la rigs lnga'i sku par byon legs can zhig blus te spyan drangs/ der brten rka sar gyi dud khyim/ re res dzam la'i sku byon gtsang spar te bkod khyab ltar nye bar bsgrigs/rong bo yar nang phyogs kyi nags nas shug shun dang shug pa der ma zad/sde dpon rdo rje sogs kyis gsal lung mdzod khang nags nas srog shing rnams blangs te skam thag chod phyir gling bzhir byas nas bzhag mchog gsum la dad pa dang thos bsam gyi nor gyis ci yang phyug pa/ rnam dpyod 171

mchog tu yangs pa'i dge ba can dge bskos las thog pa 'jigs med nor bus gtso 'gan gyi khur bzhes pa dang / bslab pa gsum gyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba/ gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i 'dul 'dzin chen po brtsi bzhag bla ma blo bzang sbyin pa gtsos grwa rgan gzhon tshang mas nus pa yod dgu bton nas/ gzungs gzhug chen mo/ byams pas dam bca'i gzungs/ 'jam dbyangs dam bca'i gzungs/ gzungs chen sde bzhi/gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi gzungs/ ston pa'i gzungs/ ma ṇi/dmigs brtse ma sogs gzungs sngags kyi rigs mang po dang / gzhan yang sku brnyan gyi rigs bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong sogs kyi sku brnyan 'bum phrag du ma'i par gyi 'phrul 'degs gyi 'gan bteg pa dang / de rnams kyi mtha' dris pa drub pa dril ba na bza' 'bul ba dar skud dmar ser dkris pa sogs sna gang thad nas sla chos dang khral chos su ma song bar byed thabs sna tshogs kyis dngos gtsang dag thon mdzad/ gsung gi rten rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dag tshar gnyis dang / rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa yab sras kyi bka' 'bum rin po che dag tshar gnyis gtso byas chos po ti che chung stong phrag du ma rnams kyi shog ngos kha grangs brtsi ba dang bzang drug 'byug pa shog mtha' ser bor sgyur ba na bza' glegs thum gdong dar rnams dngos gtsang 'bul ba la bsgo ba las mi 'da' rba dpyod ldan 'jigs med ye shes kyis 'gan 172

gcig chog gis khur te gang cis zhabs 'degs ci lcogs kyis bsgrubs/gang ltar kyang de'i skabs gyi grwa rgan gzhon bar gsum las 'phro can rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang ngos bshad sgrub gyi bya ba mtha' dag thugs la bsnams pa'i bka' drin gyis bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di gegs med bde legs ngang grub pa gdon mi za'o//de nas rab rgyan shing khyi1994lo'i dbo zla2dkar tshes3bzang por rje btsun byams mgon yab sras kyi srog shing rgyu shug pa las grub pa gtso bo'i ring tshad khru tsi bco brgyad yod pa rnams la/ brtsi bzhag zur ba blo bzang 'od zer gyis ram 'degs byas/ rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs shing rang bzhin bzang ba'i dge slong dge 'dun don grub 'jigs med nor bu dge 'dun tshe ring 'jigs med ye shes blo bzang bkra shis dge 'dun legs bshad rnams kyis 'gan bzhes te/ srog shing rnams tshad ldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin chad lhag nor gsum dang bral zhing /ha cang nan chen gyis gzab gzab ngang mtshal chen byugs te gser bzang pos legs par bris/ de'i tshe spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis gser shog brgya/ de bzhin du bzo dpon bsod nams mkhar/ dge 'dun chos grags/ blo bzang bstan pa rnams kyis gser shog brgya re/bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'phags pa rgyal gyis gser shog lnga brgya/ gcung bsod nams 'bum gyis gser shog brgya/ phran gyis kyang gser shog 173

brgya bcas khyon bsdoms gser shog chig stong brgya tham pa'i rgyu song phul te srog shing rnams bzhengs te ro rkyang mtshon byed rtsa dur ba dang ku sha gnyis/ 'phags pa rgyal gyis srog shing gi na bza' spus legs gos g.yung ris ma dmar ser gnyis bcas srog shing che ba la na bza' rim pa bcu tham pa/ gzhan rnams la na bza' lnga re phul/ shes rab kyi rten smyorathe rkapa la ched dmigs kyi rgya khab stong phrag du ma'i srog lcibs gos skud sna lngas legs par dkris/ srog shing rnams kyi ngos la bzang drug dang rin chen bye ma byugs te bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ de ltar nang bzhugs kyi gtso bo srog shing tshad ldan dag thon mdzad de bkra shis rab gnas kyis mthar brgyan/ de nas gnyis pa'i bcu gcig rgyal phur 'dzoms pa bkra shis don grub tu grags pa'i nyin dge ldan pa'i yi dam gyi gtso bo dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzhi bsnyen chen mo bzhi phud pa'i sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas gtsos mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i sgyug thogs pa blo bzang 'od zer sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu phrag gcig dang gsum gyis gdugs bdun gyi ring dkar rdzas la brten nas 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas thun bzhir bcad de/ gzungs gzhug dang gnod sbyin 'khor lo sgrub tshul phun tshogs char 'be+ebs ltar cho ga chad lhag dang bral ba'i ngang sla chos su ma song bar ngos gtsang bsgrubs so//174

de nas dmar phyogs kyi tshes bco brgyad skar ma rgyal 'dzoms pa'i dge bar rdo rje 'dzin pa blo bzang sangs rgyas/ smyug thogs pa blo bzang 'od zer/ grwa ba dmangs kyi klog gi slob dpon bka' drin can sangs rgyas rgyal/ rten bzhengs 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gdung khur ba rong bo blo bzang dge 'dun sogs kyis gtsos grwa ba mang mang gis na bza' gzab sprod dang chos gos rnam gsum paṇa zhwa gser mdog bzhes te/bsu ba chen po gter bum dang bang mdzod rus shing sogs byams khang du spyan drangs nas/ seng khri'i dbus su bkra shis pa'i rdzas kyis mtshan pa'i dkar yol gyi gter bum che legs gcig phyogs bzhir gter bum che ba mdzes ris sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dag go gzhan gter bum che chung mang po dang / 'bru mdzod che chung du ma sogs dang /bang mdzod kyi mkho dgu'i yo chas rigs don chen po la dmigs pa dag 'dzoms pa'i khul du spungs/ dzam pho mo'i 'khor lo snang ris can che legs de dbus kyi gter bum che ba'i steng du bzhag ste/ rus shing bslangs grub pa dang gser zhun cod pan bslangs bzhes kyis spyan dmigs ma g.yengs pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam dang rgyal ba ma lus ma gsung bzhin 'bru dkar gyi char phab ste tshul 'di la brten nas bu ram shing ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang / nang sgos khyad par can du ma 175

'ongs pa na bskal bzang sangs rgyas lnga ba rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i bstan pa la smin grol gyi skal ba can du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa chen po la dmigs pa'i thugs smon mdzad do/ /de nas dmar phyogs tshes nyer gsum la gser ljongs bstan pa'i bdag po rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i bstan srid kyi 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi khyon yangs por kharigog med khyab gdal du spel ba'i shing rta ba chen po/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang po zhes dus kyi mtha' na skye dgu ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/ 'gro ba'i sgron me/ thub bstan yongs kyi bdag po/'jig rten gyi mig gcig pur gyur pa 'khor zhabs 'brang dang bcas pa/sde 'di'i ser skya pho mo thams cad gzab spras gang bzang gi sgo nas ser sbreng dang rta bsu rkang bsu bla na med pa dang bcas dad gus spro gsum gyi ngang nas bsus te/ bkra shis gtsug lag khang chen seng chen brgyad kyis bteg pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por mgon po gang gi zhabs sor mi 'gyur g.yung drung ris su phab ste thugs gang dges kyis ser skya yongs la phyag dbang gnang zhing rjes 'dzin gyi zhal gsung dron po lhu things pa stsal pa la/ sgar grong nas kyang sgo gsum gus 'dud lhur blangs te mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ mnyes pa gsum gyis thugs mnyes par mdzad/ de nas bdag nyid chen po yab sras bcas sku ngal bsos te 176

tshoms chen du bzhugs/ de'i phyi nyin gral tshes24bzang po bkra shis don grub nyin mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po skyabs rje dam pa nyid gtsor bzhugs kyis dgon 'di'i dge rgan ming 'dzin pa blo bzang dge 'dun sogs yi dam gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dam gtsang rdor 'dzin bcu gsum gyis 'jigs byed kyi cho ga sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gzungs gzhug thun gcig bsgrubs te/ bzo bo rtser son seng gshong rgya mtsho ngo g.yog bcas lhar bskyed do/ /khong rnam pas na bza' gzab spras dang chos gos paṇa zhwa gser mdog dang bcas bzhes shing / rje bdag nyid chen pos phyag tu spos ring bsnams/ grwa ba mang mas mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsgrengs te rol cha dang bcas byams pa'i srog shing dang gzungs gzhug rnams ba'e/ngas sar gdan drangs/ de'i mod la rje bdag nyid chen pos rten bzhengs pa'i dgos pa dang bsngo smon gal che tshul mdor bsdus tsam gsungs nas byams pa'i sku gzugs ma'i sgo nas byams mgon yab sras smon lam gyi dpang bor dmigs pas spyan drangs te byams pas dam bca'i gzungs dang / gnas mchog dga' ldan ma sogs gdangs mthon pos sgra dag gsal gsum gyis gsungs par thams cad nyams 'don gyis mos 'dun gcig pas mthun 'gyur gyis smon gnas 'grub pa'i bden bdar byas pa dang chabs cig tu srog shing bslangs nas thal skad sngon du 'gro bas dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam dang / sham bha la'i smon 177

lam/ mdo sngags kyi lam rim gnyis kyi smon lam rnams gsungs nas rigs ldan rgyal bo'i bstan pa la bya ba byed pa dang / mdo sngags kyi bstan pa spyi dang / rje bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i smon 'dun rtse gcig pa bgyis pa dang / skye ba thams cad du bla ma rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung ste ma 'ongs tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus su mgon po gang gi gser zhal mngon du mjal te gsung gsang bdud rtsis ngoms med du 'tsho ba'i skal ba bzang po mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun mos gang shes zhe thag pa nas bgyis shing / bkra shis bka' rgya ma dang bcas rab gnas mdzad de 'bru dkar gyi char phab bo/ /de'i tshe yang bla ma rdo rje 'chang la dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba btegs te grong ri dgon kun la brtse ba chen pos rjes 'dzin gyi skyabs 'jug nan cher zhus/ rje nyid nas kyang byams pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i rten 'brel du rten 'gangs chen mang po dang ja gos dar lha rdzas sgor bcas gnang ste ser skya kun la rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon dang sbrags zhal ta brjed du phangs pa'i bka' drin bskyangs so/ /de nas rim bzhin phran gyis lag bdar nas gzungs 'bul 'khrul spong nyin byed ltar go rim ma 'khrugs par mthar chags su bsgrigs te rten gsum gyi phung bo dpag tu med pa dag gis legs par yongs su gtams pa ma gtogs/ rten bzhengs gzhan ma ltar shug shun dang dri zhim shing lo shug pas nang 'gengs par byed pa lta bu ma 178

yin par nyin du ma'i bar dge bskos las thog pa rnam dpyod ldan pa bzhin bzang blo bzang dpal ldan gtsos grwa ba dam gtsang bar shar ba mang bos g.yo zol bral zhing / brtson pa grim lhod med par bkra shis pa'i sngags 'don bzhin dbu gzungs dang mgrin gzugs/ tsūd gzungs bar gzungs smad gzungs pad gzungs sogs dang / byamaṅge pas dam ba ca'i gozungs gtsos gzungs sngags kyi rigs dang / byams chos sde lnga dang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gtsos gsung pod glegs bam gyi rigs dang / gzhan yang sku gsung thugs gsum gyi rten rnams go rim ma 'chol bar dngos gtsang dam por bsgrigs te brag ri brtsegs pa bzhin brjid chags pas na bza' glegs thum gdong dar dang bcas bkod pa ha cang legs shing khra lam mer bzhugs pa dang / spyi bor rigs bdag gi tshul du mdo smad bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i sku brnyan tshon ris ma sogs dang / de'i nang phyogs su bde ba chen po'i rten kun+da lta bu'i haṃ yig mtshon pa'i phyir/ ring bsrel sangs rgyas 'od srungs dang / shākya thub pa gnyis gtsos dga' ldan gser gdung sogs kyi ring bsrel 'phel gdung bcu phrag lnga lhag bzhugs pa dang / mgrin par gsung rnam pa thams cad pa mtshon pa'i phyir chos dung dkar bo nye zho bral ba dang / gsung snyan pa'i dril bu mdzes cha 179

can/ thugs kar thugs bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang /rgyal ba sras bcas kyi ye shes lnga'i mkhyen rab kyi yon tan mnga' ba mtshon phyir rdo rje rtse lnga ba/sngon gyi rten rnying lo rgyus can bsod nams 'bum nas phul ba'i rje mchod 'dzin ma li sku byon gtsang de thugs kar dngul gyi kun ra pa tra ris dang shel sgos brgyan par phyi nas sgrib med du mthong bar bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du lte bar bde ba chen po'i ye shes 'phel bar byed pa gtum mo'i a thung dang / gsang gnas su bde ba chen po stong ba dang sbyar te skyong ba mtshon pa sogs rdo rje lus kyi bkod pa la bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo ma nor bar bsgrigs so/ /der ma zad rten 'brel gyi dbang gis 'phags pa skyabs kyis sngar gyi byams pa rnying ba'i rin chen mdzod spu de do dam gang drag bgyis pa phyir phul te mdzes par brgyan/ /gzhan yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs dang / da ltar gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa rnam gnyis kyi ring bsrel khyad 'phags can du mas gtsos ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi ste/ chos sku dang / yungs 'bru lta bu dang / sku bal dang / sku gdung gi ring bsrel rnams kyis byur bur gtams par byas pa dang / bar mtshams rnams su yongs grags kyi sman bzang po drug po gtsos dri bzang po'i sman sna'i rigs mang po dang /bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i dad gtong mtshungs zla ma mchis pa/'tsho byed gzhon nu gnyis pa tho gya'i 'brug byams mkhar zhes snyan grags 180
