kyi ba dan phyogs su g.yo ba gang nyid kyis thog mtha' bar gsum du grogs gang drag bgyis te sgor chig stong ri ba'i sman sna phul ba de dang / rin chen bye mas bkang ste bar stong rnams legs par gtams/ de nas dar gos bzang po dmar ser nyis brtsegs kyis dkris par mtshams mtshams su gos dar gyis dam por bcings/ de'i thog tu yang na bza' spus legs kyis btum ste 'jim byugs kyis mi gsher ba'i ched shug shun gyis legs par lcibs pas zhib tshags thon par byas/ gso ma'i srad bu dag gis rnam par bcings nas 'thor 'khrugs su mi 'gro ba byas zin pa na 'jim bzo bgyis te gtso sku rgyal ba byams pa'i sku gzugs dngos bzhengs pa la brtson pa cher bskyed kyis 'bad pa lhod med bgyis so/ /de'i tshe ming bkra legs pa'i zhal ta ba chos sgron gyis zhabs zhu sgrub pa dang / rang sde'i skye bo pho mo byings kyis sa dmar gyi 'jim par shog bu bsres te dngos gtsang brdungs shing phan tshun gcig mthun dang dad spro'i ngang byams pas dam bca'i gzungs dar dir du sgrog cing rab mtshams med par brtson pa shugs drag bskyed nas gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges legs kyi go 'phang thob byed kyi bag chags dngos gtsang bskrun par byas so/ /de yang kho bo cag gis gsol ba 'debs rten byams sku chen mo sgo dmar byams chen dang seng gshong ma mgo'i byams sku sogs byon gtsang dag la ma phyir byas/ dus 'khor dang sdom 'byung rtsa 181

'grel/ shā ri'i bus zhus pa/ tshangs pa'i tshad yig kṛ ya sa mu ts+tsha/ ko sa la'i rgyan sogs kyi dgongs don ltar phyis kyi bris pa tshad ldan gyi chag yig dang mthun par mdo rgyud gsal ba'i me long steng nas lha sku'i thig chen brgyad btab ste/ bzo dpon rgya mtsho dang bsod nams mkhar sogs dang dgongs bsdur gyis cha tshad thams cad blangs te bsgyur bcos 'os pa'i ngag bkod gang byas lha ris pa rnam pas dang du blangs/ de nas sku'i dbyibs phal cher 'jim bzo skabs seng gshong lha bzo yang lo na ches rgan pa'i stabs kyis zhib tshags ma thon pa na/ rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs shing sems dkyel che ba/ tshangs pa'i pir rtse yang dman par byas pa bzo bo rtser son bsod nams mkhar gyis bslab gsum nor gyis phyug pa rdo rje spun grogs bzo bo dge 'dun chos grags dang bsdebs te don gyis byams sku bzhengs pa'i bzo dpon gyi khur bzhes nas 'bad pa cher bskyed kyis bzhengs skabs/ kho bo cag gis dpyod ldan 'bag bzo'i rgyus shes pa dag la'ang legs nyes kyi cha rtog tu bcug ste bzo bo rnams kyi rang 'dod cung zad tsam yang ma zhugs pa dang / dka' tshegs la ma bltos par brtson pa shugs drag bskyed de bzhengs so zhes go bar bya'o/ /gtso bo'i skya bzo phal cher grub bstun sras gnyis sogs sgrub pa'i bya ba la 'bad de gtso 'khor gsum sogs kyi skya bzo phal cher legs par grub zin pa na skam thag chod pa sogs kyi phyir hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes nas 182

bzhengs mtshams byas te ngal bsos so/ /yab sras kyi sku tshad rnams gzhung dang mthun zhing re ltos ma phyi ltar ji bzhin byon gtsang phebs pa dang / mchog dman thams cad kyis cha gang nas bltas kyang yid drangs te dad pa 'phel ba dang rang gi rtog pa la yang yang 'dris par byas pa'i re ba las kyang ches cher 'phags pa zhig byon legs phebs pa ni tshe rabs kun tu bla ma rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa'i brda ru 'khums te/ spro dgas dad ldan ser skya pho mo'i yid bgang bar bgyis so/ /mdor na bzo dpon bsod nams mkhar dang / dge 'dun chos grags/ mi skya bzo bo tshe ring don grub ngo g.yog bcas kyang las 'bras dpang bzhag gis byams pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa la gang sgo nas mngon lkog bral zhing dad 'dun rtse gcig pas sha gang tsha byas pas rten bzhengs bla lhag tu grub pa byung ngo zhes gleng ngo / /de nas dga' ston dang 'brel seng gshong lha bzo la dmangs sgor chig khri lhag dang /gos rnam grangs du ma/ ja lan chung gcig ja bag lnga/ bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas pa dang / rang gi bzo bo rnams la lha dar sogs phul pa dang bzhengs pa'i las grwa btsugs pa nas lag 'jog skabs skabs kyi ster cha/ lag yon dga' rtags rnams la bzo bo mgu nges kyi dngos chas ma tshegs par phul te mgo mjug bar gsum thams cad du bzo bo rnams spro 'os pa'i las sha stag la 'bad do/ /gzhan yang bla ma dang 183

mchog gsum la dad pa'i nor gyis phyug pa/ kha ton dge sbyor dang sgos su lam rim tshirges bcad ma bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas blor bzung ste thos bsam byed pa sogs khyim pa'i lta ba las ring du gyur pa'i dge ba can par rko rtser son pa dge bsnyen bkra shis kyis rgyal ba byams pa'i phyag mtshan 'khri shing gi sdong bu yal ga lo ma pad 'dab dang / chos kyi 'khor lo spyi blugs dang bcas shing stag pas legs par brkos te 'bur thon byung ba la lha dar bcas lag yon gyi ster cha mi dman par bgyis so//1995lo'i hor zla brgyad pa'i dkar tshes la rka sar skya ser nas kyang byams khang la gser tshon 'bul ba dang / gyan bar so so'i gyan thang bzhengs pa sogs kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo mngon par 'du byed pa la phyogs te/ shing ris gtong ba la lha ris pa gtso bo bsod nams mkhar dang dge 'dun chos grags zung gis nus pa yod dgu bton nas tshon ris kyi 'gan bzhes pa dang / brtsi bzhag bla ma las thog pa dge 'dun sbyin pa dang dge bskos dge 'dun don grub gnyis gtsos grwa ba bar shar pa rnams dang / sde dpon rdo rje dang kun bzang / ja ma bun phrang dang rdo rje dbang rgyal sogs lha bzo ngo g.yog bcu phrag drug lhag gis g.yo zol dang sla chos su ma song bar thams cad gang nus kyis tshon rtsi zla gnyis kyi ring legs par grub par bgyis pa dang / sgos su rgya mthongs khar lañdza/184

byams pas dam bca'i gzungs bris pa dang / phyi'i khyams la bzo bo bi shwa karma yang skyengs par byed pa snga na ma byung ba'i ri mo dang gser tshon lta na sdug kyang yid du 'ong ba'i matros ris khyad du 'phags pa ngo mtshar can du mas spras pas phul byung ltar grub pa ni sus bltas kyang sum rtsen lha'i khang bzang yang dman par byas nas 'gran gyi do med du gyur to/ /lha dpon zung gtsor byas nas bzo bo rnams la 'dzugs sgang grol gsum dang dga' ston lag yon sogs kyis thugs gang dges mdzad do/ /gzhan yang byams khang phyi nang gi gser tshon gyi 'gro song la shog sgor gnyis khri lhag sgar grong spyi so nas btang / phyi nang gyan bar gyi gyan thang la lha khang gi 'og shod du sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs dang / rgya mthongs su rje tsong kha brgyad cu dang zhing bkod sna tshogs/ sum thog gi gyan bar rnams su rnam 'dren skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs dang rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu sogs bzheng rgyur phran bdag gis sgar grong gi gros dbang rnams la gsal btab ste ci nas kyang bzheng dgos tshul gyi kha ta slob gso nan cher mdzad pas gros mthun byung / de nas sgar nas spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas sogs dang grong nas sde dpon rdo rje rnams las byed pa tshan dag sne mo bar bskos te gyan thang rnams kyi gtso sku'i skya thig phal cher lha'i bzo bo rka sar klu 'bum lha ris pa rje byang chub rab gsal gyi phyag rgyun bla na med par 'dzin pa/ bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes shing 185

dad dam gtsang mas chos 'dul ba'i nang mdzod 'dzin pa'i rnam dpyod can bzo bo rtser son dge 'dun chos grags dang / bzo dpon bsod nams mkhar zung gis btab pa dang / phyi'i khyams ra'i rgyal chen spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras gnyis ni dge 'dun chos grags dang / yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po gnyis bsod nams mkhar gyis bzhengs pas rgyal chen bzhi'i rus tshugs zhib tshags tshon mdangs bcad 'then lugs gser bris sogs gang la bltas na'ang lta bas chog mi shes shing rka sar lha ris pa'i bzo rtsal gyi khyad chos 'bur thon byung ba dang / gson nyams ldan pa sogs kun gyi bsam brjod las 'das pa'i mig gi bdud rtsi bla na med par gyur/ bris thang de dag rka sar lha ris pa'i bzo rgyun spel mkhas sde 'di'i bzo bo rtser son ser skya rnams kyis gser tshon gyi 'gro gron phangs med du btang ste mi rang sger gyis khas blangs pas ji ltar bzhengs pa dag ni 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar ro//1996lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i yar tshes bzang por bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo 'phags pa rgyal gyis byams mgon yab sras la 'bul rgyu'i gser dmar dang gser skya rnams tshags su chud par byas pa la/ bzo dpon bsod nams mkhar dang dge 'dun chos grags zung gtsos rang sde'i mi skya lcags byams rgyal dang dge bskos las thog pa dge don/ zhal ta ba ja ma dge 186

'dun sbyin pa ngo g.yog bcas kyis kyang las 'bras dpang bzhag gis na bza' sogs la thog mar gser sbyor spyad kyi thong g.yis sum skud byas rjes gser skya dang gser dmar gang 'os kyis bsdebs nas 'bul ba la brtson pa dang / byams sku'i dbu rgyan la yang gser dmar dang gser skya 'thab nas phul te rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku brnyan la gser btul ma phul ba dang / dbu rgyan gyi dkyil gyi dbus su dgon 'di'i rten rnying grags pa can gso sbyong ston pa li sku byin can bzhugs su gsol te shel sgos btums pas sgrib med du gsal bor mjal thub/ de nas bzo dpon dge 'dun chos grags kyis gser dmar rnams btul bas gser mdangs legs po byung / de nas yab sras gsum gyi sku shar gser btul ma phul cing / rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'phra bkod dang bcas khyad par du 'phags pa dang / mdor na shā ri'i bus zhus pa las/ bris pa'i las mtha' rab tu byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar bzo rig pa'i las la mkhas shing 'dod pa chung la chog shes pa la sogs pa'i bzo bo'i khyad par bshad pa rnams yang dag par ldan pa'i lha bris pa rtser son pa bsod nams mkhar dang / dge 'dun chos grags gnyis kyis gtsos lha bzo ngo g.yog sogs las byed so sos zho sha yod dgus mi pham rgyal ba'i dbang pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs gang 'gyur gyis gser chab phul bas kun gyi bsam don yid bzhin du grub/ zla tshes bzang por gtso sku'i spyan 'byed skabs/187

rgyal ba byams pa mgon po rdo rje gdan gyi spo la bzhugs te chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du skor ba na skal bzang 'brel thogs rnams dgyes pa'i spyan ras zum pa med pas rjes su skyong ba'i bkra shis rten 'brel gyi dan rtags ni/ byams sku'i gser mdangs dang spyan ras kyi 'byed legs pa 'dzum nyams sogs smra bsam brjod las 'das pa byung bas ser skya pho mo kun gyis smon gnas rnams yid bzhin du grub pa dang / grong ri dgon kun rgyal ba byams pa la dad shugs ma zhan pa dang khyad par du bzheng pa por dad stobs lhag par che ba'i rtags su gleng ba don gnas su 'khums so/ /de lta bu'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di thog ma'i 'dun pa btang ba nas bzung mdo sngags bstan pa'i srog shing shes bya kun gzigs khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' rje 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtshos gegs dang bar chad thams cad byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis bsal/ rang gzhan la ljags bkod gang dgos rnams dgongs zhib kyis mdzad/nang bzhugs kyi rten sogs phyag bstar gyis mdzad 'os pa rnams phyag bdar gyis mdzad nas gzhung bzung / zang zing dpal 'byor gyi gtong ba yangs pa'i sgo 'byor ldan 'phags pa rgyal nas phye/ las byed kyi 'gan rnams rka sar dgon grong gis bgyis/ phran bdag gis kyang bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum du bkod khyab lhu things par byas te gegs med bde blag tu sngar bsam pa las lhag 'grub byung ngo / /byams pa'i 188

g.yas kyi khri steng du dpal mnyam med jo bo rje'i sku brnyan mi tshad las brgal ba la khri drug 'gyogs dang ldan par srog shing gzungs gzhug dang bcas bslab gsum nor gyi bdag po zhi dul bag yod can lhag bsam ldan pa'i phul byung can gyi bzo bo dge 'dun chos grags kho bos 'gro gron btang ste lag bstar gyis 'jim bzo bgyis nas gser chab dang bcas cha tshang phul ba dang / byams pa'i g.yon du rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i snang brnyan gong gi de bzhin du gtong phod che zhing gzhan phan ldan pa/ blo grim zhing las la mkhas pa/ tshangs pa'i pir rtse yang dman par byed pa'i bzo bo bsod nams mkhar gyis snga ma ji lta ba bzhin bzhengs pa lags pas/ gang ltar kyang bzo bo rtser son pa 'di gnyis ni rang ga ba zhig dang mi mtshungs par sngon gyi legs smon grub pas/mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du 'dus bzang chos gling gi bstan srid kyi bya ba rnams ha cang nyag phra zhing nyam chung ba'i dus su gzhi nas gsos te phyag rjes bsub tu med pa bskrun pa ni dus mtha' 'dir chos sde 'di la mtshon na dkon tshod du gda' bas bka' drin ches mchog tu che zhing ser skya yongs nas rjes su yi rang gi gnas so/ /gzhan yang byams chen bzheng skabs su lag yon phar zad 'tsho chas kyang ngan ngon tsam la brten nas bka' spyad 'bad brtson lhur bzhes kyis ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad bzang khyad mtshar bskrun pa ni ha las pa zhig yin no/ /des na gtsug lag khang 189

rten dang brten pa'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di sgrub pa'i sbyor ba brtsams pa nas mjug grub pa'i bar rong 'brog gi dad ldan pho mo kun gyis dngos rdzas kyi 'brel thogs pa mtho ba rta dang glang bo/ dma' ba khab dang skud pa sogs ci 'byor gyis phul ba rnams sne mo ba dag gis chud zos su ma btang bar rten bzhengs phyogs la dmigs te gtong rtsis kyis zhib rtsis sogs do dam gang drags bgyis pa ni/ zhwa dmar ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/ sbyin bdag rang gi srog las gces pa'i nor/ /dad pas phul ba gnyen 'khor 'dus tshogs kyis/ /ci dgar spyod pa ma brtags nyams bde yang / /phyi ma'i rnam smin dran tshe 'jigs su rung / /dad gshin dkor rdzas dzam bu ljon pa'i 'bras/ /zhing mchog ma dros rgya mtshor skyed bsrings pas/ /bsod nams gser sbyangs rnam smin rin thang tshad/ /gzhal du med par gyur pas bdag yid drangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi dgongs pa mngon du byas te/ /zhe thag pa nas ci nus kyis 'bad pa lhod med bgyis so/ /'o na rgyal ba byams pa'i sku gzugs mthong grol ma 'di de ltar legs par grub par bgyis na/ /de'i 'gro sgo zang zing nor gyi bdag po bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtso bo ni ji lta bu zhe na bshad par bya ste/ de yang bzheng pa po sbyin pa'i bdag po ni/ bla ma dang mchog gsum la dad gus nor gyis brgyan cing /bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho bas sde 'di'i rgyan du che ba/190

nor lha'i rgyal bo'i gan mdzod la mnga' dbang sgyur pa'i rka sar 'phags pa rgyal ces pa ste/ ji skad du/ sbyin bdag lhag bsam mi ldan pa/ /phrag dog 'gran sems kun slong gis/ /theg pa chung zhing 'gyod sems can/ /ngang thung bzod bsran shin tu chung / /nor gyi tha shal g.yo sgyus bslus/ /dpa' bo bzhin du gzengs mtho ba/ /dge ba'i lam srol snub byed ni/ /rang gzhan phun tshogs nyams pa'i rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sbyin bdag gi skyon dang bral zhing / bsod nams tshogs ni mi nyams shing / /legs par sdud pa'i sbyin bdag ni/ /dad ldan byas pa shes pa yis/ /lha dang lha bzo dbyer med du/ /dge ba'i lam la dang ba'i blos/ /gtong ba'i gom pa 'god par byed/ /theg pa che zhing snying stobs ldan/ /phan yon mtha' dag sdud par byed/ /sbyin bdag mchog gi mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sbyin bdag gi mtshan nyid dang rjes su mthun pa zhig ste/ sbyin bdag de nyid kyi rang bzhin cung tsam spro na/btsan phyug dpal gsum 'dzoms pa'i sde 'di'i khrod na bu rabs tsha rgyud bdun gyi ring ya rabs kyi las la brtson cing srid 'byor bla na med pa'i dpal gyis brgyan pa'i gzi byin 'gran zla dang bral bas rnam par dkar ba'i las kyi gra ma nyams pa yar zla'i rjes su snyegs pa dang / sngon bsags bsod nams kyi 'bras bu dus su smin pa/ rka sar phyug po mar grags pas kun la mthong rtsis dang gdeng 'jog mtho ba'i pha rgan sha bo'i 191

bur skyes so/ /chung dus nas bzung rgan la sri zhu dang dman pa rnams la snying brtse bas sbyin gtong la dga' ba dang / dge 'dun gyi sde la rtsi 'jog gus 'dud ha cang che zhing / mchog gsum la dad pa dang rnam dkar gyi las la rgyun par brtson pa'i ya rabs kyi ngang tshul lhun gyis grub pa dang / pha rjes bus zin pas bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i spyi sems can zhig go /nga brgyad lor spyi tshogs mgo rting slog skabs chos srid kyi dpal gyis ci yang phyug pa'i a khu dang pha ma kho rang dang bcas khri mon du bcug ste mnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal drag po tshad med pa myangs pas pha khu rnams tshe dus byas/ kho rang btson ra las thar nas pha yul du 'byor rjes 'das gson gyi ched du zhe thag pa nas dge rtsa rnam dag bsgrubs/ de nas brgyad cu tham pa lor zhing 'dir bstan srid kyi skya rengs dang po shar la nye ba'i tshe/ rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling gi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bcas bshig gtor du btang nas ming tsam lhag med du gyur te ci bya gtol med la thug pa'i tshe/ thun rin rdzong na khyad par can gyi bstan srung 'dod khams dbang mo'i zangs gser las grub pa'i li sku zhig yod pa thos skad/ kho bo'i rnam par rtog pa'i 'char sgor/ sde 'di'i sngon gyi rten rnying khyad par ba srung ma dpal ldan lha mo'i sku brnyan las gzhan ci snyam nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug blo bzang sangs rgyas sogs la zhus te skyen par gdan 'dren par chas pas 192

dgon pa'i 'du khang gi shul ga dar dang gtsang sbra legs par byas/ sde dpon pad+ma rgyal gyis spyan drangs pa'i tshe sde 'di'i skye bo phal mo ches sngar lo grangs bcu phrag zung lhag gi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi sgra tsam yang ma thos par gzhan dbang du gyur pas som nyi'i dra bar tshud/ yin na'ang sde 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan srung 'dod khams dbang mos sde 'dir slar yang bshad sgrub gyi bstan pa spel bar dus las ma yol bas legs par byon pa'i rten 'brel ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs su song gshis/kun gyis dad 'dun dang yid ches kyi gting tshugs pa byung / 'di'i skabs su 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen yang ha cang zhan stabs da lta dang bsdur na gnam sa'i khyad par mchis na'ang / bstan srung la mchod bya'i bsangs rtsi lo 'khor gcig la 'dang tshod cig dang / mchod pa mchod me snyan shal sogs gang 'byor phul te ya rabs kyi bya ba rnams bde blag tu 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug nan chen zhus/ de nas 'tsho chas kyang ngan ngon tsam la brten nas chos sde 'di la ram 'degs gang drag bgyis/ chos sgo 'byed skabs su gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi sngags dung phyur can gyi 'khor lo che ba zhig bskor bas grwa btsun rnams thugs gang dges kyis grogs/ mdzad/ dmangs sgor nyis stong lnga brgya lhag 'gro gron btang ste bzhengs/ de'i phyi lor lha sar tshong grogs dang bcas lhan du 'byor/ de nas rka sar lha rams pa brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i sku dbon ye shes rgyal 193

mtshan dang 'phrad skabs des bshad rgyur/ khyod dang 'phrad pa shin tu bzang / bdag gi bsten pa lha mo yin stabs nga dgu lor sku gsung thugs rten gyi phung bo dpag tu med pa jo khang gi mdun nas me la sreg pa'i tshe/mtshan mor ma gcig dpal lha mo'i rma bya'i sgro gdugs 'di me las phyir bton te da lta'i bar nyar tshags do dam byas yod/ nga'i bsam tshod la yang rten rnying bla na med pa 'di rang gi dgon par 'phrod na snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang yod ces bsnyad/ kho bos kyang rten 'brel ha cang 'grig song snyam pa'i sa dang po rab tu dga' ba thob pa ltar dga' spro tshad med skyes rung bya ba brel 'tshab che bas de'i steng du ma 'khel par rim 'gyangs su lus/ rang yul du log nas rnal 'byor ba blo bzang sangs rgyas sogs la rgyu mtshan zhus tshe/ khong rnam pas de ni chos sde 'di bstan srung chen mos dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung ba'i dan rtags rang yin pas/chos sde 'di dpal ldan lha mos thugs nas ma bsnyel par 'phrin las g.yel med du sgrub nges so/ /zhes gzengs bstod dang bcas cis kyang spyan 'dren dgos pa'i zhal ta gnang / gsung de bden par nges nas slar yang blo stobs bskyed de lha sar chas nas bde 'jags ngang brtol/de'i dus su lam bgrod dka' bas ha cang stabs bde min yang dka' ba khyad bsad kyis sems gcig blo gcig gis bstan srung dgyes pa'i bya ba gang nus kyis bsgrubs/ de nas sku dbon ye shes rgyal mtshan btsal te 194

song skabs kho rang gi rgan mo ma rtogs med pas sngar lo'i rgyu mtshan rnams bsnyarde tshe/ kho mo na re/ ye shes rgyal mtshan kho rang mi rtag pas zin/ mos rgyu mtshan de 'dra mi shes zhes lab/ de nas phyir log nas nyal /lang du 'dug pa'i tshe/ tshong grogs shig gis kye a khu 'phags pa rgyal khyed nyid 'dir shog dang a lags khri rgan tshang rgya gar nas 'dir phebs 'dug myur du mjal du 'gro zhes bshad pas dga' spro dang bcas tshong grogs rnams dang lhan du khong la mjal kha zhus nas srung ma'i rma bya'i sgro gdugs kyi rgyu mtshan zhus te lung bstan gnang bas ha cang bzang gsungs/ de skabs srid jus dog pas rkyen dbang du 'gro nyen che bar dogs nas phyi nyin gzhan la gsang ste ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta tshe tan zhabs drung rin po che'i sku mdun du song / de dus khong ni lha sa'i rig gnas khang la zhu dag gi mdzad sgo spel bzhin bzhugs par sngar gyi rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pa'i tshe/khong nas thugs dgyes dgyes kyis rigs kyi bu 'di 'dra'i rten 'gangs chen zhig lag tu 'ong dka' bas thabs mkhas kyis myur du gdan 'dren pa la chas dang lam bar du gegs dang chos skyong gis 'khren cha mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las khong gis zhu zhes bka' mchid lhu things pa dang bcas gsung gi gnang ba thob/ de dus dngos chas ha cang dkon pa'i sgang du song gshis lha sa'i tshong grwa nas mar rgya ma nyer drug nyos nas slar yang kho mo'i mdun du song ste yus dang bcas phul te rgyu mtshan zhus pa na/ kho 195

mos kyang dga' ba'i 'dzum dang bcas de 'dra zhig yin na gdan zhu byos dang rten rnying khyad par ba 'di na mchis zhes rma bya'i sgro gdugs cha tshang ba de kho rang la sprad de song / de nas ma 'gyangs par rang dgon du legs par gdan drangs so/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan ni rka sar lha rams pa'i sku dbon yin pas/ lha rams pa khong dam bca' bzhag ste a mdor phebs pa'i tshe phyag khrid gnang nas rang dgon du bcar bzhugs mdzad/ nga bdun lor rkyen dbang gis phyir rang yul lha sar phebs pa zhig go /gang ltar kyang lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams grogs mdzad pa la brten nas/ lo stong phrag lhag gi dngos rdzas bla na med pa/ sngon gyi chos rgyal rim byon dang rgyal dbang yab sras sogs skyes chen gnam gyis sa bkab pa ltar rim par byon pa dag gis ye shes pa rnams dngos su bstems te byin gyis brlabs pa'i ma gcig dpal lha mo'i rma bya'i sgro gdugs 'di nyid reb gong gser mo ljongs dpal nā len+d+ra rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gang gi le lag tu gtogs pa sgrub pa'i sde chen po rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling gi rten khrod kyi gtso bor bzhugs so/ /de nas 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi tshe/ dmangs sgor bdun stong ri bas yon sbyar te kho rang nyid lag bstar gyis lha sa'i rtse zhol bka' 'gyur gdan drangs pa dang chabs cig tu sku 'bum byams pa gling nas gser zangs kyi byang chub mchod rten khru tsi gsum can zhig blus 196

te gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs/ 'du khang la dgos nges kyi mchod pa'i yo chas zangs gser las grub pa'i theb tse che ba bdun tshar gnyis dang / de 'dra'i spus legs can theb tse 'bring bdun tshar gsum bcas phul ba dang / gya dgu lor phran gyis dgon 'di'i dge rgan gyi ming tsam khur te lam rim bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas tshogs 'don du ched 'dzugs skabs/ dge 'dun pa rnams la mang ja 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / phran la ja lan chung gcig gos yug gcig lha dar sgor bcaso phul te bsnyen bkur gzab/ de nas bzung bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi dus mchod zla1 1tshes5la lam rim gsung ba'i rgyun tshugs pas 'di phyi'i don bde blag tu grub/ de nas dgon 'di'i byams khang grub ste rten gtso byams sku ma bzhengs pa'i skabs shig la/ phran nas kyang dgun chos grol nas chos mtshams la lo ltar 'di gar dpe khrid kyi rgyun skyong bzhin mchis pa'i tshe/ dgon pa'i gros dbang rnams rim 'byor gyis byams chen ji ltar bzhengs pa'i gros byas pa dang / sngar lo byams khang bzhengs skabs su rka sar dud khyim re res 'brel thogs kyang dkar thigs bslangs zin pas slar yang 'os 'gab med par dgongs nas re zhig bzhag de nas phran bdag gis kyang bla ma dang lha la gsol ba btab ste ji ltar byas na bzang snyam pa'i bsam gzhigs btang mthar/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo 'phags pa rgyal la zhu dgos snyam ste/ zla tshes bzang bor ri rtser 197

nyi shar gyi dus su nye gnas bzhin bzang dge 'dun tshe ring mngags te 'bod du bcug nas lhan du nang ja 'thung skabs/ kho rang dga' spro dang bcas 'dzum nyams kyis de ring bya ba ci yin lags zhes bshad zhor du mdang tho rangs gnyid log pa'i skabs su rmi ltas bzang bo zhig byung bas/bud med mdzes ma na gzhon 'brog mo zhig los yin snyam pa zhig 'ongs nas dgyes nyams dpe med mdzad pa zhig rmis pas/ mnal sad de hor nag gi mgron po zhig yod pa de la bsnyad de kye 'di ni a ma dpal ldan lha mos nga la grogs bgyid pa'i snga ltas yin zhing rmi lam 'di 'dra nam byung na nga'i bsam don 'grub nges yin zhes bshad ma thag 'bod mi dge 'dun tshe ring sgo 'gram du slebs pa dang dus mtshungs byung ba'i rten 'brel ha cang 'grigs zhes bshad/ de nas bdag gis kyang dri ma med pa'i lha dar sngon du btang ste ma 'ongs tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus kyi mgon po rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan bzhengs dgos tshul las brtsams te go don rags tsam brjod nas bkra shis bde legs kyi rten 'brel zhus pa na/ kho bos legs so e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang / khyed rnam pas ram 'degs kyis dang bdag gis bka' bzhin du sgrub nges lags zhes bshad pa na/sgar grong gi sde mo ba dag gis kyang kho bo la bstod bsngags dang bcas kha btags btang nas zhe thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes rjes su yi rang byas so/ /sku brnyan bzheng rgyu'i dbu btsugs pa nas bzung ste bstan pa'i sbyin 198

bdag chen mo 'phags pa rgyal dang klu mo rgyal bza' tshos gos yug dmar po dang ser bo thag mgo du ma dang bcas brazheng bya'i mkho dgu'i yo byad rnams lag thogs mi dgos par tshags su chud par byas nas skya bzo'i mjug grub pa'i bar bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di khur du blangs te ci nus kyis bsgrubs so/ /skya bzo grub rjes lha dpon la bya dga' dang bcas 'gro song rags rtsis byas na dmangs sgor bzhi khri lhag btang bas so/ /de rjes gser chab kyi dus su'ang zhal gser rnams la gser dmar btul ma dang / de las gzhan pa na bza' sogs la gser skya phul te gser mdangs sogs gang cha nas bsams kyang 'di ma 'grub bya ba gcig kyang med pas phul byung ltar rang byon du grub pa ni spyir bod gangs can gtsos rgyal khams spyi dang khyad par du reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi yul gru rnams dang / nang sgos su rka sar sgar grong gi dad pa dag snang dang bsod nams/ sbyin bdag 'phags pa rgyal dang klu mo rgyal gnyis kyi las bsod dang lhag bsam gyis sku brnyan gser gyi lhun po ltar rab tu brjid cing mdzes pa'i rnam pa can zhig nye bar byon pa ni smra bsam brjod las 'das pa zhig go /rang gi lha bzo bsod nams mkhar dang dge 'dun chos grags sogs la bya dga' dang bcas ston chung mdzad de thugs gang dges mdzad/ khong rnam pas kyang gser chab 'bul skabs sems thag pa nas sha gang tsha'i sgo nas gtsigs su bzung ste legs par 199

grub pa byung / 'di'i skabs su 'gro gron rags rtsis brgyab na dmangs sgor khri bcu tham pa btang ba dang / song tho skya bzo dang gser sogs la khyon bsdoms dmangs sgor khri bcu bzhi lhag btang ste bzhengs pa 'dis mtshon pas rang gi pha ma gnyis gtsos mkha' khyab kyi ma rgan sems can thams cad gcig kyang ma lus pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i skyabs 'jug smon lam dang bcas byams pa'i sku gzugs phul byung bzhengs pa la/ /mthun rkyen sgrub par byed pa'i lus can rnams/ /rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i zhabs drung du/ /theg mchog chos kyi dpal la spyod par shog /ces gsol ba 'debs pa dang smon lam gang shes kyis rgyas btab bo/ /mdor na bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rka sar sgar grong gis dngos po ci 'byor gyis 'brel thogs pa dang / yang na dad ldan sbyin bdag rnams kyis 'di'i phyogs la lus kyis 'bad brtson byas pa dang / ngag gis kha bkod bgyis pa dang /yid kyis gegs med bde blag tu grub na ci ma rung snyam pas spro dga' dang bcas rjes su yi rang byas pa ste sgo gsum gang rung gis 'brel thogs te 'bad pa rnams don dang ldan zhing / mngon mtho dang nges legs bsgrub pa'i rgyu phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba gdon mi za bas 'og tu phan yon gyi skabs su 'chad 'gyur ltar go bar bya'o/ /de ltar bde blag tu grub 'phral mchod pa'i yo byad rnams grogs po'i blor mi shong ba zhig bshams te/ rnal 'byor ba blo 200

bzang sangs rgyas gtsos smyug thogs pa blo bzang 'od zer dang slob dpon sangs rgyas rgyal/ rtsi bzhag las thog pa dge 'dun sbyin pa/ dge bskos las thog pa dge don dang phran bcas kyis gdugs bdun la 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i cho ga sngon du btang ste/ rab gnas dngos gtsang btsugs nas byin rlabs kyi char phab bo/ /gzhan yang gzhung lugs smra ba dge 'dun 'od zer gyis steng du gser zangs kyi gañdzi ra dang / nang du dung dkar cha bcas phul/ spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas kyis dngul srang zhe gnyis phul te seng gshong dngul mgar gyis bzos pa'i dngul rkong che legs de la bzo yon spyi gzhung nas sgor chig stong dgu brgya sprad/ theb tse spus legs can bdun tshar che ba gnyis 'phags pa rgyal gyis dang / de 'dra'i bdun tshar gcig spyi gzhung nas bzhag theb tse chung ba stong sgar grong spyi nas bzhag ban des dmangs sgor chig stong ri ba'i mdzes cha can spus legs bum pa che ba cha/ don grub kyis rdo dril dang byams pa mgon po'i na bza' za 'og gi cod pan mdzes cha can sogs mchod rdzas yo chas gya nom pa mkho dgu rnams mdzes par spud/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nya la 'grub ston dpe med mdzad de bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'phags pa rgyal bza' tshang 'khor bcas la/ dgon pa'i sne mo ba dag gdan 'dzoms nas spyi dang bye brag gi legs so 'bul ba'i bshad gtam mthil phyin pa bka' drin che ba'i gzengs bstod dang sbrags bstan pa dang 'gro 201

ba la phan pa'i bya ba bgyid pa'i bka' 'doms snying la lci ba dang /bka' drin gtang rag tu/ dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas kyis mtshon tshe rabs kyi phreng bar bla ma rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos dngos su rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo yangs por grol ba'i don du rnam 'dren lnga ba lung ston byams pa gos drub byon gtsang che legs/ma 'gyangs par zung 'jug gi rgyal thabs rang dbang du spyod pa la dngos grub zhu ba'i ched du lam sngags kyi glegs bam zung / skyes bu gsum gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rang rgyud la mngon par byang chub par 'gyur ba'i bka' drin stsol ba'i don du byang chub mchod rten/ phrug gcig spus legs gos yug gcig dmangs sgor chig stong /ja lan chung gcig ja nag du ma/ lha rdzas che legs dkar ser zung dang bcas phul te sgar grong so so nas bka' drin zhus so//gsum pa ni/ nang bzhugs rten ji ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul ni/ dang po seng khri'i dbang du byas pa la seng khri'i gtso bo gter bum rnams sngar bshad ltar gter bum gyis gtsos bang mdzod kyi dngos rdzas rten 'brel gyis sa bcad ma stong zhing nyer spyad kyi rigs khyad par can gyi dgos pa la dmigs pa rnams 'dzoms pa'i khul du spungs te/ dbus kyi gter bum khar gnod sbyin pho mo gtso byas pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang srog shing gdan dang tshogs bdag 'khor lo bcas bzhugs su gsol ba'i mthar dzam dkar nag dang nor sbyin ma dag gi 'bum khang mthar chags 202

su legs par bsgrigs so/ /sku'i gtso bo srog shing ni gru bzhir bzhengs pa'i gnas yig lnga ste/ spyi bor o/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar ṭ+wāṃ/ gsang gnas su hrīḥ bcas gser gyi lañdza bkod/ mdun phyogs su yi dam gsang 'dus kyi dbang brgyud man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla brgyud/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs sogs/ gsang 'dus lha tshogs kyi gsang sngags/ bka' sdod mgon po gtso bor gyur pa dang /g.yas phyogs su rgya chen spyod brgyud dang rlabs chen spyod brgyud/ yi dam 'jigs byed kyi dbang brgyud man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla brgyud/'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i lha tshogs kyi gsang sngags/ bka' sdod chos rgyal phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dang bcas pa/ rgyab phyogs su nyams len byin rlabs brgyud dang / yi dam dus 'khor/ khro bo rdo rje shugs gtso bor gyur pa dang / g.yon phyogs su zab mo lta brgyud dang phyag chen brgyud pa/ yi dam bde mchog dang / bka' sdod rnam sras gtso bor gyur pa'i gnas so sor 'bri 'os pa'i gzungs rnams dang /gso sbyong dang / bkra shis dang / phyogs so sor dam bca'i gzungs don chen po la dmigs pa'i 'dod gsol re dang zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'dod gsol dag go rim ma 'chol bar mthong ba brgyud pa'i man ngag ltar gser bzang pos bod yig dbu can du bzhengs te bzhugs pas ni nang bzhugs kyi srog 'dzin pa yin no/ /de yang nang rten de la ring bsrel 203

rnam pa bzhi las 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams kyi mtshan byang go rim du bkod de de'i mjug tu ring bsrel gzhan rnams phyogs sdeb bya bar 'dod do/ /des na nang bzhugs sku'i rten gyi gtso bo rin chen ril bu'i dbus sku rje mchod 'dzin ma lo rgyus can/ rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho'i gdung tshu'i rje sku/ gser zangs las grub pa'i rje mchod 'dzin ma/ dbus nas byon pa'i rje sku gnyis/ rdo rje 'chang a bh+ya zhabs kyi gdung tshwa'i rje sku/ rje tshong dpon dge legs ma/ rten 'dam las grub pa'i rje sku/ spos 'dam las bzos pa'i rje sku/ rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang a bh+ya zhabs/ rdo rje 'chang blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs kyi snang gro/ thub pa thog mtha' mar grags pa'i sku byin can/ la mo bde chen gyi rten sgrom nas byon pa'i bstan pa'i bdag po'i snang brnyan sman sku byin ldan dkar chag can/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i phyag tsha ston pa bzhi/ gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku/ sngar gyi byams chen gyi gzungs gzhug nas byon pa'i ston pa'i sku che legs/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag tsha 'jigs byed dpa' gcig la 'khor bcu gcig gis bskor ba'i byin rlabs gzi 204

'bar/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi phyag tsha 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa/ rten 'dam gyis bzos pa'i 'jigs mdzad rdo rje lha bcu gsum pa/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gdung tshwa'i 'jigs byed kyi sku /rgyal sras phyag tsha yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku/ jo bo rje dpal a ti sha'i phyag tsha/ rdo rje 'chang gi gdung tshwa 'khor chen dang 'jigs byed/rten 'dam las grub pa'i gsang bdag 'khor chen/ jo bo rje'i phyag tsha 'od dpag med/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i 'dra sku dbus nas gdan drangs pa/ rdo rje 'chang g.yer gshong tshang gi phyag tsha dus 'khor sku bdun/rgyal tshab rje'i dngul sku byin can/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i sku gsum/paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i phyag tsha mi 'khrugs pa/ chos rje don grub rin chen gyi phyag tsha/ rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho'i ba/dung tshwa'i rigs gsum mgon po/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i ba/dung tshwa/ de'i gdung tshwa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ brag dkar sprel rdzong nas byon pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ lha ldan nas byon pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sku che legs/ skal ldan blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'dra sku/ rten 'dam gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rdo rje 'chang gi gdung tshwa'i gsang bdag sgrol ma/ sgrol dkar/ dbyangs can ma/rnam 'dren bla ma yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i phyag tsha sgrol dkar/ rten 'dam las grub pa'i dbyangs can ma shar bla brang nas byon pa/ sku phyogs 205

bla kho rin po ches gnang ba'i phongs sel sgrol ma/ mgon po'i sku/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rje'i phyag phreng can tshogs bdag glang sna dkar bo/ shog gur par btab pa'i gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa yab sras kyi 'dra par brgyad/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo'i sku chig stong drug brgya/ gos thang nyis brgya/ gtso 'khor gsum pa brgyad/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku lnga/ mgon po 'od dpag med kyi sku chig stong drug brgya/rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i sku chig stong drug brgya/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sku chig stong drug brgya/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ mnyam med jo bo rje/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ rje tshe 'dzin ma/ yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho/ sgrol ma rnams kyi sku chig stong drug brgya re/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sku bzhi brgya bco lnga/sangs rgyas sman bla'i sku nyis brgya/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sku nyer gcig 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi sku sum brgya zhe gcig 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi sku bzhi bcu/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sku dgu/ tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sku bdun/ kun rig gi sku gsum/ gsang bdag gi sku bzhi brgya drug cu re gnyis/ rig byed ma'i sku bzhi bcu/ jo 'brom yab sras kyi sku lnga/ bu ston rin po che'i sku lnga/ sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i sku lnga/ gdugs dkar mo'i sku nyis khri drug stong dgu brgya/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi shog thang gnyis/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi shog thang gcig bcas bzhugs pa ni sku'i rten gyi rim pa'o//206

yang gya'i don grub kyis rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum cha tshang gcigayang gya'i dka' thub kyis rje yab sras kyi bka' 'bum cha tshang gcigarnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum cha tshang tshar bcu/rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig bcas pa ni bka' 'bum ji snyed bzhugs pa'i rim pa'o/ /yang gya'i byams pa dang yar skor blo bzang zung gis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog spus legs tshad ldan cha tshang gcig yar skor brtson 'grus dang mgo 'dug sha bo thar zung gis bka' 'gyur spus legs tshad ldan cha tshang gcig bcas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog cha tshang gnyis bzhugs so/ /gsang 'dus/ rtsa rgyud tshar gsum/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud tshar gsum/ 'jigs byed rgyud tshar gsum/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod tshar brgya/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod gser bris ma/ ting 'dzin tshar nyis brgya bcu/'phags pa tshar brgyad cu gya bdun/ bskal bzang tshar bdun cu don gnyis/ thar myo/do tshar sum cu/ yum 'bum pa dag tshar bdun/ nyi khri pod gsum/ gser 'od sa bcu ma tshar nyer bzhi/ rdo rje gcod pa tshar lnga/sman bla'i zhing mdo mdo sde brgyad brgya ba/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing mdo/gser bris gcig dang skya pod gcig bcas mdo sdud pa tshar gnyis/ gso ba rig pa'i rgyud ba'i/ tshar gnyis bcas pa ni rgyal ba'i bka' ji snyed bzhugs pa'i rim pa'o/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo tshar gya bdun/ sngags rim chen mo 207

tshar brgyad/ legs bshad gser d+meng tshar bdun/ byams chos sde lnga/gzhung pod lnga'i rtsa ba/ rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho'i rtogs brjod tshar gsum dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar nyi shu/ zhabs brtan gsol 'debs tshar nyi shu/ skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i tshe rabs rjes 'dzin tshar brgya dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar lnga/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs tshar brgya/ skyabs 'gro tshar brgya/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma tshar brgya/ rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros kyi gsang 'bam ༄ ༄pod dang po tshar gsum/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum tshar bcu/ spyod 'jug chen mo tshar bcu gcig zhwa dmar lam rim tshar gsum/ g.yu rngog rin chen rdo rje tshang gi skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya tshar gsum/ tshad ma rig thigs tshar gnyis/ dpag bsam 'khri shing tshar gnyis/ skyes rabs so bzhi ba tshar gsum/ rten 'brel bstod pa tshar brgya/ gser bris kyi mdo sde rgyan/sman mchog chen mo tshar drug lam sgron tshar nyer lnga/ rje'i khyad par 'phags bstod tshar brgya/ sems can mgu bar byed pa'i bstod pa tshar brgya/ bstod sprin rgya mtsho tshar nyer lnga/ sman thung tshar nga lnga/ gsang bdag 'khor chen kyi cho ga tshar bco lnga/ gnas bcu tshar brgya/sgrol ma tshar bzhi/ dus 'khor gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar gsum/ snyan ngag dbyangs can dgyes glu tshar gsum/ sum rtags sogs kyi rtsa 'grel sogs mang po yod pa ni pod gzhung ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i rim pa'o/ /gser bris 208

kyi bzang spyod smon lam/ rje'i bstan pa dang mjal ba'i smon lam tshar gsum/ lam sngags zung gi smon lam tshar brgya re/ gnas mchog dga' ldan ma tshar sum brgya/ dag pa'i zhing mchog ma tshar brargya/ sham bha la'i smon lam tshar gnyis/ dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smen lam bcas pa ni smon lam ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dmigs brtse ma bdun khri lnga stong / byams pas dam bca'i gzungs drug khri lnga stong /'khor chen sngags bzhi khri nyis brgya/ ma ṇi drug khri/ a ra pa tsa brgyad khri dgu stong / rnam bcu dbang ldan mang bo/ rnam rgyal gzungs ring mang bo bcas dang / gzhan yang gtso bo dbu gzungs sogs gzungs gzhug chen mo tshar chig stong dang bcas pa ni gsung gi rten gyi rim pa'o/ /rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi ba'i phyag tsha mchod rten byin rlabs can dang / ri bo rtse lnga nas byon pa'i mchod rten dang / mchod rten brgyad sogs bzhugs pa ni thugs kyi rten gyi rim pa'o/ /ring bsrel gzhan rnams phyogs bsdebs su 'god pa gang zhe na/ sngar zhus zin pa ltar 'phel gdung bcu phrag drug lhag dang / sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi gdung thal/ bstan pa'i bdag po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gdung thal/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung tshwa dang gdung khrus ril bu/rdo rje gdan gyi ston pa'i na bza'/ lha ldan jo bo'i na bza'/ jo bo lo kai shwa ra'i na bza'/ chu bo nai k+ta'i 'gram du lo drug la dka' ba spyad pa'i 209

gnas chen gyi sdong bo'i yal ga yul wā rā ṇa sī'i mchod rten chen mo'i sa/rdo rje gdan gyi sa/ bya rgod phung bo'i ri'i sa ste bstan pa'i bdag po dang nye bar 'brel ba dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ / thugs rje chen po rang byung lnga ldan gyi sku gzugs kyi tshal bu 'khrul med/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i sku sha dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi na bza'/ bde bar gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung dang skyes chen dam pa du ma rje gong ma rim byon gyi byin rten sna mang 'dus pa'i ril bu/ 'phags bod skyes chen du ma'i sku'i ring bsrel sogs rten khag phyogs bsdebs kyi rten 'dus ril bu khyad 'phags can/ ri bo rtse lnga'i 'jam dbyangs kyi na bza' dang rgya khab/ de'i thugs rje chen po'i sku'i tshal bu/ jo bo rje a ti sha'i ma ṇi ril bu dang na bza'/ slob dpon pad+ma ka ra'i dbu ljon ril bu/ dbu zhwa / na bza'/ lha 'dre bka' tham/ bram ze skye ba bdun gyi sku sha'i ril bu/ skye bdun ril bu byin can rnams te 'phags bod kyi skyes chen dam pa dang nye bar 'brel ba'i byin rten rnams gyi mtshan byang khag gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i na bza'/ rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyi na bza'/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i na bza' dang mda'/ rwa lo rdo rje grags kyi gdung dkris dang dbu skra/ bsam yas mchod rten dkar bo'i nang bzhugs kyi gzungs/ be+e ro tsa na'i phyag bris/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma'i dbu skra/ sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi 210

sgrub khang gi sa dang sgrub gtor/ rje red mda' ba'i gdung tshwa/ lo chen ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi gdung tshwa/ dngul chu dharma bha dra'i chos gos/ sa skya gong ma rin po che'i na bza' dang phyag nas/ mgon po gur gyi na bza'/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i dbu zhwa/ chos rje don grub rin chen gyi snam sbyar/ phyag par/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal khebs/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi zhwa nag gi tshal bu/ lho rgyal sras rin po che'i dbu skra/ 'gro mgon rang grol gyi dbu skra/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi phyag phreng / bod kyi grub thob gong ma'i na bza'/ma gcig dpal lha mo'i na bza'/ yi dam bde mchog gi na bza' rnams ni lo chen mkhas grub phyogs 'dus rtsod med kyi byin rten mtshan byang phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ /gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan pa'i bdag po khams gsum bla ma shar tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi snam sbyar mi 'dra ba d+nghasmrasum/ na bza'/ tshems par/ rje bdag nyid chen pos nor lha dzam la sgrub pa'i sku brnyan gyi tshal bu/ chos rje don rin zhabs dang rje rin po che rnam gnyis kyi sgrub khang a ra pa tsa'i lha khang gi rten gtso'i thab sa/ dga' ldan gser gdung chen mo'i gur shing / srog shing gi tshal bu/ gser gdung gi sa/ gdung thal/ gdung tshwa/ rje nga 'dra ma'i sku chos dang na bza'/ rdzing phyi'i sems pa'i lhung bzed byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba can/ sku 'bum gser sdong gi byang chub shing / lo 211

ma/ rten 'dus ril bu/ dga' ldan chos rgyal rang byon gyi na bza'/'jam mgon bla ma'i thugs sras rje mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi sku chos/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i na bza'/ byams chen chos rje'i na bza'/ rje dge 'dun grub gyi na bza'/ rgyal dbang sku phreng gsum pa'i na bza'/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i na bza'/ dbu zhwa/ dbu skra/ phyag dpe'i glegs thag phyag nas/ khrus ril/ rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i bzhugs khri bdud rtsi can gyi cha shas/ rgyal ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i bzhugs gdan/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ na bza'/bzhugs gdan/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ sku chos/ dbu skra/ rten 'dus byin can/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang bsgyur mtshungs pa med pa'i sde dpal bzang po'i phyag phreng /na bza'/ sku chos/ zhabasu gags/ sku gzan/phyag nas/ tshe ril/zhal khrus/ rten 'dus/ dus dbang gi rdul tshon bye ma/ ma ṇi dung sgrub ril bu/ phur ba yang snying spu gri'i sgo nas smin sgrub bskyangs pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman 'phags bod skyes chen du ma'i byin rdzas/dus dbang 'thor 'bru/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi na bza'/gtsang chab ril bu/ sku 'gag paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi tshogs zhwa/ na bza'/ paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma'i na bza'/ rdul tshon bye ma/212

gsol rtsam/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po sku phreng bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i dbu zhwa/ dbu skra/ phyag nas/ tsha sngags bka' brgya ma/ zhal khrus/gdung tshwa/ bang khebs/ gzim 'bog bzhugs gdan/ byang sems dkar dmar gyi ril bu/ bkras lhun byams chen gyi na bza'/ paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza'/ rgyal dbang rim byon gyi bzhugs gdan/ rten 'dus ril bu/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman/ phur lcogs ngag dbang byams pa rin po che'i na bza'/ sku mched rin po che'i na bza'/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi dbu zhwa/ a rig dge bshes chen mo'i dbu skra/ gdung tshwa/ gdung rus/ rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin gyi dbu lo/ rje sang tshang smyung gnas pa'i tsha sngags/ dbu skra/ yongs 'dzin gling rin po che'i dbu lo/ gdung thal/ khri ngag dbang snyan grags kyi na bza'/ ba so rin chen gyi na bza'/ rwa sgreng tshang gi na bza'/yongs 'dzin khri byang rin po che'i na bza'/ sku phreng gsum pa'i na bza' bcas/ gong sa skyabs mgon rnam gnyis gtsos skyes chen khag gi byin rten gzi 'od 'phro ba rnams kyi mtshan byang dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ /ma/do smad kyi sgrub pa'i shing rta ba chen po rnam 'dren skal ldan rgya mtsho'i yang sprul ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ skyabs mgon dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi na bza'/ sku 'gag skyabs mgon 213

chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/skyabs mgon blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku gzan/ skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i gdung rus/dbu skra/ na bza'/ phyag phyis/ dbu zhwa bubs/ skyabs mgon bstan 'dzin 'jigs med skal ldan gyi sku 'gag bubs/ dbu skra/ mdo smad kyi bshad pa'i shing rta ba chen po kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i na bza'/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i na bza'/ 'jam bzhad sku phreng lnga ba'i na bza'/ drug pa'i phyag phyis rnams ni mdo smad bshad sgrub kyi shing rta ba rnam gnyis sku phreng dang bcas pa'i byin rten gyi mtshan byang phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ /rtsod med kyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba'i dbu skra/ sku phreng lnga ba'i sku 'gag dbu skra/rje gser khang rin po che'i dbu skra/ na bza'/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos chos pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/ gdung rus/gdung tshwa/ snam sbyar/ sku phreng gnyis pa sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyi sku gzan/ sku phreng bdun pa rje 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ na bza'/rje ma ṇi ba shes rab bkra shis kyi na bza'/ rje a rol blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ sku 'gag bubs tshang /zhabs phyag zung / sku sham/ phyag phyis/ gdung tshwa/ na bza'/ khri khebs/ sku gzan/ ḍā ma ru'i gos kyi tshal bu/ rje a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi na bza'/ phyag sen/ tshems/ sku thul/214

sku gzan/ zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ sku 'gag dbu skra/ zhabs phyags/ grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan pa'i dbu skra/ sku gzan/ na bza'/ sku 'gag rdo rje 'chang rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i gdung thal/ dbu zhwa/ sku 'gagazhabs phyags/ rten 'dus/ na bza'/ dbu skra/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ba'i gdung tshwa/ na bza'/ bzhugs gdan/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros kyi na bza'/ sku 'gag rten 'dus ril bu dkar chag can/ bdag gi skyabs gcig rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po rje mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i gdung rus/ phyag sen/ shangs khrag dbu ljon cha tshang / ag tshoms/lteb gri/ zhabs phyags ya gcig gzhi bsnyen chen mo'i skabs kyi bzhugs gdan byin chags/ 'thor 'bru/ gsol zas/ so shing / phreng thag ting lung / gos ber gyi tshal bu/ maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ na bza'/ sku 'gag sku gzan/ chu dmar blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/ khri rgan 'jam pa'i dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ dbu skra/ 'jigs byed bsnyen chen skabs kyi ljags sngags/ rdo rje phreng dbang gi bum rdzas ril bu/ zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol gyi na bza'/ zhabs phyags/ thar shul dge 'dun chos skyong rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ kirti tshang gi na bza'/ rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i na 215

bza'/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i dbu skra/ gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi dbu skra/ chu bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi dbu skra/ na bza'/ la mo gser khri tshang gi dbu skra/ g.yer gshong mkhan po ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ gung ri dkon mchog rin po che'i zhal dkris/ thar shul dge legs tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ rje shes rab 'byung gnas kyi gdung rus/ sku sham mkhas grub rin chen rdo rje tshang gi dbu zhwa/ snyan grags sku gong ma'i gdung dkris/rje bstan 'dzin mkhas mchog gi dbu skra/ rje dge 'dun dar rgyas rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ na bza'/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i phyag phreng / smra ba'i dbang phyug blo gros rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ na bza'/ smra ba'i khyu mchog sems dpa' chen po rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ 'tsho 'du grub sprul 'jigs med chos dbang nyi ma'i dbu skra/ stag ge sprul ba'i sku rin po che'i dbu skra/ bse mchog sprul rnam gnyis kyi na bza'/'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi ston pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu/ lha ldan jo bo'i lhung bzed nang gi 'bru sna/ lcags po ri'i na bza'/ byang chub shing bi 'bras bu rnams ni mdo dbus kyi mkhas grub gnyis ldan dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i paṇa grub so so dang rten so so las byung ba'i rten sna thor bu sna tshogs kyi mtshan byang phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ /'phags bod sgrub brgyud ril bu 'khrul med kyi rten 'dus myong 216

grol chen mo 'brel tshad don ldan rang grol/ bal bo'i mchod rten 'phags pa shing kun gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu/ rnam 'joms ril bu/ reb gong ri khrod pa'i tshe ril/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi ka ba'i cha shas/bdud rtsi chos sman/ bya khyung gser gdung chen mo'i ril bu/ rten sna stong phrag gceg phyogs bsdus kyis phab pa'i byin canaskeril bu/ bla brang gi rgyud pa dang dus 'khor kye rdor rnams kyi rdul tshon phye ma/ la mo bde chen sgar bzhugs kyi rten sna byin can/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi ma ṇi ril bu/dpal ldan sa skya gong ma rim byon gyi rten 'dus myong grub ril bu/ phyag nas/ byin rten phab ldan bdud rtsi ril bu/ rong bo shar bla brang gi rten 'dus ril bu/ pe cin dga' ldan byin chags gling gi tsan dan jo bo'i sku'i cha shas/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi mgon po'i bla rdo/ tsan dan rkang gcig rten 'dus rin chen bsam 'phel/ rgya gar rdor gdan gyi me tog ri bo rtse lnga'i me tog kun bzang / phyag rdor dung phyur bsgrubs pa'i ril bu/ khro bo sme brtsegs kyi ril bu/ tho gya'i byams khing bzhengs ska bas kyi rten 'dus ril bu/ reb gong ri khrod pa'i bde mchog dkar bo'i tshe ril/ sems dpa' chen po rje lam rim pa'i rten 'dus ril bu/ rong bo rgyud pa'i lcags mkhar sgrub sngags/ rten 'dus ril bu byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba/ bod gzhung gi rnam sras bang mdzod kyi g.yang rten/gnas chen nyer bzhi'i sa sna chu sna/ ri bo rtse lnga'i sa sna chu sna/ se ra'i 217

mnol bsangs/ rgya gar bal bo 'bar ma dbus gtsang stod tsa ri sogs kyi sa sna chu sna/ rin chen ril bu du ma/ chu bo gaṅgā'i chu/ rten 'dus ril bu dkar chag rab gsal zla ba'i me long can/bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum gyi na bza' dang sa sna/ mtsho ma dros pa'i phye ma/ ri dwags bse ru'i rwa/ mdo dbus gtsang gsum dang rgya nag bal bo dag gi gnas chen khag dang / nub phyogs yo rob gling dang ri pan sogs sa khul gzhan gyi sa sna chu sna nga sna/ bum rdzas nyer lnga/ rab gnas chen mo'i khrus ril/tsan dan sprul gyi snying bo/ ma pham g.yu mtsho'i chu/ tsan dan dkar bo'i brdar phye/ rwa sgreng shug pa/ gangs ri ti se'i phye ma sna lnga rnams ni rten 'dam ril bu sa sna chu sna gang yod kyi mtshan byang phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ /'khor gyi nang bzhugs ni/ rten sna'i rigs gtso bo dang cha 'dra ba dang / srog shing sogs kyang zhib tshags dag thon gyis bzhengs pa las dmigs bsal gzhan med do zhes go bar bya'o//bzhi pa ni/ gyan thang sogs ji ltar bzhengs tshul ni/ phyi nang steng 'og bar gsum kun tu gser tshon gyi mdzes ris sogs rka sar lha ris pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos 'bur du thon zhing / lha'i bzo bo'i sor mo'i 'du byed kyang dman par byas pa'i bzo rtsal kun nas mdzes pa'i dbus su gtso sku rgyal ba byams pa mgon po'i snang brnyan sum thog can rten bzhengs gzhan dang mi 'dra bar spus legs shing bzo bkod 218

khyad du 'phags pas nyams che bar bzhugs so/ /sum thog steng gi gyan bar dbus su rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho la rang nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs kyis bskor pa rnam dpyod can dge slong blo bzang dpal ldan gyis bzhengs/ g.yas g.yon gyan brgyad la rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu'i gyan thang brgyad rnams spyi gzhung nas 'gro gron btang ste bzhengs/ nyis thog bar shod kyi dbus su byams pa'i zhing bkod dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi gyan thang bzo bo bsod nams dar rgyas kyis bzhengs/ g.yas g.yon gyan brgyad la rje tsong kha brgyad cu'i gyan thang brgyad ni rim pa bzhin/ ban kho/ dge 'dun/ kun thar dang dko bha/ lha mkhar/ nyi ma/bsod nams/ pad+ma rgyal rnams kyis bzhengs/ 'og shod du gtso bor sangs rgyas 'khrungs rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing gyan thang dgu can gyan bar dgu la bzheng pa po rim bzhin dge slong dge 'dun 'jigs med/dge slong grags pa/ dge slong bsod nams bzang po/ mi skya byams pa rgyal/ kun bzang / tshe ring rgyal chung / ri stag sangs rgyas/ bstan 'dzin/ rnams kyis bzhengs / gzhan yang gyan phyed bzhi las dang po gnyis la lnga brgya ba rnams kyi gtsug gi cod pan mnyam med jo bo rje'i rnam thar/ de bzheng pa po btsun thar byams dang rin chen zung gis bzhengs/ gzhan gnyis la sgrol ma nyer gcig dang thugs rje chen po 'phags pa phyogs bcu bzhengs par bzo bo rin chen bkra shis dang 219

lcags byams rgyal gyis bzhengs/ sgo 'gram nang 'khor gyan bzhi las g.yas kyi dang por dpal yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gyan thang tshe ring rgyal che bas bzhengs/ gnyis par dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i gyan thang tshe brtan don grub kyis bzhengs/ g.yon gyi dang por gtso sku ston pa la 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyis bskor pa'i gyan thang mkha' 'gros bzhengs/ gnyis par srung ma'i gtso bo ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo'i gyan thang 'brug rtse rgyal gyis bzhengs/gzhan yang thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ ltung bshags lha so lnga'i gyan thang rnams ni spyi so nas bzhengs/phyi'i khyams su rgyal chen bzhi las yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po rnam gnyis kyi gyan thang bzo bo rtser son bsod nams mkhar gyi sor mo'i 'du byed las grub/ spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras kyi gyan thang rnam gnyis lha'i bzo bo bslab gsum rgyan ldan dge 'dun chos grags kyi sor rtse las grub/ sham bha la'i zhing bkod kyi gyan thang bsod bhas bzhengs/lha chen a myes rma rgyal gyi gyan thang bstan 'dzin gyis bzhengs pa rnams ni sla chos dang khral chos su ma song bar bzo dpon zung la bri gtogs dang /lhag bsam rnam dag gis gser tshon gyi rgyu song btang ste lha bzo rnams kyis nus pa yod dgu bton nas bzhengs so/ /nang gi kun ra'i dbus su dge slong dge 'dun yar 'phel gyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog cha 220

tshang bar bzhag bstan 'gyur glegs bam nyis brgya dang bcu gsum de dad ldan rdo rje dbang rgyal gyis phul/ rje yab sras gsum gyi bka' 'bum cha tshang gus ldan rdo rjes legs par bzhag pa rnams ni gsung gi rten gyi rim pa'o/ /gos sku chen mo ni/ sngon chad chos sde 'dir gos sku chen mo bshams srol dben kyang / bslab gsum nor gyis brgyan pa'i bzo bo rtser son sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi 'char sgor snga ma'i dus su skyes chen rnams kyis kyang gos sku chen mo zhig bzhengs na legs tshul gyi bka' mchid yod na'ang rkyen dbang gis de'i steng du ma 'khel bar 'dug des na da lta cis kyang gos sku chen mo zhig bzhengs te legs grub byung na ci ma rung snyam ste/ sgar grong gi gros dbang rnams dang dgongs bstun gyis 'gan ci lcogs kyis khur/ mtsho sngon mda' bzhi nas dkar thigs bslangs te gnyan thog lha bzo ba rnams la yon sprad nas lha grangs gtso 'khor nyer gnyis can zhig bzhengs grub byung ba ni 'di ltar/ gtso sku rgyal ba 'od dpag med che legs can/ g.yas su sras kyi thu bo 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo/ g.yon du sras kyi thu bo 'phags mchog phyag na rdo rje ste yab sras gsum dang / steng gi dbus su bstan pa'i bdag po/ g.yas g.yon mtha' skor rnams su rim pa bzhin rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ ma hā 221

paṇ+ḍi ta a bh+ya zhabs/ rka sar klu 'bum lha ris pa/ bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba/ rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/ sangs rgyas sman bla/rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po/ bstan srung dam can chos kyi rgyal bo/ dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang mo/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ mgon po zhal bzhi ba bcas legs par bzhengs pa'i rgyu cha spus legs shing / gos drub kyi skya thig dang bzo bkod ha cang dge thon pas gson nyams ldan pa dang /bzo rtsal dang mdzes cha sogs sna sgor mo nas phul byung ltar gos sku chen mo nye bar byon pa tshorab rgyan bgrang bya bcu gsum pa sa yos lo'i spyi lo1999lo'i hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi rgyal du grags pa bkra shis pa'i nyin chos sde 'dir gdan drangs par/ bkra shis rab gnas rgya chen po'i ngang ston chen mdzad nas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams la legs so 'bul ba'i tshul gyis ser skya yongs kyis legs skyes phul te bkra shis pa'i sgo brgya phyes so/ /byams khang gi mtha' skor du ma ṇi 'khor lo brgya rtsa brgyad gser zangs kyis legs par bzheng pa po thos bsam nor gyis ci yang phyug pa bzhin bzang dge 'dun legs bshad dang dge 'dun 'od zer zung gis gnyer te nye bar bzhengs/ gang ltar na'ang byams khang rten dang brten pa bcas g.yo sgyu khram gsum dang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis ma bslad par bzhengs pa yin te/ 'jam 222

pa'i dbyangs bstan pa'i sgrol mes/ dbang med khrims kyis bsdus pa'i dpya khral dang / /bun skyed bsngos rdzas la sogs khram pa'i zas ma yin sdig dang ma 'dres rgyu sbyor gyis/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo che 'di bsgrubs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sdig pa dang ma 'dres pa'i dad rdzas kho na yin la/ ji skad du/ dad ldan dad pas sbyin rdzas yin mod kyang / /chud gzan ma gyur rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du/ /bsod nams mi zad gter du bsgrubs pa yis/ /rang gzhan gnyis kar sman yon bgyis so snyam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dad gshin gyi rdzas bsod nams kyi zhing du bsngos pa la dga' mgu yi rang ba'i sgo nas rten bzhengs phyogs la ser skya yongs kyis 'bad khul byas pa yin pas phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa rang gzhan kun la thob pa gdon mi za bar snyam mo/ /gzhan yang byams khang phyi nang kun tu gser gyi pa tras mdzes par brgyan pa dang / nang gi rgya mthongs dang phyi'i khyams ra'i steng g.yas g.yon la byams pas dam bca'i gzungs lañdza dge don gyis gser bris dang/ sgo chen steng la gzhung brgya smra ba smyug thogs pa sgo dmar dge 'dun don grub kyis byams chen me yis kyi sho lo ka gcig po de lañdza sum rkang phab ste gser gyi pa tra ris sogs kyis mdzes khyad thon pa kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsi lta bur bskrun to/ /mdun du mchod khri dang mchod pa'i rdzas ngos gtsang ba dang / rin chen gnyis pa'i maṇ+ḍal che legs/ dngul zangs sa rkong bu che chung du ma/223

theb stong dang bdun tshar che ba gsum lhag sogs mchod cha dang / nyin re bzhin yon chab stong re dang / tshe 'bar gyi rgyun 'bri mar dang / yid du 'ong ba'i me tog bdug spos zhal zas rgya mtsho rol cha sogs rnam dkar gyi rgyun bla lhag tu btsugs te sngar gyi phyag srol bzang po rnams nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel dang / myur du tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir bla ma rgyal ba byams pa mgon po'i thugs dgongs zab mo yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs shing legs byas kyi phung bo rang rgyud la sdud ci thub bgyis te snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'dir dal ba'i rten la snying bo len par chas so/ /mi yi khyu mchog shākya seng ge yi/ /rab yangs mkhyen stobs nam mkha'i mthongs phye nas/ /mdo sngags chos tshul nyin byed shar ba'i tshe/ /theg gsum zer gyis phyogs kun gsal bar mdzes/ /sgos su byams sku nor bu'i za ma tog /dkon nor las drin byin rten 'dzam gling rgyan/ /mi zad ring bsrel rnam bzhis yongs gtams pa/ /ro 'dzin bye bar sprul te brjod la ngal/ /brgyad khri'i dus kyi khri gdugs nyi ma'i gzi/ /skye dgu'i bsod nams mkha' la 'dren pa'i thabs/ /sngon med skya rengs rta bdun kha lo bar/ /zla med legs byas 'khor lo 'di gyur cig /rgyal bstan spyi dang 'khrul bral dge ldan lugs/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i kho lag phyogs rdzogs pa/ /spyod ngan rta res gcod pa yongs min par/ /dus mthar mi nub rtag tu rgyal gyur cig /tshe rabs phreng bar mi pham mgon nyid kyis/ /224

rjes bzung gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myangs nas/ /bla med byang chub go 'phang mngon gyur tshe/ /'brel thogs kun kyang tshul der spyod gyur cig /ces pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//lha mo khang dang chos 'khor khang sogs bskrun tshul/mkhyen rab nor bu'i dra bas gdong mdzes shing / /dmigs med brtse ba'i mche zung rab dkar la/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i myos bum mngon mtho ba/ /skyabs mchog sa srung dbang bos bdag skyongs shig /skye dgu'i bsod nams laṅga'i rtsig ngos la/ /blo ldan sgra sgrog rgyal bo'i sku gcig kyang / /phye ba phrag brgya'i snang ba dbye nus pa'i/ /ha nu man+d+ra gzhan zhig srid 'dir dben/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i dpal gyis nyer mdzes pa/ /srid na ches dkon dge ldan ring lugs che/ /'dzin skyong spel la dge legs dpal ba bzhin/ /sde 'dir rtsen pa'i dge mtshan mtha' ma rig /sum rtsen khang bzang la yang co 'dri ba/ /dad brtson nor gyis bzhengs pa'i garnyo la/ /gcig las gcig lhag mig gi bdud rtsi ru/ /grub pa'i skal bzang gling 'di'i rgyan du che//lha mo khang dang chos 'khor khang sogs gsar du bskrun tshul la/ de nanu/ gna' snga mor bzhengs pa'i rten brten pa bcas shul med du gyur na yang sde 'di'i ser skya thun mong nas nus shugs yod dgu bton te pha mes kyi phyag srol bzang po nyams gso bgyid cing de bde legs kyi rtsa ba tshugs 225

pa'i phyir 'bad pa lhod med bgyis pa ni 'di ltar ro//lha mo khang ni/ de yang chos sde 'di'i bstan srung gtso bo ni dpal ldan lha mo ste sngon ches ring mo zhis/ nas bsnyen cing mchod pa'i zhing dang /'phral phugs kyi 'dod don ma lus pa bcol bas ma g.yel bar 'phrin las bsgrubs kyang sdongs grogs tshul bzhin mdzad pa'i lha srung gnyan po rang mchis so/ /des na 'phrin las kyi bka' gnyan gzi byin 'bar ba/sngon gyi rten rnying phul phyin byon gtsang dpal ldan ma'i zangs gser gyi sku brnyan che legs khru gang can de gtsos sku gsung thugs rten mang dag dus kyi srin mos khyur mid bgyis nas shul tsam yang lus med du byas mod/ yin na yang gang gi thugs rje mthus bstan pa yang dar 'dir chos sgo 'byed skabs rten 'brel gyi thog mar dpal ldan lha mo'i li sku byin rlabs can phebs pa dang / lha ldan jo khang nang gi srung ma'i gtso bo ma gcig dpal lha mo'i rma bya'i sgro gdugs lo rgyus can cha tshang gdan drangs te chos sde 'dir lhan cig tu 'dzoms pa dag la dpags na/ rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i thun min gyi gdul zhing re skong gser mo ljongs rig pa'i grong khyer 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dang / ya rabs las 'phro can skal ldan gyi skyes bu mang dag mchis pa'i dan rtags rang yin pa ni/ mkhas blun phal mo cher zhu ci dgos snyam mo/ /'o na de lta 226

bu'i rten 'brel rang chas su yod pa'i chos sde 'dir lha mo khang rten dang brten pa bskyar bzo ji ltar bgyis she na/ rab rgyan bgrang bya bcu gsum pa/ me yos lo'i spyi lo1987lo dkar tshes la spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas dang sde dpon rdo rje sogs kyis lha mo khang bzhengs rgyu'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi nang gyan drug can zhig shing bzo yang gya'i dpal 'byor gyis bzos pas hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes la legs grub byung / bzo bo rtser son bsod nams mkhar dang dge 'dun chos grags ngo g.yog lngas shing ris btang ste rngo+on ris phul phyin grub/ nang gi gyan dbus mar mgo 'dug tshe ring don grub kyis 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i sku brnyan mi tshad las brgal ba skya bzo gser tshon dang bcas legs par bzhengs pa'i nang bzhugs gtso bo paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi phyag tsha 'jigs byed kyi sku byin can bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon rnams su mgon po phyag drug pa'i sbyin bdag dge slong blo bzang 'od zer dang / dam can chos rgyal gyi sbyin bdag dbang rgyal dang / dpal ldan lha mo'i sbyin bdag yar skor klu 'bum dang / rnam sras kyi sbyin bdag mgo 'dug lcags byams rgyal rnams kyis yon sbyar te 'bag sku mi tshad las brgal ba re bzhengs/ de dag gi gzungs gzhug kyang dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin chad lhag gi skyon dang bral bas ngos gtsang bsgrubs/ g.yas su mgon chos lnga bo'i gyun thang bzo bo dge 'dun chos grags kyis 'gro gron btang ste legs par 227

bzhengs/ g.yon du lha mo gtso 'khor gyi gyan thang bzo bo bsod nams mkhar gyis rgyu song btang ste bzhengs pa dang / lha mo'i thang ga che legs shig kyang bzhengs/ yar skor bsod nams kyis lha mo'i nag thang gser bris can bzhengs/ phyis 'khyams kyi g.yas su a ma brtan ma dang g.yon du lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan dag rang sde'i dad ldan rnams kyis rgyu song phangs med du btong ste nye bar bzhengs pa rnams ni rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas kho nar nges so/ /gzhan yang rten rnying lha mo'i nag thang dang mgon po chos rgyal rnams kyi thang ga gsum/ rten gyi gtso bo gser zangs las grub pa'i lha mo'i sku brnyan mkhyid gang las brgal ba byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba can dang / sgos su rka sar lha rams pa brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i sku dbon lha sa ba ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis ram btegs te dad ldan 'phags pa rgyal gyis spyan drangs pa/ sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i rgyal blon paṇa grub mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten 'gangs che zhing gzi byin 'phro ba'i rma bya'i sgro gdugs de gser gyi sgrom nang du bzhugs gsol gyis kha dam rgyas mnan te rten gtsor bzhugs so/ /nyin re bzhin 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa dang / lha mo mgon chos sogs kyi cho ga dag gtsang ngos lha mo'i bskang bshags brgya phrag re chag med dang / lo gtor dang rgyun gtor mchod pa mchod me rol cha snyan dar rgyun bsangs bcas bar ma chad par phul te/ bstan 'gro'i 228

don la ched dmigs kyis gsol 'debs dang 'phrin bcol gang shes kyi sgo nas bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa'i phyag srol bla na med par mchis so/ /chos 'khor khang ni/ sngon gyi chos 'khor khang rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag skyabs rje a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi ljags bkod ltar bzhengs pa'i byin rten dam pa rnams ni da lta mthong thos dran yul du gyur kyang / yang dar 'dir kun gyis shugs bskyed de gzhar yang slar gso bgyid pa'i las grwa btsugs te sde dpon dang tsho dpon sogs ser skya rnams kyis gyan sna drug can zhig gsar du bskrun/ gtso bo ni gong zhus ltar dad gtong rgyan gyis mdzes pa dpa' mdzangs ldan pa sbyin bdag 'phags pa rgyal gyis gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi 'khor lo bskor ched par shing dang shog gu snag tsha sogs bsgrigs/ dgon pa'i dge tshul slong rnams kyis par gyi las la brtson te gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi sngags dung phyur spar nas srog shing la dam por bsgril/ dar skud kyi srad bus bcings pa dang na bza' sogs phul te legs par bskor/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang rje mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho gtsos skyabs rje dam pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / lugs gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo kha so blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las/ grub sprul 229

'jigs med chos dbang nyi ma sogs rim par byon te rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs mdzad nas byin rlabs spungs zhus kyi bkra shis pa'i mdzad sgo spel/ lo gcig gi ring nyin mtshan kun tu bar ma chad pa ra sgar grong gis re mos kyis bskor pas rtags dang mtshan ma ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan mngon sum du grub/ gyan dbus mar bla na med pa'i rgyud yi dam gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi sku brnyan mi tshad las brgal ba 'bag bzo mgo 'dug tshe ring don grub kyis bzhengs te rgyu yon sbyar/ de'i g.yas su rje btsun seng ge sgra'i snang brnyan gong gi de tsam bzhengs pa la mgo 'dug lcags byams rgyal gyis mthun rkyen sbyar/ g.yon du rje btsun na ga rak+ṣa'i sku brnyan che tshad gong dang mtshungs pa la rin chen dpal rgyal gyis rgyu rkyen sbyar/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge gdong can ma'i gyan thang ban+de dang sangs rgyas thar gnyis kyis bdag rkyen sbyar/ dpal rta mgrin gyi gyan thang 'brug bhe dang bla ma skyabs zung gis rgyu yon sbyar te bzhengs/ steng gi gser tog mgo 'dug 'jam dbyangs kyis phul/mtha' skor gyi ma ṇi dung phyur gcig dang bye ba drug bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa rnam dpyod can blo bzang bkra shis kyis bzhengs/ ma ṇi bye chung gnyis yar skor 'od zer gyis bzhengs pa sogs kyi sku gsung thugs rten rnams lha'i bzo bo yang dman par byed pa'i sku nyams che zhing gzi byin 'bar bas sa bdag klu gnyan las byung ba'i nad kyi rigs las grol te/230

skye dgu rnams dad 'dun che bar mngon no// sngon gyi par khang chen mo yang gzhi nas rtsa gtor du btang bas da lta nyams gso bgyid pa'i gzhi rten ma mchis pa'i dbang gis rim 'gyangs su lus/ yin na yang par shing 'ga' re gsar du bskrun pa dag ni 'di ltar/ mdo ting nge 'dzin/ gser 'od sa bcu ma/ gzungs gzhug chen mo/ smyung gnas cho ga gnas bcu sogs kyi par legs par bskrun pa dag mchis so/ /dge 'dun gyi rung khang ni/ snga ma'i rung khang thog so can ni gzhi med du btang bas/ da lta gyan bcu gnyis can zhig bzhengs yod/ de'i nang du tshogs zangs bzhi las sde gzhung gis ka cu nas ha yang gi rigs las grub pa'i tshogs zangs che ba de dmangs sgor chig stong bzhi brgyas blus te bzhag ha yang gi rgyu las bzos pa'i tshogs zangs che ba gcig kyang ka cu nas dad ldan sha bo skyid kyis blu yon sgor brgyad brgya sprad de bzhag gung tshigs sla nga ri stag kun bzang gis bzhag ja zangs yar skor 'tsho bas bzhag go /gzhan yang ja bra thug rje'u sogs yo chas rigs yar ldan du mchis pas da gzod gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa'i tshod du gda' 'o/ / der ma zad da lta sngon gyi gyo thog can gyi mchod khang dang lha khang sogs shul med du bgyis na yang / slar yang skyabs rje dam pa a lags bis pa tshang gi nang chen nam gzim khang zhig gso bgyis 231

grub pa dang / lhag par du rong bo shar gyi phyag mdzod chen mo rka sar a khu ye shes grags pa'i gzim spyil thog so can bzhi bcur nye ba de yang shul med du bgyis na yang / da gzod gang gi tsha bo bzo bo rtser son pa bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa dge 'dun chos grags kyis snga ma bzhin phal cher gzim khang sbyar te/ skyabs mgon brgyad pa che po mchog der zhabs sor bskyod cing bzhugs sa'i mthil du mdzad de bkra shis pa'i mdzad sgo bla lhag tu spel/ der brten grwa shag phal cher du phyag yul gyi mchod khang rang rang gang 'byor gyis bzhengs te rten gsum gzi byin 'bar ba dag gsar bzhengs bgyid pa'i skabs so/ /lhag bsam yar zla'i rjes su snyegs pa dge slong blo bzang thogs med kyis dmangs sgor chig khri'i 'gro song btang ste dgon pa'i mkhar sgo zhig gso legs par bgyis grub pas mchog tu dge dad gsum nor gyis ci yang phyug pa bzo bo rtser son bsod nams mkhar gyis dgon gzhung la dmangs sgor chig khri'i spyi 'jog bzhag go/de lta bu'i sgrub pa'i sde chen po rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling gi tshogs 'don chos spyod sogs kyi phyag len dngos gtsang tshugs yod pa'i go rim rnams ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di ltar hor zla dang po nas hor zla bcu gnyis bar zla rer tshogs 'don gyi gtso bo ni/ hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig gnam lo gsar tshes la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa dang lha mo'i 232

cho ga rnams gsungs te lha srung dpal ldan lha mor tshe gtor btang / de nas tshes lnga nas tshes brgyad bar sgrub mchod btsugs te dang po tshes lnga nyin kun rig tshes drug la gsang 'dus/ tshes bdun brgyad zung la 'jigs byed dang mgon chos lnga bo'i cho ga cha tshang bcas bskang gsol la 'tshogs te lo gcig gi ring la chos sde 'dis mtshon pa'i yul khams spyi'i bstan pa dang 'gro ba la ched dmigs kyis 'phrin bcol gang legs mdzad par mtshon no/ /hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig la bla mchod dang gnas bcu sogs smon lam rnams 'don pa dang / hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar kun rig gi sgrub mchod nyin lnga la sngon chad ris bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten na yang da lta rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas kun rig gi bdag 'jug dang sbyin sreg cha tshang ngos gtsang sgrub bzhin mchis/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes gcig la 'od dpag med la brten pa'i stong mchod rgyas pa'i lugs 'don rta dbyangs gsum cha tshang 'gro nges bya ba/ tshes lnga nas tshes bcu gcig bar gdugs bdun la 'don rta dang bcas sman thung dang smon lam rnam lnga sogs dang nyin rer mchod pa chig khri bzhi stong lhag g.yo med kyang bkod pa mdzes par bshams te bsod nams kyi tshogs sgo kun nas rlabs chen bsags pas bzhi ba'i mchod par grags so/ /tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga zung la/rje blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i smyung gnas cho ga'i sgo nas 233

theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa blangs nas smyung gnas srung ste spyan 'dren khrus gsol rgyas pa mdzad/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug nas dbyar gnas la 'tshogs te rgyun tshogs la phyag mchod dang bzang spyod/ gnas bcu sogs dang / dgong khar skyor sbyang chag med/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer dgu'am gnam stong la dgag dbye mdzad de dbyar gnas grol rjes rdo rje 'chang a bh+ya zhabs kyi phyag bzhes bzhin mdzad de dbyar ston mdzad do/ /hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la 'jigs byed dang lha mo'i cho ga sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas lha mo'i gshegs gtor/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la sman mchog chen mo/ hor zla bcu ba'i tshes bco lnga la byams pa'i stong mchod/ dge ldan lnga mchod chen mo tshes nyer lnga la kun rig bdag 'jug dang bcas pa/ tshes nyer drug la chos spyod kyi rim pa/tshes nyer bdun la gsang 'dus/ tshes nyer brgyad dang nyer dgu zung la bskang gsol/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga la rdo rje 'chang rje mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho'i dus bzang yin pas lam rim bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas sogs 'don pa dang / hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga nas nyer dgu bar yongs grags kyi bod lo sku rim nyin lnga/ gzhan yang lo gcig gi zla re'i dus bzang tshes brgyad la sman chog chen mo/ tshes bco lnga la gsang 'dus/ tshes nyer lnga la kun rig tshes nyer dgu la bskang gsol rnams dang / bco lnga dang gnam stong la dus 'brel gso sbyong chag 234

med mdzad do/ /chos thog dang dus bzang gang gi tshe'ang snga mor phyi'i khyams nas ltung bshags tshar gcig dang spyi bshags tshar gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas dmigs brtse ma dang bcas nang du 'tshogs 'phral brgya rtsa 'don pa'i phyag len ngos gtsang tshugs yod do/ /shi chos/ gang gi skabs su'ang lho sgo'i cho ga dang sman bla/ lam rim tshigs bcad ma 'don rta dang bcas tshugs so//byang chub mchod rten mthong grol chen mo bzhengs tshul/ chos sde 'di'i byang skyor du sgar grong gi 'gab sa gzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas su skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs bkod ltar bzhengs pa'i byang chub mchod rten ni dus kyi 'pho 'gyur gyis 'byung bzhir thim zin na'ang yang dar 'dir slar yang gzhi nas bskyar gso bgyid pa'i go skabs ldan zhing / phal mo cher 'dun pa dang mos pa ches cher bdo bas mkhyen spyan yangs pa blo bzang 'od zer dang / sde dpon kun bzang dang rdo rje zung gtsos tsho chen gsum gyi mi bcu gnyis sne mo bar bskos te/1987lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshe bco lnga'i nyin mngon par 'du byed pa'i las kyi grwa btsugs/ skya ser mang bos sa rdo bskyal te rdo rtsig dang rmang gzhi rdung ba sogs kyi las la brtson/ smyug thogs pa blo bzang 'od zer gyis thig rtsa btab pa ltar/ sog ri'i dka' thub rgyal sogs kyis ar 'dam gyis rmang gzhi nas bzung mchod rten gyi seng khri'i bar legs par 235

brtsigs te lo der las mtshams bzhag go 1988lo'i nag zla'i nya la las mgo brtsams te dge bcu'am rmang dge nas rim par las bzo ba rnams kyi gso zol dang bral ba'i lhag bsam rnam dag gis bum stod man nye bar brtsigs/ bslab gsum nor gyis mdzes pa'i gzhung bzang smyug thogs dbang po blo bzang 'od zer gyis mchod rten gyi srog shing la mtshal chen byugs te mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin nor chad lhag gsum dben pa'i ngos gtsang dag thon bris te/ na bza' 'bul ba dang —dar skud dmar ser gyis dkris pa sogs tshags su chud par byas/gzhan yang gzungs gzhug chen mo gtsor byas nas gzungs sngags sna tshogs stong phrag du ma dang / sher phyin gyi mdo yum 'bum pa dag tshar gcig ting 'dzin dang 'phags pa brgyad stong pa/ mdo sde bskal bzang rnams kyi glegs bam brgya dang sum cu lhag bzhugs pa rnams dang /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bdag po skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa/ rdo rje 'chang g.yeragashong 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos gnang ba'i paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza' byin can/ rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa 'khrungs gzhi'i sbra gur gyi cha shas/sku 'bum gser sdong chen mo'i byin rten dam pa/ rong ston skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i zhabs phyags ya gcig ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs phyags ya gcig mdo smad bstan pa'i bdag po a 236

rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs phyags ya gcig sogs byin rten 'gangs che ba'i rigs gtsos ring bsrel rnam pa bzhis mtshon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten phon che ba ngos gtsang gra dag bsgrigs pa dang / seng khri'i nang du gzhug bya'i gter bum du ma dang bang mdzod kyi/ rigs gang 'byor rnams tshags su chud par byas/ dzam la rigs lnga'i sman sku khri phrag du ma/ gter bdag dzam pho mo dang gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs kha sbyar te na bza' ser bo phul ba la gos skud dmar ser gyis legs par dkris pa rnams kyis mtshon gzungs gzhug gang mkho'i rigs cha tshang nye bar bsgrigs/ blo bzang sangs rgyas gtsos rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu phrag gcig dang gsum gyis nyin mang bor dkar zas la brter te gzungs gzhug ngos gtsang bsgrubs/ de nas gral tshes bzang por sku gsung thugs rten rnams gzungs gzhug 'bul sar spyan drangs nas gzhug bya'i rim pa rnams go rim ma 'chol bar bsgrig pa'i mgo brtsams/seng khri'i dbus su gter bum rnams dang nye 'khor du bang mdzod kyi rigs nye bar bsgrigs/ de nas ji ltar 'os pa ltar dzam bha la'i sku rnams bsgrigs te dbus kyi gter bum steng gnod sbyin 'khor lo bzhag pa sogs kyis seng khri'i nang yongs su byur bur gtams par byas rjes rab gnas mdor bsdus byas/ srog shing bang rim bzhi bar btsugs te bslangs pas dge 'dun pa rnams kyis bstan 'gro'i don la thugs 'dun 237

gcig mthun gyis sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma dang bcas rab gnas shis brjod ci rigs mdzad/ go rim ltar dbu gzungs sogs bsgrigs te sman sna dang rin chen phye mas bkang bar byas/ las byed pa rnams kyis kyang bum pa'i steng du rin po che bre dang bre stan chos 'khor bcu gsum sogs nye bar brtsigs te/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa shākya seng ges zhing re dir chos 'khor thog mar bskor ba'i dus tshes dge ba hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi la nyi zla zung gis legs par brgyan te byang chub mchod rten dpangs tshad rmid nyi shu lhag can legs par grub bo/ /tshes bco lnga la rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang tshogs chen khri ba rje blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las rnam gnyis gdan drangs pas/ khong rnam pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams bkra shis rab gnas kyi dpang bor spyan drangs te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don la ched dmigs kyis rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgya chen mdzad pa dang chabs cig ser skya yongs la phyag dbang gi bka' drin bskyangs pa la dngos rdzas sbam mtho ba btegs/ mdor na byang chub mchod rten gyi rgyu song rags rtsis ltar na dmangs skor chig khri brgyad stong lhag sgar grong spyi so nas btang ste legs par bzhengs so//rka sar sde gzhung gi rgyud khang ngam sngags khang bzhengs tshul/ sngon gyi lha khang rnying skyon gyis zhig ral du song ste sde dpon tsho dpon sogs kyis 238

rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis bskyar gso bgyid pa'i gros mthun byung / de'i skabs kyi sne mo ba gtso bo dad gtong nor gyis mdzes pa'i sde dpon kun bzang dang lha mkhar rgyal/ bun phrang / rig 'dzin don grub sogs kyis bya ba'i las kyi 'khor lo 'du bya ba'i grwa btsugs te/ spyi lo1985lor gsar skrun mdzad/ shing bzo bzhin bzang rdo rje tshe ring ngo g.yog gis g.yo zol dang bral ba'i ngang lhod med brtson pa bskyed de bzhengs/mchod yul gyi zhing gi mchog sku gsung thugs gsum las sku'i rten gyi gtso bo snang mtha'i thugs sprul slob dpon pad+ma ka ra'i sku brnyan mi tshad las brgal ba can gtso 'khor gsum pa gzungs gzhug dang bcas gus ldan dpal los rgyu yon sbyar/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba'i sku brnyan gyi sbyin bdag dad ldan 'od zer gyis bgyis pa dang / g.yon gyi rgyal kun 'phrin las kyi ngo bo rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan tshe ring don grub kyis bzhengs pa la gser gyi sbyin bdag sde ba'i las byed pa rnams kyis bgyis/sangs rgyas stong sku dgon pa'i grwa btsun rnams gyis bzhengs/gzhan yang nges pa don gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba'i 'dra thang / thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gi thang rnying / slob dpon rin po che'i thang ga ma gza' rdor gsum gyi thang ga sogs bzhugs so/ /gsung gi rten sher phyin gyi mdo yum dum pa bcu gnyis/yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum mgur ma/ mdo ting nge 239
