'dzin/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa/ mdo sde bskal bzang / gzungs bsdus rnams bzhugs so/ /ma ṇi 'khor chen klu 'bum tshe ring gis rgyu yon sbyar te bzhengs pa sogs rang sde'i dad ldan pho mo rnams kyis rgyu yon phangs med du sbyar te rten bzhengs phyogs la 'bad pa lhod med bgyis pa'i dge mtshan rnams mig mthong lag zin du grub pa de ltar ro/ /sde 'di'i skye dgu rnams spyir na dad pa dang 'dun pa shas che bas ya rabs kyi spyod pa la dga' zhing / mchog gsum la sri zhu bla na med pas mi khyim phal cher la sku gsung thugs rten phon che ba bzhengs pa'i mchod khang re med pa min pas/ nus pa yod dgu bton te dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur dang bkur ste la dus rtag tu gzab pa dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs te phyag dang bskor ba smyung gnas sogs la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bar ma chad par brtson pa dang / sku dang sa ts+tsha sogs spar te 'bum khang bzhengs pa dang yang na chur bskyod pa'i cho ga'i sgo nas lugs srol bzang po rnams lag bstar bgyis pa phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin bla lhag tu 'phel ba dang / der ma zad mkhas dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa rka sar klu 'bum lha ris pa byang chub rab gsal dang lha ris pa blo bzang shes rab sogs kyis kyang sngon ring mo zhig nas sde ba'i mgo stod kyi gnas 'dir sa bcos rten bzhengs shig bgyis na spyir sde 'dir rigs rgyud dang nor longs spyod sogs gang ci'i thad nas dar rgyas che ba'i dge mtshan 'byung zhes 240

lung gis bstan pa dang / de'i khar rang bzhin drang zhing lhag bsam yar zla'i rjes su snyegs pa'i dge ba can/lha ris pa bsod nams kyis sngon gyi lung bstan thos 'dzin bu gar zhugs ma thag cis kyang rten bzhengs shig bskrun dgos tshul las brtsams te/ yar skor tsho ba'i mgo 'dzin rnams la rting skul nan chen mdzad par brten/ gros la dbang ba rnams kyis kyang gros mthun byung ba dang gza' mchog ra hu la'i sku rten yang rang bab kyis yar skor tsho ba gcig gis mi chog sde gzhung gis 'gan dang len dgos zhes bka' gnang bas mag sar paṇ+ḍi ta la yar zhu bgyis pas khong gis dbyen bsdum mchod rten zhig bzhengs na legs tshul gsungs pa ltar rab rgyan bgrang bya bcu gnyis pa sa pho stag spyi lo1998lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la dbyen zlum mchod rten bzhengs rgyu'i las grwa btsugs/ bzo dpon lcags byams rgyal dang blo gros zung dang de'i khar kun bzang / sha bo tshe ring / bkra shis/ 'jigs med/ blo bzang dpal ldan rnams dang / gzhan yang yar skor tsho ba'i khyim mi re res nyin ltar so phag dang rdo bye ma ar 'dam sogs bskyal te gang lcogs kyis brtson pa lhur len mdzad/ dbu sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa la snying nas re ba'i snying stobs can/ bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag 'tsho byed dge 'dun dpal 'byor gyis dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin phyag bstar gyis mchod rten gyi thig chen btab ste bkod 'doms kyis khyab par mdzad/ tshes nyer 241

bdun la sa bdag snying gter sbas/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la mchod rten gyi bang rim bzhi bar srog shing btsugs te bkra shis rab gnas mdzad/ tshes bcu bdun nas rten 'bul rgyu'i gzungs gzhug sku gsung thugs rten rnams rim gyis dge 'dun pa rnams kyis zhib tshags ldan pa'i ngang ngos gtsang phul/ las bzo ba rnams kyis mthar gyis bzhengs te dbyen zlum mchod rten che tshad byon legs can zhig legs grub byung / 'phags pa rgyal gyis nyi zla bzhengs pa dang sgo rgyan bzo bo dge 'dun chos grags dang bsod nams mkhar gyis bzhengs/ de'i gtso sku gsang bdag gi sku brnyan bsod nams mkhar gyis bzhengs/ grub 'phral dge 'dun pa rnams kyis bkra shis rab gnas mdzad de byin chen phabs so/ /de ltar yar skor tsho ba gsum gyis gtso byas nas rka sar sde ba'i dad ldan gtong phod can byings kyis ma dngul phul ba'i 'gro gron khyon bsdoms rags rtsis brgyab na bzhengs pa'i gla rngan rma brtsis par rgyu cha gcig po la dmangs sgor nyis khri lhag btang ste gral tshes bzang bo nyi shu la mjug yongs rdzogs grub rjes ser skya lhan 'dzoms kyis legs grub chos kyi dga' ston la ngoms med du rol/ gzhan yang mchod rten gyi nang gzhug rten gyi rim pa rnams dgod pa la/ ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi las 'dir sku gsung thugs rten rnams rim gyis brjod na/ gtso sku gsang bdag gi sku brnyan che legs khru do can/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa'i 242

sku brnyan byon gtsang / sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi ring bsrel gzungs gzhug tu bzhugs pa'i rje sku khru gang can/ yab rje'i sku che legs khru gang can/ 'jigs med rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan shog thang gya lnga/ bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba'i snang brnyan nga lnga/ o rgyan snang srid la gnon gyi sku brnyan brgya dang bco lnga/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sku brnyan go lnga/'jam dbyangs gzhon nur gyur pa'i snang brnyan bdun/gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku bdun/ rdo rje phur bu'i sku gsum bcas sku brnyan gyi rim pa rnams bzhugs pa'i rim pa'o/ /gzungs gzhug chen mo tshar bzhi bcu/rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa chen po'i bka' 'bum cha tshang / rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi gsung 'bum/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi gsung 'bum/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud tshar gciga'ajam mgon tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar tshar gsum/bka' 'bum thor bu/ rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma/ rje'i khyad par 'phags bstod/ rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs tshar gsum/yab rje'i rnam mgur/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang / bla ma rgyang 'bod dang 'brel ba'i tshe rabs rjes 'dzin/ rjes 'dzin gsol 'debs rdo rje tshig rkang ma/ zhabs brtan gsol 'debs/ ting 'dzin tshar bcu gcig 'phags pa brgyad stong pa/ mdo sde bskal bzang tshar bzhi/ gser 'od sa bcu ma tshar bcu gcig rdo rje gcod pa tshar gnyis/243

mdo sdud pa / gzungs bsdus/ skyabs 'gro tshar brgya dang bcu/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma tshar brgya dang brgyad/ yum 'bum pa dag tshar gnyis/thar mdo tshar gnyis/ ltung bshags/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings ma tshar nyer bzhi/ dbu ma 'jug pa/bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo/ tshad ma sde bdun yid kyi mun sel/ grong khyer sgrol ba'i 'khor lo phan yon dang bcas pa tshar brgyad/ sgrol bstod yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa tshar gnyis/ mdo dang gdugs dkar/ 'jam dbyangs dang 'jigs byed zhi khro sbrags sgrub 'don chog shes rab mig 'byed tshar gsum/ slob dpon gyi gsung bka' bsdus/ gong sa mchog gi gsung bden gsol zhabs brtan gsol 'debs dang bcas tshar gnyis/rab 'byams rgyal ba ma/ tshad med yon tan/ gnas brtan phyag mchod tshar gya gnyis/ sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo/ shar gangs ri ma/smon lam rnam lnga/ lam rim smon lam tshar lnga bcu/ sham+bha la'i smon lam tshar lnga bcu/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi smon lam/ rje'i bstan pa dang mjal ba'i smon lam/ byams pa'i sku gzugs ma/ gnas mchog dga' ldan ma tshar gnyis/ bka' thang sde lnga/ bka' thang shel brag ma/sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma/ dge ldan bstan 'bar ma/ kun khyab spros bral ma/ ma ṇi bzhi 'bum chig khri lnga stong brgyad brgya/ gsang bdag sngags bzhi brgya/ rnam rgyal gzungs ring tshar brgyad/ lha mo'i sngags 244

bh+yoḥ bdun ma drug brgya bzhi bcu rnams ni gsung gi rim pa'o mchod rten brgyad can tshar brgyad ni thugs rten gyi rim pa'o/ /nang rten sna tshogs gyi rim pa dag ni bde bar gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung / sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i ring bsrel/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi ring bsrel/gong sa mchog rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sku gzan/ phyag nas/ma ṇi dung sgrub ril bu/ bdud rtsi chos sman/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gdung tshwa/ dbu skra/ phyag phyis/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho'i dbu thod/ na bza'/ sku lcug gdung dkris/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i gdung rus/rje'i sku gdung ring bsrel/ tshems par/ gser gdung gur shing / na bza'/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i skabs kyi rnam rgyal lha dgu'i sa ts+tsha byin rlabs can/ gdung tshwa 'jam dbyangs sku gsum/ gdung tshwa ston pa'i sku gsum/ gdung tshwa mi 'khrugs pa'i sku/ gdung tshwa rje sku/ gdung tshwa gsang 'dus sku/ rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ bzhugs gdan/ sku lcug rgyal dbang sku phreng gsum pa'i na bza'/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ o rgyan rin po che'i na bza'/ rgyal bo khri srong cilde btsan gyi na bza'/ be+e ro tsa na'i phyag bris/paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi tshogs zhwa/ sngas 'bol/ paṇa chen sku phreng gsum pa'i bzhugs gdan/ paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza'/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi na 245

bza'/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi na bza'/ sa skya gong ma rin po che'i na bza'/ sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sgrub gtor/ jo bo zhal gser/ na bza'/ lhung bzed nang gi 'bru/ rje nga 'dra ma'i sku chos/ rgya gar gyi ston pa'i na bza'/ yongs 'dzin gling tshang gi gdung tshwa/ skal ldan blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ skal ldan bdun pa chen po'i na bza'/ dbu skra/zhabs phyags/ phyag phyis/ skal ldan brgyad pa'i dbu spa/ na bza'/ grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan tshang gi sku gzan/smad gos/ na bza'/ rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ dbu zhwa/ rdor phreng bum chu'i ril bu/ skra gri'i shubs/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla ba'i dbu skra/ rje gser khang ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ khri chen 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ a rol blo bzang lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag sku sham/phyag phyis/ na bza'/a rig dge bshes chen mo'i dbu skra/ kirti tshang gi na bza'/ g.yu rngog rin chen rdo tshang gi na bza'/ bis pa sku phreng lnga ba'i sku 'gagasngon gyi byams pa'i rten sna/ rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros kyi na bza'/ sgo dmar sprul sku'i na bza'/ la mo'i yongs 'dzin rje blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ dus dbang gi rdul tshon phye ma/ chos pa rin po che 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i phyag tsha/ chu bzang rin po che'i dbu skra/ na bza'/ phyag phyis/ rje blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo 246

rje'i dbu lo/ sems bskyed mchod pa'i rdzas/ bshes gnyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i phyag phreng / rje 'jigs med chos dbang nyi ma'i dbu skra/ mkhan chen tshang gi dbu skra/ zhwa dmar blo bzang 'jigs med bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ klong rdol rin po che'i na bza'/ 'bras spungs yi dam gyi na bza'/ se ra'i rta mgrin gyi na bza'/ lha sa'i sgrol ma'i na bza'/ sku 'bum gser sdong chen mo'i tshal bu/ bya khyung gser gdung chen mo'i na bza'/ slob dpon gyi lha 'dre bka' tham/ nan ha'e 'phel gdung /gangs ti se'i 'phel gdung / ri bo rtse lnga'i kun bzang me tog dang me tog ser chen/ byang chub shing gi lo ma/ rten sna stong phrag 'dus pa'i ril bu/ sa skya'i rten 'dus ril bu/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi rten 'dus ril bu/ mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi rten 'dus ril bu byin can/ po ta la'i rten 'dus ril bu/ bya khyung gser gdung gi rten 'dus ril bu/byin rten sna mang na 'dus ril bu/ shar bla brang gi rten 'dus ril bu/rten 'dus ma ṇi ril bu/ a lags mag sar tshang gi rten 'dus ril bu/bod gzhung gi rnam sras bang mdzod g.yang rten/ rgya gar gnas chen rnams kyi sa sna chu sna/ rgya nag ri bo gru 'dzin gyi sgrub phug gi bla rdo dang sa sna/ bse ru'i rwa/ rwa sgreng shug pa/ gzhan yang gnas chen du ma'i rten 'gangs chen du ma dang sman bzang drug sogs kyis byur bur gtams te skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa'i rten/ ngo mtshar ba'i 247

gnas/ bsod nams kyi zhing mchog dam par dbyen zlum mchod rten legs par bzhengs so//dpal ldan gser ljongs 'dzin ma'i grwar/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i na dar zhing / /legs byas nor bu'i rab mtshan pa'i/ /chos sde za ma tog 'di rgyal/ /e ma rab 'byams thub pa yi/ /byams brtse ga bur zhun ma'i khams/ /lhun grub phyag na pad+ma yi/ /'phrin las mdzes pa'i bsti gnas mchog /gtsug lag khang chen me tog phreng / /star la brgyus par lung rtogs bstan/ /rlabs chen dbu 'phang mdzes byed du/ /snga na med pa'i dpal du grub/ /yang sgos gangs ljongs nags ma'i tshal/ /gang 'di gzigs pa ma btang bar/ /brgya phrag grangs kyis rol ba'i gar/ /mnyam med legs byas rtse dgas bcings/ /bdog pa mi zad gaṅgā'i klung / /rnyog bral dpal mos legs bskyangs pa'i/ /rten gsum kun da gsar ba'i 'dzum/ /gling 'di'i bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor grub/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//248

sde 'dir bzo rig byung 'phel/de yang bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rgyas sras chen po rgyal blon dang lo paṇa bka' drin can ji snyed cig byon pa'i mthu las bcu phrag rig pa'i gan mdzod bla na med pa 'di nyid las/ 'dir rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya gyal bzo rig pa rags tsam 'chad par bya ste/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos/ don gnyer rjes 'dzin bzo rig mtha' yas kyang / /sgo gsum bzo la shes bya kun kyang 'du/ /zhes lus ngag yid gsum gyi bzo gsum ni bzo rig tsam du ma zad shes bya kun 'du bar gsungs so/ /des na bzo rig thams cad las 'phral phugs gnyis kar phan bde zad mi shes pa 'jo ba ni mchog gsum gyi rten bzhengs bya rgyu de yin/ /'o na de 'dra'i bzo rig bod 'dir ji ltar byung na/ shes bya kun khyab las/ ri mo bal ris rgyun las sman mkhyen gnyis/ /byi'u lugs gsum dang bkra shis rnam gsum nas/ /sgar bris srol gtod 'bur bzo'ang rim mkhas gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sku gsung thugs rten bris 'bur gyi sgyu rtsal ni thog mar bal bo'i lha bzo ba'i phyag rgyun dar khyab che ba dang / dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i sgang tsam la mang stod byi'u sgang ba 'khrungs pa nas rim par de yi lugs gyi bris rgyun dar khyab che ba dang / dus rabs bco 249

lnga ba'i dkyil tsam du bzo bo sman bla don grub rgya mtsho mchog dang gong dkar sgang stod mkhyen brtse chen mo rnam gnyis byon pa nas khyad 'phags bris rgyun sgyu rtsal 'bur thon byung ba dang / dus rabs bco lnga ba'i mjug tsam la lho kha yar stod du bzo bo nam mkha' bkra shis byon nas rim par bris rgyun khyad du thon nas sgar sdis dang sgar bris gsar mar grags pa sogs dar khyab shin tu chen po byung / mdor na byi'u sgang ba'i lugs dang sman thang lugs/ mkhyen brtse'i lugs/ sgar lugs/ sman gsar gyi bris rgyun rnams bod chol kha gsum gyi yul gru kun tu dar khyab ches cher byung bar brten/ yul mdo smad reb gong gser mo ljongs 'dir lha bzo'i lag rtsal khyad du thon pa las/ sgyu sde 'dir yang lugs bzang de nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya bzhag la sus kyang bsgrun du med pa'i mdzad rjes can mang du byon pa dag las bzo rtsal khyad 'phags can gling 'di'i rgyan du che ba 'ga' re dang / de'i rgyun 'dzin pa'am rkang 'dzin pa dus rabs gsar ba'i nang sgyu rtsal ha cang 'grem spel dang bsam spyod lag rtsal sogs sna gang thad nas yar thon dge ba can rnams mthar chags su ngo sprod mdo tsam bshad par 'dod do/ /des na sde 'dir bzo rig las lha bzo dang par rko rdo rko gsum ji ltar byung ba rnams rim par brjod na/ 250

sgyu rtsal phun tshogs lha bzo'i skor/sgyu rtsal phun tshogs lha bzo ni/ gna' ches ring mo zhig nas sde 'dir lha bzo'i rgyun ha cang dar khyab che na'ang gnas lnga kun gzigs paṇa chen rka sar klu 'bum lha bris pa byang chub rab gsal zhes mtshan snyan ba dan dkar bo 'dzam gling sa'i go la'i steng du g.yo ba/ bod kyi bzo rig sgyu rtsal thun mong ma yin pa 'don spel byed pa la 'gran zla dang bral ba 'di lta bu sngar lo rgyus steng byung ma myong ba zhig go /rje 'di nyid rab byung bcu bzhi ba sa mo 'brug spyi lo1808lor 'khrungs pa nas spyir bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas dang / khyad par du thun mong snang tshod la lha bzo rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i lha yi bzo bo bi shwa karma ltar byon te 'jig rten mtha' dag kun tu snang bar byas so/ /rje 'di ba'i phyag bzo bris 'bur gang la mtshon na yang rus tshugs byad dbyibs zhi khro bar ma tshon mdangs sogs gang dang mi mtshungs pa srog ldan gyi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa/ lha gzugs bris thang dang 'bag gi rigs bzhengs pa la rab gnas mi dgos par gsung 'byon par grags pa dang / lha pho mo'i nyams dang bcad 'then phyogs sgeg nyams brjid rngam sogs thun min gyi bzo rtsal dang mdzes ris kyis sa gsum mdzes par byas so/ /mdo dang rgyud sde thun mong rig gnas sogs grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son te 'gro ba mi'i bde rtsa kho na sku tshe gang bor nyams bzhes gyis dus 'da' 251

bas bod kyi bzo rgyun khyad par ba bla nas blar spel rba'i 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen por gyur pa'i mdzad pa rags tsam 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar yin 'dir mi spro'o//rab byung bco lnga ba'i smad tsam la rka sar lha bris pa'i rgyud 'dzin mkhas dbang rje blo bzang shes rab 'khrungs/ khong ni chung dus nas bag chags sad stobs kyis rig gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga ste bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs/ lhag par du sngon gyi goms stobs ches cher bdo bas lha bzo rig pa la mngon par phyogs te rka sar klu 'bum lha bris pa'i srol rgyun don gnyer hur brtson sgos mngon par bslabs/ bris 'bur gyi lha sku dang gos drub gtsags drub shing rko sogs la mkhas par sbyangs/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med zhabs kyi pad+mo spyi bor bsten te gtan gyi mdun ma'i rtsa bar bkur/ ka ring gi rje sku bzheng skabs rdo rje 'chang gi thugs bzhed ltar thig khog nas rje sku'i skya thig btab pas rdo rje 'chang gis bstod bsngags dang bcas thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad/ gzhan gyan thang dang thang ga gang mang bzhengs pas khong gi thugs la ha cang babs/bris 'bur sogs gang bzhengs na sku nyams dang rus tshugs kyi sgyu rtsal gzhan las khyad du thon/ khams gsum bla ma chos kyi rgyal bo shar tsong kha pa chen po'i lte mtshal 'pho ba'i lum bi ni'i dga' tshal sku 'bum byams pa gling du/ gong sa paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas thams cad mkhyen cing 252

gzigs pa chen po sku phreng dgu ba blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma chen po'i gser zhal sgyur ba'i tshe/ rje 'di bas zhal bkod ltar thang ga zhig bzhengs te gzigs rtog phul bar paṇa chen mchog nas thugs dgyes nyams dpe med mdzad pa'i ngang bsngags brjod dang bcas bya dga' dang / paṇa chen nyid kyi phyag par dang thel rtags can gyi lha dar che legs/ sku par sogs gnang / de 'dra'i byin rten bla na med pa'i lha dar yang tsha bo chos skyabs kyis nyar tshags byas pa da lta mjal rgyu yod/ de nas khong gi lha bzor bskos te thang ga du ma bzhengs/ yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi dgon 'dir yang grub pa'i khyu mchog rwa rgya rin chen rdo rje'i thugs bkod ltar/ mgon po 'od dpag med kyi gos sku chen mo'i thig dpon dang bzo dpon zung gi 'gan bzhes te bzhengs grub byung ste mthar gos sku bshams pas 'ja' 'od shar ba dang / 'bras char bab pa'i ltas bzang ngo mtshar ba byung ba kun gyis mig mthong lag zin du grub/sku tshe 'dir gos sku chen mo bzhi bzhengs pa dang thang ga che chung mang du bzhengs pa rnams mdzes rtsal ha cang thon pas kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsi lta bur gyur pas skad grags che bar mngon no//lha bzo snyan grags can kun bzang ni/ gzhon dus nas rnam dpyod can yin pas bzo bo mkhas pa blo bzang shes rab tshang bsten te bzo rig la legs par sbyangs/ rje 'di yi slob ma gtso bor gyur nas lo 253

'khor dgu'i ring la bsten nas sbyangs pa mthar thon par mdzad/ sngar byon mkhas pa'i phyag rgyun rnams bla lhag tu spel/ blo gros dang lag rtsal rab tu rgyas te kun gyis gdeng 'jog ha cang mtho bas la mo zhabs drung dkar bo sku phreng brgyad pa'i lha bzor gyur/ la mo bde chen dgon pa'i 'du khang chen mo'i shing ris dang gyan thang mtha' dag legs par bzhengs/ der paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzim spyil gyi tshon ris dang thang ga 'bag sku'i rigs cha tshang dang / gser gdung khang gi gyan thang sogs legs par bzhengs pa rnams sku bab dang tshon mdangs sogs cha gang nas bltas kyang rka sar lha bris pa'i bris rgyun 'bur thon byung ba dang / bod kyi bzo rig rgyun 'khyongs dang dar spel byung ba'i mngon rtags bla lhag tu byung bar brten/ skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis kyang dgyes sor dpe med gnang / mgur dgon pa'i 'du khang dang jo khang sogs kyi rten gsum mang du bzhengs/ snang ra'i rnga ba dgon gyi 'du khang gsar ba'i gyan thang sogs dang byams sku rnams bzhengs/ zhabs drung sgar thog gi 'du khang sogs kyi rten bzhengs dang / zi ling mkhas pa mi gsum gyi lha khang gi rten bzhengs skor rnams nga brgyad yar sngon gyi bzo rtsal phyag rjes ngo mtshar dag go/1978lor reb gong bod brgyud nang bstan sgyu rtsal khang dbu brnyes nas ched gnyer gyis gdan drangs pas kun gyis brtsi mthong dang 254

gdeng 'jog ha cang che/ da lta lha mo dbyangs can ma dang rgyal chen yul 'khor srung / 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs bzhengs pa rnams mdzes rtsal 'bur thon can gson nyams ldan pa'i lag rtsal gyi khyad chos rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu grags pa ltar ro/1983lor ri bo nyi zla'i lha khang gi tshon ris dang thang ga sogs bzhengs/ lhag par du rong bo dgon chen 'du khang chen mo'i rgya mthongs khar yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs rnams reb gong lha bzo dpe legs can che bzhis bzhengs pa dang / rong bo grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gang gi srung ma dpal ldan ma'i gyan thang dang khyams kyi rgyal chen bzhi sogs bzhengs pa dang / gzhan yang sha sbrang dgon dang g.ya' ma bkra shis 'khyil/ kan su'u rma chu rdzong mtshan grags dgon/ rnga ba dgon dang tan tig dgon/ sgo dmar dgon/ gnyan thog dgon/ yid dga' chos 'dzin/ sgos su rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling gi 'du khang gi gyan thang sogs reb gong yar nang mar nang gi dgon pa phal cher dang / rdzong khul zhing chen gzhan rnams su yang bris 'bur gyi thang ga dang gyan thang sogs nye bar bzhengs te bod kyi bzo rig pa'i sgyu rtsal 'grem spel byas pa dang / rgyud 'dzin slob ma yang mang du byung ste rka sar lha bris pa'i bzo rgyun thun mong ma yin pa dar spel khyab gdal du btang ba'i phyag rjes bla na ma mchis pa bgrang gis mi lang ba bskrun yod do/ /255

der ma zad rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin ting zho phin dang ho yo pang rnam gnyis dang lhan du par blangs te khong rnam gnyis kyis che brjod gnang ba sogs kyi snyan grags che'o//lha bzo sha bo thar ni/ kho bo ni chung dus nas lha bris la dga' zhing ya rabs la dad pa zhig dang mi rabs bzhi'i lha bzo'i khyim rgyud yin te/ lha bzo skal bzang gis bris thang mang du bzhengs pa dang / lha bzo gcod pas sde gzhung gi thugs rje chen po sogs bzhengs pa dang / lha bzo bla ma rgyal gyis byams khang snga ma'i lha dpon dang / dbus nas rje tshong dpon dge legs ma'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can gdan drangs pa dang / lha bzo sha bo thar ni da lta'i 'du khang chen mo'i tshon ris kyi lha dpon yin pas kho bo ni shing ris dang gyan thang sogs bzhengs na gser tshon gyi mdangs dang zhib tshags ha cang che ba'i bzo bo rtser son zhig go/lha bzo byams pa rgyal/ pir thogs dbang po kun bzang gi slob ma yin pas lha bris kyi rig rtsal ha cang bzang / chung dus nas khong gi rjes su 'brangs te bod kyi lha bzo'i sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs la mdzes cha dang zhib cha thon pa'i dpe legs can zhig yin/ reb gong bod brgyud nang bstan sgyu rtsal khang gi lha bzo'i dga' tshal dam par zhugs te lag rtsal gyi khyad chos rtsal du bton/ rin thang bral ba'i thang ga mdzes ris can du ma bzhengs te bu rig 'dzin don grub sogs la rgyun spel/ bod brgyud nang bstan 256

kun 'dus zhal thang chen mo bzhengs skabs pha bu gnyis ka der zhugs te bod kyi bzo rig pa'i sgyu rtsal bla lhag tu spel/lha bzo chos skyabs/ rka sar klu 'bum lha ris pa'i srol rgyun 'dzin spel byed pa la zla dang bral ba blo bzang shes rab lags kyi tsha bo yin pas/gzhon dus nas lag rtsal la bslab pa'i blo gros can zhig yin/ rang gi a khu'i mdun nas lha bzo rig pa la mkhas par sbyangs/ reb gong bod brgyud nang bstan sgyu rtsal khang gi gras su zhugs te lha bris kyi phyogs la lag rtsal 'bur thon byung / rong bo dgon chen grwa tshang thos bsam gling ba'i skyabs 'gro tshogs zhing sogs bzhengs/ spen dkar thang dgon gyi 'du khang chen mo'i rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs kyi gyan thang bzhengs/ mtsho sngon zhing chen bod sman khang nas rgyud bzhi'i thang ga gya gcig bzhengs/ de bzhin du zhing chen gso rig slob grwa chen mo dang / zhang kang / ri pin rnams la rgyud bzhi las brtsams te thang ga gya gcig re bzhengs/ lha sa'i bsam yas dang / gser rta dgon/ gro tshang rdo rje 'chang / zhabs drung sgar thog g.yer gshong dgon/ yid dga' chos 'dzin/ rdo rje rdzong / go'u sde sgar/ rang dgon rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling rnams su gyan thang dang thang ga che chung mang du bzhengs/ rgyal khab gzhan la mtshon na a me ri ka dang 'jar pan/ o si khru li ya/ han go rgya gar/ zhin ca po/ hrang ha'e/ hrin krin bcas rgyal khab dang sa 257

khul mang por bod kyi lha bzo rig pa'i srol rgyun thun min gyi khyad chos rnams 'don spel bla lhag tu mdzad/ spyan mi bzang gi thang ga zhang kang mes rgyal gyi pang du log tshur bsdu skabs pe cin nas 'grems ston bgyis pas bya dga' zangs kyi rtags ma blangs/ lo 'khor lnga bcu'i dga' ston skabs ston pa'i mdzad bcu las sku bltams pa'i thang ga pe cin du 'gran bsdur byas pas gser gyi rtags ma thob pa sogs bya dga' mang bo thob pas rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu snyan grags che bar mngon no//pir thogs dbang bo bslab gsum rgyan ldan dge 'dun chos grags ni/ chung ngu'i dus nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste yon tan la legs par bslabs/ de nas lha yi bzo bo mkhas dbang kun bzang lags dge rgan du bsten nas lha bzo rig pa la nan tan chen pos bslabs te sbyangs/ lo bcu dgu'i steng dge rgan dang lhan du rong bo grwa tshang gi bla mchod tshogs zhing sogs bzhengs/ de nas lo rer rong bo grwa tshang gi rgyal chen bzhi/ sha sbrang dgon pa'i rgyal chen bzhi sogs/ zhabs drung sgar thog gi 'du khang sogs dang / gcan tsha'i mgur dgon pa'i rten bzhengs/ rnga ba dgon pa'i rten bzhengs gyi rigs mtha' dag dge rgan chen mos dbu khrid de mdzub khrid kyis bzhengs pa'i bka' drin la brten nas snga na med pa'i bod kyi bzo rig gi lag rtsal je mthor song gshis/ ri mo'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos 'don spel byed thub pa byung / rang 258

lo nyer gnyis tshe rtse khog rdzong rong bo dgon pa'i 'du khang la tshon ris dang skyabs 'gro tshogs zhing sogs bzhengs/ nyer bzhi'i steng mtsho lho gung ho rdzong khams chung dgon nas dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi gyan thang dang gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong sogs kyi gyan thang mang du bzhengs/nyer lnga la mtsho lho kos nan rdzong mang ra zhang gi tho le dgon nas skyabs 'gro tshogs zhing gi gyan thang sogs nye bar bzhengs/ nyer drug steng zhin he rdzong gi dkar mo g.yas 'khyil a tshogs dgon gyi byams khang gi tshon ris dang / sku 'bum dge bshes tshang gi ljags bkod bzhin thang ga du ma bzhengs/ nyer bdun la rang dgon gyi byams khang rten brten pa grogs dang bcas rten bzhengs phul phyin grub/ mtsho sngon po'i mtsho snying ma hā de pa'i 'du khang du dpal ldan lha mo'i thang ga sogs mang du bzhengs/mtsho sngon po rgya ye dgon pa dang sde gzhung gnyis ga nas gyan thang sogs bzhengs/ nyer brgyad steng rang dgon gyi byams khang sngar pha rgan shing dpon don grub ngo g.yog gis bzhengs par/ bu bzo bo rtser son dge 'dun chos grags kyis lha bzo grogs dang bcas tshon ris legs par btang / sngags sa'i mtshams thog gong ma nas ma ṇi khang gi rgyal chen bzhi sogs bzhengs grub byung ba la a lags mi bskyod tshang nas thugs mchog rab tu mnyes par gzhan yang 'du khang gi rgyal chen bzhi yang nye bar bzhengs/ nyer dgu ba la bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal kun 'dus zhal thang 259

chen mo bzhengs par deng dus kyi rig pa'i dpa' bo brtson 'grus rab rgyas lags kyis ched du gdan drangs te phyogs gcig gi lha dpon gyi 'gan bzhes nas dge ldan pa'i grub mtha'i phyogs kyi paṇa chen 'khrungs rabs dang/ bka' gdams pa'i mnyam med jo bo rje yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa/ sa skya'i grub mtha'i gtso thang sogs dang / rtsis rig pa'i bla brgyud sogs dang / bla brang dge bshes blo bzang rgya mtsho'i thugs bkod ltar dkyil 'khor brgya phrag lhag gi thig rtsa legs par btab pa dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi rnam thar sogs lo grangs bzhi lnga'i bar gangs can gyi lha bzo sum brgya lhag gi lhan du kun 'dus zhal thang chen mo legs par bzhengs so/ /gzhan chos sde chen po bla brang nas gyan thang dang thang ga dkyil 'khor sogs mang du bzhengs te bod kyi bzo rig thun min gyi sgyu rtsal dar spel ngos gtsang dang / sgos su reb gong rka sar lha bris pa'i bris rgyun bla na med pa phyogs su spel ba'i pur thogs dbang bor grub bo//lha'i bzo bo rtser son bsod nams mkhar ni/ snga ma'i bag chags kyi dbang gis blo gros kyi rtsal rab tu rgyas te slob dpon chen mo kun bzang lags kyi mdun nas lha bzo rig pa la sbyangs pas tshegs med du shes/ sngar rab tu byung ste rig pa'i gnas la bslabs nas bag chags kyi dbang gis byang chub par gyur/ 'dus bzang chos gling gi byings 260

'dren chen mor bzhengs te zhabs 'degs bsgrubs/ rang lo bcu dgu'i tshe dge rgan rin po che dang lhan du dpal nā len dra rong bo dgon chen gyi rgyal chen bzhi dang bla mchod tshogs zhing lha mo'i gyan thang sogs dang / sha sbrang dgon pa nas sgrol ma'i zhing bkod dang dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs thang ga che chung mang du bzhengs te tshon mdangs dang bcad 'then phyogs sogs la rgan rin po ches mdzub khrid kyis lag len mthar phyin bgyis te lha bzo rig pa'i shes bya skya thig dang tshon mdangs zung ni 'di'i srog snying mtshon pas na de gnyis byang chub par gyur pas/ rgan rin po che nas blo ldan bsod nams mkhar dang dge 'dun chos grags zung ni nga'i slob ma'i yang rtse yin zhes bsngags brjod dang bcas zhal gsung dron po lhu things pa mdzad/ don du kho rang gi rgyal thabs su dbang bskur te 'di'i shes bya'i gsang tshig mtha' dag gtad zin pa dang pha shul bus zin pa don thob kyis go bar gyur/ gzhan yang zhabs drung dkar bo'i dgon khag sogs la grogs dang bcas ji ltar bzhengs pa gong du lha bzo dge 'dun chos grags kyi skabs su brjod pa ltar dang 'dra ba'i 'dir yang bskyar mi 'god do/ /rang lo nyer gsum skabs su mtsho sngon po'i a lags nyi mgon tshang nas yon sbyar te lha sa bsam yas mi 'gyur gtsug lag khang gi rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi thang ga bzhengs/ ston dus su mgo log dga' bde rdzong long skya dgon gyi gyan thang sangs rgyas stong sku gnas 261

brtan bcu drug sogs legs par bzhengs/ nyer bzhi ba la rtse khog a lags thub bstan gyi dgon par rten bzhengs che chung gang mang dang / lo rer rim pa bzhin gling gya sa dkar shar dgon pa'i sman bla'i zhing bkod sogs dang / yar nang hor gyi 'du khang gi gyan thang sum cu sogs lo snga phyir bzhengs/ nyer brgyad pa la rang dgon 'dus bzang chos gling gi byams chen mthong ba don ldan bzhengs te grogs dang bcas phyi lor tshon ris btang / de nas sum cu ba la bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal kun 'dus zhal thang chen mo'i dbu brnyes nas ched gnyer gyis gdan drangs pa ltar dge ldan pa'i grub mtha'i shing rta'i srol 'byed tshad ma'i ston pa 'jam mgon rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i mdzad rnam tsong kha brgyad cu dang /bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs dang / bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa'i mes po 'brom ston pa'i rnam par dang gnas brtan bcu drug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs dang / yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs bzhengs te bod chol kha gsum gyi me tog mnyam bzhad dang / mkhas brgya 'gran gleng gis bod kyi sgyu rtsal thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa/ mdzes ris phun sum tshogs pa rnams pir thogs dbang bo gangs seng srab med du 'phyo ba'i bod kyi dpyod ldan na gzhon dag dang lhan du 'dzam gling gi rgyan du kun 'dus zhal thang chen mo khyad mtshar bskrun/lhag par du rang dgon gyi byams khang gi gyan thang du ma dang phyi'i khyams 262

kyi rgyal chen yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes bo'i gyan thang gnyis ka gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i lag rtsal phul du byung ba'i khyad chos thon yod pa dang / de mtshungs su dge 'dun chos grags kyis rgyal chen spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras rnam gnyis bzhengs so/ /pir thogs dbang bo khong rnam gnyis kyis byams khang gi khri'i g.yas g.yon du jo bo rje dang rje tsong kha pa rnam gnyis kyi 'dra sku bzhengs pa sogs 'jig rten na zla dang bral ba'i bzo rtsal gyis 'dzam gling mdzes par byas so//gzhan yang deng rabs kyi lha bzo na gzhonashes yon can bzo bo mkhas pa/ lag rtsal zla dang bral ba bsod nams ni/ pir thogs dbang bo kun bzang lags yun bsten gyis sgyu rtsal la mkhas par sbyangs/ rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtshos/ bsam pa bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ lha bzo mkhas pa 'di ni bsam pa phun tshogs dang spyod pa phun tshogs gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen gnam kyis sa bkab pa lta bu dag gi mdzad pa lhur len gyis yon la rngam pa'i 'dod sred can gyi lha bzo lta bu gtan nas ma yin zhing / snying rje che ba dang yon la mi rngam pa lhag pa'i bsam pa sogs ldan pas/ mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i skye bo ya rabs can gyi bzo lta rang chas su mnga' ba zhig go /dgon pa dang grong sde gang du lha sku dang mdzes ris spel ba rnams deng rabs kyi sgyu rtsal gyi nyams ha cang 'bur du thon yod 263

pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal kun 'dus zhal thang chen mor bzhengs pa'i lha ris dag byad dbyibs dang nyams brjid thon pa'i lag rtsal ngom pa dang / mtshon mdangs dang gser bris sogs la bzo rtsal dpe legs can zhig go/lha bzo bsod bha ni/ bzo bo rtser son pa dge rgan kun bzang la bsten nas bzo rig la mkhas par sbyangs/ nyam chung tshul mthun gyis lha bzo rig par sbyangs 'bras mi dman pa thob pas dgon sde sogs su lha rten gang mang bzhengs/ zhal thang chen mor ched gnyer gyis zhugs te lha rten sogs lo du ma'i bar la bzhengs/ lag rtsal gyi chu tshad kyang ha cang mtho ru gyur pas lha bzo la mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob pa sogs kyi yon tan mnga' ba zhig go/'bag bzo ched mkhas tshe ring don grub ni/ rang bzhin bzang pos chung dus nas bzo rig pa la sbyangs te 'jim bzo la ha cang mkhas par gyur/ rang dgon gyi byams chen bzhengs skabs su gang nus kyis hur brtson dang sha tsha ba'i sgo nas grogs po rnams dang lhan du byams pa bzhengs/ mgon khang du yi dam 'jigs byed dang mgon chos rnams kyi 'bag sku bzhengs pa dang / chos 'khor khang nas 'dra sku sogs nye bar bzhengs pas sku nyams dang bzo lta ches cher byung / gzhan dgon sde dang sde gzhung rnams su 'bag sku che chung mang du bzhengs te 'jim bzo'i lag 264

rtsal rgya cher spel pas bzo bo dpe lag can du grags so/ /de ltar yul gru 'dir bod kyi lha bzo rig pa'i srol rgyun 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i pho gsar na gzhon tshangs pa'i pir rtse yang dman par byed pa bgrang gis mi lang ba mtha' dag 'dir 'god par mi nus la/ 'on kyang bzo bo mkhas pa bi shwa karma rka sar klu 'bum lha bris pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rgyun 'khyongs byas te phyogs mthar spel ba'i skal bzang re gnyis ma gtogs ma bkod pas re zhig de tsam mo//bzo rig par rko'i skor/de yang gna' snga mo'i dus su chos sde 'dir gsung rab ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi par gsar du bskrun pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis dgon grong gang du'ang gsung rab dang lha sku sogs par du bskrun pa'i bzo rig gi sgyu rtsal dar snga zhing / bzo bo mkhas pa yang mang du byung bas gangs can bod kyi bzo rig gi khyad chos phun tshogs dag dar spel byas te yab mes kyi srol rgyun bzang po nyams pa gsos nas chad pa 'thud pa'i dpe legs can gyi legs byas mtha' dag pa ni brjod kyis mi lang la/ des na 'dir par rko rtser son pa 'ga' re'i ming tho tsam ngo sprod kyi tshul du dgod par spro'o// par rko mkhas pa dge slong blo bzang rgyal ni/ spyi lo1901lor skyes te bzo rig la legs par sbyangs/ gsung rab par du bskrun pa la blo 265

gros dang brtson 'grus ches cher bdo bas dgon khag mang bor gsung rab par bskrun gyi 'gan bzhes te bzo rgyun khyad par ba'i rgyun spel/par bskrun bya ba'i gnas gtso bo ni bla brang phyogs su dngos phebs kyis lo grangs mang bor par brkos te bzo rtsal khyad mtshar bskrun/ rong bo dgon chen du yang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs gsung rab kyi par mang du bskrun pa'i phyag rjes can zhig yin no//par rko rtser son sha bo ni/ bzo yi sgyu rtsal la ha cang byang ba'i mgyogs myur ldan pa zhig yin/ rong bo dgon chen du lam rim dang sngags rim/ gzungs gzhug chen mo rnams dang / rang dgon gyi gser 'od sa bcu ma/ rtse khog so nag dgon pa'i gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud gyi par sogs brkos pa rnams chos sgo phyes tshun chad kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul lo/ /nga brgyad yar sngon du gsung rab kyi par khyad mtshar bskrun pa dag ni brjod kyis mi lang ngo //par rko phul byung can sha bo thar ni/ par rko'i phyogs la lag rtsal ches cher mdzes pa'i mi gsha' ma zhig yin/ rka sar dgon pa'i gser 'od sa bcu ma/ ting 'dzin sogs grogs dang bcas par du bskrun/ sgo dmar dgon pa'i 'od dpag med kyi zhing mdo/mdo sde brgyad brgya ba/'od dpag med kyi stong mchod sogs kyi par brkos pa dang / dgon chen gyi lam rim dang sngags rim gzungs gzhug chen mo sogs bzo skrun gyi gras 266

su yang yod/ nga brgyad yar sngon du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil sogs dgon khag mang po'i par rko mdzad de par gyi bzo rig spel/ sprel rdzong dgon par yang spyod 'jug chen mo sogs kyi par brkos te lag rtsal ngom mo /par rko mkhas pa blo bzang ni/ par gyi sgyu rtsal la ha cang mkhas pas gong zhus kyi par bskrun mdzad pa dag gi gras su bdog pas bzo rtsal gyi mdzes cha ldan pa'i dpe legs can zhig go /par rko rtser son mkhas dbang bkra shis ni/ bzo rig par brko'i bags la lag rtsal gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos ldan pa dang /yig tshugs dang rgyu spus kyi cha nas kyang yang rtser thon pas kun gyis mthong chen brtsi 'jog che bar mngon/ rong bo dgon chen gyi lam sngags dang gzungs gzhug chen mo/ stag tshang lha mo dgon gyi mdo sngags bstan pa'i srog shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ tshul khrims tshang gi nag rtsis kyi gzhung sogs dang / rang dgon gyi ting 'dzin dang gser 'od sa bcu ma grogs dang bcas lhan du gtsor byas nas brkos pa dang / bla brang phyogs su yang gsung rab kyi par mang du bskrun/ rang dgon gyi 'du khang dang byams khang rnams su mdzes ris pa tra dang pad sdong sogs bzo bskrun khyad mtshar can bla lhag tu spel yod do/ /gzhan yang par rko na gzhon 'jam dbyangs dang snying lcags rgyal/ klu 'bum rgyal/ rdo rje tshe ring / lha lung rgyal/ don grub/ tshe ring rgyal/ sangs rgyas sogs mang du yod pas yi 267

ger 'jigs pas ma bris so//bzo rig rdo rko'i skor/de yang mchog gāsum gyi rten sku gsung thugs gsum gyi bzo skrun ni/sde 'dir snga mo zhig nas dar khyab che bas bzo rig gi lte gnas su gyur/yin na'ang deng rabs kyi sgyu rtsal ni sngar las rgyu spus dang mdzes cha sogs sna gang thad nas je legs dang je rgyas su song gshis/ rdo bzo'i phyogs kyi lag rtsal yang sngon thon byung bas kun la gdeng 'jog ha cang mtho/ der brten sde 'di'i na gzhon lag rtsal pa rnams kyis rong 'brog gi dgon pa dang sde ba/ khyim tshang rnams su sku gsung thugs rten rdo rkos mang du bzhengs pa dang / rdo bzo mtha' dag 'dir mi 'god la re gnyis kyi ming tsam 'god na/ rdo bzo bsod nams/ dpa' 'brug don grub/dko bha/ don grub chung / sgrol ma 'bum/ dbang phyug sogs rdo rko pa bdun cu lhag mchis so/ /yul phyogs gang dag tu bzo skrun bgyis na/mgo log rta bo zhing gi bka' 'gyur/ rkang tsha sa tho dgon pa'i bka' 'gyur dang gser 'od sa bcu ma/ mdo sde bskal bzang / bka' thang shel brag ma/ o rgyan stong sku sogs bzhengs/ rkang tsha phyug nor dgon par mdo sde bskal bzang dang sangs rgyas stong sku/ rig smon pha yag sde ba'i bskal bzang dang sangs rgyas stong sku/ them chen rdzong then phang zhang gi bskal bzang dang sangs rgyas stong sku/ them rdzong klu mang dgon gyi 268

bskal bzang dang sangs rgyas stong sku/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum/ sgrol ma g.yang 'bum/ thebs brgya sde ba'i bskal bzang dang sangs rgyas stong sku/ rta nag ma nas ting 'dzin/ shing mgon nas gser 'od sa bcu ma/ mdo sde thar pa chen po khyon bsdoms tshar stong phrag gsum lhag dang gzhan yang gsung rab sogs bzhengs pa rnams yig gzugs shin tu legs shing che chung ma shor ba'i sgo nas chad lhag nor gsum dang bral ba'i rten bzhengs rnams 'byor ldan bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa dam par bskrun to// dpal ldan rigs rus gtsang mas mngon mtho ba/ /dregs ldan gtsug nor srong btsan lha yi rje/ /che btsan rgyud las 'phos pa'i rka sar zhes/ /ngo mtshar dpal yon mched pa'i gtam de snyan/ /sde bzhi'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i dga' tshal cher/ /nyer 'khungs bod kyi sgyu rtsal zil mngar 'bum/ /'khyil ba'i bzo rig pad+ma dkar bo'i ljon/ /pir thogs rkang drug khyu yi nyer 'tshor grub/ /byang chub mdzes ris phyogs rdzogs zla shel dbang / /sngon med rab gsal dkar bo'i 'dzum grol bas/ /skal bzang ku mud tshal yangs cher brtas te/ /skye dgu'i bde skyid dasi la la ngoms med rol/ /'di na brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten mtha' dag kun/ /snang bar byed pa'i bzo rig sman mkhyen lugs/ /sde 'di'i kun gsal bu mo'i rgyan nyid du/ /drangs pa'i dge mtshan gling 'di'i dpal du che/ /269

tshangs pa'i sor rtse la yang dman ster zhing / /gsung rab mdzad med mi zad 'phrul 'degs che/ /sor mo'i 'du byed las kyis nyer bskrun pa'i/ /dpal yon ldan pa'i dpyod ldan mtha' ma rig /'byung bzhi'i ches cher sdang ba rab zhi zhing / /mkhregs shing 'jam pa'i gor mo'i rdo ngos su/ /bzo rtsal shugs kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun/ /skye dgu'i dpal du bskrun pa 'di ci zhig /de lta'i gangs can bzo rig gan mdzod che/ /bde blag nyid du ma lus dbang bsgyur ba/ /legs byas mi dman bsod nams lhun po'i rtser/ /smin 'dis sa gsum shis par gyur cig gu/ zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//270

bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon skyes chen dam pa rim byon rnams kyi mdzad rjes rags tsam brjod pa/gtsug lag don la mkhas shing lta ba btsun/ /bslab gsum mi zad yon tan g.yas su 'khyil/ /lung dang rigs pa'i dbu phreng dgung du brtsegs/ /thar 'don rgya mtsho'i mgon de bdag gi skyabs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug mi pham zla ba'i zhabs/ /che dgu gang dag skyes rabs me tog phreng / /bstan 'gro'i dpal du spel pa'i ji snyed grangs/ /bdag ltas brjod pa ngal ba'i rgyu ru zad/ /de lta na 'ang sde 'dir sar gnas dag /rim par byon pas bde gshegs lam bzang gang / /'dzin skyong spel ba'i dge mtshan snang ba'i dpal/ /gcig las gcig lhag mdzad rjes 'dir yang dran/ /de yang chos sde chen po 'dir bslab gsum nor gyis brgyan cing mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan dang / rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin brtson pa lhur len byed pa'i yon tan tshogs kyis mngon par mtho ba dag rim par byon te/ zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha dbang gis kyang bskrun par mi nus pa'i ma smad 271

thabs mkhas spyod pas 'phrul 'degs rlabs po ches gang la gang 'tsham gyis dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas dge ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsnyal ba med par btsugs te/ gdul bya rnams ma smin pa smin par mdzad/ smin pa rnams grol bar mdzad nas sa 'dir sngon med rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dus ston la ngoms med du rol ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa ni/ ji skad du/ dbyangs can 'dzum pa'i rol mor/ de nas thub bstan rtsa lag pad dkar phreng / /gzhan phan sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston skyed pa can/ /mu tig star la brgyus 'dra rim byon pas/ /sa 'di dbus 'gyur tshal gyi dum bur byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang ches mtshungs shing / zhing 'di'i gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i slad du sangs rgyas byang sems rnams bsam bzhin du tha mal ba'i skye ba bzhes te dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par rol ba'i tshul gyis ma smad thugs bskyed rlabs po che yongs su smin pa'i pad tshal lhug par bzhad pa dang chabs cig gzhan phan thabs mkhas kyi spyod pa'i dri ngad phyogs su khyab par brten/ snga na med pa'i dam chos rin chen gsal ba'i mdzad bzang yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad pa sogs bsam brjod las 'das pa mtha' dag pa ni su zhig gis brjod par nus mod/ yin na'ang skal ba dang ldan pa dag gi dad pa'i gsos su bka' drin gzhal mtha' bral ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams chos sde 'dir rim par byon te bstan pa'i srog zungs ji 272

ltar bsos pa ni/chos sde gzhan nas phebs pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi mdzad rjes/ chos sde gzhan nas phebs pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi mdzad rjes rim par brjod pa la/ de yang bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rgyal rig pa'i chu bo 'dun nas 'bab/ /rje mkhas pa rnams kyis 'dud par 'tshal/ /ces re skong gser mo ljongs kyi yul rgyal thang gi sa rdo rje 'dra ba'i lte bar chags pa rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas gzhung bzang gi chu bo ma lus pa skal bzang stong phrag mang bo'i mdun sar 'bab bzhin pa paṇa grub bye ba'i 'byung gnas chos sde chen po rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling de la phyogs ris med kyi mkhas dgu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rnams pad mari mtsho la ngang ba bzhin thod phyags grangs su brtsegs te 'dud cing gus pa'i tshul gyis brten pa yang dag par lung gis bstod bsngags kyi me tog sil ma 'thor ba gang gi byang ngos nye 'dabs su gtogs pa sgrub pa'i dga' tshal dam pa ste/ ches phra tshig gi zla shel gzhon nur yang / /ches zab don gyi bsil zer rab rgyas pas/ /ches mang blo ldan bde 'byung gtsug rgyan du/ /ches dkar 'od kyi dge legs rnam par gsal/ /ces pa ltar rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor los dngos su byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung ba/ nges pa don gyi paṇa 273

chen sa la rgyu ba'i zla ba de nyid kyis phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i rka sar dgon 'dus bzang chos gling gang der rje nyid kyis mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor ma lus pa rang dbang du rgyun mi 'chad par rgya cher bskor ba'i mdzad bzang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo kun bzang 'phrul gyi bkod pa rab 'byams su brdal bar brten sar gnas kyi sems dpa' dag rim par 'khod pa'i mdzad rjes las brtsams te cung tsam dgod par spro'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ snyigs ma'i skya rengs 'od kyis reg pa yi/ /mkhas grub rgyu skar phreng ba rim 'das tshe/ /dmu rgod snyigs dus 'gro ba'i lha skal du/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs nyi ma khyod gcig shar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas btsun bzang grub mkhyen brtse nus gsum sogs cha gang nas kyang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i mdzad bzang yongs su rdzogs pa skyabs mgon skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po ste khong ni/ ji skad du/ thugs rje chen po kun tu sbas pa'i bu/ /'jig rten khams rnams rgya mtsho 'di yis gang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo smad nor 'dzin yangs pa'i thig ler bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu paṇ+ḍi ta dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug gnam gyis sa bkab pa 'dra ba sa'i dreg pa lta bur byon pa'i nang na/ gsang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i rang rtags dngos su gsal zhing / mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i 274

shes bya mtha' dag la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pas rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po/ dben gnas gangs khrod ri sul thams cad du sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng ba la 'gran gyi do med drang srong dbang bo/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sgrog pa'i thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi rtsa lag khyad par du mdo smad bshad sgrub gyi bstan pa spyi dang sgos su 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i dbu sngags bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi ring lugs dri ma med pa dus mthar spel ba la mtshungs zla ma mchis pa'i shing rta ba chen po/ rnam 'dren bla ma yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho dbyangs can mngon par dga' ba'i sde dpal bzang po ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rje chos sku tha snyad bral na yang / /las skal ldan mang po bsod nams las/ /rje rgyal ba mang po der lhags te/ /gnas byin gyis rlobs pa kho bos 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / bod byang gi phyogs nas byang phyogs su/ /mi khyod kyi sprul ba dam pa zhig /'bangs mgon med mang po 'dul du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mgon po gang gi sprul rabs bdun pa'i tshul du byon pa dang / kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal bo 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtshos/ khyab 'jug lte ba'i pad+ma las bltams grags pa snyan pa'i mu khyud rab mtho dpal stug ri mos mthongs ka mdzes/ /zla ba'i cod pan sar bas sgeg ldan bzhi gsum mig gi 'od 275

zer rnams spro du mar 'thung ba'i gdong ba 'dzum/ /sirtsa'i bdag po dga' ba'i gnyen gyur nam mkha'i bu mo mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig zur phud grol ba'i nags tshal las/ /smin pa'i gtsug tor nor bu'i 'od kyis zhabs sen chu ris sngo ba'i mdangs 'dzin 'khrungs rabs rim byon gus pas mchod/ /ces bsngags pa ltar mtshan gyi dri bsung phra mo tsam yang snying la bsil ba'i bdud rtsir 'jo ba phyag na pad+mo yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sku'i phreng ba spyi dang / yang sgos khyad par can du reb gong gsar mo ljongs pa rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha'i rnam par rol ba gang dag la 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de na yi ge sa dang ka /dang po dag tu brjod pa dang / /de nas yi ge ra dang gha/ /dang po rab tu brjod pa dang / /dang po yi ge ba dang ni/ /legs bzhin legs te sde/ /zhes mdo smad sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i shing rta ba chen po yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho dang / sog yul dam pa'i chos kyis dkar bor bsgyur pa ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ skye dgu mtha' dag gzi byin gyis skyong ba dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas/ gdul bya byams brtse'i thugs kyis 'dul ba blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ mkhas bya mtha' dag phyag mthil du 'grem mdzad blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ bstan srung bran du bkol bzhin lugs gnyis skyong ba blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ sku phreng bdun pa kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal bo skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung 276

rtogs rgya mtsho ste sku phreng bdun ka'i mtshan zur dngos su gsal bar thon pa'i sgo nas lung gi bsngags pa 'di nyid do/ /des na rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo skal ldan bdun pa chen po gang gi gsang gsum gyi rnam ra thar pa dag ni rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa'i yul las 'das na phran bdag 'dras cha tsam yang brjod par ga la nus mod/ 'on kyang skyes chen dam pa ngag gi dbang phyug dag gi gsung bzhin 'dir dri ni rten tsam dgod par spro'o/ /des na rje 'di nyid sprul ba'i zlos gar gang du bsgyur pa ni/ bod chol kha gsum las mdo smad ger ling rta'i chol kha/ rma g.yang phyug mo gzhung nas bzung ste nor bu dga' 'khyil tshul gyis phyi skor nang skor gnyis su bskor te 'khyil ba'i mthar rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa/ rgyang grags bdun stong drug brgya'i srid du brkyangs pa'i rma klung dbang mo'i dga' 'khyil nang mo'i mthar rma chu'i yur thig gis phye ba'i byang rgyud 'dzin ma'i thig le chu bzang rwa lo thang du rigs rus phun tshogs kun gyi smon yul du gyur pa yab btsan sa don grub tshe ring dang / yum 'dan ma bza' rta mgrin skyid gnyis la sras ming sring bcu gnyis byung ba'i brgyad pa'i tshul du rab byung bco lnga ba'i me 'brug lo'i zla tshes phun sum tshogs par ltas bzang dang bcas sku nye bar bltams/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'di nyid gzhon dus nas sku'i gzi byin gsung gi gdangs thugs kyi mkhyen stobs sogs rang ga ba zhig dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par can gyi rang rtags yongs su rdzogs 277

shing / zhabs dkyil du 'khor lo dang thugs kar dpal be'u'i mjes ris mtshan pa sogs sku bongs rdzogs par ma zin gyi bar gsal bor mngon par yod la/ mgrin pa'i thad du bu ga che ba zhig yod pa phyis su'ang mjal rgyu yod/ 'di ni skyabs rje dam pa thub bstan yongs kyi bdag po a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs kyi mgrin pa'i thad du yang de ltar mchis pas khong rnam gnyis sprul gzhi gcig par mkhas dgus gleng bar grags so/ /dgung lo gsum pa sa rta lo'i sa ga zla ba'i nyar dus gsug rjen par gzigs pa kun 'tshogs te skyabs mgon sku gong ma'i sprul skur thag bcad/ dgung lo bzhi bar dpal nā len+d+ra rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gi shar bla brang chen mo nor bu gru 'dzin gyi yang rtser mi 'jigs seng ge khri la lham me lhan ne lhang nger mnga' gsol bar gyur to/ /de nas rdzi rgya'i rab 'byams pa bshes gnyen dge 'dun rgya mtshor yongs 'dzin gyi che 'don zhus/ mnga' ris gyi gdul bya rgya mtsho'i rdul grangs dang nyams pa'i dbus tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo'i gdong lngas bteg pa'i gser gyi khri la zhabs zung bkra shis pa'i re khā nye bar bkod de dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo rgya cher spel pa sogs las brtsams te/ sku bstod phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan las/o swa ste/ byang phyogs skal ldan blo gros bzang bo'i 'dzum/ /'phrin las snying bo lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i grar/ /skyong mkhas mi pham bla ma gnyis 278

pa'i zhabs/ /'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rgyal gyur cig /ces sogs kyi sgo nas rgya cher gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dgung lo bdun par khri rgan rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho nas mkhan po dang /yongs 'dzin mchog nas grogs bgyis te rab byung dge tshul dkyus gcig la bzhes/ dgung lo bcu gcig steng mkhan po de nyid kyi mdun nas rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang lta zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sku tshe 'di'i dbang du byas pa'i dkyil 'khor du thog mar zhugs par gsang mtshan snang mdzad rdo rjer gsol/ gzhan yang dmar nag bcu gsum ma sogs kyi dbang dang / thugs rje chen po bde gshegs sogs bzhis bskor ba sogs rjes gnang gi skor/ brgya rtsa sogs lung gi skor rnams snga phyir gsan/ dgung lo bcu gnyis par ma hā paṇ+ḍita gnas lnga kun gzigs blo bzang dpal ldan zhabs yongs 'dzin du bkur/bsdus grwa nas bzung mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i dpe khrid dang dbang lung rjes gnang man ngag sogs snga phyir bum pa gang byo'i tshulo du gsan pas dran dbang yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa'i mtshan gyi rol mo bdag gir bzhes/ rdo rje 'chang mañdzu'i zhabs las sku tshe srung ba'i lha gsum sogs chos bka' rgya cher bzhes/ khyad par du tshe rabs kyi rigs bdag gong na med pa 'angam dpal dbyangs dngos rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad spyi bo'i rgyan du bsten te dbang bka' chos 279

man ngag chu gter chen po dad 'dun gus rtag spyor ba'i yur bar drangs nas ngoms pa med pa'i thugs kyi rol mtshor bskyil ba'i gsan sbyong nyams bzhes bla lhag tu lhur bzhes mdzad/ sgrub bstan mnga' bdag rje a rol rdo rje 'chang las dbang mi tra dang dus 'khor sogs spyi zur gyi dbang bka' mang bo dang / bde lam dang blo sbyong 'grel ba bzhi sbrags sogs bshad lung dang bstan 'gyur dang rje yab sras sogs kyi bka' 'bum bklag lung gi rim pa dpag tu med pa gsan/ bar skabs shig la grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan nyams mus dang mkhan khrir bzhugs mkhan dkon pa gang cis lo 'di'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la mdo sngags chos kyi rang sgra 'jigs med seng chen myos pa'i nga ror sgrog pa smra dbang bye ba'i zur phud kyis bteg pa'i khri la mngon par bzhengs te bshad sgrub bstan pa'i khur dngos su bsnams nas 'chal ba tshar gcod dang / rab byung la mi 'os pa'i 'tshong dang bun skyed zang zing nor la rngam pa sogs 'gog pa dang /rgyugs 'jog len/ slob gnyer gyi rting skul/ chos grwa nas gzhug skyor du bsdus grwa'i rigs 'phrul gtong ba sogs mdzad pas rang shugs kyis chos grwa'i rtsod pa yar ldan du 'phel zhing rigs smra yang mang du byung ba gleng /rtse gzhung sha bu nar du chibs bsgyur te zla7tshes8la 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bur sku tshe 'dir thog mar thugs rje chen po dpal mo'i lugs kyi dbang gi chu bo dang / gur lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang stsal/ dgung lo nyer gcig 280

bzhes pa'i tshe sa ga zla bar paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma re skong du gdan 'dren pa'i gra sgrig mdzad de sa ga'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu bzhi la rgyal bstan yongs gyi bdag po paṇa chen blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang po gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'jig rten du gsar phebs kyi skabs rta 'gying du chibs bsu dang / mjal phyag dri ma med pa'i lha dar bcas sngon du btang / rta bsu rkang bsu sogs sa chen po'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i dad ldan stag shar mang bo dang / ser sbreng bla na med pa dang bcas dpal nā len+d+ra rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen bde chen chos 'khor gling gang gi mi 'jigs seng chen kyis bteg pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por spyan drangs so/ /mnyes pa gsum kyis thugs mnyes par mdzad de chos 'khor bskor bar skul ma gnang bas zhal bzhes thob/tshes bco lnga'i nyin snang ba mtha' yas gso sbyong gi mgon du byon te so so thar pa'i mdo bsgrags pa dang gang gi dung gi tshems bar nas 'phrul gyi ljags brkyangs te spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang sta sogs chos sbyin stsal ba'i bka' drin thob/ paṇa chen rin po che zhing 'dir phebs pas thugs gang dges mdzad par brten khong gi mtshan zhabs pa rnams kyang ngo mtshar ba'i ngang nas yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi tar rtogs brjod gser gyi me tog rtsom skul gnang / dgung lo bcu dgu'i steng lha babs dus chen dang bstun te yab rje skal ldan ras pas zung 'jug mngon du mdzad pa'i 281

gnas shar rab dga' rgyal mtshan mthon po'i gzim spyil nas thub bstan yongs kyi bdag po bgyid pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i thugs bskyed kyi mthu grub cing / ston pa shākya seṅge nyid dang mtshungs pa'i mdzad bzang sgo kun nas lhun gyis grub pa rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus nas spong bdun 'khor bcas kyi tshul khrims bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes te thub pa'i dbang bo'i rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol bar mdzad do/ /de nas gdan sa gsum gyi khri gdan zur drag zhan mang po dang bcas pas spos 'grem gyis 'du khang bka' gdams pho brang du dgyes ston chos kyi khri la spyan drangs/ mkhan po rdo rje 'chang nas thub sku rgya gar shar li/ 'dul ba'i las chog gi glegs bam/ snam sbyar spus legs/ sku lcug lha dar dkar ser bcas 'bul lam du bstar ba bzhes shing / phyi nyin nas bzung sde khri'i sa bcad dang sprags 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i bshad lung smin rgyas/ brgya rtsa'i phyag khrid bcas chos ston du stsal pa legs par bzhes so/ /khrums zlar mgon shul gyis zhus pa ltar dang bo'i sangs rgyas kyi skur bzhengs te dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang mo che gsar du gnang ste gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhung bshad kyis mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i yid dbang cig car 'phrog pa dang / khyad par du dus 'khor grwa tshang du hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin gdan sa chen 282

po bde chen chos 'khor gling gi grwa sa gsum kyis gtsos dge 'dun 'dus pa'i li khri'i rgya mtsho ral ba lta bu la dus 'khor dbang chen gnang ba sogs snga phyi rnams su dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa rgya cher spel ba gzhan las lhag par mdzad pa sogs bsam brjod las 'das/ dgung lo nyer bdun steng thos bsam gling du mkhas grub bye ba'i spyi gtsug gis bteg pa'i chos kyi khri la zhabs zung 'khor lo'i mdzes pa nye bar bkod nas rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i 'grel ba don gsal sdud pa dang sbyar ba'i bshad lung slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang dbyer med pa'i gtam du drangs te gnang zhing / mjug tu dgon ma lag sgrub sde dang ri khrod pa bcas pa'i dge 'dun lnga stong la nye ba'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho la smon sems cho gas 'bog pa mdzad pa sogs theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor pa klu sgrub thogs med lta bu'i mdzad bzang mngon par bstan pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen gang mdzad mtha' dag pa ni su zhig gis brjod par nus mod de/ mi nus mod 'on kyang 'di tsam gyi rngo mi thogs pas rgyas par gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /mdor na skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po/ 'jigs bral tshangs sras snyems pa'i blo ldan srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan sarba dz+nyā chen po'i zhal snga nas sa'i steng na rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs dang shes par bya ba'i gnas thams cad nam mkha' la mdung bskor ba ltar thogs pa med par kun 283

mkhyen gyi mtshan sgra spyir ma song ba'i sgo nas phyogs thams cad nas sgo thams cad du zla dang bral ba'i mdzad bzang rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan dkar bo g.yo med du bsgrengs pa'i sgo nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la ston pa shākya thub pa mi yi seṅge 'khor bcas mtshan ldan dge slong gi rnam par rol pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal bo rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bo'i gtsug tu mchod pa yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho/ lung rigs gter mdzod dpal chos mkhan sprul blo bzang lung rtogs chos kyi rgya mtsho/ 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i rnam rol don gling mkhan po a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ khri chen dang po'i mgon po gangs can kha ba ri ba'i nye bar 'khor chen po rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang po sogs sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa du ma tshul bzhin du bsten te mdo sngags chos tshul gyi man ngag bang mdzod gter du rdzogs pa'i thugs bskyed las dag zhing na smon pa'i chos kyi dga' ston rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dge mtshan 'dzam gling sa yi khyon nas 'og min gyi bar mched pa stong gsum du grags pa'i ba dan dkar po yug 284

gcig gis khyab par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang gsang ba gsum gyi mdzad sgo yangs bor phye ste/dmigs pa med pa'i brtse ba chen pos skal ldan gyi gdul bya mtha' yas shing mu med pa rnams smin grol la 'god pa'i tshe sgrub pa'i sde chen 'dir chibs gyi kha lo yang bsgyur te chos 'khor khang nas klu dbang rgyal bo sogs kyi sgos chos du ma sger chos su gsungs pa sogs kyi bka' drin stsal/ mchod rten mthong ba don ldan gsar du bzhengs skabs ljags bkod kyis khyab par mdzad de thugs rjes gzigs pa mi dman par gyur pas ser skya yongs la dad spro lhag par 'phel/ reb gcig la rka sar gyi khyim zhus gnang ste bkra shis rab gnas kyi mdzad sgo spel nas byin rlabs kyi char chen 'dod dgur phab/ dgon pa'i byams khang dang 'du khang sogs la yang rab gnas rgyas bsdus ci rigs mdzad/sgar grong nas dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba btegs/ gzhan yang skyabs mgon badz+ra dha ra gang nyid nas re skong stod smad bar gsum gyi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi mos 'dun bzhin dus 'khor dbang chen dang 'jigs byed/ bde gsang /thugs rje chen po'i dbang sogs ci 'dod du stsal cing mnga' ris kyi gdul zhing gi mtha' gru kun la zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs te phyag dbang dang zhal gsung sogs thugs brtse ba chen pos chos sbyin ma lus pa gnang bar mdzad pa ni sku'i sgyu 'phrul gyi thog ma rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i rnam par thar pa ji lta bu bzhin las 285

gzhan du mi dmigs so/ /dad rdzas dang gshin rdzas gang 'byor mtha' dag snga phyir zhing gi mchog la bsngos pa dang / zang zing gi bdog pa rnams chig dril gyis tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo sogs 'byor ldan bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa bla na med pa mchog gsum gyi rten dang brten pa rgya cher bzhengs pa'i 'du byed las kyi bya ba mtha' dag sku nyid kyi ngos nas legs grub byung ba dang / phyag rdzas thams cad bsod nams mi zad pa'i mdzod du bskrun par mdzad de bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen yar ldan du mdzad do/ /deng dus nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i sems can sna tshogs kyi las dbyar dus kyi sha mo ci tsam brdol ba'i rkyen ngan byung ba de tsam gyis snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po'i thugs bskyed mdzad bzang me la bud shing bsnan pa bzhin mched pas bstan 'gro'i don du rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs che zhing rgya che la grangs mang ba thugs nyams su bstar pas 'phrin las 'od dkar yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad/ gzhan yang sems can gcig gi don du yang dmyal ba'i me nang du tsham tshom med par zhugs te bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa'i sdug bsngal dang len snying stobs kyi go cha ya lad du bgos nas dka' ba brgya phrag du ma khyad du bsad rang rgyud smin byed phar phyin drug dang gzhan rgyud 'dul byed bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs pa byeng chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho'i pha mthar phyin cing / rgyal bstan kho na'i 286

ched sku srog blos btang ba lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi mdzad pa phyag bstar gyis rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa rta hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod bdun dang skar ma so lnga'i steng re zhig lnga ldan zhing du ngal gsor phebs so/ /sku gdung yid bzhin dbang rgyal gdan sar phebs te mchod sdong chen mo 'dzam gling rgyan gcig lta bur bzhengs grub byung ba bstan 'gro'i mgon du bzhugs pa 'di nyid lags so/ /tshul 'di la sku bstod las/ /gang gi ba spu'i rtse mo rer/ /rgyal kun gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing / /stobs bcu mnga' ba mtha' dag las/ /lhag pa'i bka' drin yid la lci/ /rnam pa de slad yon tan dang / /bka' drin yid la dran pa yi/ /dad gus shugs kyis khyod bstod na/ /bdag cag mgon du zhabs brtan mdzod/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bdud rtsi dang / /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi/ /'phrin las rnam pa thams cad pas/ /ljongs 'di'i legs tshogs dgung du spel/ /thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling / /gang 'di rigs pa'i 'bab stegs su/ /snyems pa'i mkhas dbang khri phrag gis/ /'geng ba'i rtsa lag khyod la re/ /gzhan yang dus kyi dmod pa yis/ /rgud kyang khyod la brten pa rnams/ /lugs gnyis mjing ba bsnol ba las/ /'jigs bral dbugs 'byin chen por zhu/ /de ltar mchog gi yon tan gyi/ /ul phon por bsngags pa'i dges/ /zhing 'di spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /'phrin rles dpal gyis 'tsho bar 287

shog /bstod tshig 'di yang gser ljongs 'jig rten na/ /rong ston rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kho na yis/ /chos srid a mra'i 'bras bu longs spyod pa/ /dpal ldan 'jigs med smra ba'i seṅges smras/ /zhes 'jigs med gdong lnga myos pa'i dbyangs la drangs pa'i rjod pa thams cad kyi yang snying 'di yis don bsdus te yab rje bla ma 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jigs mdzad dgyes pa'i rdo rje yab sras kyi legs gsung rin chen sil ma'i cha shas 'ga' zhig ma bslad par snying rje'i rang gzugs gong sa mthong ba don ldan thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' drin la snying nas dad gus skyed pa'i rten du brjod pa 'di tsam bgyis so/ /slad mar yang mgon po gang gi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi stobs kyis sprul ba'i zlos gar bsgyur pa reb gong gser mo ljongs pa rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo sku phreng brgyad pa mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu rje bstan 'dzin 'jigs med skal ldan mchog bstan 'gro'i mgon du sku snga ma'i mdzad bzang mi nub ba'i rgyal mtshan thugs bskyed dpung ba brtan pos srid rtser bsgrengs te skal ba dang ldan pa'i 'dul bya dpag tu med pa rnams bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi legs mdzad dam pas nye bar skyong bzhin pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi rnam thar thos bsam sgom gsum/mkhas pa'i rnam thar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ dam pa'i rnam thar sdom gsum rnam dag che po'i rnam thar 'khor lo gsum gyi legs mdzad 288

rnams phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du bdag gir bzhes te brtson pa lhur bzhes mdzad bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /gzhan yang sde 'dir yang chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te byams khang dang 'du khang sogs la rab gnas dang ser skya yongs la phyag dbang gnang ste/ mi khyim re rer ja bzhes gnang zhing bkra shis rab gnas mdzad nas dgos chos mang pos tshims par mdzad/de'i der yang chos sde 'di'i bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i dge 'dun chos grags kyis bzhengs pa'i gzim spyil bkra shis nyams dga' skyabs mgon sku gong ma dang a rol rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi bsti gnas dam par phyag bzhugs gnang bas dgyes sor dpe med mdzad pa sogs kyis gdul bya rnams dad pa'i sa la bkod/ de ltar mnga' ris kyi gdul bya rnams chos srid gnyis char gyis skyong ba dang / bstan 'gros don bla lhag tu mdzad pa'i skabs nyid do//gong sa bdun pa mchog rka sar la gser zhal bsgyur skabs zhu rgyur spel ba/ o swa snyi/ lung rtogs rin thang med pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal thabs la/ /dbang bsgyur mtha' dbus drag zhan ma lus pa/ /'phrin las don yod lcags kyus dbang gyur cig /ces yid la brnag pa'i don chen po las brtsams te shis brjod g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang mnyam 289

par bsgrags pa'i rten 'brel gyi phung bo rang byung lhun grub bde ba chen po'i ngo bor yongs su grub pa sngon du btang ste gang zhig zhu bar bya ba ni/dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi bkod pa rgya dang phyogs su ma lhung ba'i dbus na skal bzang rnam 'dren stong gis phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i zhing khams mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ba stegs bu la me tog dang / ri rab la bang rim bzhin du bkod pa mdzes par chags shing /gang gi lte bar dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi rkang 'thung ral ba'i cod pan du 'dzin pa/ lho gling grub pa'i gnas mchog 'di la/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rim par byon pa dang 'byon par 'gyur ba mtha' dag pas sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ston pa las deng gi dus su 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pa de nyid nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul bstan te skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la theg gsum mdo sngags sna tshogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor bas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag dge legs kyi snang ba yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad de/ nag phyogs bdud kyi ris ma lus pa ni spa bkong / dkar phyogs lha mi'i tshogs mtha' dag pas ni rgyal ba'i rnga brdungs/mtho ris dang thar ba'i sgo 'phar rnam par phye bas na phan pa dang bde ba'i dpal mi zad pa'i dge mtshan mtha' dbus yongs la rgyas pa 'di lags la/ byang sems sa chen po la 290

bzhugs pa rnams dang sprul ba'i nyan thos dpag tu med pa'i tshogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang shing rta chen po rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas 'phags pa'i yul du thub pa'i rang lugs mya ngan med pa'i rkang 'thung yongs su bskyangs pa dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bsod nams mi zad pa'i dpung ba stobs su mtho ba'i chos brgyad rim byon dang / lo paṇa gser gyi ri bo lta bu rnams kyis rgyal bstan 'dzam bu'i mchod sdong spyir bskyangs shing / rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba dang / jo 'brom yab sras sogs mnyam med bka' gdams pa dang / sa chen gong ma rnam lnga sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa dang / mar mi dwags gsum sogs bka' brgyud pa rnams kyis chos tshul g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra 'gog med mkha' khyab tu bsgrags pas grub mtha' so so'i sgo nas bde bar gshegs pa'i rang lugs rnam par dge ba'i dpal du bsgrubs pa re re nas ya mtshan pa'i gnas kho na yin na'ang / khyad par du mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal pos/ tshogs gnyis spyod pa rlabs chen shar ri'i rtser/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo smra ba'i zla ba 'dzegs/ /thub bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ /rje btsun bla ma snying gi mun sel rgyal/ /zhes rgya cher bsngags pa ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mes po/ bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag po/gangs ljongs tshad ma'i ston pa rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo de nyid nas 291

rtag chad kyi mtha' rmang nas khegs pa'i 'khrul bral dbu ma chen po'i lam bzang dang / gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam zung du 'brel ba snying bor byas pa'i bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis khyer ba'i bka' srol gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i lugs bzang dru ku la'i gos dkar yug gcig gis stod dza ti'i me tog rgyas pa'i sa nas shar rgya mtsho chen po'i 'phang ba la thug gi bar du bskyangs pas rgyu skar gyi dbus na zla ba dang / rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag bsam bzhin du grub mtha' gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing dri ma med pa'i bka' srol de nyid 'dzin pa'i skyes bu chen po ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs las grangs mang chos kyi dgon sde ni phyogs mtshams khor yug tu tshom bur spungs pa las/ bdag cag gser ljongs yangs pa'i zhing 'dir/ bis pa paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla bas/ rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gser ljongs dkyil 'khor rnam par dkar ba 'di/ /stong phrag zla ba'i spu long rab g.yos pas/ /smag rum lhag med byas pa'i mthu'am ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang gi 'phrin las kyis gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'dzin ma la phan pa dang bde ba'i gzugs can bzhin du mdzad pa'i byed po/ bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub pa'i khyu mchog gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu byon pa dag gi khrod na zla med pa'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sgrog 292

pa'i thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsa lag spyan ras gzigs dbang skyabs mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho dpal bzang po ni/ ji skad du/ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / /bstan pa'i snying bo bshad sgrub rnam gnyis dang / /dam pa'i rnam thar sdom gsum nyams len la/ /phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'bad/ ces gsungs pa ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/bshad sgrub rnam gnyis/ sdom gsum nyams len so so'i ngos nas rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo'i rang lugs 'dzin skyong spel par mdzad pa'i rnam thar mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa sha stag tu gyur cing / khyad par du/sa rdo rje 'dra ba'i rked pa nas/ /mi khyod kyis sgrub rgyud bstan pa spel/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i 'bras bu smin pa'i dus la babs pa na/ legs par bshad pa mi zad pa'i nga ro bsnyengs pa med par sgrog pa'i mkhas dbang stong phrag du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal bde chen chos 'khor gling gsar du bskrun pas zhing 'dir rgyal bstan gyi chu bo mtha' dag gang las 'byung pa'i ma dros kyi rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa 'di bzhin lags shing / yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho de nyid slar yang mi'i gar du brten pa mdo smad kyi 'phags pa nye bar 'khor chen po ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang srid pa gsum gyi bla na 'phags pa'i gdugs dkar gcig gis yul gru mtha' dag khyab par mdzad pa dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas/ ngo mtshar byams brtse'i rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i 293

tshul bzung ba blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa lhan skyes su mnga' ba blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs sku'i phreng ba gong ma rnams dang / khyad par du/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub pas thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi srid la dbang bsgyur zhing / snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo dmu rgod pa rnams thabs mkhas zad mi shes pa'i 'phrul gyis yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang mtshan brjod par dka' ba/ phyag na pad+mo blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dpal bzang pos chos dang srid kyi 'phrin las zung du 'jug pas gser ljongs yangs pa'i bstan 'gro'i phan bde dgung du spel ba ni/ mkhas mchog dpa' bos/ du'i mtshon byams pa ru mtshon phra mo'i dpung gi cho ga tsam/ /de'i ni mi kho tshig rtsub mi smra ba yang legs par srung / /de yi bka' khrims chos yin rgyu med nor yang dam pa mchog /de ltar rmad du byung yang ngan pa'i chos srid dregs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa mngon du babs pa lags la/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang de nyid nas bdag cag gdul bya mtha' dag thugs rje'i ra ba las phyir ma gzhol bar/ legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ phyag na pad+mo gsang gsum sa bon mchog /mthon po'i legs kyi zhing sar btab pa las/ /lus can yongs kyi 294

dbugs 'byin phan bde'i gsos/ / mi dbang dge sbyor lo tog 'di go bltams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skye rgu ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/'gro ba'i sgron me/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar dregs ldan thams cad kyi bla na sku gsung thugs kun tu bzang po'i spyod yul can/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po/skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po nyid rigs phun sum tshogs par sku'i skye ba bzhes shing / mi mthun phas kyi sde thams cad thugs bskyed mi zad pa'i dpung gis zil gyis mnan te/ ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo gling bzhi'i mkha' la 'phags nas rang gi gan sa su spyon pa dang / tshangs pa chen po tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu dpag tu med pas skor te sum cu rtsa gsum nas tshangs chen du ldog pa dang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo bdag nyid chen po'i 'khor dang bcas te ljongs nas kun dga' ra bar btegs pa bzhin/ sku'i gzi ma nyams gsung gi gdangs ma shor/ thugs kyi gzigs pa ma btang par gser ljongs yul gyi nyan yod rgyal byed kyi tshal chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal bde chen chos 'khor gling du phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba skal ldan rgya mtsho yab sras kyis chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i pho brang sde bzhi'i lang tsho g.yang du chags pa'i gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang du bde bar phyag phebs/ de 295

nas bzung mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ lus kyi myu gu dang por gyur pa yi/ /gnas skabs der yang yon tan me tog ni/ /dpag med dri bzang rdzogs pa'i snying po can/ /'di lta'i ngo mtshar su yis bsam mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sku'i na tshod kyi myu gu gzhon nur gyur pa'i gnas skabs nas/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag khri chen dang po'i mgon po 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ mgon po gang gi sprul ba'i rang 'dra spyan ras gzigs dbang blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mi pham dbyangs can dges pa'i rdo rje ste rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum dbu blar bsten pa'i sgo nas dbang lung man ngag gi rgyun mtha' dag bum pa gang byok+ṣe tshul du gsan dang gsan bzhin pa dang / yongs 'dzin bgres pa rigs pa'i dpa' bo dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / yongs 'dzin gzhon pa snyigs dus kyi paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ba rnam gnyis las rigs pa'i bsgo skal spyir bzhes shing /khyad par du/ gser ljongs yul gyi gnas lnga gzigs pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs bla ma blo bzang dpal ldan gyi spyan sngar bka' pod so so dang rgyud sde rab 'byams/ thun mong rig pa'i gtsug lag phyogs med la gsan spyong mdzad pa'i sgo dang por phyes te/ bsdus sbyor gyi rigs pa la brda bstan pa tsam gyis rtog ge rgan po dag gi khengs pa snyil ba'i mkhyen rab kyi nyi ma sgrib g.yogs med pa'i dkyil 'khor las spros pa'i lung 296

rigs kyi dga' ston nam mkha' mdzod kyi bang ba kha phyes pas/ bdag cag skyabs mgon mchog gi 'phrin las kyi grib bsil la gnas pa'i gser ljongs yul gyi dreg zhan mtha' dag gi rgyud la kun dga' mi zad pa'i bdud rtsi rdzogs ldan dang po'i sprin du 'khrigs pa las e ma/bdag cag gser ljongs yangs pa'i gdul bya rnams ni skal ba dang ldan no/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che mgon gyis zin no/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams ni ston pa dang bcas so/ /zhes bsngags pas sar ba'i man+dar dbang med du spro zhing / ji skad du/ shes rab me long gtsug lag kun la gsal/ /'phrin las dpal gyis 'gro kun 'bangs su sdud/ /gzi byin chen pos gzhan phyogs zil gyis gnon/ /thugs bskyed mchog gis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel/ /zhes gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin legs mdzad kyi bkod pa mtha' dag chad lhag med par bstan dang ston bzhin pa'i skabs nyid na/ sgrub pa'i dga' tshal 'dus bzang chos gling 'dir chibs zhal gyi dang po bsgyur te seṅge'i khri la zhabs sen gyi pad+mo nye bar bkod pa'i legs skyes dang rten 'byung mtshon byed du/ bcas 'bul lam zhu ba lags na/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/ mdor na skyabs rje'i zhabs pad bskal brgyar bstan/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las snang bas sa gsum khyab/ /lung rtogs pad tshal mtha' dbus kun tu 'phel/ /'gro rnams rab dga'i gar gyis rtsen pa mdzod/ /297

ces gsungs pa ltar zhabs pad mi shigs g.yung drung gsar ba'i lang tshor bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du g.yo ba med par thos bsam sgom gsum/mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs yon tan zad mi shes pa'i bang mdzod 'dzam gling na 'gran zla med pa myur du bdag gir bzhes nas/ che btsan rnam par gnon pa'i gzi brjid kyi dpal lhag par rgyas shing / skye bo mi srun pa rnams chos dang mthun pa'i bka' khrims btsan pos rgyas btab ste/ mtshungs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyi phrag pa brtan pos bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i legs tshogs mtha' dag gong 'phel du bgyi ba'i khur chen po bla nas blar btegs te 'gro ba rnams rab dga'i gar gyis rtsen pa dang / mgon po gang gi 'phrin las la brten nas khrims ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba'i sde 'dir yang dge 'dun thams cad thugs mthun khrims gtsang ba'i sgo nas chos spyod rnam bcu'i mdzad bzang dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ba la brten nas/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las phyogs su skyong ba dang mchod gzhi rka sar tsho gsum du'ang bkra mi shis pa'i rigs thams cad ming tsam yang mi 'byung zhing / tshe bsod stobs 'byor mnga' thang rigs rgyud sogs legs tshogs kyi dngos po thams cad gong du 'phel ba la bsten nas skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' khrims tshul bzhin brtsi ba'i 'bangs su bag yangs su rol chog pa'i skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen 298

mkhyen zhes zhu lags/ zhes pa ltar ro// mdo smad bstan pa'i srog shing gcig pu/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag byams brtse'i gter chen skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa rje a rol blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho ni/ snang mtha'i thugs sprul slob dpon pad+ma ka ras/ byang sems bdud rtsi 'jo nus pa'i/ /lung rigs ded dpon bla ma 'byung / /dmar po zhwa ming skyes bu'ang 'byung / /mdo sngags ris med sgron me byed/ /ces dang / de sogs pad 'byung nga'i sprul ba/ /su yis tshad bzung ga la srid/ /ces rje nyid dang thugs kyi sras po zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta rnam gnyis kyi mtshan zur dngos su thon cing slob dpon rin po che'i rnam sprul du zhal gyis bzhes shing / mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i thub bstan rin po che gsal ba'i sgron mer gyur pa lung gis dngos su bstan pa ltar/ rab 'dod bgrang bya nga dgu ba khro bo zhes pa shing glang la lcang lung grong tshor sku bltams/ dgung lo bdun par 'dul 'dzin chen po rong rgan dge 'dun mkhyen rab kyi drung nas bar ma rab byung dang dge tshul dkyus gcig la bsgrubs te dge 'dun lung rigs rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gyi me tog gsol/ dgung lo brgyad kyi tshe mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang don yod rgya mtsho las 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa dang kun rig gi dbang sogs mang du gsan skabs mthar maṇ+ḍal bshad pa dam pa nyid nas sgra dag gsal gyi ngang nas phul pas der 'khod kyi che dgu rnams kyi 299

brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog bla ma rin po che thugs dgyes nyams kyi ngang legs dar stsal nas bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'thor/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa me byi'i lor rigs smra gdengs can 'bum gyi bste gnas rong bo grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du zhugs te ci las kyang gal che ba legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyis bsten tshul gnad 'gro zhig gal 'gangs che bar dgongs te/ gzhung brgya'i mnga' bdag dge 'dun mkhyen rab/ mkhas pa'i dbang phyug shing bza' paṇ+ḍi ta/ khri sprul blo bzang rgyal mtshan seng geskyabs mgon gser khang rdo rje 'chang yab sras sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen bcu phrag gsum tsam sangs rgyas dngos gzigs kyi mos gus drag pos rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes te/ ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad/ sgos su yab rje gser khang pa chen posatshosku na phra mo'i dus nas thugs kyi sras po gcig pur bzung ste 'jam mgon snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bgo skal rdzogs par stsal pa sogs bka' drin gzhan las bla lhag tu che bar brten/ sku tshe gang bor rje de nyid kyi gsung sgros dang mdzad spyod kho na la thugs gtsigs shin tu gnang zhing / dgung lo nyi shu ba shing sprel la/ rje de nyid las bsnyen par rdzogs te blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ de nas bsdus grwa blo rtags bka' chen bzhi'i rtsa ba rnam bshad snying bo'i rgyan legs bshad 300
