snying bo sogs thugs 'dzin gyi steng nas gzhung so so'i dpe khrid dang /chos grwar brgal brtag gis gtan la phab pas dbu phar rnam 'grel gtsos bka' pod chen po lnga'i dgongs don phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud de kun rmongs dbul ba sel ba'i mang thos nor bu'i mdzod du gyur/ rgyud sde khungs ma nas byung ba'i spyi bka' dang zur bka'i dbang dang rjes gnang gi rgyun phyogs 'dir gang bzhugs thams cad thugs rtsol chen pos gsan cing / sngags rim chen mo sogs rgyud don lam gyi rim par bsgrigs pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi skor/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sngags kyi rim gnyis zab mo'i dmar khrid mkhas grub gong ma rim byon gyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gsang mdzod ma lus pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan pas/ bla na med pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i zab gnad mtha' dag thugs su chud de mdo sngags kyi gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ma lus pa gdams par shar ba'i thugs nges gting tshugs pa 'khrungs/ rje nyid sku na phra mo'i dus nas srid pa'i phun tshogs mtha' dag la nges 'byung rang 'khrungs su yod pa'i khar/ yab rje gser khang ba'i nyams bzhes kyis thugs phrog stes/ dgung lo nyer lnga ba la ri khrod du byon pa nas bzung 'di snang gi bya bzhag thams cad 'phongs phyis kyi rdo bzhin rgyang du bskyur/na bza' dang bzhes chas sogs ngan ngon tsam la brten nas mkhar gong bsam grub bde ldan sogs de'u gsing spang ljongs dang / rdza khrod nags 301

khrod kyi dben gnas brgya phrag brgal bar tshe blos btang gi rnam thar bzang pos 'jam mgon sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par mdzad/ nyid gyi zhal nas lo bzhi bcu rtsa grangs kyi bar thag nye ring gang du 'gro yang chos gos khur nas rkang thang la 'gro ba ma gtogs bzhon pa la brten pa ma byas/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gis sha dang ja mar gyi ched du rtsol ba mang bo byed pa 'di 'dra sngon gyi ri khrod pa tshos mi gnang / nged kyang ri khrod pa dkyus ma'i skabs ja mar sha thud mod chi le ba med/ ma rgan gyi phye rtsam phran bu re byin pa dang phyis su bsod snyoms cung zad re bslangs te zas 'grangs tsam la brten nas dge sbyor gang thub byas pa yin gsungs/ de ltar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i lam gyi go rim nges pa med par dang po nas bskyed rdzogs lta bu mtho bsnyegs byas pa'ang rmang gzhi med pa'i mkhar las dang 'dra bar sa chod chung bar dgongs te ri khrod du byon ma thag pa nas bzung mnyam med thub pa'i dbang bo'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs don rgyal sras mi pham pa dang 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi man ngag la brten nas shing rta chen po gnyis kyis ji ltar bkral ba'i lam srol/ dpal mnyam med a ti sha dang 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa sogs 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub gser gyi ri bo lta bu rim byon rnams kyis nyams myong tshad ma'i sgo nas gtan la — 302

phab pa'i gdams ngag gi nying khu che ba bzhi ldan byang chub lam rim gyi rim pa'i khrid skyong ba 'di thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad nas/ dge sbyo ra gzhan rnams de'i yan lag tu 'khyer bar mdzad pas sde snod kyi dgongs don dang mthun pa'i myong ba khyad par can 'khrungs te gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa na/ phyogs ris med nas 'dus pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gang 'tsham gyi dbang khrid lung sogs rgyun chags su stsal pas skabs 'dir reb gong phyogs dang rma nyin srib dpyod ldan gyi khrod na rje 'di ba'i slob mar ma gyur pa ches dkon par snang / rje nyid kyis thugs kyi ze'u 'bru ltar gces par bskyangs pa'i sras kyi thu bo ni/ byang phyogs skye dgu'i rnam 'dren mtshungs med mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid skyabs mgon blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang /snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta zhwa dmar dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho khong rnam gnyis yin la/ gzhan yang mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid dgu nyin srib gyi char 'khod pa'i skye sprul yod do cog dang / nub phyogs gtsang rwa rgyal gser lag dgon sogs dang /byang rgyud du sku 'bum byams pa gling / bya khyung rnams dang / a rig dgon khag rnams/ la mo bde chen dgon ma lag rnams dang / shar bis mdo rdo sbis sogs dang / lho rgyud dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil kha gya gter lung sogs phyogs gzhan gyi dgon sde che chung mang bo dang / gsung 303

las skyes pa'i bu slob skye sprul ches mang bos sa steng du khyab pa byung / chos sde chen po dpal nā len+d+ra rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling dang sgrub sde bco brgyad kyis gtsos gser ljongs yangs pa'i dgon sde so sor zhabs btegs te chos 'khor bskor nas gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god pa'i tshe/ rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling 'dir yang chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te dbang khrid sogs nyin du ma'i ring la 'dod chos mang du stsal/ rab byung mang bo bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs kyi sgo nas bka' drin bskyangs/lo ltar ma ṇi dung phyur du ma dang smyung gnas kyi sgrub rgyun btsugs pa sogs kyi grong dang dgon gnyis la brjed du phangs pa'i zhal gdams mang du gsungs/ chu byi lo'i ston rka sar dgon gyi tshogs yongs la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang dang rjes gnang / dad ldan 'gar gcod dbang dang 'don cha'i skor gyi lung bcas stsal/ sa sbrul lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gsum dang nyer bzhi'i bar ri stag brgyud de rka sar dgon du phebs/ kun rig gi blos bslangs gsar bzhengs la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad cing bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa ba gsum la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen sgrub dang bcu cha'i skor gyi zab khrid lung dang bcas stsal/ lcags lug lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu dgu la rka sar dgon du phebs te ye shes grags pa'i shag tu bzhugs/ bdud rtsi'i 'phrod bzhes grub 'phral bde chen sgo mang mkhan sprul rin po che dang / bshad gra'i lha 304

rams pa tshang sogs la dril bu lha lnga dang las dkyil gyi dbang / dpa' ris pa kha shas la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid sogs bka' chos mang du gnang / gsum pa'i nyi shu la sgo dmar du phebs/ dgung lo re brgyad pa chu sprel lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes dgu nyin rka sar dgon du phebs te/bde chen sgo mang mkhan sprul rin po cher rgyal sras thogs med bzang po'i khrid yig gi steng nas blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid rgyas pa/ rka sar ye shes grags pas dngul rta mig ma gcig phul te zhus don ltar 'jam lugs tshe dbang dang rdo rje gcod pa'i lung sogs stsal/ rje gser khang ba chen po'i bka' rtsom rnams kyi lung rgyun ltar byams pa'i stong mchod/sman bla'i stong mchod/ sems sems byung gi rnam gzhag sham+bha la'i smon lam le tshan gsum/ mtshan brjod smon lam sogs kyi lung gi bka' drin bskyangs/ sgo dmar dang rka sar gnyis nas bsod snyoms bzang 'gran zhus pa la bsngo smon bkra shis bcas mos pa dang sbyar/ shing phag lo'i zla bcu ba'i yar tshes la nag gya/ ri rtsa/ spen dkar thang / tho gya/ dkar rtse gdong rnams kyis thab bsu dang bcas rka sar dgon du zhag shas bzhugs/ lcags sbrul lo'i zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin spen dkar thang dang sdong skam gnyis kyis thab bsu zhus te rka sar dgon du phebs/brgyad pa'i bco lnga nas ri khrod pa nyis brgya lhag tsam gyis mdo sde gsung sgrogs dang / gzungs sngags sna tshogs bzla ba sogs zhabs brtan mang 305

du bsgrubs pa'i mthar nyer lnga'i nyin tshe bum phul te zhabs pad brtan pa'i bden tshig bsgrags/ 'di dus ri khrod pa rnams la dgon de kas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ ri khrod pa rnams kyis gtsos ser skya ches mang bar bde mchog dkar bo dang 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i rjes gnang / lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub le tshan gnyis/brtan bzhugs 'bum chog sogs kyi lung bcas stsal/ ri khrod pa bzhi bcu skor la rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen sgrub dang bcu cha'i zab khrid shin tu rgyas pa yig sna so so'i lung bcas dang / brag dkar me long dbu mdzad sogs nyung bsdus la 'jigs byed bdud las rnam rgyal gyi dbang / rong bo dgon sprul sku sogs ri khrod pa 'gas zhus te yang bskyar gyis bsnyen sgrub dang bcu cha'i khrid bcas stsal/ nyer bdun la sgo dmar dgon du phebs/ de kar bya khyung gi 'cham gsar du tshugs pa rje nyid la gzigs 'bul zhus par/ nged rang rgas pa'i khur gyis non kyang dka9dze ri tshegs la ma 'dzem par thams cad bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrubs pa 'di don yod par gyis— la/ phyin chad ma mtha' rka sar dgon pa lta bur mig ltos byas nas sgrig lam spyi dang khyad par du khas blangs pa'i bslab khrims ma nyams par byed rgyu yid la zungs zhes bslab ston gnad du 'dril ba zhig mdzad/ chu lug lor dgu ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin rka sar du phebs te ye shes grags pa'i shag tu bzhugs/ 'du khang gsar bzhengs 306

kyi thebs su dngul srang sum cu gnang zhing / dngul srang bzhi bcur nye ba'i yon gyis sku 'bum nas rgyal tshab mkhas grub gnyis kyi gsung 'bum cha tshang gdan 'dren mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad cu ba shing sprel lo'i bdun pa'i bcu dgu'i nyin hor nag tu dad ldan gyi khrom chen por chos 'brel bsngo smon phyag dbang sogs mos pa ltar stsal te rka sar dgon tu phebs/gtsang sgar gyi grwa ba bzhi bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrubs shing / rdzong dkar sprul ba'i sku'i zhus ngor sgrol ma dkar ljang gnyis kyi rjes gnang stsal/ bdud rtsi'i 'phrod bsten grub 'phral rdo sbis kyi grwa ba 'ga' zhig dang mjal ba mang bor thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang 'dod sbyar gyi lung kha shas gnang / 'du khang gsar skrun la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad de gang ci'i thad nas sgar grong ser skya kun la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sprin gyi klong yangs nas dam pa'i chos kyi sprang char 'dod dgur phab ste bka' drin rjes 'dzin lhod med mdzad/ yab rje gser khang ba'i phyag bzhes ltar sa ga zla bar bzhi ba'i mchod pa gdugs bdun gyi ring la mchod pa 'bum phrag mang bo bshams pa'i sgrub rgyun btsugs/ nya la smyung bar gnas te lha mchog thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas cho ga chad lhag med par gsung mchog yi ge drug ma bgrang ci thub kyis bgrang dgos pa sogs kyi dge rgyun dang / dus tshes bzang bo rnams la sman bla sogs tshogs 'don du ched 'dzugs gnang / gzhan yang rka sar sgar grong la yang yang brtse 307

gzigs kyis 'dod chos mang du stsal te dad pa'i sa la bkod pa sogs kyi bka' drin bsam brjod las 'das pa zhig go /mdor na rje nyid mthar gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod de/ sngon byon mkhas grub yongs kyi rnam thar ma lus pa sku tshe 'dir phyag bzhes gnang ba lta bu'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i khyad chos rnams la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas kyang bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba'i yul du gyur/ljags rtsom po ti gsum tsam bzhugs/ mthar sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams rdzogs te dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis steng mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan/ sku gdung mchod rten rin po che gdan sa dam pa rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen du bzhugs/ gang gi rnam thar rgya mtsho lta bu las skra rtse'i thigs pa tsam las ma spros pas/ rgyas par spro na rnam thar dad ldan rna ba'i bcud len la gzigs par zhu/ji skad du/ yum chen mo mi mo'i gar du rtsen pa ma gcig lab kyi sgrol mas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba 'di 'dra 'byung / /'brom gyi sprul ba skyes bu dam pa ni/ /ngur smrig tshul 'dzin bslab pa gsum dang ldan/ /rgyud sde chos la snying bo bcud du 'dren/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan skyes bu de 'dra 'byung / /zhes mtshan sgra dang mdzad pa sogs gsal bar lung gis bstan pa ltar/ gangs can 'gro ba yongs kyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i sgyu 'phrul 'brom 308

ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bsam bzhin dus mtha'i skye rgu rnams kyi mgon dang dpung gnyen du gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa/thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas 'jam mgon bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin cing spel ba la rgyal ba rang nyid kyi mdzad pa dang sgo kun nas mtshungs pa/ bstan 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang chen po/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum na g.yo ba de nyid do/ /dam pa 'dis ni ring nas ye shes mchog gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad cing / dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas par sprul ba'i rol gar bsam mi khyab pa rim dang cig car du spros te/ dpag tu med pa'i lus can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul ni rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa'i yul las 'das na bdag 'dras brjod par ga la nus/ 'on kyang bdag dang bdag 'dra'i dad pa'i gsos su 'gyur ched mdzad bzang rags tsam brjod pa la/ rje 'di nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sku phreng rim byon kyi 'phrin las 'dod dgur spel ba'i yul mdo smad reb gong gser mo ljongs zhes grags pa'i cha shas snod bcud phun sum tshogs shing / dge bcu g.yang du 'khyil ba'i yul gru a bur the bu zhes sde tshogs gnyis su 309

mched pa'i nang tshan las/ a bur tsho ba'i char gtogs/ mgar gyi rigs las mched pa'i a bur nang tsho'am/ pe hu'i brgyud las yab dge 'dun bsod nams dang / yum sgrol ma skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa byi lo'i zla tshes gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams/ 'khrungs ma thag nas tsog bur spyan phye zhing 'dzum dang bcas bzhugs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i spyod pa phal ba'i skye bo'i bsam yul las 'das pa byung / de'i tshe yab kyis yi dam skyabs zhes mtshan gsol/ sku na phra mo'i dus kyi rtsed 'jo'ang ri khrod 'debs pa dang / lha khang bzhengs te/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad de ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshul/ grogs kyi byis pa rnams la chos 'chad pa dang / phyag dbang 'jog pa bum chu stor ba'i rnam pa sogs ring nas legs mdzad de dag la goms pa'i dan rtags dang / phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel gyi snang ba mngon du gyur pa mang bo mdzad/ dgung lo gsum pa'i steng rgyal ba'i dbang bo bcu gsum pa chen po'i rigs kyi cod pan yongs 'dzin zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang po dang grub pa'i dbang phyug rje 'jigs med bsam gtan rin po che rnam gnyis kyi lung bzhin/gser ljongs yul gyi skyabs mgon drug pa chen po rje btsun blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bos rje a rol blo bzang lung rigs 310

rgya mtsho'i yang srid du thugs thag bcad/ dgung lo lnga'i steng rong bo dgon chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rab 'byams pa blo bzang dar rgyas yongs 'dzin du bsten te/ ji skad du/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge sbyor klog dang mgo skyabs 'gro nas bzung 'don cha yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin mdzad par dka' tshegs cung zad kyang med par thugs su chud/ dgung lo bdun pa'i steng gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i spyan sngar/ bar ma rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan gsol/ de nas zla tshes dge bar rong bo dgon chen gyi thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi chos grwar gsar zhugs kyi mdzad sgo gang rgyas gnang zhing blo gsal rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog gi dpung chen po dang lhan du/ tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i rigs lam phra zhib phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i grwa nas mgo bzung /dgung grangs nyer bzhi'i bar du chos grwar chag med mdzad de/ gzhung chen bka' pod lnga'i spyi don dang / mtha' dpyod kyi steng dpe khrid zhib rgyas dang / rtsod pa/ dogs gcod/ thugs 'dzin/ skyor sbyang sogs la shin tu dam par mdzad pas mkhas dgu'i yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 311

phrogs/ thugs rab shin tu che ba/ dper na snga dro rer legs bshad snying po'i dpe cha mda' tshad ma gsum re skyor tshad lnga drug tsam gnang na thugs thog nas shar mar 'gro ba dang / gang zin gtan nas bsnyel ba med pas gzungs spobs shes rab kyi gter la dbang 'byor ba'i rang rtags mngon du gsal/ zhor du sum rtags dag gsum/ sgra snyan sman rtsis sogs thun mong ba'i rig gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa gnang / snyan ngag gi lam nas tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i gsung rtsom gyi nyams la deng dus kyi mkhas par rlom pa sus kyang 'gran zla med pa mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud rang grol du song ba'i dan rtags su skyabs rje khri rgan rdo rje 'chang nas bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor ba thos so/ /gzhan yang thun mong ma yin pa'i nang don rig pa las/ gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i lam gyi gnad spyi dang / bye brag rgyud sde so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi thig dang /phyab/ rgya/ gar dang / rol mo 'bud dkrol brdung gsum tshun chad kyi phyag len dang / zhib cha rnams so sor ma 'dres par bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i mdun sar zhib khrid dang / bdar sha chod pa'i sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa sogs mdor na mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag thos tsam dang sbyang tsam ma yin par/ lung dang rigs pa'i lam nas thos bsam kyi sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par bcad de mkhas dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam par gyur/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa sa sprel lo'i 312

sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas mkhan slob sbrags ma gnang ste brtan mkhas gnyis ldan gyi dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su da chog nyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa legs par mnos te/'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug nor lta bur gyur/ de yang bstan pa'i snying bo 'dul khrims tshul bzhin du bsrung ba shin tu gal che bar gzigs nas bslab gzhi phra rags thams cad srung thabs rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar srung bar mdzad de 'phags pa'i yul gyi nye bar 'khor slar 'jig rten du byon pa lta bu'i mdzad pa bdag gir bzhes pas thub bstan yongs kyi bdag por mngon du bzhengs/lo snga phyi 'di dag gi skabs su rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rigs kyi cod pan yongs 'dzin zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/gser ljongs yul gyi skyabs mgon drug pa chen po rje btsun blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor ba grub pa'i dbang phyug rje 'jigs med bsam gtan/ skyabs mchog kirti rin po che blo bzang 'phrin las/ rong bo'i khri rgan rin po che 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ khong a lags rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho/che shos byang chub bstan pa'i sgron me sogs mkhas grub dam pa bcu phrag 313

lhag gi zhabs pad nye bar bsten te rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi ljags lung gi rgyun gang bzhugs dang / rje yab sras gsum dang rgyal dbang paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon/ sa skya gong ma rnam lnga sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi sngon byon mkhas pa'i dbang bo tshad mar gyur pa mtha' dag gi gsung 'bum gyi lung rgyun gang bzhugs dang /byang chub lam rim pa'i khrid chen brgyad du grags pa dang / gzhan yang lam rim blo sbyong / lta khrid snyan brgyud ci rigs kyi khrid dang / zhal lung /mi tra rdor phreng gtso byas rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs du ma'i smin byed kyi dbang dang / rjes gnang spyi bka' dang zur bka'i skor ci bzhugs/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gtso byas pa'i rgyud sde gong ma'i rim gnyis kyi khrid dang / zhal lung man ngag sna tshogs/ lhag lha'i be+e'u bum dang / las tshogs sogs kyi lung khrid dang / zhal shes snyan brgyud gsang ba bka' rgya ma'i skor sogs deng skabs mdo dbus khams gsum na dbang khrid lung gsum man ngag snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa bar ma chad pa gang bzhugs sku ngal la ma bltas par rtsol ba drag pos gsan bzhes mdzad pas thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing / man ngag rgya mtsho'i gter la mnga' bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal bo chen por gyur to/ /dgung grangs nyer lnga ba chu byi lor/ rong bo dgon chen gyi gser khrir mnga' gsol mdzad de lo ngo gsum gyi ring dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor bsnyen 314

bkur phun sum tshogs pa'i gtong ba mi zad pa'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye bar ma zad chos 'dul ba'i bca' khrims spyi dang / dge 'dun gyi nang khrims/ grwa tshang so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bca' khrims la rting mnan ches cher mdzad pa dang / 'dzin grwa so sor skabs gang bab kyi rgyugs dang tshig bzhag rtsod pa/ dpe khrid blo 'dzin/ skyor sbyang sogs kyi thad lta rtogs gang zhib dang / zhi drag gang 'os kyi gting bskul rgyun ma chad par gnang bas/ lo de dag tu sngon las lhag par chos grwa dar rgyas dang /'chad nyan yar rgyas su song bar kun gyis gleng / dgung grangs nyer brgyad pa shing yos lor/ zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i drung du ri khrod kyi skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang thugs ha cang mnyes te/ ma 'ongs pa'i rten 'brel la dgongs nas/ nyid kyi sku gzan bzhes 'phro dang sku gsung thugs rten 'dul 'dzin ri khrod pa brgya phrag gnyis lhag gi mtshan tho bcas phyag tu phul zhing / rang nyid kyi rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur bar mdzad de sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ lo der gser ljongs skyabs mgon drug pa chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus pas/rong bo'i nang so gtso byas reb gong shog pa bcu gnyis kyis bla dpon ser skya drag zhan du ma dang / rong bo dgon chen gyi bla ma los snes gtsos dege 'dun pa yongs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ skyabs rje nyid rong bo dgon 315

chen gyi skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal tshab tu bzhugs te/skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po gdan sar phebs pa'i bar dgon chen gtso byas sgrub sde/ lha 'bangs dang bcas pa'i chos srid kyi bya ba spyi'i 'gan bzhes shing / lhag par yang srid rin po che rtsad gcod dang /brtag zhu/ mtshan 'bul/ gdan sa chen por zhabs pad 'khod pa sogs kyi bya ba'i gdung phrag tu bzhes/ lo 'di dag gi snga rjes su rong bo dgon chen gtsos sgrub sde yongs kyi bla sprul dang / ser skya yongs nas nan zhu mdzad pa ltar sems bskyed mchod pa phyag len rgyas pa'i tshul dang /gzhan yang so so'i 'dod mos ltar dbang rjes lung gsum mang du stsal/bar skabs shig tu skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi gdan sa lcang lung sgar gsar dang / nags gzhi'i ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ thun mong ba'i snang tshod du rje gong ma a rol blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i gzim khang gi khyams ra'i logs su brag dkar sprel rdzong gi gnas kyi bkod pa dang /de'i mdun du dgon pa zhig dang / gnas bdag zhing skyong gnyan sprel zla ba'i gzugs ris bcas ldebs bris yod pa la gzigs pa dang / ma 'ongs par gnas der dgon pa zhig 'debs pa'i lung bstan mang du gsungs pa gzigs pa'i rkyen byas te/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho gtso mdzad de ri khrod pa bzhi gnas 'dir bzhugs su bcug lo de'i ston kar rong bo dbo/na chen du phebs nas dgun bzhugs gnang / de'i phyi lor/ bsod 316

nams stobs kyis phyug pa'i rkang tsha'i chen hu gtso byas dgon grong ser skya thams cad kyi re ba ltar rkang tshar byon nas mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang dang /gzhan yang 'dod chos mang du stsal/ de nas a tshogs su phebs nas a tshogs dpon pos dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi mthun rkyen du rta chen brgya dang lug stong gcig phul/ lo der sprel rdzong dgon du rje nyid kyi gzim khang dang / grwa shag bco brgyad tsam legs par grub ste/ 'du khang gyan lnga ma zhig gsar bzhengs kyi 'go tshugs/ shing glang lor 'dul 'dzin ri khrod bstan pa 'dzin dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen grags pa rnam gnyis gtso bor mdzad pa'i ri khrod pa bco brgyad dang / gzhan yang dgon par gsar zhugs kyi dge tshul slong mang du 'dus par dus 'brel gyi gso sbyong dang / dbyar dgag bcas gzhi gsum gyi phyag len ngos gtsang phra zhing zhib pa gsar 'dzugs gnang /de nas rim gyis grwa rgyun je mang la song ste tshogs pa rgyas par/ me stag lo nas bzung zla re'i tshes brgyad la maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba dang / tshes bcu la 'jigs byed bdag 'jug tshes nyer lnga la bde mchog sgrub mchod tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ zla mjug la bskang gsol rgyas pa/ gzhan yang lnga mchod chen mo nyin lnga'i bde mchog bdag 'jug sogs tshogs chos thog gi 'don pa dang / 'grig lam gsar 'dzugs gnang / dgung grangs zhe gnyis pa sa sbrul lor/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po lde tsha'i ye shes rgya mtsho tshang dgon par gdan 'dren 317

zhus shing / 'chad nyan gsar 'dzugs gnang / lo der gtsang chen sprul sku blo bzang lung rtogs nyi ma khri bar bsko bzhag gnang ste dus bzhi'i chos thog tu bsdus grwa'i 'dzin grwa gsar tshugs rnams la tshig bzhag dang /gzhan chos thog tu so sor bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byed rgyu'i ljags bkod gnang / de ltar gtsang ba rin po che nas kyang / lo gsum gyi ring 'chad nyan dang chos khrims dam 'dzin/ bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang bas bla ma dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde dang bcas par thugs mnyes pa'i kun bzang mchod sprin khyon kun dkrigs/ lo snga phyi 'di dag gi nang rkang tsha gong 'og dang 'khyams ru/ bong stag a tshogs lha sde sogs su phebs te dgon sde che chung rnams la gang 'dod kyi dbang rjes lung gsum dang / gzhi byes kyi dad ldan skye bo mtha' dag la ci 'dod pa'i chos sbyin zad pa med pa'i sgo phye bas thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad/ gzhan yang chab cha'i dgon pa so ma dang a rig gnyis nas dus 'khor dbang chen stsal/ dgung grangs bzhi bcu ba me yos lo nas gser ljongs yul gyi skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i rigs kyi bdag por bzhengs te bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang gis thog drangs te mi tra brgya rtsa sogs rgyud sde du ma'i spyi zur gyi dbang dang / rjes gnang / lam rim chen mo dang bde lam phyag chen sogs lam rim blo sbyong skor gyi khrid dang zhal lung / 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi zhal lung /318

gzhan yang be'u bum sna tshogs kyi ljags lung stsal/ dgung grangs zhe brgyad pa shing phag lor rong bo dgon chen du ched bzhugs skabs/ seṅge gshong sogs sgrub sde du mas gdan zhus ltar so sor byon nas 'don chos sna tshogs stsal pa dang / tho gya'i bod skor dgon du ser skya stong phrag du ma 'dus par dus 'khor dbang chen gnang / de'i skabs tho rgya'i bud med brgya phrag lhag tsam la skyabs rje nyid nas bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa gnang / de nas bzung kho mo tshos ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar sha dang sgog tsong spangs te smyung gnas rgyun ma chad par srung bzhin ma ṇi dung phyur gsog pa dang /rgyun du maṇa 'khor lag dang mi 'bral ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i lam du bkol ba'i srol byung ba da lta'ang ma nyams par yod pa skyabs rje 'di nyid kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs nyid do/ /dgung grangs zhe dgu ba me byi lor kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi nyi ma dpal bzang bo sku 'bum nas rong bo dgon chen du phebs skabs/ skyabs rje nyid nas 'gan gyi gdung bsnams/ de nas skyabs rje mchog gis thams cad mkhyen pa 'khor bcas mgar rtse dgon du gdan zhus gnang ba ltar/ snang ba mtha' yas mchog sku 'khor rgyas spros bcas mgar rtse dgon du phyag phebs mdzad/ de dus kun gzigs mchog dang gser zhal lhan 'dzoms dgyes brtse'i gsung gleng 'byung 'gyur bstan 'gro'i don du smin pa gnang ste dngos 319

'bul gyi rnam grangs sbam mtho ba phul te/ thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung khyon du dkrigs/ dgung grangs lnga bcu me glang lor/ dbus gtsang chos kyi dga' tshal du chibs bsgyur gnang ste/ jo shāka rnam gnyis gtsos rten gtso rnams la gser chab sgron 'bul dang 'brel/ snyan dar ‘lha rdzas/ jo bo yid bzhin nor bu la sku chos gsar 'bul dang / gtsug lag khang rnam gnyis la stong mchod phul ba dang 'brel thugs smon zab smin gnang ba sogs rnam par dkar ba'i phung bo mi zad pa'i gter du bsgrubs/ gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren skyabs mgon bcu bzhi ba chen por gzim chung mjal kha zhus te dngos 'bul gyi rnam grangs sbam mtho ba btegs/ gdan sa chen po bzhi dang rgyud grwa rnam gnyis gtsos chos sde khag gi dge 'dun re re'i phyag tu bod dngul srang gang dang zho lnga re'i sku 'gyed phul ba sogs bsnyen bkur rgya chen byas te 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa spro ba mdzad/ gzhan yang bsam yas dang / gdan sa mthil sogs gnas chen khag yod tshad la gnas gzigs dang 'brel/ mchod 'bul dang sku 'gyed phul te thugs smon gzab rgyas gnang / skyabs rje phur lcog rin po che sogs mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi skyes chen dam pa du mar phan tshun dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'dod par 'jo ba sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che thugs bzhed ltar bde blag tu grub cing / mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur rgyas pa la 320

brten nas snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab/ de dus srid skyong stag brag rin po che nas rje 'di nyid la mkhan po no mon han gyi cho lo gnang ste lugs gnyis kyi gzigs skyong rgya che ba thob/ dgung grangs nga gcis/ pa sa stag lor mdo smad phyogs su chibs bsgyur gnang ste gdan sa'i bla sprul khag dang mtsho sngon phyogs kyi bla dpon ser skya drag zhan du mas bsu ba rgya chen po dang bcas gnas chen brag dkar lhun gyis grub pa'i bde chen chos rdzong gi gdan sa chen po thos bsam yon tan dar rgyas gling du bde bar byon te dbus ston rgya chen po dang 'brel zang zing gi 'byor ba mi zad pa'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye/ rten gtso khag la mchod 'bul dang dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam bzhugs pa la snam phrug rtser son gyi zla gam re sku 'gyed du phul zhing bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod sprin dkrigs/dgung grangs nga gnyis pa sa yos lor rong bo dgon chen gyi gdan sa gsum gyi bla sprul gtsos ser skya spyi 'dus kyis gdan drangs pa ltar dgon chen du chibs bsgyur mdzad/ gong sa skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po cher dgyes mjal dang thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis gsung gleng rgyas spros bcas dngos 'bul gyi rnam grangs mi dman pa phul/ rten gtso khag la snyan dar mar me stong 'bul sogs mchod sprin rgya chen phul te thugs smon gnad smin gnang / grwa tshang gsum gyi dge 'dun chig stong lhag dang/ri khrod pa gnyis brgya lhag la snam phrug rtser son gyi gong snam re sku 'gyed du 321

phul/ dgung grangs nga gsum pa lcags 'brug lor sprel rdzong dgon du gzhung chen po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i yig cha'i steng nas byed dgos pas sgo mang ltar yin/de la rten 'brel gyi gnad chen po yod ces gsungs/ de nas dgon par chos 'dul ba'i bca' khrims dang dge 'dun gyi nang khrims gtso gal che bar dgongs nas bca' yig chen po ljags rtsom mdzad de/ mkhan rin po che gtso byas las sne 'dus spyi yongs la bka' slob dang bcas stsal/ lo snga phyi 'di dag gi nang mtsho sngon rkang tsha dang /bong stag 'khyams ru/ a tshogs/ lha sde/ gtsang a rig rtse khogahor/ g.yu rngog bdud shul/nags mtha'/ sgo me chos rje sogs yul gru dang / dgon sde che chung du mar zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs te yul gru so so'i bla dpon dang dad ldan skye bo bgrang gis mi lang bar so so'i 'dod mos bzhin du dus 'khor dbang chen dang mi tra rdor phreng sogs rgyud sde du ma'i spyi zur gyi dbang dang rjes gnang / lung dang byin rlabs gang la gang 'dod du gnang bas gdul bya'i re ba yongs su bskangs par mdzad cing /dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'dod par 'jo bas gdul bya mtha' dag la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon khyad par can bskrun par mdzad do/ /dgung grangs nga bdun pa shing sprel lor/ mgon shul tsho chen bcu gnyis kyis gdan zhus ltar byon nas sems bskyed mchod pa 322

gnang / de nas gter lung dang gtsos dgon par phebs nas/ gtsos gser khri rin po che sogs phyogs 'dus kyi bla sprul ser skya stong phrag brgal bar sems bskyed mchod pa phyag len rgyas pa'i tshul du stsal pa gnang /de nas mgar rtse nas gdan zhus ltar byon te dus 'khor dbang chen gnang /dgung lo nga brgyad pa shing bya lor/ skyabs rje mi nyag rdo rje 'chang / sku zhabs chu bzang rin po che/ che shos rin po che sogs nas gdan zhus ltar 'jam mgon bstan pa'i 'byung gnas sku 'bum byams pa gling du chibs bskyod mdzad/ gser sdong rin po che gtsos rten gtso khag la mchod sprin rgya mtshos thog drangs 'dus sde rin po cher bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas gnang / bla sprul che khag rnams kyi thugs bzhed ltar lhag lha du ma'i dbang dang rjes gnang sogs 'don chos sna tshogs kyi thugs bzhed bskangs/ dgung grangs re bzhi ba lcags yos lor sku 'bum du byon te/ kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog sprul rin po cher mjal phyag phul bas/ kun gzigs mchog nas kyang thugs mnyes pa chen pos gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing / lhag par skyabs rje nyid kyis dus mthar bstan 'gror sman pa'i legs mdzad rgya chen po la thugs ha cang rangs pas/ phyis 'byung rten 'brel gyi sgo la gzigs te/sngon paṇa chen sku gong mas rgya nag nas sangs rgyas stong sku cha tshang tshar gsum gdan drangs yod pa las cha tshang gcig lhag lus su yod pa/323

skyabs rje 'di nyid kyi dgon pa gsar bskrun kyi rten skal du gnang ba sogs gzigs skyong tshad med thob/ skyabs rje nyid nas kyang kun gzigs thams cad mkhyen pa mchog dbus gtsang chos kyi gdan sa chen por zhabs pad bde bar bskyod pa la/ nye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen du dmigs nas mdzo spus legs sga thag cha 'grig brgya dang rta chen spus bzang lnga bcu phebs rdzongs su phul/ lo der sprel rdzong dgon du 'du khang chen mo bskyar bzhengs byed rgyu'i 'go tshugs/ dgung grangs re lnga ba chu 'brug lor/ sgo me dang / jo skor/ 'ba' klo'u tshang sogs nas gdan zhus bzhin so so'i re 'dun ltar dus 'khor dbang chen re gnang ste slar sprel rdzong dgon du byon/ de'i tshe dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gyi rol mo 'dzam gling yongs su khyab pa gang nyid sprel rdzong dgon du chibs bskyod gnang ste yun ring bzhugs par/ skyabs rje nyid kyi bka' lung ltar bshes gnyen mchog gis/ 'dus sde yongs la dga' lha dang / lam gtso'i khrid rgyas par stsal pa dang / sku zhabs gtsang ba tshang / chu skya tshang / kho nag tshang sogs bla sprul khag dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang rgya mtsho tshang gtsos 'dzin grwa gong ma'i slob gnyer ba yongs la rten 'brel gyi tshul du phar phyin gyi dbu nas mdzub khrid gnang / de'i skabs bshes gnyen mchog gi zhal nas/ sku zhabs rin po che ni rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po bstan 'gro'i dpal du 324

bsam bzhin srid par skye ba bzhes pa'i sku dngos yin pa tshad mas grub/mtha' 'khob kyi sa stong 'di lta bur 'chad nyan gyi sde chen po 'di 'dra phyag 'debs mdzad pa 'di las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phyag rjes 'jog rgyu med/ 'di ni rje bdag nyid chen pos ri bo dga' ldan dang /kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil phyag 'debs mdzad pa dang sgo kun nas mtshungs/ 'du khang gsar ba 'di sprul ba'i lha khang dngos man/ cha rkyen gang yang mi 'dzoms pa'i sa stong 'di lta bur rten bzhengs 'di 'dra'i rgya chen po'i cha rkyen rnams 'bad rtsol chen po la ma ltos par lhun gyis grub pa 'di lta bu la sprul ba'i lha khang zhes zer/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang rnam gnyis dang bsam yas lha khang chen mo sogs la sprul ba'i lha khang zer ba'ang rgyu mtshan de lta bu la brten nas btags pa red ces sogs thugs shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gsung mchid mang du bgyis pa thos so/ /dgung lo re drug pa chu sbrul lo'i dbyar thog mtsho sngon rkang tsha dang a rig phyogs nas gdan zhus ltar phebs te/ slar sprel rdzong dgon du byon nas hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes la 'du khang chen mo legs 'grub kyi rab gnas mdzad par/ rdo rje 'chang nyid nas slob dpon dang / dge bshes rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos rab gnas kyi bshad pa rgyas par gnang ba dang /gzhan yang sku zhabs chu bzang rin po che/ an rgya zi rin po che sogs bla 325

sprul che khag du ma dang bcas rong bo rgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar gyi rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs gnang / de'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung bas thams cad dad pa'i sa la bkod/ dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo la mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung dang / rdzong taspreg brgyad kyi sku tshab gtso byas mtsho sngon dang reb gong phyogs kyi bla dpon dang sgrub sde khag gi sku tshab/ dad ldan gyi sbyin pa'i bdag po brgya phrag lhag 'dus par/ zang zing dgo/'a ston nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo cig car du phye/ dgung grangs re bdun pa shing rta'i lor/ sku 'bum nas nan zhus mdzad pa ltar lo de'i dpyid zla ra bar chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gi mkhan po gsar bzhugs kyi khri ston rgya chen po gnang ste che shos sgar bar bzhugs gdan 'jags/ lo gsum gyi ring la dge 'dun tshogs pa nyis stong brgal bar chos srid zung 'brel gyi sgo nas legs par bskyangs te/'jam mgon rgyal ba'i bshad sgrub gyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par mdzad/ dgung lo re brgyad pa shing lug lor/lhar bcas 'gro ba'i rnam 'dren phyag na pad+mo gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mchog pe cin nas sku 'bum du chibs bsgyur mdzad par/skyabs rje nyid bsu ba ang gsum pa'i gras su lan gru ru byon/ gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen por gus phyag sngon du 'gro ba'i gser zhal rjen mjal gyi bka' drin thob/ de yang gangs ljongs 'gro 326

ba'i mgon po snying rje'i lha gcig phyag na pad+mo srid par gar du bzlos pa/'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid kyi sprul gzhi gcig las bkyes pa'i rnam 'phrul dwangs pa'i mtsho nang gi zla gzugs bzhin thugs rgyud ngo bo dbyer med du gnas pa'i dan rtags su/ rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung las/ khyed rang bsu ba ang dang po'i gras su mi phebs pa ci yin zhes bka' stsal par khong gis bdag bla chen mi drag gras su mi gtogs par ri khrod pa'i bla ma dkyus ma lta bur gyur rkyen yong ma phod pas dgongs 'gal med par zhu zhes pa dang / gzhan yang thugs nang shin tu gshin pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ de nas rgyal dbang mchog dang lhan du chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling du byon/ lha mi'i rnam 'dren gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas/ gdan sa'i bla sprul khag gtso byas phyogs 'dus kyi bla dpon ser skya drag zhan skye bo pho mo 'bum phrag brgal bar thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / de'i tshe me tog 'phen skabs rgyal dbang mchog gi zhal snga nas/ da ni bla sprul dpon rigs che 'bring chung gsum dang / dad sden ser skya dmangs tshogs yongs kyi tshab tu sku zhabs a rol rin po che gcig pus dkyil 'khor du me tog 'phen rgyu yin pas tshang mas de la gsol ba thobs zhes gsungs te/bla slob yongs kyi tshab tu skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang gcig pu la me tog 'phen par gnang ba ni/ ring nas thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthu btsan pas slad mar gdul bya — 327

mtha' dag gi mgon skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dam pa rdo rje 'chang gcig pur rag las pas de la gsol ba thobs gsungs pas/ don du spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal ba'i dbang bo nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nges so/ /de yang gangs can 'gro ba yongs kyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal snying rje lha gcig spyan ras gzigs dbang mchog rigs dang rigs bdag gi rnam rol du ma'i sgyu 'phrul gyis skad cig kyang g.yo ba med par dus dang rnam pa thams cad du gdul bya'i don 'ba' zhig gi mdzad pa lhur bzhes te lus can mtha' dag thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam du dkri bar mdzad pa ni/ gser 'od dam pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa'i sku/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /bkod pa rnam pa sna tshogs ston/ /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar gdul bya dag pa yi/ /chu yi snod ni thams cad du/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dpag tu med pa cig car 'char/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /skabs der skyabs rje nyid gtso byas te reb gong ri khrod pa dang sprel rdzong dgon pa'i bla sprul 'dus sde bcas nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par brtan bzhugs chen mo phul/ rgyal mchog nyid nas kyang thugs dgyes pa chen pos zhal bzhes gnang ba dang 'brel/ da lta mdo smad phyogs 'dir bsta na 'gro'i bya ba rlabs chen bdag gir bzhes pa ni khyed gcig pur 328

gyur pas phyin chad kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po sgrub pa'i thugs 'gan bla lhag tu bzhes dgos pa sogs kyi bka' slob snying don can mang du stsal/ skabs shig la rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling 'dir chibs bsgyur te gzhung bzang rnam dpyod can dge slong dzam bha la'i grwa shag tu dgun bzhugs gnang bas zhal nas ri khrod dben gnas 'dir spong ba bsam gtan dang klog pa thos bsam 'phel ba'i khyad chos ldan zhes dgyes tshor dpe med mdzad de sgar grong gi dad ldan ser skya mang bor dbang bka' chos dgos 'dod nor gyis re ba'i bang ba bkang bar mdzad/ gdan sa 'dir sa sgrib nyen che bas khong la 'phrin las kyi skyabs bcol pa na/ bdag gir bzhes te phebs bzhud gnang zhing gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi 'khor lo skor dang rim gyis zhi bar 'gyur ro zhes ljags bkod lhu things pa stsal pa ltar sngags dung phyur can gyi 'khor lo bskor pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa la bkra shis rab gnas mdzad/ rting mar ma ring bar sa sgrib kyi nad kyi rgyun chad de sman yon bla na med par gyur/ gzhan yang gsang bdag 'khor chen dang / seng ge sgra/ na ga rak+ka'i lung sogs kyi bka' drin bskyangs/'du khang dang byams khang / mchod rten mthong grol chen mo sogs la rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs mdzad de skya ser kun la las 'bras las brtsams te bslab bya gang 'dod du stsal pa sogs kyi gsung 329

gleng dmar/ der ma zad gnyan khrod chu mig brgya rtsa'i dbu yang gdan sa 'di nas btsugs te tshul ldan dge slong blo bzang zla bas zhal ta ba'i zhabs zhu gang legs bsgrubs pas tshe rabs nas tshe rabs bar du brtse gzigs kyis rjes 'dzin 'bral med kyi zhal bzhes thob/ dgung grangs bdun cu ba me byi lor hang nge'i ri rgan ske 'bum khang thang du lha sdes zhus te bla sprul khag mang po dang / ser skya 'bum phrag brgal bar dus 'khor dbang chen gnang ba'i skabs rje'i zhal nas/ kho bos mi tshe 'di la dus 'khor dbang chen tshar nyer bdun btang zin/ sngon paṇa chen sku gong ma'i bka' lung las/ bdag la khyod kyis rigs ldan nyer lnga'i grangs kyi rten 'brel las dus 'khor dbang chen tshar nyer lnga 'don dgos zhes lung bstan gnang yod kyang / da ni nyer lnga'i grangs las brgal te nyer bdun zin pa rten 'brel bzang / da re dbang nyan par 'ongs pa'i skye bo rnams ma zad/ 'dir 'ongs ma thub kyang sems gting nas nyan 'dod yod pa'i rgan gzhon pho mo byis pa su yin kyang / dbang chen 'di thob nges yin pas khyed rang rnams skal ba bzang / phyin chad 'di lta bu'i skal ba ldan rgyu dka' mo red/ nged kyis mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel thogs pa'i skye bo mtho dman bar gsum thams cad ma 'ongs par byang phyogs sham+bha lar rigs ldan 'khor gyi thog mar 'gyur ba'i smon lam btab yod/ khyod tsho la dad pa'i a long brtan po yod na 'dren pa'i 3ni0

lcags kyus mi bslu ba dkon mchog gi bden stobs dang rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin/ zhes dgongs gzhi can gyi zhal gsung mang du thos so/ /da ni mdor bsdus na/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid rgyal ba thams cad kyi brtse ba'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dang tha mi dad pas/ ring mo zhig nas rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mngon du byas zin kyang / skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams rim gyis bkri ba'i ched du rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la gsar du slob pa'i legs mdzad lhur bzhes pa ste/ de yang rje btsun mi pham mgon pos/ 'di na dang bo thos pa la brten tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa las ni yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo dang / rje zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sogs mkhas grub dam pa mang bo'i zhabs pad bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin bsten te/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dgongs 'grel bka' pod chen po lnga dang gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag bcas dang / dbang lung rjes gnang man ngag la sogs da skabs gangs ri'i khrod na bzhugs pa phal cher gus rtag brtson 'grus lhod pa med pas gsan sbyong mthil phyin gnang ba'i zhor la sgra snyan sman rtsis sogs thun mong gi rig gnas la'ang sbyang ba rgya cher gnang / de yang rang bzhin gyi 331

sbyang ba tsamyo/ ma yin par thos don gdams ngag tu shar ba'i nges shes kyis nang byan chud pa byung ste thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin la/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten ni tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la rag las par dgongs nas sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams mtha' dag dran shes bsnyel ba med par rtag tu bsrungs te pham lhag dang rtsa ltung gi nyes pas gzhar yang ma gos par mdzad cing / dus kyi dbang gis nyes byas phra mo re byung na yang rang rang gi gzhung nas gsungs pa'i phyir bcos kyi cho gas dag par mdzad de ltung ba dang zhag tu mi 'grog par gnang bas gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po skur bzhengs pa legs shing / bla ma'i rnal 'byor srog tu byas te lam yongs rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'grus par mdzad pas nges 'byung dang byang sems lta ba rnam par dag pa sogs thugs rgyud la ji bzhin 'khrungs shing / zhi gnas dang de kho na nyid la dmigs pa'i lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin brtan po brnyes pa dang / gang snang lha'i 'khor lo'i rnam rol tu shin tu gsal ba'i skyed rim gyi rnal 'byor shin sbyangs khyad par can gyi bde bas zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dben pa gsum dang bden pa gnyis kyi grol lam phyin ci ma log pa zla nyi'i rgyu pa rnyu tīr zhugs gnas thum gsum byas pa las byung ba'i 'di dga' bzhi'i ye shes mnyam bzhag pa dang / de las langs pa'i rjes thob gang snang stong ba dang / stong ba bde ba/ bde ba lhan skyes 332

kyi bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje 'chang gi rnam rol tu 'char ba'i nyams rtogs khyad par can mnga' brnyes pa ste mdor na lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa ji lta ba bzhin thugs rgyud la mnga' ba yin la/ de ltar yon tan gyi mdzod du gyur nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i tshul la/ 'chad pa'i yon tan gyi dbang du byas na/ dbang lung rjes gnang khrid zhal lung bklag lung nyams khrid sogs chos bka' go/nga gnang ba'i tshe na yang / shes byed kyi lung / mtha' gcod kyi rigs pa/gsal byed kyi dpe dang bcas pa'i sgo nas blo mchog dman kun la rang rang gi blo tshod dang bstun pa'i go rgyu che zhing / gdul bya'i blo sna chos phyogs su bsgyur ba gtsor 'don sgos/skyon dang bral ba 'ba' zhig dang /brgyud ldan dam pa'i phyag bzhes cung zad kyang ma nyams par spel bar mdzad cing / de la brten nas mdo smad lho byang gi char 'khod pa'i grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma sprul sku yod tshad dang / bka' rab 'byams smra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dus thog der byon pa phal cher zhal slob tu ma gyur pa med pa lta bur snang bas de dag gi mtshan re re bzhin zhib tu 'god mi nus so/ /rtsod pa'i yon tan ni/ rje chos kyi nyi mas/ sgrub dang sun 'byin zlog par dka' ba'i mda'/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i rtsal kyis 'phangs pa yis/ /phas rgol sbyin skyes spobs pa'i grogs bcom ste/ /thub bstan gangs ri 'dzin pa khyod gcig nyid/ /ces gsungs pa 333

ltar rje 'dis rang nyid rgyal ba dang gzhan pham par 'dod pa'i kun slong ngan pa thams cad ring du dor nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang / the tshom gyi dri ma sel ba'i ched 'ba' zhig tu dmigs te/ 'brel zla sgrub pa/ 'gal zla 'ango/ga pa/mtshungs zla bsgre ba sogs rtsod pa'i yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas ca/ti mug gi dra ba gcod pa ral gri'i 'khor lo lta bu dang / sun 'byin rlung gis mi g.yo ba lhun po lta bu/tshig don la mi rmongs pa thub pa'i sras ltar rtsod pa gnang ba yin la/dbang lung khrid sogs kyi caskabs su gsung bshad gang gnang thams cad rtog ge ba dag gis ji ltar dpyad kyang skyon gyi rnam pa phra mo tsam yang mi rnyed pa rtsod pa'i yon tan yin no/ /rtsom pa'i yon tan ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa sogs rtsom pa'i rgyu ma tshang pa med par 'dzoms pas mdo rgyud gang dag gi dgongs 'grel mdzad dgos na'ang chags thogs mi mnga' mod/ sngon byon mkhas grub dam pa'i bka' 'bum ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa dag rdul khrod na 'o rgyal bar gzigs nas gsung rtsom phon che ba ma gnang la/ 'on kyang lam rim sogs 'ga' bzhugs pa ni dam pa'i man ngag gis brgyan cing /nyams myong gi gsung legs gshis gsung rab mtha' dag gi brjod bya'i kand 'dus shing / gdul bya'i rgyud 'khul tshabs che ba sogs khyad chos bsam brjod las 'das pa dang /gsung mgur dang dam pa'i gsol 334

'debs sogs tho ra bu du ma bzhugs pa yab don gyi gnad dang tshig gi nyams sogs cha gang nas kyang 'gran zla bral bas mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog cing / bstan pa rin po che'i mdzes rgyan du gyur pa 'ba' zhig yin no/ /gzhan yang rgyal bstan spyi dang / khyad par mnyam med tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs kyi rgyal mtshan yu ba phyag tu bsnams pa'i khur chen nyid gcig pus bdag gir bzhes shing / mdo smad lho byang gi yul gru mang por zhabs pad bkod de dus 'khor dbang chen tshar nyer bdun gnang ba sogs chos bka' rgya cher spel te mdzad 'phrin mkha' khyab tu spro ba'i sgo nas gdul bya ma smin pa smin/ smin pa grol/ grol ba mthar phyin par mdzad pa dang / mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel tshad don ldan gnang ba'i tshul shin tu mang la/ de dag gi stobs kyis ljongs 'di'i dregs ldan che dgu sogs drag zhan bar ma thams cad kyis gus pas btud cing mchod pa la brtson pa'i sgo nas gcig chog gtan gyi skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa yin no/ /der ma zad dgon sde ris med thams cad la mchod bkur bsnyen gsum yang yang gnang ba dang / dbul phongs la sbyin gtong gnang ba dang / rang dgon thos bsam dar rgyas gling gsar 'debs dang / 'du khang chen mo sogs rten brten pa mtha' yas pa gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rgya cher spel ba sogs chos srid zung gis bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po gnang ba yin no/ /mgon po 335

gang gi mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi sogs rgyal ba'i sras kyi mdzad bzang la bslabs pa'i tshul las brtsams te rgya cher spros na brjod rgyu'i phongs pa mi 'dug kyang 'dir sa bcad ma stongs tsam du cung zad bris pa'o//yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag spyang lung khri rgan 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho ni/ gser ljongs mgon shul sgar ba'i rje'u rigs las rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me stag la sku bltams/ rje a rol rje btsun blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho las rab tu byung zhing / dgung lo bcu bdun par byang chub kyi sems thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ rje de nyid las bka' chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bco brgyad par ma cig zhi drag gi byin rlabs gsan te chu mig brgya rtsa 'grims pa nas gcod kyi nyams len nyin re bzhin 'bad/ dgung lo bco lnga'i steng nas bzung ste rten bzhengs sogs las kyi 'khor lo'i 'go brtsams/ rong bo'i gzim khang dang / rdo rje rdzong dgon pa gsar bskrun mdzad pa'i rten brten pa'i gtsug lag khang / chos 'brel zab pa'i dgon sde so sor rje sku dang sgrol sku sogs sku brnyan mi tshad las brgal ba brgya phrag tsam dang / bris thang nyis brgyar nye ba/ phyag dpe glegs bam pod nyis stong tsam gsar du ba'e/ngas / a rol blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar gyi par gsar 336

bskrun dang / da dung sku gsung thugs rten/ gzhan yang bzhengs bkod mang ngo / /chung dus nas bzung tshogs bsags rgya chen gnang bas yon chab bye ba dang / mar me lnga 'bum/ yi dam gyi zhi rgyas dbang gi sbyin sreg nyis brgyar nye ba/ 'jigs byed bcu cha chen mo tshad ldan/ gzhan yang tshogs mchod dang / drug cu ba sogs yi dam chos skyong la mchod pa rgyun mi chad pa dang / gdan sa'i grwa tshang rnams kyi mkhan khri rim bgrod kyis bskyangs pa'i rgyu song rags rim la yang dngul srang 'bum phrag lhag song na yang zhal bzhugs dus tshul de dag gtan nas mi gsung ngo / /skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgya mtshan dang mkhan chen dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ a rol blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho/zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta/ grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan sogs man ngag bang mdzod 'dzin pa'i sems dpa' so bdun gyi zhabs pad bsten te mdo rgyud chos kyi gter chen por gyur/ sdom pa gsum gyi bcos mtshams las nam yang cung zad kyang 'da' ba med pa 'phags pa nye bar 'khor las dpe len sa med tshod du grags 'dug zhal 'don ljags bzlas gnang ba mtha' dag kyang gzhan dag sku tshe gang la mi nus pa'i rnam thar sha stag yin/ mdzad 'phrin thams cad bstan 'gro'i don la dmigs pa'i tshul rnam thar du gsal ba ltar ro/ /dgung lo bcu gcig nas bzung ste nyer brgyad bar tshogs chos grwar hur thag gis 'grim ste bka' pod 337

rnams la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin du mdzad kyang / de tsam gyis kyang ma tshims par yongs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs su rnyiḥ 'i zhabs nas kyang gsan pa sogs brjod kyis mi lang / chos 'chad nyan la phyag rjes rlabs chen mdzad yod cing / tshul der ha cang thugs khur mdzad pas yongs 'dzin bka' drin can la zhal chems kyi tha mar yang grwa tshang rin po che thugs la bsnam dgos/ skyabs mgon sku dbang rgyas na grwa tshang gral rnga na skya log ger gtong rgyu zhe la bcug nas grwa ba byed mkhan rnams mtshams gcod rgyu dang / slob gnyer bsdus grwa nas gso rgyu/ tha na yig chod kyang nyams song bas 'dzin skyong gang drag mdzad dgos/ tshogs pa mang mi dgos/sngar dge 'dun pa lnga brgya zer/ de tshe skyabs mgon mchog la snyan gnon dgos zhes sogs mang bo zhib rgyas dang / skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po sku dngos la yang / bsdus grwa dang tshad ma la hur thag mdzad nas rigs pa'i dbang phyug tu bzheng rgyu dang / rang nyid rigs pa'i dbang phyug tu bzhengs nas kyang grwa tshang la'ang bsdus grwa nas nyams pa gso rgyu sogs zhal gdams zhib rgyas su stsal/ mkhas grub dam pa mang po'i zhabs pad nas rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dbang bka'/ man ngag rim gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa/ rgyud sde dgongs 'grel dang babs pa'i khrid/ bshad lung / rtsal bshad/ gleng 'phros ci rigs mdzad pa la brten nas sngags phyogs kyi bshad pa rdzogs/ tha na tha snyad rig pa'i gnas la'ang / rong 338

dgon blo bzang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho dang / dus zhabs pa mtsho byung dgyes pa'i dpal las sum rtags dang / phyi ma las sgra dbyangs can ma sbyangs/lus bzo bri thig 'bud rdung dang / ngag bzo rta 'dur dbyangs gsum/yid bzo thos bsam sgom gsum 'di mi mkhyen bya ba med cing / gsung tshangs dbyangs la 'gran pa dang / phyag bris mgyogs dag nyis 'dzoms kyi tshad du byed/ gso rig la rang gi mkhyen rab kyis zhib sbyangs mdzad nas sman sbyin gyis 'gro phan sman pa chen po dag las che ba byung ba byang chub kyi sems kyi rang stobs su grags/gsung rtsom thad snyan ngag gi nyams dang ldan pa'i shugs 'byung gi bka' rtsom mdzad mkhan zhig la 'di nyid ngo mtshar ba zhig yin/ phyag bris la shar gyis btab pa phyir bcos dag zhu gang yang mi dgos shing /drung yig pas bris na gsung gi rjes su mi chod pa yin/ de yang / sngar sbyangs pas ma tshims par rjes sor yongs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs blo bzang dpal ba'i mdun nas 'grel bshad chen mo rnams dang bsdur te snyan ngag gi dpe brjod tshad ldan dag mig tu byas te sbyangs pa la mngon brjod rnams de dag gi bshad pa'i gzhung la ma brten par thugs su chud/ de dag la brten nas rkirti rin po ches kyang bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad do/ /nang don rig pa'i thad la/ dgung lo brgyad kyi dus skyabs rje a rol rin po che'i mdun nas lam khrid gsan pa nas bzung snga phyir lam rim gyi bshad pa tshar nyi shu lhag dang / spyi bka'i 339

dbang chen gnyis/ rjes gnang stong rtsa/ bka' bstan dang gsung 'bum lnga bcu lhag dang / chos skor dang las tshogs be'u bum skor lnga bcu lhag sogs glegs bam stong phrag zin to/ /gsung mgur las kyang /rin thang che ba gser gyi khres po zhig khur nas/ /rta rmig lcags kyis btums te rgyal khams kun bskor kyang / /rnyed dka'i zab chos dbang khrid lung gsum kyi bdud rtsi/ /rgya che grangs mang thob 'di skal ba re bzang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / /thos tshad dpyad 'jog gis dben par nyams su bzhes te rtogs pa klong du gyur pa yin no/ /de yang zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta'i mdun nas sgrub pa mthar thon gyi dam bca' mdzad pa nas dkar bo gshong bkra shis chos rdzong / dar zhing / bla ma'i bzhugs gnas bkra shis chos rdzong / sman tshong bde chen/ tsha rgyal thar ba gling /bkra shis 'khyil/ rdo rje rdzong sogs su lo khyud mang por thun mong dang thun min gyi ting 'dzin rol bas yi dam gyi zhal dngos su bstan te phyis 'byung lung bstan mang bo dngos su gsungs pa rnam thar du cung gsal lo/ /dgung lo nyer lnga bar lcang skya'i nags zhis su 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gzigs shing gzungs sngags ljags bzlas mdzad pa yang sku tshe smad kho nas ma ṇi lta bu'i grangs kyi tshad du phab na dung phyur nyi shu'i tshod tsam song zhes rnam thar du gsungs/ da dung 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang gang blo ma re re nas 'bum tshar dang / lam rim chen mo brgya lhag340

bdag 'jug khrir nye ba/gzhan yang sngags rim dang smon lam sogs cho ga rgyas bsdus rnams kyi grangs bgrang mi nus so/ /gsung rtsom yang sdom gsum chen mo sogs pod 'ga' par du 'khod pa dang / da dung ma 'khod pa yang yod la/gsan yig chen mo pod gsum brgal ba bzhugs so/ /rang nyid kyis gang dag gsan pa mtha' dag lan gcig ma yin par yang nas yang du gdul bya la legs par bstan pa'i dbang lung rjes gsum gyi chos tshan 'bum phrag tsam dang / khrid bshad lung sogs rgyas bsdus zhib tu bsams na bsam brjod las 'das so/ /de phyir gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob kyang / nang thugs kyi sras gcig 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po dpal thams cad mkhyen pa kun gzigs 'jigs med paṇ+ḍi ta/ rong ston chos kyi dbang phyug bla na ma mchis pa gong sa phyag na pad mo thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po skyabs mchog bdun pa skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal/ a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ lā kha tā le ho thog thu blo bzang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ gong sa'i yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan sogs rje 'di'i bla slob gnyis kar gtogs pa'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag phyed dang gnyis tsam dang / rong bo'i gdan sa chen po dgon ma lag dang bcas pa nas rgya nag gong ma chen po'i bka'i 341

lung gis mtho ba'i dbang du byas na kyil thu khan er te mong ge dpal dar no mon han mtshan sgrog ho thog thu 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i nye sras kyi dbang du byas na sras kyi thu bo dpal chos mkhan sprul blo bzang lung rtogs chos kyi rgya mtsho/ nang thugs kyi sras gcig ma ṇi ba shes rab bkra shis kyi skye rgyud 'dzin pa rdzong dkar che ba blo bzang bkra shis chos 'phel rgya mtsho rnam gnyis/ bse khri rgan sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bkra shis 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ g.yer gshong sprul ba'i sku nga ga dbang bstan 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho sogs dang / rong bo thos bsam gling la bka' drin che ba'i dbang du byas na dpal chos mkhan po/ rgyal mkhan chen/ tsho 'du mkhan chen te mkhan chen rnam gsum dang / rong bo khri rgan rnams che ba'i che ba lags stabs rgyal mkhan sprul blo bzang tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma/ tsho 'du mkhan sprul blo bzang chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang / de'i yang sprul 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ rong bo khri rgan sprul sku dge 'dun lung rtogs rgya mtsho dang / bgrangs zin mtshan sgrogs mekhan chen/ don gling mkhan chen rnams kyi steng byang rtse mkhan sprul gong ma blo bzang dge legs rgya mtsho dang de'i sprul sku 'jam dbyangs mkhas btsun rgya mtsho/ 'dan chos 'khor mkhan sprul blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ yer ba mkhan sprul blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ste mkhan chen rnam pa brgyad dang / de'i 'og 3 42

nas che ba la/ skyabs mgon sku phreng gis yongs 'dzin du bkur ba rnams bgrang 'os pas/ gong smras dpal chos mkhan chen/ tsho 'du mkhan chen/don gling mkhan chen/ rdzong dkar sku zhabs/ g.yer gshong mchog sprul rnams skyabs mgon sku phreng gang rigs kyis yongs 'dzin du bkur ba'i dam pa dag gi skye rgyud yin zhing / skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i yongs 'dzin mdzad pa byang rtse rigs pa'i dbang phyug dge 'dun rgya mtsho rnams rje 'di'i bka' slob ste phyi ma 'di yongs grags dam pa'i skye sprul gyi gras min yang gong zhabs mchog gi che ba dang bstun nas 'dir bgrangs so/ /yi dam gyis lung bstan pa'i che ba'i dbang du byas na skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa/ a rol sku zhabs chen mo/ rong chen kirti'i mchog sprul/ 'jam mgon blo bzang dpal ba sogs sras kyi thu bo 'gran zla dang bral bar mchog dman kun gyis shes dgos te/ yi dam gyi lung las/mchog bzhi la sogs mchod pa'i rten/ /sku dkar gsol na rang 'od 'tsher/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang bis pa sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs don yod rgya mtsho/ sman tshong bde chen sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ stag ge sprul sku blo bzang bkra shis rgya mtsho/kha so sbrul ba'i sku blo bzang chos 'byor rgya mtsho/ brag dkar sngags rams pa'i sprul sku/ nang so'i sku skyes yang sprul blo bzang 'phrin las rgyal mtshan/ sgo dmar sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ stag lung 343

grub sprul ngag dbang chos rgya mtsho/ rong dgon sprul ba'i sku/ sku dbon mergan chos rje sku phreng snga phyi/ rong bo dbon sprul/ g.yu rngog dbon sprul/rong dgon dbon sprul/ drung yig dbon sprul/ brag dkar dbon sprul/'dam bu brag dkar sogs re skong khul gyi bla sprul phal che ba dang /phyogs nas bka' slob tu 'dus pa la 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i sras kyi thu bo bstan pa'i dar chen phyogs mthar skyod pa brgyad kyi nang nas 'gran zla dang bral ba lho rgyud bstan pa'i sgron me rong chen kirti rin po che sku phreng dgu ba skal bzang blo gros kun dga' lung rtogs rgya mtsho dang / sku phreng bcu ba ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa tshe ring dpal bzang po/ de nyid kyi yongs 'dzin klu sgrub sprul pa'i sku sogs lha mo nyin srib kyi bla sprul dang / thu med gser khri sprul ba'i sku bstan pa rab rgyas/gtsang chung ba blo bzang mkhas btsun rgya mtsho sogs kyi skye sprul dang /mkhas dgu'i gtsug rgyan tshe tan zhabs drung 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros dpal bzang po dang / ko'u ba dbon sprul blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho/ kho tshe sprul ba'i sku dge 'dun bstan pa phun tshogs sogs rma lho byang gi yul thag ring bo nas 'dus pa dang / chu dmar sgom sprul/'ga' dwags sprul sku sogs bis mdo dang tsho lnga phyogs nas byon pa bcas dge ldan rang bstan 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dpag tu med pa dang / ljongs 'di'i phur thogs stong gi bdag po khyung dgon sprul ba'i sku blo bzang 344

legs bshad nyi ma/ zhabs dkar sprul ba'i sku/ chu cha rig 'dzin sprul ba'i sku dri med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rig sngags 'chang ba'i skye rgyud pa mang bo dang / rdzi rgya'i lha rams pa dge bshes ma khyab ces zhu ba dge 'dun grags pa/ bra bo rab 'byams pa bstan 'dzin rab rgyas sogs tshe blos btang gis sgrub pa snying bor byed pa'i drang srong mang bo dang / 'bras har chen lha rams pa ye shes dngos grub/ blo gling lha mo'i mkhan zur blo bzang dam chos/ rong bo dge bshes a rol yongs 'dzin blo bzang dar rgyas/ bla brang rdo rams pa dpa' ris blo bzang chos 'phel/ gtsang brtsi bzhag blo bzang bstan 'phel sogs rigs pa'i dbang phyug seng chen srab med du 'phyo ba lta bu mang bo dang / kirti'i drung chen blo bzang sangs rgyas/ gzu lung drung chen blo bzang dge 'dun sogs lnga rig nor bu'i phreng ba mgrin pa'i rgyan du 'dzin pa'i rig gnas pa mang bo dang / gser ljongs yangs pa'i lha btsun chen po 'jigs med dbang phyug stobs rgyas sogs rong bo'i che chen nang so gsar rnying / skyabs mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar 'dzin pa sku dbon jog rug thu nang so dge legs rgya mtsho/ngo mo'i phyag mdzod blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs shar bla brang chen mo'i mdzod pa mkhan chen snga phyi rnams dang / hor gter ston che chung / rong bo'i a 'phar sku skyes/ ko chen rig 'dzin pad+ma thugs mchog rdo rje sogs sngags 345

'chang phur thogs mang po dang / rmi rgyal bo mgon po bsod nams yum sras/ mkhar dgu'i nga ro chen po bsod nams bstan 'dzin sogs phyogs yas mas kyi dregs ldan mang bo dang / mgon shul tsho chen bcus mtshon pa'i dad gtong dpal 'byor gyis mtho ba'i sbyin bdag pho mo sogs rang gzhan thams cad nas gsung gi bdud rtsi la spyod pa dang / rje 'di'i bslab pa'i chu lon brtan par mdzad pa'i mkhan bu sdom brtson ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ches mang bo yod kyang rnam thar du zhib 'khod ma byung bas sdom kyi sdud ma nus shing / de dag thams cad la rang rang gi blo kha dang 'tsham par lam yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len dang gzhung chen mo la thos bsam dang / lam rim blo sbyong dang rig gnas la sbyong ba sogs gdul bya lam la bkri ba'i thabs mkhas dang ldan pa ljongs 'dir sngon ma byung ba lta bu'i mdzad bzang rgya che la/ mdor na mdo khams smad 'dir dus rabs gcig na ston pa 'khor bcas 'jig rten la byon pa lta bu'i rgyal bstan dbu 'phang dgung la reg pa byung ba mtha' dag gi gzhi rtsa khong la thug pa'i tshul nges par shes dgos pa'i gnad du che bas/ rjes 'jug dag kyang rje 'di'i thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i rnam thar skal bzang rna cha zung la mjal bar zhu/ da dung zur zhu cung zad ni/ dgung lo nyer dgu bar gser khri chen mor phebs te 'chad nyan slob gnyer la gsung skul gang drag gnang zhing zhabs tog phun tshogs bsgrubs te chos 346

kyi bya ba yar ldan du spel/ lhag par du gling rgya'i lha rams pa blo bzang chos grags dang / rdzi rgya'i lha rams pa dge 'dun grags pa/ sdong skam lha rams pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs kyis 'dzin grwa gong 'og tu bka' pod kyi dpe khrid gnang zhing / rje 'di khri lo gnyis pa'i dus mkhas pa'i dbang bo grwa skor ba dpa' ris rab gsal phebs pa sogs rje 'di'i thugs bskyed kyis rtsod grwa ha cang gong du 'phel zhing nyid nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par bskor ba sogs kyis phyogs kun nas yid smon byed par grags so/ /dgung lo so brgyad par gsang chen rgyud pa grwa tshang gi khrir phebs te chos dang zang zing gnyis char nas dge 'dun rnams kyi blo tshim par mdzad pa dang / skabs der chos sde 'dir brtse gzigs kyis chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te ser skya yongs kyi 'dod mos bzhin dgos chos mang du bstsal/ phyag dbang gnang nas bcar bzhugs mdzad/'du khang nang gi kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku brnyan mi tshad las brgal ba la gzungs sgrub dang gzungs 'bul rnams phyag bstar mdzad de rab gnas dang shis brjod mdzad/ 'di'i dkar chag kyang rtsom gnang mdzad/ thugs ha cang dgyes tshor gyis dgun thog gcig la bsnyen mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs te thabs mkhas mdzad bzang 'phrul gyis skye dgu'i yid kyi re 'dod tshims par mdzad/ skabs de'i kun rig gi dkar chag ni 'di ltar/347

༄༅//sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan gyi dkar chag nor bu'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rmad byung blo gros bzang bo'i dkyil 'khor las/ /rmad byung 'gan las 'od rlabs 'bum spros te/ /rmad byung bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ /rmad byung dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon des skyongs/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis zab yangs chu gter snying stobs ri bos bsrubs pa las/ /legs 'khrungs bla med spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shing / /kun bzang 'phrin las 'od snang 'bum phrag sdug kun mun pa'i dgrar gyur pa/ /ngan song kun sbyong thams cad rig pa pad+ma'i gnyen des shis pas srungs/ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren bu ram shing ba yi/ /mgrin pa chos dung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgras/ /mi bzad ngan song rgyu 'bras sbyong ba la/ /cher bsngags lhag pa'i lha mchog 'di rmad byung / /'gro la rjes chags snying rje'i sgyu 'phrul las/ /gang 'dul sprul ba'i rol gar bye ba brgyas/ /'gro kun srid zhi'i 'jigs chen las sgrol ba'i/ /byin rlabs thugs rje mkha' bzhin pha mtha' yas/ /de phyir mgon de'i snang brnyan byin rlabs kyi/ /gzi 'od rab 'bar mig gi bdud rtsi'i spun/ /rmad byung ring bsrel rnam bzhis legs gtams pa'i/ /dkar chag nor bu'i sgron me 'di na 'god/ /ces yul khyad par can la phyag 'tshal zhing shis pa brjod pa dang / dngos po nges bstan gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyi 348

nga ros mdun bsus te gang gleng bar bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ 'gro 'di'i sdug bsngal mi bzad 'bar ba'i me/ /rab bsil 'phrin las gaṅgā'i chu rgyun gyis/ /gzhil mdzad bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad ces/ /grags pa'i rol mos srid zhi'i zhing kun khyab/ /ces bsngags pa ltar/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lus sems gdung bar byed pa'i sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi me dpung ma lus pa/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las gaṅgā'i klung rgyun bzhin chad pa med par 'bab pas zhi bar byed pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad ces mtshan mchog lha'i rol mo srid pa dang zhi ba'i zhing kun khyab par yongs su grags pa gang de'i sku brnyan gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag 'god pa la gsum/ thog mar bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus/ bar du nang rten gyi rim pa/ mjug tu phyag mchod sogs kyi phan yon bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ sngon byon gyi skyes bu dam pa tshad ldan du mas yul nyer bzhi'i nang tshan du yang dang yang du bsngags pa/ lha rnams dkar phyogs skyong zhing / mi rnams chos la dad pa/ sa la dge bcu tshang ba'i yul reb gong gser ljongs kyi sa'i thig ler 'khod pa'i bshad sgrub kyi sde mang du bzhugs pa'i nang tshan/ rnam dkar chos spyod bcu dang / bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa rin 349

po che dri ma med pa 'di nyid 'dzin cing spel bar byed pa'i khrims ldan dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyis rtag tu bsten pa'i sgrub pa'i sde chen po 'dus bzang chos gling zhes yongs su grags pa'i 'du khang gi rten gyi gtso bo dang / pha mas thog drangs pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sgrib sbyong dang / tshe rabs kyi phreng ba kun tu bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i sprul ba'i rol pa du mas rjes su bzung ste thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched kho nar dmigs te/dad pa dang gtong ba sogs 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi rgyan dang ldan pa'i dge slo nga bstan pas dngul srang brgya lhag gis cha rkyen gang dgos thams cad legs par sbyar nas/ lha bzo mkhas pa'i sor mo'i 'du byed kyis nye bar bskrun pa'i sku brnyan gsar bzhengs grangs gser ljib thum dang tshon sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas shing / skal bzang gdul bya bye ba'i tshogs kyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa 'di nyid legs par bsgrubs pa'i gzungs gzhug tu/ dbu gzungs/ mgrin gzungs/ stod gzungs/bar gzugs/ smad gzungs/ pad gzungs sogs chos sku'i ring bsrel gtso bor gyur pas legs par bkang ste rab tu gnas pa dang shis pa brjod pa'i me tog gi char chen po yang yang phab ste byin rlabs kyi gter du bsgrubs par mdzad do//350

gnyis pa ni/ spyir rgyud sde spyi rnam las ring bsrel rnam pa gsum du gsungs kyang / da lta yongs su grags pa mdo rgyud kyi glegs bam dang gzungs sngags sogs chos sku'i ring bsrel/ 'phel gdung sogs yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/ gdung rus sogs sku gdung gi ring bsrel/ bla ma lha'i sku gzugs dang skyes bu dam pa'i na bza' dbu lo sogs sku bal gyi ring bsrel te bzhi yod pa las/ thog mar nang rten gyi gtso bor gal che bar yang dang yang du bsngags pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel gyi skor la gzungs gzhug rgyas pa cha tshang / yab rje rdo rje 'chang blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhal 'don gyi glegs bam byin can/ g.yu rngog khri rgan sku phreng gsum pa rje btsun rin chen rdo rje'i zhal 'don bde mchog rtsa rgyud dpe 'di'i steng nas khri 'don gcig gnang ba'i byin can/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud yongs rdzogs/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ rnal 'byor ma chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal bo bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtsa rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang / bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa rnams tshar gnyis re/gsang 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud yongs rdzogs/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing mdo tshar gnyis/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo 'am ting nge 'dzin/ brgyad stong pa/bskal bzang / so thar gyi mdo rgyas pa/ tshe mdo/ spyod 'jug chen mo/dbu ma 'jug pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ byang chub lam sgron/ lam rim 351

smon lam/ bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi cho ga mgon po/ chos rgyal/lha mo/ rnam sras/ gser zhun ma rnams kyi gtor chog smon lam rnam lnga/kun rig gi rtsa rig 'bum gcig snying bo 'bum gcig yig brgya dang thugs rje chen po'i gzungs ring / bstan 'bar ma/ rig byed ma'i don kun grub pa'i 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo bzhi brgya/ nor lha sna tshogs kyi gzungs mang bo bcas bzhugs so/ /yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel ni/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung gcig dang / yang 'phel gdung 'khrul med gnyis/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'phel gdung brgya dang lnga bcu lhag dang gzhan yang byin rten sna tshogs dkar chag zur gsal ltar gyi rten 'dus ril bu byin can mang bo dang / sku gdung dang / sku bal gyi ring bsrel ni/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i dbu lo'i cha shas/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i snam sbyar/ dbu lo/ 'a/nga na bza'/ rje'i gsol dkar nang gi 'bras/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi dbu zhwa/ na bza'/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi dbu zhwa/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku chos/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku chos/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i sku gzan dang dbu zhwa/ yang na bza'/ rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa dang sku 'gag zhabs phyags/rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sku gzan/ rgyal ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku 352

'gag rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ yang skyabs mgon rin po che'i na bza'/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi bzhugs gding /dbu zhwa/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi sku chos bzhugs gding / paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi dbu zhwa dang / dbu lo/ sku sham/ sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs phyags/ rje drung dkon mchog nyi ma'i sku 'gag rgyal sras blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi dbu zhwa/rgyal sras skal bzang thub bstan gyi dbu zhwa/ chab mdo 'phags pa lha'i zhabs phyags/ phur lcog ngag dbang byams pa'i dbu zhwa/ dka' chen yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dbu zhwa/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi sku 'gag khri ngag dbang snyan grags kyi dbu zhwa/ khri ngag dbang chos 'phel gyi sku lcug rje btsun chos pa rin po che'i dbu dom dang bzhugs gding / grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sku chos/ rje ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag rje dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi dbu zhwa/ rje blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag rdo rje 'chang blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i na bza'/dbu lo bubs/ stong skor mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje sku gzan/ lcang skya ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi na bza'/mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ dbu zhwa/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i na bza' dang / sku sha'i rten 'dam ril bu/353

khri sprul blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i na bza'/ khri chen blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ khri blo bzang rgyal mtshan seṅge'i pa 'gagarje gser khang ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sku gzan/ yang na bza'/ rdo rje 'chang blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i sku gzan/ phyag mdzub kyi shubs/ de'i mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi na bza' dang / dbu lo bubs/ thar shul dge 'dun chos skyong rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ mu to tshang gi gdung rus/ rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jigs med bsam gtan dpal bzang bo'i sku gzan/ yab rje zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ dbu lo/ phyag nas/ shing bza' rdo rje 'chang blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug tshul khrims phun tshogs dpal bzang po'i sku 'gagarta tshag yongs 'dzin zung cu'i dge 'dun tshang gi zhal 'don gyi dpe thum/skyabs rje kirti rdo rje 'chang blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag dbu zhwa bcas kyi tshal bu/ gung ru mkha' 'gro ma'i dbu zhwa'i tshal bu/ bis pa rin po che sku phreng bzhi'i na bza'/ dga' ldan dam can chos rgyal bar snang ma'i na bza'/ gong ma to kung rgyal bo'i na bza'/yang rje yab sras dang / rgyal ba yab sras sogs dbus gtsang mdo smad sogs kyi bla ma skyes bu dam pa mang po'i na bza' sna tshogs kyi cha shas dang /rong bo'i smon lam chen mo'i skabs su rten mjal gtong bzhin pa'i byin 354

rten du ma/ gong sa bla brang chen mor bzhugs pa rnams kyi cha shas 'khrul med re rnams legs par bzhugs so//sku bal gyi ring bsrel du gtogs pa sku brnyan gyi skor la/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po smri ti'i phyag tsha ston pa'i sku byin can gnyis/ rje btsun byams pa'i sku brnyan mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag tsha 'khrul med gcig dga' ldan khri rin po che grags pa don grub kyi phyag tsha thub pa'i sku gcig paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag tsha rje sku dang 'jam dbyangs kyi sku gcig skyabs mgon thub bstan rgya mtsho'i phyag tsha thub pa'i sku gcigayab rje zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang gi phyag tsha rje'i sku gnyis/ skyabs rje mchog sprul rdo rje 'chang blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi phyag tshwa rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi sku gcig 'jam dbyangs kyi sku gnyis/ sgrol ma'i sku gcig mi 'khrugs pa'i sku gnyis/ mkha' spyod ma'i sku gcig rnams dang / gzhan yang dzam ser gyi sku gcig shog par gyi skor la/ rje rin po che/ gsang 'dus/ kun rig thugs rje chen po/tshe lha rnam gsum/ ston pa/ 'od dpag med sogs kyi shog thang gang mang dang / yang kun rig gi sku shog par ma 'bum gter gcig bcas bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs kyang mang du bzhugs/ yang byin rten gzhan gyi skor la/ ri bo bya rkang du dgra bcom pa 'od srungs kyi phyag rten btsugs pa las skyes pa'i tsan dan gyi cha shas/ rgyal ba rin po che nas gnang ba'i 355

shes rab 'phel byed kyi khab/ skyabs mgon shar thams cad mkhyen pa nas gnang ba'i byin rten ril bu sna tshogs/ sa skya paṇa chen gyi phyag nas 'ongs pa'i rten 'dus/ rtse'i rten 'dus ril bu/ sgrol dkar snying bo dung phyur gyis bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril byin can/ rigs gsum mgon po'i snying bo dung phyur dang / dmigs brtse ma dung phyur gcig dang sa ya lhagayig brgya sa ya/ tshe gzungs bye ba sogs 'gro nges kyis bsgrubs pa'i dge ldan ril bu khyad 'phags lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag nas 'ongs pa byin can/ bka' 'gyur gnas sgo nas thon pa'i rin chen bye ma sogs rten khungs btsun mtha' yas pa bzhugs so// gsum pa ni/ de ltar ring bsrel rnam pa bzhis phyur bur gtams pa'i bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i sku gzugs byin rlabs kyi gter tu gyur pa 'di nyid kyis mtshon pa'i rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la phyag mchod skor ba sogs byas pa'i phan yon rgyas par dam pa gong ma'i gsungs las 'byung ba ltar la/ mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'god na/spyir 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyis byed pas thos bsam sgom gsum sogs dge ba gang dang gang la 'jug kyang thog mar kun slong bzang po zhig gal che ste/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ sgom rnams kun gyi dang bo'i 'go /rgya gar skad mtshungs rang rgyud la/ /legs par brtag pa yin no zhes/ /zla med bla 356

ma mchog de bzhed/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar rang rgyud la legs par brtags te kun slong ngan pa rnams dor nas dge sems spyi dang khyad par du byang chub kyi sems kyi kun slong ma mtha' yang bcos ma tsam gsal btab/ des zin pa'i sgo nas phyag skor sogs la 'jug par bya'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon ni/ yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtshos/ lus bsrings thal sbyar yan lag lnga/ /sar gtugs phyag gcig bsod nams gzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dul ba nas bshad pa'i yan lag lnga phyag da lta bskum phyag tu grags pa'am/ sdong bo bkod pa'i mdo sogs las bshad pa'i lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag da lta brkyang phyag tu grags pa gang 'tshal yang / rang gi lus kyis ci tsam non pa'i sa 'di nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar sa'i rdul ji snyed yod pa de'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor lo'i sgyur ba stong 'gyur gyi skye ba 'grub pa sogs phan yon mang du gsungs/ de bzhin du/ sa'i snying bo 'khor lo bcu ba'i mdo las/ 'jig rten dag na bde zhing skyid pa/ /de kun dkon mchog mchod las 'byung yang / /de bas bde zhing skyid par 'udod pas/ /dkon mchog mchod la rtag tu brtson bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang cag rnams kyi tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i bde skyid thams cad dkon mchog mchod pa'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bu kho nar gsungs pas dus kun yab rje gser khang ba rin po che yab sras kyi phyag srol ltar yon 357

chab grangs mang 'bul ba sogs la rtse gcig tu 'bad pa gal che/ de ltar yon chab phul ba'i phan yon ni/ dri bzang sman ldan yon chab phul ba yis/ /las nyon sdig ltung dri ma kun dag cing / /rigs drug sdug bsngal tsha gdung rab zhi nas/ /zab rgyas lam gyi rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa dang des bskyed pa'i sdig ltung gi dri ma 'dag pa dang / 'bras bu 'gro ba rigs drug spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal gyi tsha gdung zhi zhing / shes rgyud la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung bar bshad la/ der ma zad me tog phul ba'i phan yon ni/ skye ba thams cad du lus gser gyi kha dog dang ldan pa dang /tsan dan gyi dri zhim po'i ngad ldang zhing / ro mchog dang ldan pa'i zas la longs spyod pa dang / gzhan gyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i stobs dang ldan par 'gyur/ zhes gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs / spos phul ba'i phan yon ni/ las rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las phan yon bcu gsungs shing / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo sogs las/ tshe rabs thams cad du gzhan gyi gnod par mi nus pa dang / dpal 'byor dang longs spyod mi nyams pa dang / tshul khrims kyi phung bo yongs su rdzogs shing /nam du yang dri mi zhim pa dang / mi gtsang ba'i gnas su mi skye bar gsungs/ mar me phul ba'i phan yon ni/ tshe rabs thams cad du lus 358

mdzes shing 'od gsal ba dang / shes rab kyi snang ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ba dang/ gzhan gyi gnod pas mi tshugs shing /'dzam gling gser gyis gang ba lta bu'i dpal 'byor nyams par mi 'gyur/ khyad par du sngags bla med kyi rdzogs rim zab mo'i lam gyi rmang rdo gtum mo'i bde drod khyad par can dang / de la brten nas dpe dang don gyi 'od gsal rgyud la skye bar gsungs/ rol mo phul ba'i phan yon ni/ skye ba thams cad du sbrul dang sbal ba sogs dang / lce'i dbang bo skyon can rnams su mi skye zhing / smra mkhas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / rna ba'i dbang bo dang lce'i dbang bo rnam par dag cing / snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs kun tu khyab par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon mang du gsungs/gzhan yang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ ba dan dang bla re sogs mchod pa'i bye brag gang dang gang phul yang gnas skabs su lha dang mi'i lus rten thob cing tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod lung rtogs kyi yon tan bshad sgrub chos spyod kyi bya ba sogs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang /mthar thug mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu 'grub pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa bka' dang bstan bcos las rgya cher 'byung ba rnams 'dir yi ge mang dogs nas ma bkod pas/ shes par 'dod pa rnams kyis dam pa gong ma'i gsung rab las mkhyen par mdzod cig de ltar na bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis dus rtag tu 359
