dad gus rnam par dag pa'i kun nas bslangs te dkon mchog mchod pa la rtse gcig tu brtson pa byed dgos te/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal bo'i mdo nas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa/ /yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod min pas/ /dngos po kun gyis de la mchod/ /ces dang / rje bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos/ thog mar zhing gi mthu la bsten nas ni/ /nang gi bsam pa'i stobs ni skye 'gyur bas/ /dge ba'i bshes dang dkon mchog mchod pa la/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sbyor ba bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//smras pa/ thub chen ston pa bu ram shing ba yi/ /mtha' bral mkhyen yangs nam mkha'i sgo phye nas/ /mdo rgyud chos tshul nyi ma shar ba'i tshe /phyogs kun bshad sgrub 'od kyis gsal bar mdzes/ /khyad par bcom ldan thams cad rig pa zhes/ /yo ga'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i snying bo che'i/ /byin rlabs 'phrin las dkar bo chig thub sman/ /skye rgu'i sdug kun nad brgya'i gsos su grub/ /gang zhig mthong thos dran dang reg pa yis/ /sgrub gnyis tsha ba'i gdung ba drungs 'byin cing / /mchog thun dngos grub 'dod rgu'i char 'beb pa'i/ /rten mchog dpag bsam dbang bo deng 'dir grub/ /ngo mtshar rnam snang sku yi za ma tog /rnam mang gzungs dang mdo rgyud glegs bam sogs/ /ring bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur gtams pa yi/ /cha tsam tshig gi lam du mtshon par byas/ /'dir 'bad 360

bsod nams 'od stong 'bar ba'i nyi/ /lhag bsam nam mkha'i ngos su shar ba yis/ /rigs drug sdug bsngal mun pa mtha' byas te/ /bde skyid pad+mo'i tshal brgya bzhad par shog /mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin bye ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rnam dag bshad sgrub dpung ba brtan po yis/ /blo bzang ring lugs gser gyi rgyal mtshan mchog /mi nub srid rtse'i bar du sgreng gyur cig /khrims ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /blo bzang legs bshad chos kyi rnga bo che/ /thos bsam dbyug gus rtag tu brdung ba'i sgras/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon kun 'geng gyur cig /bskal bzang rgyal ba'i nyi ma stong phrag gi /'phrin las li khri'i thig phreng bye ba brgyas/ /'jig rten ma lus lham mer gsal mdzad tshe/ /lung rtogs dam chos bang mdzod 'dzin par shog /'jig rten kun tu nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sogs/ /mi shes rgud pa'i mtshan ma kun zhi nas/ /sde bzhi'i dga' ston bla na med pa yis/ /skye rgu mtha' dag yun du 'tsho gyur cig /nam mkha' rab 'byams til gyi gang bu bzhin/ /yongs su khyab pa'i mchog gsum srung tshogs kyis/ /bden tshig shis brjod dbyangs dang lhan cig tu/ /bkra shis me tog char chen 'beb gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag nor bu'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni yul reb gong smad kyi char gnas pa'i 361

sgrub pa'i sde chen po 'dus bzang chos gling gi rgan mang nas bkra shis pa'i lha dar dang bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ba'i thugs mos ltar shākya'i btsun gzugs 'du shes gsum pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtshos bag yod chu mo glang gi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dge slong rnam dpyod phun sum tshogs pa blo bzang rgya mtshos bgyis pa dza yan+tu/'jam mgon smra ba'i nyi ma chos kyi rgyal bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gzugs/ pha rgod rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho dpal bzang po ni/ ji skad du/ gong sa phyag na pad+mo rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ de phyir mes pos bskal par bsams byas kyang / /gting mtha' dpag par dka' na bdag 'dra bas/ /rtogs brjod smra ba 'dab chags sgro rtse yis/ /mthon po'i brag ri zad par byed pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa 'di'i rnam par thar ba rje nyid dang mnyam pa'i ye shes kho nas gzhal byar gyur na yang / rdo rje 'chang chen po kun gzigs dbyangs ldan rigs pa'i 'dod 'jo'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i rnam thar chen mo'i don bsdus pa'i snying bo tsam dad pa'i rten du zhu na/ de yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rin chen 'byung zhes bya ming dang / /yi ge ga zhes gzhon nu zhes/ /yi ge ba zhes chos sems byed/ /yi ge a ming bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin byed/ /blo 362

ldan yon tan kun gyis bkur/ /zhes sku tshe 'di'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshan gyi yi ge dang rnam thar gyi 'gangs dngos su tshig gi lam nas thon pa'i lung du bstan pa yin la/ snga rol rnams su yang / rgyal ba don kun grub pa'i mdun sar 'jam dpal lha bu blo gros rin chen/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi dus na grub pa'i khyu mchog sha wa ri ba/ bha ro grub pa'i dbang bo'i mdun na rwa chen rdo rje grags pa/ lha gcig dī paṃ ka ra'i 'khor na thugs sras sa yi snying bo/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i drung na mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bo/ yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i drung du rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rje gser khang ba'i zhabs drung du/ grub ba'i dbang phyug rje 'jigs med bsam gtan/ gzhan yang kha ba ri ba'i bstan 'gro'i phan bde la bka' drin gyi khur lhun po las lci ba lha bla ma ye shes 'od sogs yongs su grags pa dang / de ltar ma grags pa'i rol gar chu yi zla ba bzhin 'byams su klas pa'i dkyil 'khor pha mtha' dang bral/ de ltar na yang re zhig bka' drin mtshungs med yab rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di ni rnam 'dren bla ma rong ston phyag na pad+mo skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las 'od dkar gyi grib bsil snum por 'khyil ba'i zhing khams nas rab byung bco lnga ba'i bgrang bya so gnyis pa rnam 'phyang gi lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin spyan ras gzigs dbang a rol lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 363

gyi sku mched du gser zhal 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mngon par bzhad/ kun mkhyen dbyig gnyen gyi rnam rol rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i rigs kyi cod pan mkhas shing grub pa'i 'khore los bsgyur ba chen po zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs dang / 'jam mgon snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag po rong ston rgyal ba'i ring lugs pa chen po khri chen 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag 'jam pa'i rdo rje ngur smrig gar du zlos pa sku'i phreng bar paṇ+ḍi ta sha stag gi rnam par rol ba/sa'i steng na 'gran zla med pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang dpal ldan dpal bzang bo rnam gsum gyis gtso mdzad pa'i mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi rnam thar mngon du gyur pas 'dzam gling gi rgyan du che ba dgu phrag gcig gi zhabs zung bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod pa'i tshul rtag ngu nor bzang gis kyang smon gnas kho na yin te/mtshan gzhi gcig zhu na/ dus rgyun bla ma zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang khong nyid nas mdzad pa'i lam khrid chen mo'i glegs bam zhal phye ba dbu sngas dang mi 'bral zhing / tha na rje de nyid kyi na bza'i tshal bu tshun chad byin rten gzhan las gtsigs che ba dang / snga phyir 'dra sku thog tshad ma sogs snang brnyan che chung mang du bzhengs shing bla ma'i gsol 'debs thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus kyi zla mchod btsugs pa sogs brjod kyis dka' 'o/ /yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa la sgo 364

kun nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos kyi gzigs pa rgyun 'jags kyis sku tshe gang bor mnyam 'grogs kyi tshul du bsten te gzhan gyis dpag par dka' ba'i bkur bzo gnang ba la rje 'di lta bu dkon pa yin no/ /de yang slob dpon dpa' bos/ snyigs ma'i skya rengs 'od kyis reg pa yis/ /mkhas grub rgyu skar phreng ba rim 'das tshe/ /dmu rgod snyigs dus 'gro ba'i lha skal du/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs nyi ma khyod gcig shar/ /gsungs pa ltar 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa la rgyal ba gnyis pa rang nyid dang mtshungs pa'i mdzad pa bdag gir bzhes pa'i tshul ni/ dgung lo bcu bzhi ba'i dus nas tshe hril bor chos grwar sbyangs pa'i rgan po yus can rnams kyi bsnyems pa brtsad nas 'phrog pa'i smra dbang mi yi seṅge lta bu'i snyan grags khyab gdal du rgyas/ gzhung gang nas gsungs kyang nam mkha' la mda' 'phangs pa bzhin thogs thug med pa dang / tha na de dang de'i thad nas rnam thar lo rgyus dang bcas zur chag sogs gang las 'phros na de dang de'i glegs bam gyi zhal phye ba lta bu yin no/ /dgung lo nyi shu bzhes tshe gong sa rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen pos kyang sku yon la ngo mtshar ba'i bsngags brjod kyi phreng ba spel na gzhan rnams lta ci/mdor na/ rig pa'i gnas chen po bcu zhes yongs su grags pa'i phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gting mtha' phyag mthil gyi rdzas bzhin gzigs pa'i sbyangs 'bras kyi nyi ma mkha' la shar zhing / de las 365

kyang nang rig pa 'dul ba kā ri ka nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i stong gzugs kyi bar la bka' bab tshad ma kun ldan du gyur/ snyan brgyud gser gyi yang zhun lta bu'i man ngag bdud rtsis thugs rgyud bum bzang yongs su katams pas/ mkhas pa la 'os pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ grub pa la 'os pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum/ bstan 'dzin la 'os pa'i bshad sgrub zung 'brel/ chen po la 'os pa'i 'phrin las rlabs chen sogs yul dus gnas skabs dang mi 'tsham par sgo thams cad nas phyogs thams cad du zla dang bral ba bstan pa la sangs rgyas nyid dang mtshungs pa'i mdzad bzang rgyas pa rje 'di lta bu gangs ri'i khrod na nyin skar tsam du snang ngo / /kun mkhyen bla ma'i yig cha la thugs zhen che bas sgo mang ba'i mkhas pa zhig la yig cha'i khrid skyong tshe yig cha'i ngo gdong ded nas rigs pa'i 'phrul gyis 'grigs pa khyab bskor re tsam yang med pa lta bus ci drag la gtugs te mthar gzhung de rgya bskyed nas 'chad pa'i tshul sogs mkhas rlom rnams kyi spyod yul las 'das pa sha stag mdzad do/ /khyad par rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang / bka' pod chen po lnga'i dgongs don mtha' dag byang chub lam rim gyi gzhung thog la khyer nas thugs thog nas bshad pa rgyas bsdus nam gnang res la tshig gi sbyor ba dang / don 'gangs sogs shugs 'byung gis 'jo ba bsam du med pa rang yin la/ sku tshe gang bor lam khrid tshar lnga bcu lhag gnang zhing / de so so la'ang brgyud 366

ldan dam pa'i man ngag bzhin gegs sel bogs 'don gyi dmigs rnam cha tshang zhing / bklag lung gang gnang gsung gdangs kyis yid 'gugs shing shin tu myur yang chad lhag gi skyon dang bral ba/ dbang rjes gnang sogs nam gnang ba la phyag len rnams ngos gtsang zhing / lha dang sngags kyi che ba thon pa/ rgyud dang grub chen kyi khungs gsal ba/ skabs bab kyi dmigs rim dang thob brda 'phrod pa sogs cha gang nas kyang ston pa 'di lta bu gang du btsal kyang mi rnyed pa'i gnas lags pas/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pas/ gang gi yon tan mthong ba yis/ /lcags kyus nya la ji bzhin du/ /nyid kyis thugs drangs chos de ni/ /khyod las ma thos skal ba zhan/ /de yi mya ngan shugs kyis ni/ /sdug pa'i bu la ma yi yid/ /rjes su song ba ji bzhin du/ /bdag gi yid ni gtong mi byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bdag lta bur sku dngos las gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa'i skal ba ma byung na yang / de nyid las/ yid la thub pa'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /shar ba tsam yang tsha ba yis/ /gdungs la zla zer bzhin du sman/ /gsungs pa de kho na ltar ro/ /rtsod pa'i mdzad pa la yang / chos grwa nas sbyong tshul mdzad pa nas bzung mgo thal skad gtong tshul nas rtsod pa'i rgyan du ci mdzad dang / dgag sgrub gang gnang la che gsal myur zab kyi rno dbal khyad du zhugs la/ lan gcig dbu ma'i thal ldog dang chos can thun snang rtsod skabs dge bshes ya med tshos kyang so thob dka' ba zla ba'i 367

tshig gsal gyi du'i thad kyi gzhung rtsod gzhir drangs te brgal brtag cha tshang gnang ba la bshes gnyen chen po blo gros rgya mtsho ba shin tu ha las te bstan bcos la bris na yang mi thon pa zhig gnang song zhes bsngags pa sogs dka' ba'i gnas rnams nyi ma bzhin gsal bar mdzad pa bris pas mi lang / bstan bcos su gnang zin pa yang rje thams cad mkhyen pas stsal pa'i gsang 'dus skor la go bo rab 'byams dang / sngags rim la bo dong paṇa chen/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum pa la ngor ba kun bzang rjes 'brangs bcas pas dgag pa ltar snang mang du byas pa rnams la rim lnga'i bka' 'grel dang / rtog bdun rgyud 'grel chen mo rnams su dgag sgrub kyis sun phyung nas rang bstan 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sgrib g.yog med par byas pa yang gzhan gyis mi nus pa'i rnam thar yin zhes kyang chog go /dgung lo nyer lnga'i steng rtsod yig 'jigs med rigs pa'i gad rgyangs ljags rtsom gnang nas bden pa bzhi las brtsams pa'i lung rigs kyi gtam bzang rgya cher spros te mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i ral ba'i zur phud kyi rtse mor yud kyis byon/ lhag par du yang rtsom pa'i yon tan ni rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang yab rje bla ma sogs re 'ga' ma gtogs pa'i sngon gyi dpa' bo dang dge dbang zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa sogs ngag gi dbang phyug thams cad gcig pu bsgril kyang cha tsam yang mtshon mi nus pa yin tshul gsung rtsom las rtogs shing /368

dgung lo bcu so nas bcad lhug gi sdeb gang snyan gyis mdzes pa'i snyan ngag ngo mtshar ba'i phreng ba rgyun mar spel ba dri za'i pi wang stong gi 'du byed las 'gongs pa sha stag tu gsal lo/ /dgung lo bcu gsum nas gzhung lugs rtsom pa'i dbu brtsams pa yin la/ de yang de dus sems sems byung gi rnam gzhag gsungs pa'i bab kho nar dpag kyang de dus nas sku yon gyi rtsal rdzogs zin pa cis mi shes/ dgung lo so dgu'i steng rtog bdun 'grel chen mdzad pa la/ khong nyid kyis/ 'jigs mdzad rgyal ba'i yab la ring zhig nas/ /mkhas grub sus kyang bgyis pa lta zhog gi /gnyid mtshor phyin pa'i rmi lam ltad mo yang / /nyams su ma myangs las de bdag gis grub/ /ces dang / dkyil 'khor gtso bo mngon gsum du/ /grub pa mi yi seṅge mang / /dgongs pa bsres pas bdag gcig pu/ /rgyud don bang mdzod 'byed la bskos/ /zhes gsungs pa nges pa'i don la gnas so/ /dus rgyun ri khrod pa lha gcig ces gsungs pa yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs lha gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rnam thar yin par gsungs/ rim lnga gsal sgron gyi dka' 'grel bsdus don dang bcas pa/dus kyi 'khor lo phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi skor/ rig byed ma'i lam rim dang / sngags rim tshigs bcad ma/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lam rim gsung mgur gyi 'grel ba bde chen gtam gyi nying khu sogs rgyud sde'i skor/rje yab sras kyi phar phyin bzhed mtshams/ drang nges chen mo pod gnyis ma/369

sgo mang phar sdom dang grub mtha'i sdom/ rtags rigs spyi don/ lam rim tshigasaṃ bcad ma/ lta khrid rgyas bsdus/ lam rim chen mo'i bsdus don dang sa gcod rgyas pa/ gsung mgur sogs sngon med legs bshad sha stag yin pas na/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos kyang bka' 'bum par byang smon tshig tu bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad do/ /paṇa chen gong mas kyang thub pa thog mtha' ma/ za 'og gi sku 'gag gos bzang lha dar sogs gnang skyes mang bo dang bcas te/ zhal nas/ khyed bshad sgrub kyi rtsal rdzogs pa'i skyes bur song gshis rje'i bstan pa la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba dang / mdo dbus kun tu bstan pa'i nyams ha cang dma' ba 'di la bya ba gang legs bgyid pa'i mgon mdzad rgyu dang /dus bzhi phyi mar rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'dus pa dang por smin grol kyi skal ba can du 'gyur zhes gsungs/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen mo rigs ldan nyer lnga ba'i rtogs brjod/ yab rje bla ma'i 'khrungs rabs rnam thar sogs rnam thar gyi skor bcu phrag rje'i khyad par 'phags bstod sogs bstod tshogs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skor / rgya bod shags 'gyed dang sman gyi sdong 'grem/ dbyangs can bshad sbyar sogs thun mos rig pa'i gzhung gi dka' gnas kyi skor/ chab shog dang thor bu'i skor/ da dung gzhung chen mo'i dka' 'grel rnams bsdoms na shog grangs bzhi brgyar brgal ba dang / lam rim brjed byang chen mo sogs 370

bstan bcos su mdzad zin rnams gsung 'bum du 'khon na pod sum cu lhag bzhugs/ de yang dka' las khyad gsod mi dgos par gang gsungs thams cad thugs la bzung zin pa zhig zhal 'don du mdzad pa'i tshegs las med pas drung yig rgyus yod yi ger byang bo zhig min bris pas rjes chod dka' bar gsungs so/ /sdom gsum gyi bcos mtshams las 'da' dogs med pa thub dbang kho na las dpe gzhan med pa lta bu'i rnam thar gyis drang srong gi spyod pa'i rgyan gyis ci yang mdzes e waṃ gzim khang gsar bskrun gyi skabs su gtsang khang khyams su srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga ba dang / nad pa'i rung khang du dge slong nad pa la ston pas nad g.yog byed pa dang / gsang spyod khang du dur khrod kyi ri mo 'bri ba tshun chad mdo nas gsungs pa ji bzhin phyag tu bstar/ stong nyid snying rje snying bo can thugs rgyud la mngon sum du 'khrungs pa'i ngang 'brel tshad don ldan byung ba da lta'i bar mngon sum yin pa 'di ltar la/ mdor na ci'adul ba nas bshad pa'i dge slong gi yo byad dang / rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor ba'i yo byad dang / rgyud 'chad skabs nye bar mkho ba rnams kyang smad rgyud phyag len bzhin cha tshang bar bsnams pa 'di tsam yang bstan pa 'dzin par khas 'che ba dag gis 'gran par bzod pa ma yin no/ /bzhugs gnas dang bcas yo byad tshun la tshul khrims kyi dri bsung 'thul le 'khyug cing mngon shes rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo 'byams su klas/ 371

reb gcig la chos sde 'dir chibs kha bsgyur te zhag kha shas la bzhugs/grwa mang la dgos chos stsal/ chos kyi bu gzur gnas blo bzang shes rab kyi grwa shag tu phebs bzhud gnang ste zhal nas khyed la rkun ma 'dzul ba e tshor thal gsungs/ de nas brtags pas kho la dngul sgor bco lnga bdog pa rkun mas khyer bas lung bstan pa sogs bsam brjod las 'das/ shin tu nyams dga' ba'i ri khrod dben gnas 'dir bsdad na dge sbyor 'phel bar nges gsungs nas dgun thog gcig la bcad rgyar bzhugs te thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad/ gzhi gsum kyi cho ga gnas bcu/ skabs gsum pa sogs chos sbyin gnang zhing ser skya yongs la 'dod chos kyis tshims par mdzad/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ 'dzam gling gsal byed bcu gnyis bdag po 'di/ /sprin dang khug sna rdul gyi nyes pa yis/ /mi sdod gling bzhir chu skyes tshal bzhad na/ /rgyal sras tshogs gnyis can rnams ji ltar sdod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gdul bya'i bsod nams shing rtas nye bar drangs te mdo smad kyi phyogs kun tu zhabs skyes ri mo'i bkra shis rnam par bkod cing / rong bo dang / bis mdo/ bya khyung / lha mo/ rnga ba sogs kyi legs bshad sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i dga' tshal gyi bla ma khri gdan zur/ dge bshes rigs smra sogs grwa slob khri phrag la nye ba/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom rgyun 'bogs pa'i mkhan bu chig stong drug brgya nyer lnga/rong bo'i lha btsun chen po dang / rme rgyal bo dpal dgon 'phrin las 372

rab brtan sogs dpon chen che chung brgya phrag mdo sngags chos kyi rbeka' drin stsal pa'i slob ma 'bum phrag du ma bskrun tshul rgyas par rnam thar gdung sel sman gyi ljon pa dang / so skye'i blo las 'gongs pa'i mdzad pa'i cha shas tsam zhig gsang rnam rin chen dang po'i sbram bu sogs la mjal nas rtogs par bya/ mthar gdul bya rdzogs par dgongs nas dgung grangs zhe dgu bzhes pa'i hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bdun la bsam bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing du rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gdan drangs pa ltar zhi ba'i dbyings su ngal gsol bar mdzad do//nges pa don ldan gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan ni/ rong 'brog tsho lnga'i nang tshan tsho 'du nas mkhas grub chen po tsho 'du mkhan chen blo bzang 'phrin las 'khrungs pa'i rigs rus la sge'u steng blo bzang mkhan po dang / de dbon blo bzang mkhas mchog zer ba sogs chos srid la rnam dpyod kyi mjug pa mnga' ba gnyis kyi tsha bo sge'u steng tshe dbang la tsho 'du mkhan po sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs ming sring mang tsam byung ba las mkhan sprul mchog gi gcen tsho 'du'i sku dbon chos mdzad du grags pa blo rig dpa' gsum phyogs su grags pa/ sge'u steng gi nang chen dang 'du khang gsar bzhengs bgyid pa po/ yul phyogs kyi snga phyi'i gyod sna mang bo'i sdig kha 'dum pa sogs chos srid la lag rjes che ba'i gtam gar yang gleng ba ni 'di'i yab yin no/ /373

ma sgrol ma zhes bya ba bud med kyi mdzes pa'i rgyan rnams rdzogs pa rgyan gos rin thang can rnams kyang 'du khang dang / gdung rten sogs bzhengs rgyu'i 'theb tu phul ba sogs lo rgyus mang zhing / phyis su 'das skabs pur ma rnyed pa la dpag na yang sprul ba'i gang zag khyad par can zhig tu nges zhes bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs gsung / yab yum de gnyis kyi srasahosu rab tshes lcags sbrul lo'i dgun stod la rtag brtan kun dga' snying bzhin phru ma'i ga shal ma ral bar ltas dang bcas te sku bltams/dgung lo bcu bar bsam gtan pa la 'os pa'i rgyan thams cad ma tshang ba med pang lhun rdzogs su mnga' ba 'gran zla med pa'i dben gnas dam pa sge'u steng dga' ldan chos 'phel gyi sgrub grwar phebs/ byang rtse mkhas pa'i khyu rgyan sems dpa' chen po gling rgya'i lha rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyi drung nas rab tu byung / de nas dgung lo bcu drug bar la phral sbyar gyi klog nas 'don chos spyod dbyangs rta dang bcas pa thugs la byang / bcu drug nas zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang /grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan sogs las zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu drug nas sems dpa' chen po lha rams pa blo bzang chos grags dang / skyabs mgon bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las/ yongs 'dzin bstan pa 374

rgya mtsho/ tsho 'du'i yongs 'dzin rong bo grwa tshang gi rigs smra rtser son byang chub kun spangs blo bzang bstan pa sogs kyi zhabs bsten te mdo sngags lam rim sogs kyi bka' chos mang du gsan pas lung rtogs yon tan gyi rmang tshugs/ dus kyi mtha' na lnga rig spyi dang khyad par phyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i gnad la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas grags mdo smad lho byang du rgyas pa rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gi dus zhabs chen po mtsho byung dgyes pa'i dpal las dgung lo nyer bzhi bar sum rtags dag gsum nas bzung / sgra/ snyan ngag rtsis dkar nag dbyangs 'char sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod sogs kyis mtshon pas rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i thig dang bcas pa'i thun mong gi rig pa'i gnas la pha las bu mkhas pa'i rnam thar mngon par mdzad de gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i 'dzam gling na zla bral ba'i mkhas grags lha lam du khyab pa byung / lha rams pa chen po las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer bzhi'i dus su lha bla ma yi dam chos srung dang bcas pa'i lung ltar bya btang bka' gdams pa chen po'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes par chas te/ snyigs dus kyi ston pa chen po rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs bsten phyir sdi tshar phebs nas bkra shis chos sdings kyi chos grwar zhugs/ rje de nyid dang / mdzod dge blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs bla mar bsten te chos thog gsum gyi ring phyin pa na chos grwa khrig ldem me 375

ba'i dge bshes thams cad zil gyis mnan par ma zad rtog ge ba'i grags pa mdo smad kyi grwa sa chen po rnams su ngang gis rgyas/ dgung lo nyer lnga bar ri khrod kyi skyabs 'jug thob ste bla gos ser bo'i rgyan thogs pa'i drang srong bsam gtan pa rnams kyi mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur/ dgung lo nyer drug nas bla na med pa'i mkhas pa'i snyan grags kyi ba dan dkar bo phyogs su btsugs/ dgung lo so gnyis par re skong mar nang dang bis mdo zal mo dgon dge legs dang bo'i chos rdzong du phyag phebs/ 'di yan ni dang bor rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal ba'i skabs yin la/ de yang sdi tsha'i chos grwar bzhugs nas cang ma 'gor ba'i skabs shig nas/'dzin grwa gong 'og kun tu rigs lam la 'gran zla ma byung bas dgung gcig 'dzin grwa bzang shos shig dam bcar phebs skabs/ khyod tsho thams cad phyogs sgril gyis lan thobs dang / nged kyi thal 'gyur 'di la lan thebs pa byung na mdun 'dir gzan sham phud de rgyal du ster ro/ /zhes zhal shom yang mdzad/ 'dzin grwa gong mar dam bca' phebs nas grol tshe gzhan dag gis 'dzin grwa der de ring khyod tsho'i 'dzin grwa rang 'thag 'dug res red ang / zhes kyal ka byed par grags/ zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang la 'ga' zhig gis 'os min gyi zhu tshig phul ba'i lan du phyag 'phrin las/ khong bas rgya bod kyi gzhung chen mo bsdur nas lta rtog byed mkhan zhig yin pas lo shas 'gor na 'dzam gling na zla med pa'i mkhas pa 376

zhig 'byung snyam pa yod/ ces bka' phebs pa dang / nged kyi chos grwa 'di la 'di las lhag pa'i shes rab can byung ma myong sogs gsungs pa ni dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i dan rtags so/ /dgung lo sum cu tham pa bzhes pa'i dgun chos kyi skabs shig 'dzin grwa 'og mar phebs nas dam bca' 'jog skabs/ lung rigs kyi brgal brtag seng ge'i ngar skad la 'gran bzod pa'i chos grogs mkhas pa chen po gcig gis/ nang pa sangs rgyas kyi lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ zhes pa'i steng nas mngon pa 'og ma'i lugs la zag bcas kyi phung bo yin na/ sdug bden dang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang 'khor ba gsum ga yin pas khyab kyang / mngon pa gong ma'i lugs la khyab che chung yod med las brtsams te bgro gleng phul bar/ yongs 'dzin rin po ches zhwa dmar ba'i gsung rtsom lam khrid chen mo'i rting mnan nas/ nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab par mngon pa kun btus dang / dbu ma rig tshogs/bzhi brgya ba rtsa 'grel/ lam rim chen mo sogs 'phags bod kyi gzhung chen mang bo'i dgongs pa yin tshul gyi dam bca' dang / yang sgo mang phar phyin mtha' dpyod du/ ngo bo'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum yod/ ces dang / ma dag pa'i snod spyi dang / nyer len gyi phung bo nang gi sdug 377

bden du bshad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig pa'i phyir/zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi tshig zin la brten nas sdug bsngal gsum 'gal dgos pa dang / nyer len gyi phung bo dang 'khor ba la nang gi sdug bden gyis khyab dgos pa'i bgro gleng btang ba la/ yongs 'dzin rin po ches zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba yin pa dang / de la rang rgyu nye bar len pa las byung bas khyab pa dang /rang rgyu sdug kun gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thog med nas bar ma chad par 'ongs pa'i dngos po yin pas khyab pa nyid kyi phyir sdug bden la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang nyer len gyi phung bo dang 'khor ba gsum gyis khyab bo zhes pa'i dam bca' brtan po brag la btab pa'i lcags kyi phur ba ltar sus kyang bsgul ma thub par gyur la/ bgro gleng gtong mkhan gyis/ de dag don gcig zer ba blo ngor mi bde zer ba tsam las gnod byed ston pa'i tshig gcig smra rgyu ma byung bar grags/ de'i rkyen gyis sge'u steng blo bzang gis bum pa 'khor bar khas blangs pa red ces kyal ka'i steng tshig de dus byung ba red/ phyis su sdi tsha dang bla brang nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu 'ga' re nas yig cha'i rting gnon pa'i rtsod yig rgyas bsdus ci rigs re brtsams nas bskur ba dang / khyad par yongs 'dzin rin po che dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum bzhes pa'i lor bod ljongs chos kyi zhing khams nas 'bras spungs klu 'bum lha rams pa 378

rtsod med mkhas pa'i dbang bo dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho zhes nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i rgyal khab thams cad du yang mtshan gyi rol mo rna bar snyan pa gang gis rtsod yig bskal pa'i me dpung zhes bya ba brtsams nas bskur ba phyag tu 'byor/ tshul de dag la brten nas bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog gi blang dor gsal bar mtshon pa dang chabs cig gangs can gyi rig gzhung la byi dor dang / yar rgyas gong 'phel du byed pa'i ched du rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rtsod yig 'jigs med rigs pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba dang / khong nyid nas gnang ba'i dgag lan chu'i 'phrul 'khor zhes bya ba dang / mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dpyi sa'i blo gros rgya mtshos gnang ba'i gsang 'dzin mtshon gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba sogs yongs 'dzin rin po che dngos dang / gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob rnams kyis bka' rtsom mang tsam zhig spel/ de ltar bod kyi thun mong ba'i rig gnas dang lhag par tshad ma rigs pa la dag ther dang yar rgyas su btang ba'i snyan grags des rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen po dang / paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma rnam gnyis nas dngos brgyud ci rigs par yongs 'dzin rin po che la bstod bsngags rgya cher mdzad pa dang / mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams nas kyang yongs 'dzin rin po che'i mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang / bka' rtsom gyi bstan bcos la bsngags brjod dpe med gnang ba yongs 'dzin tshang gi rnam thar du gsal ba ltar 379

la/ rtsod yig 'jigs med rigs pa'i gad rgyangs kyi par byang smon tshig mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen po 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros zhal snga nas gnang bar/ bum pa 'khor bar bsnyad pa'i kyal kas kyang / /blang dor gnas la 'thoms pa'i skye bo phal/ /ma dag snod bcud 'khor ba'i rang bzhin la/ /bred sha thon pa sa chen rdul la 'gran/ /zhes dang /chu'i 'phrul 'khor las/ e ma bkra shis chos sdings su/ /btab pa'i sa bon skyes grags pas/ /dpag bsam bkra shis 'khyil du rgyas/ /me tog dbus gtsang zhing du bzhad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dgung lo so gsum nas zhe gcig bar dbu sngags kyi gzhung che chung la khyab gdal gyis gzigs zhib gnang bar rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin/ dgung lo so bdun steng khri rgan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mdun nas bka' 'gyur gyi ljags lung gsan skabs bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med zhabs gtso byas pa'i rje a rol sprul ba'i sku dang / bse khri rgan sprul ba'i sku/ tsho 'du mkhan chen sogs bla sprul bshes gnyen bcu phrag bdun tsam la lam rim chen mo mdzub khrid dang / sgra/ rtsis dkar nag rgyud sde so so'i phyag rgya mchod rten dang dkyil 'khor gyi thig ris sogs bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas nam mkha'i mthongs nas phye/ dgung lo zhe gcig nas lug ra sgar gsar dga' ldan chos 'phel gling du lo gsum gyi ring bcad rgya mdzad de rim 380

gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la 'bad bzhin zhag lnga brgya nga gsum ring la byang chub lam rim gyi rgya cher bshad pa'i sgo phye ste/ thun re bzhin chos skor re re la/ bsdus don/ 'bru 'grel/ lung rigs dpe gsum gyis rgya cher bshad pa/ dogs gcod/ lag tu len tshul lnga sbyar te phal chen dkon brtsegs mdo mang gsum dang / bka' gdams gzhung drug phyogs gtogs rgya bod kyi legs bshad rnams dang / sa sde sogs byams chos/rgya bod kyi gzhung gang snyed las dbu ma ma gtogs pa'i bka' pod bzhi'i 'grel ba/ spyi don/ mtha' dpyod kyi rigs dang / bzhi brgya ba/rin phreng / 'jug pa sogs kyi spyod phyogs rnams dang / lam rim blo sbyong sogs rgya bod kyi 'di skor gyi gzhung dang bka' bstan rnams las yig sna phra mo tshun chad zhib sbrags kyis bshad pa nam mkha' la mda' 'phangs pa ltar mdzad pa ni rje thams cad mkhyen pa nas bzung da lta'i bar byung ma myong ba'i rnam thar ro/ /rtogs brjod las/ 'jam mgon thugs bcud lam rim chen mo zhes/ /dge ldan bstan 'dzin yongs kyi spyi nor de/ /phyis su rdul mang brtsegs pa'i gos gyon nas/ /chos khri'i mal du sdang ba med par mnal/ /gang gi ngo mtshar mkhyen rab dbyu gu yis/ /gzab bshad gser gyi rnga chen brdungs pa'i sgras/ /g.yo med ting nge 'dzin las slar bzhengs te/ /skal bzang blo gsal bye ba'i dpal du gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dgung lo zhe bdun steng gong sa skyabs mgon bdun 381

pa chen po'i rigs kyi bdag por phebs/ dgung lo lnga bcu ba nas skyabs mchog mthong ba don ldan gyi sku yon gsan sbyong gi ched du rong bo dgon chen gyi shar bla brang nor bu gru 'dzin gyi gzhal yas khang du yongs 'dzin bde yangs 'jam dbyangs dga' tshal gsar bskrun nang du phyag phebs te shas cher rgyun bzhugs kyi sgo btod/ dgung lo nga gcig pa'i lo gsar dus ston mdzad pa'i thog mar bdud rtsi khang du gong sa mchog dang zhal mjal 'dzoms skabs/ skyabs mgon mchog nas dbu zhwa gser mdog gsar bskrun zhig phul te rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang 'dra ba'i rnam thar mdzad pa la legs so phul/ sre lan seng ge khros pa'i nga ro yang bka' rtsom gnang / dgung lo nga gnyis par rong chen kirti rin po che ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa tshe ring gi yongs 'dzin du bzhugs/ dgung lo nga drug steng brgal lan chu'i 'phrul 'khor zhes ming gis kyang ngo mtshar ster ba de bka' rtsom mdzad/ paṇa chen chos kyi nyi mas kyang / deng sang rong bo shar gyi yongs 'dzin 'dra ba'i sku yon che ba med/ khong ba mkhas khungs med par yon tan rang brdol byung ba red/ ces yang yang gsungs nas bsngags brjod mdzad/ khri rgan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mdun nas phyag chen rtsa 'grel rnams kyi lung gsan skabs rje de nyid nas phyag rgya chen po'i bka' bab rtogs pa klong du gyur pa la gnas bcu grub chen lta bu 'byung ngo gsungs/ yang khri rgan 'jam pa'i dbyangs nas kyang /382

dge rgan tshang gi mkhyen rab 'di ci tsam gyi dka' sa zhig la thug pa na de tsam gyis cig la zug 'gro ba zhig yin pa 'di ya mtshan po zhig red/ces gsungs/ gzhan yang gsang gsum mdzad bzang 'khor lo rgyun mar bskor te gtul bya mtha' dag gang 'tsham gyis gdul pa'i tshe/ dgung lo so gsum pa chu glang lo'i zla gnyis par/ chos sde 'dir zhabs btegs te grwa mang la bde lam gyi khrid mdor bsdus dang / ltag rdor grogs dang bcas par kun btus rtsa 'grel dang mdzod rtsa 'grel lto sbyar ba'i dpe khrid gnang ba'i zhor la mngon pa gong 'og gi gzhung chen rnams la gzigs rtog rgyun ring bskyangs pas/ mkhyen rab li khri'i 'od kyi thig le yis/ /gzhi lnga'i rang spyi u dum wa ra'i mdzum/ /mngon par phye bas chos mngon sbrang rtsi'i rdul/ byu /skal bzang rkang ba drug pa'i gsos su smin/ /zhes bla mas bsngags pa don dang bcas par mdzad/ dgu ba'i dus chen nas bzung chos sde 'dir dgun mtshams la bzhugs te nangs thun la skyes bu chung ngu dang / gung thun la 'bring gi dmigs khrid dang /thun phyi ma gnyis la bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i dmigs pa'i rtsal sbyong ba dang / phyin drug bsdu bzhi la'ang thugs 'dris gtong bzhin ṭīka chen gsum dang sbrags pa'i rtsa she gtsor gyur pa'i dbu ma'i skor dang dpang ḍika chen mo la zhib gzigs/ don gnyer ba so sor lam khrid/ sems sems byung/ rje btsun dbu ma'i spyi don bcas kyi mdzub khrid stsal/383

dgung h+la so bzhi ba shing stag hor zla dang por rka sar tshogs yongs la bla mchod khrid/ ltung bshags/ bzang spyod/ sman bla/ sdom gsum sogs kyi ljags bshad/ don gnyer ba so sor thig ris kyi skor/ rab byung dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs sdom lung sogs mos bstun dang / nya la gso sbyong gi mgon mdzad cing / 'di res sngon gnas rjes dran gyi rkyen yang ci rigs byung bar mngon/ chos sde 'dir yang yang phebs bzhud gnang ste thengs shig la kho'i pha yul ga 'dra yin pa lta ru 'gro dgos gsungs nas/sngar rgyus med kyang rka sar lha bris pa'i gzhi shul du phebs te gzigs pas kun gyis ngo mtshar bar gyur/ yang gsung 'phros shig la lha bris pa'i skye rgyud yin pa sogs kyi gsung gleng mdzad par grags/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ 'jig rten rnams la thugs brtse bas/ /yun ring sa steng dam chos bshad/ /'jig rten gsum phan 'dogs zhus pa'i/ /slob ma dam pa mang du bskrun/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rig gnas che chung bcu phrag gi yon tan gyi bgo skal gyis bu slob bskyangs pa'ang / mdo smad kyi grwa sa sgrub sde phal che ba'i bla sprul/ dge bshes/ ri khrod pa/ gzhi dgon shin tu mang bo dang / snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bla sprul dang sngags pa/ gshen ston bon gyi rgyud 'dzin/ rgya rigs kyi slob ma sogs zhal slob stong phrag mang bor snga phyir chos khrid dang / rtsod khrid/ dpe khrid lo zla khor yug tu mdzad pas gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob kyi khrod nas kyang mkhas pa'i rgyal 384

thabs 'dzin pa sha stag gis mdo smad kyi phyogs 'geng bar gyur to/ /gsung rtsom gyi cha nas kyang mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mo dag las brtsams te sngon med kyi legs bshad ngo mtshar ba'i pod 'ga' bzhugs so//thub bstan yongs kyi bdag po 'jam mgon bstan pa'i gsal byed gu ru badz+ra dha ra rdzong chung mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po ste khong ni/ gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan mi zad pa zab yangs rgya mtsho chen po'i gter du rdzogs pa dag ni dpal ldan thub pa chen po rnams kyis kyang gzhal bar mi nus na gzhan dag lta ci 'tshal/ yin na'ang thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor gang 'tsham gyis bstan 'gror sman pa'i legs mdzad chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul las brtsams te rags bsdus shig brjod pa la mngon par spro'o/ /des na dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin phyag na rdo rjes mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i sprul ba mang po bye ba phrag brgyas 'gro don mdzad pa las sgos su thugs brtse ba chen pos zhing 'di'i 'gro ba'i gsos su sprul rabs mu tig phreng mdzes ji ltar spel tshul ni/ lung rtogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kha gya'i dbu mdzad tshul khrims bkra shis/ mkhas dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ skye dgu'i re skong dge ldan bstan pa'i gsal byed bstan pa'i nyi ma/mdo sngags bstan pa'i srog shing gcig pu 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho/ lung rigs mdzod 'dzin skyaṅges rje 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal 385

mtshan/ dus mthar bstan pa yongs kyi bdag po/ thams cad mkhyen pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po rje mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ mchog sprul chen po 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i dbang phyug ste sprul rabs bdun las bdag nyid chen po 'di ba sku phreng drug pa'i tshul du yul dus rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa la dri ma med pas gzigs pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i sras po yon tan gyi gter du rdzogs pa dag zam ma chad par byon pa'i ka ring stod pa'i rus tshang kha ba'i tsho bar rje'u rigs mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i yab snying bo rgyal dang / skyed yum g.yung bza' snying mo dpal gnyis kyi sras su rab tshes shing byi lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ gser ljongs yangs pa'i grub gnas brgyad kyi nang tshan bcu gcig shel gyi dgon par yum gnas mjal du song bar brag them zhig las gos ser bo'i zhabs phyags dri bral chung ngu gsar ba zhig rnyed par kun gyis ngo mtshar te khyod la bla chen zhig 'khrungs rtags red ces bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel zhus pa dang / gzhan yang de 'dra'i dge mtshan gyi rtags mang ngo / /de nas gzhon dus nas kyang zhi dul bag yod kyi rgyan gyis mdzes shing mkhyen rab gsal bas/ sku gong ma'i nyer spyad rnams ma 'khrul bar ngos 'dzin gyis yid drangs/ rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo skal ldan bdun pa chen po dang / gnas lnga kun gzigs a bh+ya zhabs dang / khri chen 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho 386

sogs kyis thugs thag bcad/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i rigs kyi cod pan zhwa dmar rdo rje 'chang la zhus tshe/ zhal nas/ ka ring phyogs nas nyi ma 'char ba mis gsungs/ de nas dgung lo drug gi steng lug ra pad dkar chos gling nas rnam 'dren shākya seṅge dang mi gnyis pa rje btsun a bh+ya'i zhal snga nas bar ma rab byung dang dge tshul dkyus gcig tu bsgrubs te mtshan la mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho zhes gsol/mtshan gyi me tog gnang ba de yang rje btsun chen po de nyid sngar rwa rgyar phebs lam gser chen gzhung du bzhugs nub kyi mtshan lam du rdzong chung rdo rje 'chang 'di ba'i chab shog yin rgyu'i glegs bam zhig tu/ me tog phal ba'i mchod rdzas med na yang / /tshig gi me tog gtor la 'gal ba ci/ /zhes dang / mtha' klas rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /khyod yon za ma tog la lcid rdzogs pas/ /'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor khor yug bcas kyi bar/ /ma theg rang tshugs gsal bas 'dar zhing g.yo/ /zhes sho lo ka du ma'i mjug tu/ mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /zhes bkod 'dug pa gzigs pa dang bstun par mtshan de sor bzhag mdzad par gsungs pa sogs ni rje 'di ba'i khyad chos bla na med pa gdul bya'i dpal du shar ba gor ma chag ste 'di 'dra'i lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa gzhan yang mang bas zhib par 'god ma nus so/ /de nas rje btsun nyid kyi 'khris su bcar bzhugs kyis dgung lo bdun par ched 387

gnyer gyis gdan sar bkod pa sogs gsang ba gsum gyi gzi byin nyin byed 'bum gyi snang bas nye bar bskyangs shing nar son pa na nyams len mthar son 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims dpal/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/snga sor lung bstan pa'i dge rgan 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims las klog sbyar klog 'don chos spyod sogs bslabs/ lo de'i dbo zla'i nya la bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi drung nas skyabs 'gro'i khrid gsan pa nas bzung rim par rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas mdo sngags rigs gnas kyis bsdus pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams ngag ma lus pa mkhyen dpyod nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i lto bar ci yang bskyil ba sogs dkyus gcig la 'og nas 'god par spro'o//dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes tshe chos sde chen po rong bo thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du tshogs bzhugs gnang ste gang ci'i thad nas rten 'brel legs po byung / skyabs mgon rin po che'i zham ring ba grwa tshang rab 'byams pa 'od zer rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten nas bsdus grwa sogs tshad ma'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i legs lam gyi dbu btsugs te blo gros zhib mos sbyangs pa gang drag mdzad/ gong sa paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma las spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang sta gon sogs dang / yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal bo blo bzang dpal ldan las 'jigs mdzad rdo rje dpa' bo 388

gcig pa dang / bde mchog lū i ba'i dbang sogs dang rjes gnang mang bo/ mdor na bsdus grwa nas bzung ste gzhung bka' pod lnga'i dpe khrid/gzhan yang khrid zhal lung sogs chos bka' lo grangs bcu gsum bar nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin bar ma chad par legs par gsan te rje nyid kyi nang thugs kyi sras po gcig pur gyur te mdzad dgongs tha ma rje 'di nyid la gtad pa sogs spro bar bya ba mang ngo / /pha rgod rdo rje 'chang chen po a bh+ya'i zhal snga nas skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ dga' lha/ bla mchod/ thun drug rnal 'byor/ 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas 'pho ba/ bde lam rnams kyi khrid/ bla ma lnga bcu ba'i zhal lung dang sta gon sngon du btang ba'i 'jug byed rnam gnyis/ bde gsang / 'khor chen/ kun rig sman bla rnams kyi dbang / 'jam dbyangs dkar dmar/ sgrol ljang / lo gyon ma/'od zer can ma/ rnam 'joms/ dzam nag mgon lha rnam gsum/chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum rnams kyi rjes gnang / rgyan 'jug chos spyod rab gsal gyi lung sogs bka' chos mang bo gsan/ seṅge gshong ma 'go nas rje yab sras gsung 'bum gyi ljags lung / sngags rim chen mo'i zhal lung / mtshan brjod kyi rtsal bshad/ dus 'khor dbang chen bcas gsan/ e waṃ nas be'u bum sngon po'i lung dang brgya rtsa'i phyag khrid/dam tshig rdo rje bzlas pa/ za byed mkha' gro/ maṇ+ḍal/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ 'od dpag med kyi 'pho ba/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub thun mong ba/389

'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i rim gnyis kyi khrid/ rdor dbyangs dbang dngos sta/ bde mchog dril bu'i lus dkyil/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi khrid dang lung / de las byung ba'i rjes gnang bdun/ 'pho khrid gser gyi sgo 'byed kyi lung khrid/ thog mtha'i bla ma brgyud mchod dang bcas bde mchog rgyud 'grel sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung / gung thang rje'i bstod 'grel gyi bshad lung / rje de nyid kyi khyad par 'phags bstod dang lto sprad pa/ lam rim tshigs bcad ma/ bla ma lnga bcu ba/'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo gsum gyi zhal lung / sgrol dkar tshe khrid/'jam lugs tshe dbang / lam rim chen mo'i zhal lung sogs thugs kyi yol gor du bskyil/ gzhan yang— sems bskyed cho ga gnang skabs sems bskyed kyi rdzas su shel phreng dkar bo zhig rje nyid la ched du stsal pa ni dgongs gzhi ha cang che bar mngon no/ /chu rta la rdo rje 'chang gis rdzong dkar la dbyar gsar 'dzugs kyi dgongs pas nyin gsum ring gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung dang phyag len bcas gnang / skabs der bstan pa'i nang mdzod so sor thar ba ris bdun gyi nang nas ches mchog tu gyur pa/ rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par 'phags pa ni dge slong gi sdom pa nyid du gzigs shing / zhing 'dir thub bstan gnas pa'i gtso bo yang 'di kho na nyid la rag las par dgongs pas snyigs dus kyi ston pa mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas 390

bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes te lhar bcas 'jig rten yongs kyi yon gnas dam pa nyid du mngon par bzhengs/ ji ltar nod pa'i bslab gzhi bcas pa'i gnang bkag phra zhing phra ba tshun chad mig 'bras ltar bsrungs pas/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po ches thugs rgyud yongs su gtams par mdzad do/ /de nas rje gsung 'bum gyi ljags lung / 'jigs byed lha bcu pa dang/ spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang rnams dang / rje nyid kyi gsung mgur steng nas blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid/ man ngag bka' brgya ma'i lung / phar phyin gyi dpe khrid bcas gsan/ gzhan yang gya ra'i lta khrid/ dben sa snyan brgyud kyi gcod dbang / bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho'i zhal lung / gsang chen bde lam kyi steng nas 'jigs byed rnam gnyis kyi khrid/ gtsang brgyud rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam gyi gdams ngag ma lus pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan bzhes mdzad de/ bka' chos rgya mtsho'i gter du gyur pas deng dus kyi mkhas dbang gser ri'i phreng ba'i dbus na lhun po ltar mngon par mdzes pa ni zhu mi dgos la/'on kyang 'dir tshig mangs su dogs nas mtshon tsam las ma spros pas rgyas par gzhan las shes dgos so/ /mdor na dgung lo gsum gyi steng bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi drung nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'idabang gi dga' 391

ston thog mar myong ba nas lo grangs nyi shu'i ring la snga phyir dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang tshar drug gsan pa'i mtshon rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi zab gsang gdams pa spyi dang khyad par gnyis med rgyud kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba dang / gsang mtshan snang mdzad rdo rje zhes mtshan gyi rol mo 'khrol te dbang bzhi'i chu bo rdzogs par mnos pas sku bzhi'i sa bon grung bo thebs par mdzad cing / rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mig 'bras ltar gces par bsrungs/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang dang rjes gnang mang bo dang / mdo sngags lam rim sogs rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung rtsa 'grel sogs gzhung chen mo rnams kyi bshad lung dang rtsal khrid mi nyung ba mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i klong du ci yang bskyil/de nas skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen po'i zhabs drung nas 'grel ba don gsal dang rgyan sbyar ba'i bshad lung / skyabs mgon mchog gis sems bskyed mchod pa gnang skabs maṇ+ḍal bshad pa mkhas rgu mtshar ba'i gtam du drangs te phul bas kun ngo mtshar/ rje 'di bas ched du zhus pa ltar mi tra rdor phreng gi dbang yongs rdzogs dang / lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid phur lcog pa'i dogs gcod dang sbrags te rje nyid la lkog chos su stsal/ rdul tshon la brten pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang dang rjes gnang mang bo/ spyod 'jug gi ljags lung bcas kyis mtshon pa'i chos bka' mang bo gnang 392

zhing / gong sa mchog gi gser zhal las/ nga la chos rgyun mang bo thob yod pas ngas khyod la 'don zhes dang / phyis su gsung gi tha mar da nas bdag gi zhal tshab tu khyod nyid bzhugs dgos tshul gyi rim pa rnams lhug par stsal pa ni/ ji ltar 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyis rang gi sras la rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun gyi gan mdzod yongs su gtod pa'i tshul las ma 'das shing / tshul de dang mthun par gong sa mchog gi gsung las skyes pa'i sras kyi thu bo nyid la chos srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag phyag tu gtad de rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba sogs da lta kun la mthun snang du grub pa 'dis kyang rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi mdzad bzang chu zla'i rol ba bzhin 'char ba'i rnam par thar pa ni bsam brjod las 'das pa'i dad ldan re ba'i shing rta rin chen nor gyis gtams so/ /de ltar lung rtogs chos kyi gter du gyur nas zhing 'dir bka' bstan dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i man ngag nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo brgya yangs por phye ste gdul bya rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par dam chos dbyig char ci 'dod 'dod du phab ste/ bshad sgrub bstan pa'i srog shing gcig pur gyur/ de yang bsam sbyor gnyis kas tshul bzhin du gnas lnga kun gzigs smra ba'i nyi ma chen po rdo rje 'chang a bh+ya zhabs dang / yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal bo/mkhas rgu'i gtsug rgyan kun spangs ngag dbang chos ldan/ bdag nyid chen po spyan snga ba dkon mchog phun tshogs/ slob dpon chen po 'jam 393

dbyangs tshul khrims/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros/skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ bka' drin mnyam med 'jigs med lung rigs/ gong sa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma/ rgyud don 'doms mdzad ye shes dpal bzang sogs skyes chen dam pa gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu bcu phrag lhag gi zhabs pad rim bzhin bsten pa las zab rgyas kyi gdams ngag spyi dang bye brag tu rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rje btsun 'jigs med lung rigs zhal snga nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi bklag lung gsan te thugs gsang rgya mtsho'i bcud du bsgrubs/ de'i rjes tsam la ji skad du/ rgyal dbang yab sras kyi 'phrin las ches gsal mod/ /mi dbang bka' khrims dang 'brel ba kha bral bas/ /bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyi dbu 'phang gcig char nyams/ /zhes dang /chos lam drang bo ru bgrod pa sems kyi chu/ /mi rtag nor rdzas dang bstod bkur phra mo'i phyir/ /log lam gcong rong du bab pa bzlog byas na/ /'di phyi gnyis ka ru dge bas brjed med kyis/ /gsungs pas gdams don las log pa'i cher rlom phal mo che rnams kyi khrod na dpa' zhing brtan pa/ mi 'gyur ba'i thugs bskyed kyi kho lag yongs su rdzogs pa mngon du gyur te lha dang bcas pa 'jig rten thams cad kyi mtshungs zla dben pa'i dpung gnyen nyag gcig pur gyur la/ khyad par du yang phyi ru nyan thos 394

kyi spyod pa zhi zhing dul ba/ nang rim gnyis kyi nyams bzhes zab cing brling ba/ de las kyang rgyal sras spyod 'jug thugs skyor gyi sgo nas gzhan don lhur len kho na mdzad pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa'i gnas dam par gyur pa zhu ma dgos so/ /de nas bstan pa yang dar skabs skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal gang gi thugs smon ltar bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid ljongs 'di'i bstan 'gro'i dpal du thog mar byon pa na/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang brgya phrag du ma dang lhan du gdan sa chen po bde chen chos 'khor gling gi chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs zung nye bar bkod de 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i zhal tshab tu mngon par bzhengs pas gser ljongs yangs pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag gi dbugs dbyung ste rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston la ngoms med du rol ba byung /de nas ljongs 'di'i dgon sde so sor rten gsum gyi dod tsam yang med pa'i gzhi nas slar yang rim par yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas pa mtha' dag rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid kyi bka' drin kho na las gzhan du ci/ pha rgod chos kyi rgyal bo kun mkhyen a bh+ya'i rnam thar dang / yab rje sku phreng gi bka' 'bum/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi nang nas dum pa bcu drug tsam dang gzhan yang lung gi skor sogs mang bo dang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa dang / kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rje chen po 395

sogs kyi dbang dngos sta tshad ldan/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub sogs rjes gnang gi skor/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor bshad pa rgyas bsdus/ dam pa'i phyag srol gra ma nyams shing / gru ma zhig pa/ byin rlabs kyi ngad ma yal bar snga phyir lan mang du gnang ba dang / dbang khrid zur bka'i sbyor 'jug kun tu bstan pa yongs rdzogs gru bzhir bsdus te gdul bya'i rang rgyud la phyag gis bzhag 'dra rgyun mi chad par mdzad pa sogs bsam brjod las 'das/ rab rgyan bgrang bya nga lnga lcags bya lor bde chen chos 'khor gling gi 'du khang chen mor rten gyi gtso bo rgyal ba blo bzang thub dbang rin po che'i sku brnyan 'dzam gling gi rten gsum gser ri'i phreng ba'i dbus na gsal brjid ldan zhing gzi 'od 'bar ba'i gser gyi lhun po bzhin gyur pa yab sras bcas bzhengs pa dang / mnyam med thub dbang gi sku sogs mi 'greng las brgal ba bcu phrag lhag rje stong sku che tshad/ lam rim bla brgyud kyi sku sogs brgya phrag lhag bzhengs/ bar shod du rje tsong kha brgyad cu/ yab rje'i 'khrungs rabs/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor/ gsang bdag 'khor chen/ dpag bsam 'khri shing /'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod sogs dang / gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong / thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / mgon chos lha mo sogs dang / gzhan yang rgyal chen bzhi sogs kyi gyan thang ngo mtshar 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa lta bu khyon bsdoms bcu phrag bdun las brgal ba 396

dang / nor bu'i mthongs skor rgyu cha bzang bo'i gos drub nye sras brgyad/gnas brtan bcu drug rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ mgon chos sogs dang /gzhan yang bla mchod tshogs zhing /skyabs 'gro tshogs zhing / lam rim tshogs zhing rnams gtsos bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa'i thang ga ches mang ba rim gyis bzhengs/ gzhan yang rgyu cha gya nom pas gos sku chen mo gsar du bzhengs/ lha khang so ma'am gser gdung khang 'jig la nye bar gzhi nas bslangs te rten gtso gong sa skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen po'i sku gdung mchod rten yid bzhin dbang rgyal 'dzam gling rgyan gcig dngul dkar rgya ma lnga brgyar nye bas bzhengs pa la rin thang bral ba'i rin chen sna tshogs kyi 'phra brgya phrag du mas spras pa phal ba'i blo yul las 'das pa dang / sgo rgyan yang dbus nas gser dngul gyis bzos pa khyad mtshar phul phyin bskrun pa sogs kyi bla na med pa'i mdzad bzang dkar bo'i snang ba mnyam med du spros/gzhan yang rje yab sras gsum/ jo sku/ thugs rje chen po/ yab rje/skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po/ blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho sogs kyi 'dra sku mi tshad las brgal ba dang / rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i stong sku khru gang can/ ltung bshags lha so lnga khru gang can/ bka' bstan cha tshang /gzhan yang gyan thang dang thang ga du ma gsar bzhengs mdzad pa dang grwa sa gsum kar rten gsum mi nyung ba bzhengs grub pa sogs bsam brjod 397

las 'das te rgyas par gzhan las shes dgos so/ /gzhan yang rgyal tshab tham sa cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen pos sgrub pa'i dga' tshal rnams su chibs zhal sgyur ba'i tshe/ sde 'dir yang brtse ba chen pos nye bar gzigs te 'du khang chen mo gsar bzhengs skabs hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi bkra shis don grub kyi nyin rje nyid gtsor bzhugs kyis rje kha so blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las dang / grub sprul 'jigs med chos dbang nyi ma/ dpal nā len+d+ra rong bo dgon chen gyi 'gran gyi do med lnga rig smra ba'i dbang bo dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ skyabs mgon brgyad pa chen po gang gi yongs 'dzin rje dge 'dun bstan 'dzin tshang sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen smra ba zla med 'khor slob bla grwa mang bo bcas bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong blangs te/ gso sbyong so thar gyi mdo 'chad pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa rin po che chad pa 'thud de nyams pa gsos pas gnas dang gnas khang rnams byin gyis brlabs te bkra shis rab gnas kyi cho ga sogs legs mdzad dam pas sa gzhi thams cad la byin chags shing yul mi kun gyis ya rabs kyi las la ngang gis gzhol te bkra shis bde legs kyi rten 'byung bla na med pa'i sgo 'phar phye/ de'i phyis chos sgo 'byed skabs su yang dngos phebs kyis sgar grong kun la 'dod chos mang du stsal te sde 'di'i chos kyi sgo mo gtan pa med par phyes/gzhi bdag gi lha khang sogs la rab gnas mdzad pa dang bstun chos 398

bka' sogs kyis re 'dod tshims par mdzad do/ /mdor na— gdan sa chen po'i bshad sgrub chos kyi 'phrin las kyi skya rengs dang po shar ba nas bzung rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa dang gnyis su med pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ lta sgom spyod gsum sogs rmad byung mtshungs zla ma mchis pa'i mdzad bzang gser gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par thar pa rim dang cig char du bskor te/ dbu sngags bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi bstan pa rin po che dus mthar spel ba'i thugs bskyed bsnyengs pa med par lhur bzhes mdzad pa dang / gdan sa gsum gyi khri skyong khur/ chos 'chad nyan/bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len sogs 'dul ba'i bstan pa rin po che gzhi nas gsos te mnyam med du che 'dzugs gnang ba dang / gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bcas rmang nas med brlags bcom gsum gyis rtsa gtor du btang ba mtha' dag gzhi nas bslangs te slar gso thugs khur gzigs skyong dpe med mdzad pa dang / dad zas gshin zas kyi bdog pa phyag rdzas gang 'byor mtha' dag chud zos su ma btang bar dge 'dun gyi sder bsngos pa dang / gser ljongs yul gyi bstan pa'i gsos gyur bshad sgrub kyi sde ji snyed cig mchis par dngos phebs kyis chos 'dul ba'i bcas khrims dang / dge 'dun gyi nang khrims rnams tshul bzhin du btsugs te chos srid gnyis char gyis legs par bskyangs pa'i thugs rje 399

dang bka' drin la brten nas gangs can ri'i khongs nas shar phyogs gser ldan gyi mtha' la thug gi bar du phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i rang srid kyi grags snyan nyi zla ltar gsal bar byas pa dang / che dgu yongs kyis ched bsngags kyi rol mo'i sgra dbyangs phyogs su 'khrol bas 'jig rten mtha' dag snang bar byas te/mthar sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams smin par mdzad nas rtag 'dzin can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du dgung grangs drug cu re drug rab rgyan bgrang bya gsum pa sbrul lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i dkar tshes lnga la spyi lo1989lor zhi dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /gdung mchod kyang rang gi gdan sa gtsos sgrub sde bco brgyad dang dgon ma lag so lnga rnams dang / mdo dbus gtsang gsum kyi bshad sgrub kyi sde rnams la 'brel ci thogs kyis bsnyen bkur dang dgongs rdzogs la nyin mtshan kun tu 'bad pas/ rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin mtshungs zla ma mchis pa/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'gro ba'i sgron me/ bstan pa'i srog shing gang gi thugs mchog brnyes pa dang rjes 'dzin gyi mtshan ma cir yang snang ngo / /gzhan yang dad ldan ser skya yongs kyi re 'dun ltar sku gdung rin po che gtso bor yab rje bla ma'i gdan sa'i bkra shis pa'i 'du khang chen mo 'jam mgon bla ma'i 'dun sa mchog tu rin po che du mas spud pa dngul gdung byang chub mchod 400

rten bzhengs pa dang / pho brang chen po bkra shis kun smon gling dang /gdan sa rdzong dkar/ ka ring e waṃ dga' tshal rnams la gdung skal dod de re res kyang ci 'byor gyis mchod gdung re bzhengs te skye dgu yongs kyi dad rten du bzhugs pa dang / rgyas par 'dir ma spros pas rtogs brjod dge legs ngo mtshar dbyangs kyi rol mo las shes par bya'o//thub bstan yongs kyi bdag po/ dge ldan bstan pa'i srog shing badz+ra dha ra g.yer gshong 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtsho khong ni/ chos srid kyi lang tsho dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa bis mdo'i khra mig ces bya bar rab byung bcu drug pa'i me phag lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i tshes la spyi lo1947lor mtshan ltas bzang po dang bcas sku bltams/ snga sor sku gong mas snyung tshul skabs gsung gi tha mar/ rten 'dir mdo sngags kyi gzhung sogs la zhib sbyangs ma nus skye ba rting mar bis mdo'i phyogs khyod dang nye bar skyes nas grwa sa chen por zhugs e thub bsam gyin yod/yum dum pa ka zhes paṇa chen chos rgyal bo'i yab chen mgor zhal 'don 'jog bzhin zhal mna' gsungs/ de nas sku gdung bzhu skabs bis mdo'i phyogs nas/ nyin mor skar chen zhig shar bas/ kun gyis phyogs der sprul sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'khrungs nges kyi ltas su 'khums/de nas dgung lo gsum bzhes pa'i tshe/ yang sprul thag gcod skabs/thams cad mkhyen pa skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen pos ang 'du 401

gsum la yang sprul gang yin thag gcod dgos tshul gyi zhu nan sku phyogs chen mo tshang la phul bas 'di ba 'khrul med yin par lung bstan/dbo zla'i bcu gcig la kha dar btang skabs 'brug grags pa dang sbrang char babs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang mang du byung / de nas bis mdo dgon chen du zhal bsgyur te ming btags phul nas mang thos tshul ldan a khu ngag dbang sbyin pas zla ba brgyad kyi ring la ched gnyer gyis bskyangs/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gcig la mkhas grub chen po chu dmar tshang gser kha tshang bis mdo'i yab chen gur mgon tshe brtan dang sku 'khor lhan rgyas bcas sgo dmar dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du bsu sbreng ngo mtshar ba dang bcas gdan drangs/ de nas phyag dbang dang bcas der 'khod tshang ma mi phyed dad pa'i sa la bkod/ phyi de nyin lha babs dus chen dang bstun te chos sde chen po rong bo dgon chen gyi bshad sgrub kyi sde rnams kyi ya gyal/ lo 'dab kyi phang phung rnam par dkrigs pa'i ljon shing sna tshogs pa tshangs chen gyi pir gyis ched du bzos pa ltar kun nas mdzes par bklubs pa/ 'du 'dzis dben zhing dka' thub drang srong dgyes pa'i spyil bu tshar du dngar ba/ phyin pa tsam gyis lus sems la dga' bde dang ngo mtshar ba'i dpal ci yang skyed pa'i dben gnas dam pa g.yer gshong bsam gtan chos 'phel gling zhes mtshan don ldan par zhabs mthil bkra shis kyi re khā mngon par bkod 402

do/ /de nas dgung lo bzhi'i steng bis mdo'i grwa tshang gi rigs smra ba seng chen srab med du 'phyo ba mang bos tshogs gleng dang bcas rten 'byung bla na med pa du ma tshar du bsgrigs pas chos kyi khri 'phang chen por 'khod de chos dang zang zing gi yo lang rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus ston la 'gran po spros/ de tshe rtsi shing las me tog gsar du bzhad pa dang / nang chen ra zhol gyi chu skyes pad dkar 'khri shing las sngar me tog gcig kyang dben/'di lor pad dkar dog po bdun gsar du bzhad pa sogs dge mtshan du ma mthong snang du grub/ de nas bis mdo grwa tshang gi gzhung brgya smra ba nor bu kun 'byung khong bas ka kha dang a ra pa tsa skyabs 'gro sogs bslab skabs dge rgan nas tshogs zhing gi thang ka mdun du bshams te ngo sprod pa'i tshul gyis mdzub 'khrid gnang ba dang 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs bslabs/ tshoms chen du a ka ru'i 'khri shing rtser 'jam dbyangs kyi 'bur sku zhig gdan drangs te bskor ba ma chag par bsag sbyang la 'bad par gdams pas bka' drin mchog tu brtsi/ de nas dgung lo bdun gyi tshe zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta'i dngos slob mog gya mkhan sprul rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho ba sngar nas g.yer gshong du 'brel che bas rje dge 'dun zla grags mog gya mkhan chen gyi dngos slob yin pas chos 'brel zab par brten/ khong gdan drangs te dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung dge tshul sogs dkyus gcig la bsgrubs te mtshan 'jam 403

dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtshor gsol ba la/ ji skad du rje bdag nyid chen pos/ yid kyi shel ni spong sems tshon gyis bsgyur/ /lag pa'i pad+ma lhung bzed bung bas mjos/ /sku yi gser ri dmar ser bla gos kyi/ /mtshams sprin gzhon nus yongs su khebs par gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar brtul zhugs kyi mdzes pa yang dag par blangs so/ /de nas ngang rong nas gzhung brgya smra ba'i gtsug rgyan shes rab rgya mtsho tshang yongs 'dzin du bzhes te phral klog sbyar klog sogs bslabs nas rje sngags 'chang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi lam rim tshigs bcad ma/ bde mchog rgyan 'jug pa sogs thugs 'dzin gnang ste skyor gang thub mdzad/nyin re ting phor stong phrag re 'bul ba dang lhan du skyabs 'gro bla mchod sman thung ltung bshags 'don bzhin brkyangs phyag brgya phrag du ma dang mchod me 'bul skabs smon lam rnam lnga dang byams pas dam bca'i gzungs sogs bsag sbyang la 'bad par byas/ khyad par du 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs lha khang du yongs 'dzin bka' drin can gyi ljags bkod ltar kha che gur kum sbyar te yon chab 'bum dang brkyangs phyag 'bum lhag phul bas bsag sbyang mnog che ba mdzad de bstan 'gror sman pa'i smon 'dun drag po'i rlabs gang che mdzad/ zhal nas de skabs dge rgan gyi thugs gtum po'i rnam pas nga'i spyan lam du/ mar rnying sogs byugs pas thabs du mas bskyangs pas bka' drin ni bsam brjod las 404

'das/ de skabs thugs log sogs gtan nas ma skyes par dad gus chen pos brtson par mdzad pa byung / deng skabs spyan la ma gnod par je gsal du song gshis bka' drin 'khor thabs bral zhes gsungs/ lo gsum gyi ring zhabs pad bsten/ de nas dgung lo bcu gnyis sa khyi la dge rgan dang lhan du slob grwar zhugs te bla grwa mang bo'i khrod du bsdad/ kun gyi bya spyod la gzigs pas skyo snang mi bzad pa dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs te spyan chab mang du stsal pas dbu sngas gsher ba mtshan du mar byung / dge rgan dang kha bral tshe spyan chab dang bcas mchog gsum la gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs mang du mdzad/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsam tshe bzhes chas sogs mi mdzad par khur khyer gyi lhag bsam bzang bos dus 'da' ba byung / res gcig slob grogs shig gis ltad mor u tshugs kyis zhus par/ zhal nas mi zhig gis mi zhig la lta rgyu ci yod ces gsungs pa sogs 'khor ba'i rang bzhin la gdug sbrul gyi tshang ltar gzigs pa sogs rang chas su mnga' bas dgongs gzhi zab par mngon/ de ltar lo bzhi'i bar duḥ khas mnar ba byung / zhal nas de tshe rmi ltas la 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi mdun gyi g.yas phyogs su yongs 'dzin tshang gis nga la gzab spras kyis gzan gnyis brtsegs phul te/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku byon legs shig rten skal du gnang byung bas thugs la da nas ston pa'i gos snam gyon pa'i skal bzang thob song snyam 405

pa'i dga' spro tshad med skyes pa zhig rmis/ de ni phyi de lo chos sgo 'byed pa sogs kyi ltas su mngon par gsungs/ de nas lhod g.yeng gi srol gyis gong sa mkhyen gzigs mchog paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal bo dpal bzang po de nyid kyi chibs kyi kha lo chos sde chen po bis mdo dpal ldan bkra shis thos bsam chos 'khor gling du bsgyur te chos sgo phye bas tshogs gral du zhugs/gong sa mchog gi yab gcig mgon po tshe brtan gyis/ lung rigs smra ba'i khyu mchog mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom gyi dam pa rje ngag dbang dngos grub mchog gi zhabs pad bsten pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad/ de nas zhabs pad bsten tshul yang / rje bdag nyid chen pos/ yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur drin can rje/ /tshul bzhin bsten pa lam gyi rtsa ba ru/ /legs par mthong nas 'bad pa du ma yis/ /gus pa chen pos bsten par zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dgung lo bco lnga nas so dgu'i bar bshes gnyen bsten tshul ma 'phyugs par gnad du 'gro nges kyis bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas thugs mnyes par mdzad de/ bsdus grwa nas bzung gzhung pod sogs la sbyangs pa gsha' ma mdzad de thugs rgyud la sngon med kyi nges 'drongs bla lhag tu 'phel/ lam rim tshigs bcad bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas dang dmar khrid myur lam sogs kyi khrid zhus te gang rgyas gnang ba gsan/ de nas dgung lo nyer dgu shing yos lor shrī nā len+d+ra gnyis pa chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil zhes mtshan snyan nyi zla 406

ltar 'bar ba'i lung rigs smra ba'i dga' tshal dam pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom gyi skyes chen dme shul 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gtugs te/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang bde lam gyi dbu btsugs/ de nas khrums zla'i dkar tshes brgyad la/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i rje nyid mkhan po mdzad/ gsang ste ston pa gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang bo sog po'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang /dus go ba rigs smra tshul khrims rgya mtsho sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang dbus bsnyen par rdzogs te dngos gtsang sbam mtho ba btegs/ de nas phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i 'du khang sogs la mchod me dang dri bzang phul te bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che'i ba dan dkar po srid rtser bsgrengs pas don gnyis rdzogs pa'i rlabs chen spyod pa'i thugs 'dun drag tu btab ste mchod mjal gnang / phyi skor du brkyangs phyag phul ba'i phyag sor sogs la chu bur byung yang ngal ba khyad bsad kyis lhag bsam dkar bos rgyal sras kyi spyod pa phyag tu bstar/ de nas phyir phebs skabs grub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa rgan gya'i brag dkar du gnas mjal du phebs tshe gnas sgor sngags rim chen mo /'khor chen bskyed rim/ rje 'od zer ma'i 'bur sku byon gtsang bcas phyag tu thon/ de ni don la gsang ba mchog gi sgor zhugs te/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi 'khor sgyur chen po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur bar 407

gor ma chag go /de nas bzung dus 'brel gso sbyong ma chag par mdzad de 'dul ba'i bslab bya sogs zhib par bslabs te chos 'dul ba'i phyag len bzhin nyams bzhes mdzad de legs lam gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye/tshes nyer lnga la 'jigs mdzad dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsam gtan gyi bdag 'jug gsung skabs/ mtshan lam du rdo nag po'i pha bong chen po'i steng khar dge rgan tshang gis dkyil 'khor gyi thig mdzub khrid kyis 'di zhes pas mdzub mo btsugs pa dang lhan du dkyil 'khor khra lam mer shar ba rmis/ bdag 'jug gsungs pa'i tshe mi zhig gis bskyed rim sogs pod lnga phul bas rten 'byung bla na med par gyur/ me 'brug tha skar zla ba'i tshes la lum+bi'i tshal gnyis pa sku 'bum byams pa gling du chibs btegs te tshes nyer gnyis lha babs dus chen dang bstun theg chen gso sbyong bzhes te phyi skor la brkyangs phyag phul nas gser sdong chen mor mchod 'bul spus gtsang phul/ de nas chu dkar ri khrod/ dgon rong /gzungs gzhug la pha bong steng du 'bru gsum rang byon du yod pa khri ka'i lha dkar bo'am byams sku rang skyes su grags pa sogs la gnas mjal mdzad skabs dben par gcig tu gzhol ba'i thugs 'dun brtan po 'khrungs/ lo snga mar bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs pa nas bzung dgun gyi lhag sgang la sku srog la ma 'dzem par dka' spyad dang len gyis mkhan po tshang la gsol phye rgya ma brgya dang / las grwa ba sogs la rgya ma lnga bcu re ched 408

gnyer gyis lo ltar phul bas deng sang 'di 'dra dkon zhes brtse bas bka' mchid lhu things pa stsal pa sogs dgyes nyams dpe med mdzad pa byung / zhal nas/ de dus ngan spyod bdo skabs yin pas/ gang la'ang 'dzem med kyis de ltar byas pa sngar gyi sdig sgrib dag yod gsungs/tshul 'di ni don du na mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ 'brom ston pa la khyod kyis tshe gang bor nyams len gyi gtso bor song ba ni/ bla ma tshe btsun tshang la sku g.yog byas pa de sha stag yin gsungs pa ltar gor ma chag go /snga sor gong sa mchog gi spyan snga nas 'jigs mdzad rdo rje dang gsang 'dus kyi dbang / tshe dbang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ 'pho khrid/ mgon chos lnga lcam sring sogs kyi rjes gnang / chos spyod rnams kyi lung sogs dbang lung rjes gnang rgya cher gsan/ dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i chos spyan mnga' ba byams brtse'i rang gzugs a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i mdun nas dgon chen du 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang dang / lcang lung sgar gsar nas bde mchog gi dbang sogs dang gdan sa 'di nas brgya rtsa'i khrid sogs/bkra shis 'khyil nas tshe dbang / spen dkar thang nas sgrol ma'i rjes gnang sogs dang gdugs dkar gyi dbang / a bar the bar nas nyin gsum gyi ring sems bskyed mchod pa sogs mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu bar hor zla bcu gcig pa'i lhag gang la dge rgan dang lhan rgyas kyis 409

brag dkar sprel rdzong du chibs bsgyur skabs/ dge rgan khong ba'i zhabs kyi nywa ste las grang ngar lhag khyad kyis khrag byung ba sogs chos phyir dka' spyad bzod bsran gyis phebs te/ sku phyogs rdo rje 'chang gi mdun nas/rig byed ma dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang tshe dbang sogs gsan te rdo rje 'chang nas gar phebs su khrid nas byin rlabs gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis nye bar bskyangs pa'i skal ba byung / phyis su dge rgan tshang nas bdag nyid chen po 'di ba'i ched du/ gong sa chos kyi rgyal bo paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan zur bung ba gzhon nus yud tsam rol bar zhu 'phrin phul ba'i lan/ bka' shog nang bla mchod bde stong dbyer med ma dang 'grel bas dmigs brtse ma gang mang 'don rgyu dang / de'i don phra rags rtogs par byas nas nyams len du rim bzhin bstar rgyu sogs rang la thob pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus rten chud mi za zhing / thos bsam bshad sgrub la 'bad pa mi lhod pa'i ngos/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyis 'jug pa gung dger skyong ba'i ngang nas zhes sogs bka' shog gsung gi bdud rtsi'i mchod yon spyi bo'i rgyan du thob/ dus gzhi ha cang rtsub ba'i skabs su yongs 'dzin tshang nas dza ya paṇ+ḍi ta blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bla mchod khrid rgyas pa'i steng nas zla gcig ring gsang chos su stsal/ rjes mar sngon sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyis bzhengs pa'i byams pa'i 'dun sar/ dkor gnyer a khu ngag dbang bde chen 410

dang lhan du dri bzang bos sbyar ba yon chab phul te/ bla mchod sogs gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ kun slong dge bas bsngo smon rlabs gang che ngos dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar ba la zhes pa nas bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog ces pa dang mnyam du yongs 'dzin tshang rje nyid kyi sku mdun du phebs pa dang dus mtshungs par brten/ brtse gzigs chen pos bsngags brjod gnang / skyabs khrid skabs sa bcad bcas zin bris su phab/ de nas dgung lo sum cu'i steng dus mthar rtsod med mkhas dbang ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros rdo sbis hor sbrel bar bzhugs skabs/ 'tshams skyes bcas 'phrin yig gi lam nas zhus ngor/ dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs la blo kha rang dbang med par skul ba'i bslab bya thar 'dod yid kyi bcud len zhes bya ba gtsug gi cod pan du thob pa ni 'di lta ste/ na mo gu ru mu ni in+d+ra ya/ yan lag mchog gi skra tshom rtsa nas dregs/ /gur kum 'od chags thub pa'i na bzas g.yogs/ /brje ba rnam gsum sgo nas rab byung gi /sdom pa stsol mdzad mkhan po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dbyangs bzhi gsal byed sum cu'i rtsa ba las/ /rnam par gyes pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i ljon/ /tshig 'dod phral dang sbyor ba'i shes rab mig /'byed mdzad klog gi slob dpon snying nas dran/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gru gzings la brten nas/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gling du nyer khrid de/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i man ngag yid bzhin 411

nor/ /lag tu gtod mkhas drin can bla mar gus/ /gsung rab legs bshad mang du thos kyang thos don bsam dang sgom pas phongs ya rabs lad mo'i kun rtog mang yang mig mthong lag zin grub pa nyung / /mnyan pos tshig sbyor sdeb la mkhas kyang nyams len byin rlabs bcud kyis dben/ /de'i phyir dam pa'i skyes mchog gang nyid dgyes pa'i bslab bya rtsom par gnong / /'on kyang thub bstan nyin byed chu lha'i mkhar/ /rnam par gzhol ba'i dus kyi mjug ma la/ /don dang ldan pa'i tshig sbyor re 'ga' zhig /spel bar su zhig le lo'i mal du mnal/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i zhal las ma thon pa'i/ /zhal gdams bslab bya gsar ba 'dir ma mchis/ /lhag par tshe mjug chos ba'i mal sa ru/ /g.yag ro thon pa bzod med skyo ba'i gnas/ /gang dran smyug rtse 'khyugs pa las byung ba/ /ngang bas chu las 'o ma 'thungs pa'i dpe/ /mkhyen yangs dgyes pa'i gzugs mtshar cha tsam zhig /srid pa lta na lan gcig gzigs mor mdzod/ /skyes nas skad cig tsam yang sdod dbang med/ /la la bgres son la la dar ma'i dus/ /tshe 'di'i grabs gshom mtha' dag 'phro bskyur te/ /'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba bshol du med/ /la la btsas ma thag dang gog shes tsam/ /la la lang tsho dar bab shi ba na/ /skra dkar rgas 'khogs pha mas dur 'debs pa/ /'chi gson go log 'di dag snying re rje/ /nam zhig 'chi nges sems gting thag chod kyang / /lo 'di zla 'di 412

zhag 'dir mi 'chi ba'i/ /dpa' gdeng rang la med pa shes bzhin du/ /rnam g.yeng skyid nyal rgyag 'dod kye ma blun/ /tshul 'di rang rer mngon du gyur na yang / /da dung srid 'byor gri kha'i mngar cha la/ /lce ldag byed 'dod kye hud bsam bzhin du/ /rang nyid mi bzad sdug la sbyar min nam/ /bdag cag 'dod zhen che bas nor bsags pa/ /sbrang mas gzhan phyir 'bad pyo'i bang mdzod bzhin/ /chu thigs tsam yang min par dka' ba'i ngang / /'chi ba'i tshe na 'gyod kyang 'phyis nas gda'/ /rgyu nor longs spyod bang ba brgyar gang yang / /srid 'di spangs nas ga shed 'gro ba'i dus/ /til 'bru tsam yang 'khyer ba'i dbang med na/ /mchod sbyin las la su zhig brtson mi byed/ /'dzam gling 'di la ji ltar tshe ring yang / /lo brgyar sdod pa nyin skar srid mtha' tsam/ /de yi ring la dam chos sgrub pa'i dus/ /'gag tu dril na zhag 'ga' tsam du zad/ /'dod dgu'i gter chen las lhag dal ba'i rten/ /da res tsam zhig rnyed pa'i skal bzang 'dir/ /'di phyi gnyis kar bde ba'i lam sna zhig /ci myur mi 'tshol gzhug la bskyur phod dam/ /sang dang 'jig rten pha rol gang snga la/ /sus kyang gdeng tshod thig pa ma byung phyir/ /rang nyid gtan du bde ba'i thabs tshul la/ /skad cig snga phyir brtson pa lhod med mdzod/ /'chi bar nges shing nam 'chi cha med cing / /'chi tshe chos las phan pa gzhan yod min/ /de slad dam pa'i chos phyir mgo bo la/ /me shor lta 413

bu'i snga 'phyi rtsod par rigs/ /'chi ba mi rtag rtogs pa'i nyams len 'di/ /dam pa'i chos la skul ba'i slob dpon te/ /kha nas bshad shes tsam du ma bzhag par/ /sems steng sbyor ba chos kyi man ngag yin/ /chos zhes bya ba sems rgyud 'chos pa ste/ /nyon mongs dbang gyur rwa ltar gyong ba'i sems/ /dug gsum 'dam rdzab dong las phyir bton te/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam du bkri par bya/ /rang nyid 'khor ba'i 'jigs las grol ba dang / /'gro gzhan 'jigs las skyob pa'i thabs la mkhas/ /dgra gnyen bar mar thugs rje mnyam 'jug cing / /kun gyi don mdzad sangs rgyas nyag gcig nyid/ /tshig bzhi'i skyabs 'gro kha nas 'don shes tsam/ /smra mkhas ne tso bya la'ang yod tsa na/ /gtso bo tshig gi 'khar ba la brten nas/ /don gyi rgan po ldang pa'i thabs 'di gces/ /bden par smra ba de yis gang bstan pa/ /nam yang bslu med gtan gyi bde thabs ston/ /nu 'thung byis pas ma la yid ches ltar/ /'di phyi'i glo snying brang gsum khong la gtod/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la sbyangs pa ma byas par/ /chos pa'i gral du nam yang snyeg mi srid/ /sa gsum brnyes pa'i 'phags pa thogs med bzhin/ /nam yang thos pas ngoms pa med par bya/ /chos phung brgyad khri'i mdo yi phyogs la ni/ /mdo sde mngon pa 'dul ba'i sde snod gsum/ /rgyud kyi phyogs la bla med rnal 'byor rgyud/ /spyod pa dang ni bya ba rgyud sde bzhi/ /mdo rgyud gzhung lugs gting mthal bral ba'i 414

mtshor/ /shes brtson zla med gzigs kyis bgrod pa la/ /thun mong dang ni thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /rig pa'i gnas kyi rkyal la thog mar bslab/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma yi ge ste/ /'bri klog shes pa tsam gyis gar mi phyin/ /sum rtags dag gsum mkhas pa'i gzhung lam du/ /rnam dpyod rta pho ma rgyugs don re chung / /snyan ngag ro bcud rdzogs pa daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung / /mu tig do shal mgrin par rab brgyan te/ /dri za'i dbyangs la 'gran pa'i 'gyur khugs kyis/ /mkhas dgu'i yid kyi brtan pa 'phrogs pa 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog /gang las bsgyur ba'i legs sbyar saṃ skṛ ta'i/ /ka tsan dbyangs gsum sdeb sbyor skar rtsis sogs/ /mkhas pa'i yan lag med du mi rung yin/ /gsung rab yod do cog gi dgongs 'grel ni/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo ste/ /skyes bu chung 'bring gis ni nges 'byung dang / /chen po byang chub sems dang lta ba ston/ /lam gyi rim par zab mo lta ba dang / /rgya chen nges 'byung byang chub sems mchog ste/ /zab rgyas nyis tshogs lam kyi rim pa la/ /'bad pa yod dgus bag chags ci thebs mdzod/ /'khor ba spyi dang so so'i sdug bsngal la/ /'jigs shing skrag nas yid rab 'byung ba'i slad/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i ngang tshul rtogs dgos phyir/ /bstan pa'i gzhi ma mngon pa mdzod la blta/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems dang rgyal sras kyi/ /phar phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi'i spyod pa mchog /sher mdo 415

rgyas 'bring bsdus par gang gsungs pa/ /bstan pa'i gzhung shing pha rol phyin par gsal/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba dngos po bden 'dzin dang / /'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i rigs pa yis/ /gtan la phab pa'i zab mo lta ba'i lam/ /bstan pa'i snying po dbu ma'i gzhung du bstan/ /skyabs gsum yon tan dngos stobs rigs pa yis/ /sgrub byed bstan pa'i lcags ri tshad ma dang / /srid las nges 'byung rnam dag tshul khrims la/ /slob tshul bstan pa'i nang mdzod 'dul bar gsungs/ /de ltar bka' pod chen po lngas bsdus pa'i/ /bka' dang dgongs 'grel glang chen rgyab khal tsam/ /ma tshim sbyong pa'i thugs spobs bskyed dgos kyi/ /be'u bum lag mthil tsam gyis ci la phan/ /thun mong lam kyi gzhi rtsa brtan pa na/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos slob dpon mnyes byas te/ /gsang chen rdo rje theg par 'jug pa ni/ /mthar thug bgrod pa gcig pa'i gzhung lam yin/ /bdag nyid mtshungs med dge ba'i bshes kyis zin/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi rna ba'i yol gor sim/ /da lta yid la brnags pa'i bya gtong zhig /dam pa khyed la rgyang nas gus pas 'bul/ /mdor na rang re rgyal ba'i sku gsum gyi/ /ya gyal sprul ba'i sku zhes mtshan snyan can/ /rang blo rang la lkog tu ma gyur pas/ /don la rang gi nyams tshod gsal ler thig /gang la re ltos 'phya' ba'i ma rgan rnams/ /'di phyir bslu med lam ston mdzad pa la/ /thog mar rang sems 'dul ba 'di las 416

lhag /gnad kyi don po gzhan med thugs la dgongs/ /da ni snyan tshig rol mos ram btegs te/ /mjug don bsdu la nye bar phyogs pa na/ /yid kyi dran rtog gsal ba'i me long du/ /ka phreng ngo mtshar gzugs brnyan 'di ltar shar/ /ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi'i bcud chags pa/ /kha ru gang thon gzhan phab zil mngar can/ /ga nas brtags kyang sems rgyud sbyong ba'i thabs/ /nga ro'i dbyangs la gyer 'di yid tsam gson/ /ca co 'du long dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /cha byad drang srong dgyes pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /ja mar bza' btung ro brgya'i longs spyod kyis/ /nya zla'i dpal bzhin sku mchog dge bar smon/ /tā re tshe gzungs tshad ldan bsnyen pa'i mthus/ /tha mal snang ngor sku tshe yun brtan ngos/ /da dung gzhon zhes phyi bshol ma mdzad par/ /na med rgud med dus na chos la 'bungs/ /patra ltar 'khyogs sems kyi yo bsrangs te/ pha rol phyin gzhung lam gyi rim pa'i don/ /ba mo mgo dang chu ser rkang gi dpes/ /ma lus gdan thog gcig tu dril nas sgoms/ /tsa ri gnyis pa tan tig shel brag tu/ /tsha grang khyad bsad sgom la zhugs 'dod kyang / /dza yi bstan la 'phel 'grib rkyen dbang gis/ /wa mo 'khyugs 'dra'i spyod lam bdag la dkon/ /zhwa ser ba zhes sus kyang khas 'che yang za chog gshin sngas tsam la mgo 'khor na/ /'a cag bstan la zhugs pa'i dgos 'bras de/ /ya ma yongs la don med chud re gzan/ /ra ri'i skyon bral 417

lhag bsam rab dkar des/ /la rgyab lhun po du nga ri'i phang ba nas/ /sha tsha'i gtam gyi phreng ba nor bu'i rdog /sa ga'i yar ngor tshig gi star la brgyus/ /ha cang rgyas min don gyi 'bras bus phyug /a thur go sla bklags pas don kun chub/ /ka mad sum cu'i bya dka'i snyan ngag 'di/ /dbyangs can phyag sor rgyud las nye bar drangs/ /tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dpag bsam ljon shing las/ /smin pa'i bslab 'doms g.yur du dud pa'i 'bras/ /brtse ba'i gter chen mnyes phyir phul ba la/ /tshad gzungs med pa'i dgyes pa skyed gyur cig /mang thos mkhas rnams legs bshad gtam gyis mnyes te ba tshwa'i ro ldan zang zing de ma yin/ /zhi dul btsun pa sdom gtsang mdzad pas mnyes te bslab khrims yal bor smyo spyod de ma yin/ /bstan la bzang ba gzhan phan bya bas gnyes te rang don kho na lhur len de ma yin/ /sprul ba'i sku mchog lung rtogs nor gyis mnyes te 'jig rten bslu brid chos brgyad de ma yin/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchog grub pa'i sde/ /grub chen chos pa sngags 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /skyes phreng rim byon gdong lnga'i khri 'phang la/ /dbang ba'i mchog sprul gang nyid mtshungs zlas dben/ /rgyal bstan pad+mo bzhad pa'i mtsho'i ngogs su/ /bshad sgrub gshog zung bgrad pa'i 'phur lding gis/ /bstan 'gro'i sa chen sman pa'i don slad du/ /ngang bas chos kyi mgrin rnga phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /bgrang bya'i khur thogs 418

btsun gzugs rgan po ngas/ /snying gi dkyil 'khor dbus nas zol med du/ /sprul ba'i skyes mchog gang la re ba'i don/ /dam pa'i byin gyis 'bad med lhun grub shog /ces dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs la blo kha rang dbang med par skul ba'i bslab bya thar 'dod yid kyi bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lung rtogs bstan pa'i gsal byed g.yer gshong sprul ba'i sku rin po che 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtshos 'phrin yig gi lam nas skul ma gnang ba'i ngor/ rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho yab sras kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i gral mtha' ba/ rgan po 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros kyis rab rgyal me sbrul sa ga zla ba'i tshes bzang por gus pas sbyar ba thugs kyi bzhed dgu lhun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa ltar dang / de'i phyis phan tshun thug 'phrad med skabs shig la/ bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi gsol dkar nang de ro brgya'i bcud kyis gtams pas 'tshams zhus bcas phul skabs/ rje nyid nas kyang gsol dkar bkra shis rtags brgyad du ka ra sogs dang bcas gsung shog gnang ba ni/shar nub sa 'dzin 'khyud mor gnas 'cha' bas/ /shākya'i sras gyur phan tshun mdza' ba'i skyes/ /bzhes phor bdud rtsi'i bcud bzang gtams pa 'dis/ /phyis 'byung rten 'brel sgo brgya 'byed par smon/ /zhes rten 'brel kyi bzang skyes bcas rjes 'dzin gyi legs lam ched du stsal/ de dus gser ljongs yangs pa'i skyabs mgon/ gong sa skal ldan bdun pa 419
