chen po zhi bar mnal tshul bstan par/ sku gdung rin po cher byug pa'i bzang drug sogs sman bzang dgu dang mnol bsangs bcas phul/ de nas dgung lo so gcig skabs/ rje nyid 'khrungs gzhi ya cir phebs 'phral/ dkar tshes bzang bo bkra shis pa'i nyin thog mar mjal 'phrad gnang zhing rje nyid kyi zhabs skyes pad dkar chun po spyi bor thob/ de nas rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i gsung spyan ras gzigs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lam rim bsdus don/ sham+bha la'i smon lam sogs kyi lung gsan te dgyes gzigs kyis sems la phan pa'i bslab bya mang du stsal/de nas lan grur phebs skabs khong tshang la chos snam gyi rgyu'i byin rlabs phul/ phyis su lan grur yang yang mjal skabs gsung thor bu 'ga'i lung gsan/ sngar dgung lo so gcig steng gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'dun sa mchog tu/ a lags rin po che'i 'dra par dang tshe ril 'tshams skyes bcas zhu 'phrin phul bas/ thugs brtse ba chen pos/ a lags rin po che'i tshe rabs rjes 'dzin dang lam rim bsdus don gnyis phyag bris su phab nas sku gong ma'i dbu lo skyes dang bcas bka' drin stsal/ dgung lo so gsum steng pe cin du rin po che dang dngos mjal skabs snga sor gnang ba'i phyag bris steng de gnyis kyi ljags lung stsal te 'bral spangs ga'u las 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi phyag tsha dang / gong sa mchog khri mon du bzhugs ring zhal nas kho bo'i 420

mthe'u chung zung gi sen mo srin mdzub dang mnyam na grol bar nges/zhes ga/sungs pa ltar grol ba de dus kyi sen mo ya gcig dang rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rten mchog bla na med pa dang bcas stsal te bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin bskyangs pa'i rang bzhin 'jig rten gyi rgyan du ngom pa byung / de dus lha mo'i tshe gtor rje nyid kyis phyag bstar gyis bzos te phul bas/ snod du bdud rtsi mang du bab pa ril bur phab pas dge mtshan ya mtshan pa byung / de nas gnam lo gsar ba'i dus ston la/ gong sa mchog nyid dang yab yum gtso 'kho/ ra dang lhan rgyas bcas ngoms med du rol ba'i rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston la 'gran pa byung / lo der ri bo rtse lngar phebs grabs skabs dri med gos dar steng phyag tham bcas rin po che nas 'di nyid rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i 'jam dbyangs kyi phyag tu phul zhes gang gsung bka' bzhin ri bo rtse lngar phyin te/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku gang la 'bul rgyu'i nges pa ma zhus stabs/ thog mar mjal ba la 'bul na rten 'brel gyi gnad du che snyam nas mdzad/ de nas ri bo rtse lnga'i lcang skya'i bla brang gnas mjal skabs rgya'i dge slong zhig gis 'jam dbyangs smra seng dzhaiñtsa las grub pa che legs shig dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod bcas phul ba thugs la spro dga' dang bcas rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes 'dzin gyi dge mtshan rmad byung du 'khums/ rgyal zla'i tshes bco lnga la rgyal ba 421

tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sgrub phug bka' yan dong zer ba gnas mjal skabs sgrub phug gi brag ngos chos 'byung gi dbyibs lta bu las sngar med pa'i chu thol byung du brdol bas gnas srung dang der 'khod skye bo mang bos ngo mtshar zhing kun gyis longs spyod pa byung / rjes sor rin po che dang lhan rgyas bcas gnas mjal skabs chu'i dod tsam yang mi snang bar gsungs/ dbus ri sogs la mjal tshe grang ngar che na'ang dka' tshegs khyad bsad kyis phebs te gnas 'brel rlabs chen sgos mchog gsum bslu med rgya mtshor smon 'dun drag pos 'phrin bcol nan chags mdzad de sngon gnam bskos rgyal bo chen pos bzhengs pa/ rgyal ba rnam gnyis spro sangs la phebs pa'i bsti gnas mchog sogs la zhib mjal gnang /phyi de lor gong sa mchog paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'khor tshogs lhan rgyas kyis gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar chu stod zla ba'i nya la chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te dpal ldan bya rgod phung bo'i ri bo chen po'i gnas kyi lte bar chibs btegs/ der gong sa mchog dbur bzhugs kyis 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bdag 'jug chabs cig tu gsungs/ phyi dror yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i khrid dang sham+bha la'i smon lam gyi lung sogs gsan/ de nas sngon paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis gong ma chan lung dgung lo drug cu bzhes tshe dga' ston du tshe dbang bskur ba'i ched du bzhengs pa'i gnas mchog bsdi shis lhun por chibs bsgyur/ sngon paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes 422

kyis bzhengs pa nas bzung 'di lo'i bar lo 'khor sum brgya 'das pa'i dga' ston gsar ba'i lang tsho rdzogs ldan dpal gyi mched zlar ngom/dgung lo so gsum bzhes tshe zla tshes gsal bor ma nges kyang mtshan lam du/bis mdo dgon chen gyi garnyo la'i khri 'phang mthon por/ gong sa mchog paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo de nyid gos ber dang dbu zhwa bcas legs par bsnams te phyag tu thod par 'o mas bkang ba zhig bsnams pa de/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su dge bskos kyi tshul du yod par nyid kyi gsol dkar yu ring du blugs pa ma lus par 'thungs pas thugs la sngar med kyi bde dga' zad mi shes pa byung ba rmis/ tshul 'di ni dgung lo so bzhi'i steng bshad sgrub kyi sde chen po rnams dang khyad par du bis mdo dgon chen dpal ldan bkra shis thos bsam chos 'khor gling sogs kyi chos sgo phye ste 'du khang chen mo sogs gsar bskrun sgos gdul bya'i zhing sa gshin por zab rgyas chos kyi char phab pa'i rten 'byung bla na med pa'i ltas su 'khums/ de nas gong sa mchog gi chibs kyi kha lo mdo dbus gtsang gsum du bsgyur te/ chos sde so so'i dad ldan mang bos bkur ba'i gtsug na 'phrog byed sder lngas bteg pa'i rin chen khrir 'khod de chos srid kyi dpung ba gtum po dam bca' bzhi ldan gyi 'khor los dpal ldan thub pa'i bstan pa spel zhing yangs pa'i rgyal 423

kham sa zhi bder sbyor skabs/ rje nyid sku dbon gyi tshul du phyi bzhin 'brangs te dbang lung sogs gang gsungs mnos te nang thugs kyi sras thu bor gyur pa'i rang zhal gsar du ngom/ de nas chos srid kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i dbu brtsams te bis mdo dgon chen gyi grwa tshang 'du khang gyan lnga can zhig gsar bskrun mdzad/ rong bo dgon chen du tshogs bzhugs gnang skabs chos grwar zhugs te phar phyin chos 'khor gyi tshul las brtsams te thal phreng 'ga' res gyis/ mkhas rlom dag gi rgyud kyi log rtog ngan pa rnams tshar bcad de cha tsam yang phal bas bsgrun par mi nus pa'i mkhas pa thob/ de nas grwa ba bdun brgya lhag la phyag yon sgor bcu gcig dang / mar rgyam gang re/ nyin 'khyongs bcas dang /dgon gzhung la sgor stong gnyis/ gro rgya ma sum stong / phrug thag 'go gsum/ gos chen gyi ka 'phan cha gcig gos g.yung ris ma'i gdugs ser gcig gdan dkar bcu sogs dang/ rten gyi gtso bo gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga nas phyag tu phebs pa dzhairgyu las grub pa 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi sku de nyid sngon ri bo rtse lnga nas gong sa mchog gi spyan sngar gdan drangs te ched dmigs kyis gnas mchog de'i a ga ru'i srog shing la gong sa mchog nas phyag ris phab ste sngar gnang ba'i phyag sen dang paṇa chen sku gong ma'i dbu lo na bza' sogs dang rin chen phye ma bcas gong sa mchog nas phyag bstar gyis gzungs gzhug phul te rab gnas gnang ba'i byin 424

chags can gnas mchog de nas gdan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ rje nga 'dra ma'i dbu zhwa/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'di ba'i phyag tsha 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'bur sku byin can/ ston pa'i sku blugs ma byon gtsang rin po ches rab gnas can/ sa skya bla rdo'i gur gyi sku byin chags pa/ paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs phyags ya gcig bcas phul/ rgyud dus 'khor la yang sgor chig stong lnga brgya re dang ja bag bcu tham pa re phul/ de nas khrums zla'i yar tshes la gong sa mchog bis mdo dgon chen du chibs zhal bsgyur te tshe dbang sogs stsal skabs maṇ+ḍal bshad pa snyan tshig gdangs dbyangs lam nas phul bas dgyes nyams dpe med mdzad/ chos sgo 'byed skabs dang snga phyi thog mtha' bar gsum du/ ri bo rtse lnga nas gdan drangs pa dzhairgyu las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi sku byon gtsang can gyi gzungs gzhug la gong bshad ltar gong sa mchog gi phyag sen ya gcig phyis su gnang ba de dang a ga ru'i srog shing dang rten sna bcas phul pa'i sku byin rlabs can/ gser zangs las grub pa'i lung ston byams pa lag khru gsum can/ shug pa tsan dan gyis bzos pa lung ston byams pa rgyab yol can mi tshad gcig tsam/ khams khang ser rin po che'i ther sham/ ri bo rtse lnga nas gdan drangs pa lhung bzed 'khar gsil chu tshags bcas dang / lha sa'i bka' 'gyur ro cog la na bza' 425

gdong dar glegs shing sogs cha tshang phul/ sgor chig stong / grwa ba re la phyag yon sgor bdun re dang nyin 'khyongs bcas phul/ rjes sor slar yang gong sa mchog chibs bteg ste 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi dbang gnang tshe dbang yon dngos gtsang bcas maṇ+ḍal bshad pa phul bas thugs dgyes pas gsung gleng spyi bor phebs/ sgo dmar dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi chos sgo 'byed skabs/ lum+bi'i tshal gnyis pa chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling nas gdan drangs pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i thub sku byin can/ mar nang rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud 'grel pod gnyis/rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum tshar gcig ston pa'i rdo sku blugs ma byon legs can/ ja bag brgya/ grwa ba bzhi brgya lhag la sgor bdun re/mar rgya ma gang re dang nyin 'khyongs bcas phul/ chu khyi lor rgyal ba byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan gdul bya'i dpal du gzhar yang bskrun pa'i legs lam byung ba na/ rje nyid kyis thorge mtha' bar gsum du thugs la btags te/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs dang thub pa'i dbang bo'i rang bsrel brgya lhag gis thog drangs te sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba mdo dbus gtsang gsum kun nas spyan drangs pa'i rten gyi kha byang ni ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i byams pa'i dkar chag mu tig phreng mdzes su gsal ba ltar dang / gzhan yang sgor sum stong gos kha brgyad cu/ ja bag nyis brgya/gro 426

rgya ma lnga stong bcas gnang ste chos srid gnyis char gyi sgos gzigs bskyongs mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni phran bu bdag lta bus brjod pa'i yul las 'das te gzhal gyis mi lang ngo / /dgung lo so dgu bzhes tshe hor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis lha babs dus chen dang bstun/ gdan sa 'dir chos nyan pa chig khri la nye bar gdugs dkar dbang chen dang legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang sku tshe 'dir thog mar stsal pas gdul bya mtha' dag smin grol gyi lam la bkod de yul gru 'dir dge legs mi zad pa'i byin char phab/ sngar lo mtshan lam du/ byams chen gyi g.yon phyogs su khri stan sum brtsegs steng du rje nyid kyi gding ba btang bar mi mang bos bzhugs gsol 'debs par 'khod pa rmis/phyi de nyin gdan sa 'dir chibs bteg ste mos 'dun ltar lam rim bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas kyi ljags lung stsal skabs/ dad ldan ser skya 'dus spyi nas gdugs dkar dbang chen gyi nan zhu yang yang phul ba dang/ sngon bka' drin mnyam med ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros dpal bzang bos gdul bya rnams rjes 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' lung dang gdugs dkar dbang chen gyi phyag dpe mtshan ldan dam pa'i man ngag bcas lhug par gdams pa spyi bor thob pa phyag tu bstar rgyu'i skal ba byung / lcam sring gi rten thang la gong sa mchog gi phyag par dang rab gnas zhus/ gdan sa dam pa g.yer gshong bsam gtan chos 427

'phel gling gi chos sgo sa tshi zla ba'i dkar tshes bcu gcig la 'byed pa'i tshe/ dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba/ lnga brgya tha ma ba rnams kyi mgon dang skyabs gcig pu/ thams cad mkhyen pa rje mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po dang / kha so sprul ba'i sku rin po che blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las/ 'tsho 'du grub chen 'jigs med chos dbang nyi ma/ mkhan po rdo rje 'chang gi yang sprul skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnams dang / gzhan yang bla sprul du ma dang bshad sgrub kyi sde so so'i dge 'dun pa rnams dang / bis mdo dgon chen gyi rigs smra ba bcas gdan drangs te tshogs gleng dang bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong mdzad de gser khri thams cad mkhyen pas bkra shis gso sbyong gi mdo 'chad de rten 'brel phun tshogs kyi sgo kun nas mtshungs zlas dben par gyur pa byung / mchog sprul sogs la dngos 'bul gzab/ grwa tshang sum brgya tsam la phyag yon sgor bcu gcig re phul/ sprul sku tshang thog mar khri khar phebs te gdan sar bkod nas sku gsung thugs rten/ sgor sum brgya/ ja bag brgya/ chibs rta bcas dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba btegs/de nas rje nyid khri khar phebs te/ mdo sngags kyi lam bzang mtha' dag gi snying bo lam rim bsdus don gyi ljags lung stsal/ sa zla'i nya la dben gnas dam pa bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos sgo phye bar/ bkra shis gso sbyong blangs te so thar gyi mdo gsungs/ ri bo rtse lnga nas spyan drangs pa 428

gser zangs las grub pa thub dpa nga shi sku che legs shig dang sgor stong gcig gos chen gyi gdugs gcig ka 'phan cha gcig bcas bka' drin stsal/ de nas rim par sha sbrang dgon/ spen dkar jisnang /seng ge gshong ya 'go ma 'go'i dgon/ rka sar dgon 'dus bzang chos gling sogs la phyag bteg ste rab gnas dang phyag dbang sgor brgya re bcas stsal te dad ldan mang bo'i rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba mang du bskrun/de nas ngang rong bkra shis chos 'phel gling gi chos sgo 'byed skabs/ ri bo rtse lnga'i gser zangs las grub rdosga'i sman bla'i sku che legs gcig rin po che'i 'dra par phyag tham can/ ting 'phags bskal gsum/ sgor stong gnyis/ ja bag nyis brgya/ grwa ba nyis brgya la sgor lnga re nyin 'khyongs bcas phul/ rjes sor dgung lo so brgyad steng 'du khang 'grub ston du chibs bteg te/ rab gnas chen mo tshugs te/ tshe dbang bcas stsal//tshes brgyad la gsang sgrogs bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling gi chos sgo 'byed pa'i tshe/ ri bo rtse lnga nas gdan drangs pa'i sman bla'i sku gcig sgor stong gnyis/ ja bag nyis brgya/ gdan dkar bcu tham pa/ grwa ba nyis brgya la phyag yon sgor bdun re phul/ bkra shis gso sbyong dang so thar gyi mdo gsungs/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i khrid bcas dang / rjes sor dgung lo so bdun steng 'du khang gsar bskrun gyi chos ston du chibs bsgyur te/rab gnas chen mo dang tshe dbang sogs stsal/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 429

rin po che sgo thams cad nas dar rgyas su spel ba dang / 'dus sde rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang ngos thos bsam sogs la brtson pa lhod med kyis zhes pa'i zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i bcud bzang skal ldan rnams kyi dad pa'i snying por phog yar lam ko'u ba dgon du phebs te rab gnas gsungs te phyag dbang stsal/ de nas la mo bde chen du phyag bteg/ 'du /b.ri sogs la rab gnas dang phyag dbang bcas gnang / gcan tsha'i sgar khar dad ldan rnams la tshe dbang phyag dbang / rin po che'i 'dra par phyag tham can/ gos chen gyi bla bre ja bag lnga bcu/ sgor lnga brgya sogs stsal te smin grol la bkod/ dgung lo so brgyad bzhes tshe mtsho sngon po jo bskor dgon par phebs te gong sa mchog gyi sku par phyag tham can/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i khrid dang sgor chig stong phyag dbang bcas bka' drin stsal te/'du khang gsar bskrun gyi ljags bkod gdams/dus der dgon 'go bteg/ so dgu bzhes thog dgon rung brag skya rdo rje rdzong gi chos sgo 'byed skabs/ bkra shis gso sbyong dang so thar gyi mdo 'chad/ tshe dbang gnang / grwa ba brgya lhag la sgor bdun re dang nyin 'khyongs bcas nyin nyi shu lhag bzhugs/ 'du khang bzheng thebs la sgor sum stong stsal te so so'i 'dun mos bskangs/ rim bzhin rdo sbis dgu ri'i grwa tshang bse chang / lcang shar sgar/ gdong sna'i sgar/ dmag dpon sgom ra/ mdo rtse sgar bis thang la ka ka ring lung yon thang sogs la 430

yang yang chibs bteg ste yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i lung sogs dang sgor brgya re phyag dbang bcas bka' drin bskyangs/ rma chu'i spyi rdzas dgon du bkra shis gso sbyong dang / so thar gyi mdo 'chad/ 'du khang sogs la rab gnas dang / dpal ldan lha mo'i sman sku lag khru gsum can dang phyag dbang bcas stsal/ dgung lo so lnga'i lcags bya dka' thub zla ba'i tshes la mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang bo ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bka' drin mtshungs med 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros tshang rgya zhur du bzhugs ring / rje nyid gtsos phran bu dang bcas gsan mkhan lnga bcur nye bar 'jam dpal zhal lung dang gzungs gzhug 'bul chog shel dkar me long dang 'khrul spong nyid byed sogs kyi mdzub khrid dang rtogs brjod dngul gyi me tog gi lung bcas bgo skal mnos/ dgung lo so drug steng mtshungs med paṇ+ḍi ta a bh+ya mtshan can bis mdo dgon chen du ched gnyer gyis zhus te dbyar bzhugs gnang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ dbyangs can ma/ mgon chos lnga dang gur sogs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ sngon 'gro khrid chen bzhi/ sman chog chen mo dang rgyan 'jug sogs kyi lung / zhar byung sum rtags dag gsum bcas gsan/ bsgrub bya brgya lhag bsnyen rdzogs la 'god skabs rje nyid gsang ston mkhan po mdzad/ phyi de lo hor zla drug pa'i nang dge ldan bstan pa'i chu mgo dpal ldan bya khyung theg chen yon tan dar rgyas gling 431

nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi pod bcu gsum gsan/ bya khyung gdan rabs sogs kyi lung / bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang / 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang cha tshang / mkha' spyod ma'i dbang lung zur bka' mang du gsan/ de skabs a ra pa tsa'i sgrub phug tu gos chen gyi bla bre spus gtsang dad gdung drag sdo+os/ phul te bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs smon rgya cher btab par brten smon don 'grub pa'i re 'bras su de'i drang thad du 'ja' 'od skum po dkar gsal can shar bas/ bcu phrag rig pa'i dbang bo a lags shar gdong tshang dang der 'khod pa rnams kyi mthun snang du byung / chos sde de'i re 'dod bzhin so thar gyi mdo gsungs/ zhal nas de dus 'ja' 'od dkar gsal can lan gsum du shar ba byung zhes gsungs/dgun lan gru nas zla ba gnyis ring kirti'i sdom gsum gyi bslab bya dang sor mdo'i khrid/ 'dul ba'i las chog phyag rgyun 'bog chog bcas cha tshang bar rgya cher gsan/ snyan ngag spyi don gyi khrid gang rgyas gnang ba thugs brtson chen pos sbyangs pa phul byin mdzad/ de skabs khrid rgyugs kun bzang 'khor lo zhig 'phul tshe/ bla ma mchog nas dgyes 'dzum dpe med mdzad de deng skabs 'di 'dra'i rtsom mkhan dkon zhes bsngags brjod kun da'i chun po gtsug gi rgyan du thob/ de dus gsung 'phros su snga yan 'phral du rtsom 'phror bri dgos zhes shar gdong tshang la thugs 432

gtsigs kyi zhal chems stsal/ skabs 'di'i kun bzang 'khor lo ni gzhan na gsal ba'i der gzigs par zhu/ de dus bla ma mchog la chos gos dngos kyi byin rlabs phul/ dgung lo so brgyad shing byi mchu zla'i tshes bco brgyad nas bis mdo dgon chen du bla ma mchog gi gam nas bka' 'gyur sher phyin pod nyer gcig gi ljags lung dang / gdugs dkar dbang chen lha so bdun ma'i dbang dang legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gdugs dkar bzlog chen gyi lung / rgyud bzhi'i man ngag rgyud ma gtogs phyi ma gsum gyi lung / gzhan yang bka' rgya ma'i man ngag gi skor sogs gsang chos su mang du stsal pa rnams 'dir zhib par ma spros so/ /de yang mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gdams pa mtha' dag lo dgu'i ring bum pa gang byo'i tshul du legs par gsan pas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i bdag po'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol lo/ /de nas bla ma mchog nyid zhi bar mnal ba'i tshul bstan par/ dgongs rdzogs la yon chab dang mchod me sogs rgya cher phul te gsol 'debs gdung shugs drag pos thugs mchog mnyes pa'i mchod pa ci nus mdzad/ de dus sku gdung yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyi ched du tan tig dgon dang tshe tan dgon gnyis ka ma mthun pas rtsod gleng byung ba na/ shar gdong tshang dang khong rnam gnyis kyis thabs mkhas pa'i sgo nas/ tshe tan dgon la sku gdung gi 433

tshab tu rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog cha tshang gnang ba sogs kyis 'dumatshopar mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang rtswa sa'i rtsod gleng sogs rong 'brog du ma la chos srid nyis char gyi sgos 'dum par byed pa'i mdzad bzang rgya bod kun gyis bsngags gnas su gyur/ dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa'i tshe bis mdo grwa tshang gi 'du khang ngan mo'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i dbu btsugs/ sgos su byams khang ched gnyer gyis phyag yon btang ste mdzes bkod ldan pa'i thog so gsum can la tshon rtsi bcas phul phyin du grub/ de nas byams pa'i sku tshad lag khru nyer lnga can bzo bo rtser son pa seṅge gshong rgya mtsho dang sgo dmar mang thos tshul ldan ngag dbang rgya mtsho sogs kyis bzhengs/ g.yas phyogs su rje sku mi tshad las 'das pa rgyab yol du rje gzigs pa lnga ldan dang / g.yon phyogs su rje sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyi 'dra sku la 'jam dbyangs rigs lngas bskor pa'i rgyab yol can/ rje stong sku 'bur sku can/ gyan thang bdun bcas rten brten pa 'gro ba'i zhing du bskrun par mdzad/ 'du khang chen mor gong sa mchog gi sku mi 'greng tsam las brgal ba/ lha sa'i bka' 'gyur la gos thum gdong dar glegs thag glegs shing bcas cha tshang / sku gdung gi sgo rgyan gyi phra la byu ru che ba brgya/sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyi 'khrungs rabs kyi thang ga che legs gcig sogs bzhengs/ dgung lo zhe gcig steng rab rgyan me yos dbo zla'i gral 434

tshes nyer brgyad la/ mkhas dbang dam pa yongs 'dzin blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho tshang snga phyir yang yang zhu nan gyis g.yer gshong du gdan drangs te zla ba gnyis ring / lam sngags gnyis kyi zhal lung / bde mchog gi sta gon sngon du btang ste/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum kun rig sman bla thugs rje chen po rnams kyi dbang / rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang / bde mchog dang 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu'i rjes gnang / mgon chos lnga bo'i rjes gnang sogs rgya cher gsan te gtang rag maṇ+ḍal gyi dod tsam 'bul ba ni 'di ltar/ gser zangs kyi tshe dpag med kyi sku mtho gang tsam/ ting 'phags bskal gsum/ dzhaiṣ+ṭṛ las grub pa'i mchod rten lag khru gang can/ li'i maṇ+ḍal/ rdo dril/dung dkar cha/ na bza' cha tshang / sku thul/ zla gam bzhugs gdan sogs cha tshang / gos rnam grangs lnga/ sgor khri gcig ja bag brgya/chibs rta/ sa gdan gyan gang can/ gdan dkar dmar/ phrug thag 'go bcas phul/ chos nyan pa rnams la sgor gsum re kha dar bcas phul te/ bla ma mchog gi thugs mchog mnyes pa'i thabs ci nus kyis mdzad de 'phral phugs kyi don bla lhag tu grub pas rdzogs ldan dpal gyi mched zlar gyur/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes la gong sa mchog paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal bo blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po 'khor brgya phrag dang bcas pa lugs gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyi 435

bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas bis mdo dgon chen gyi 'du khang chen mo sogs rten brten pa gsar bskrun gyi dga' ston du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar/ sras kyi thu bo nyid nas kyang ser sbreng sogs mchod bsus kyi rim pa zad du med pa'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba bcas rgya cher bsus te/gdong lngas bteg pa'i chos kyi khri 'phang gi yang rtser zhabs mthil bkra shis kyi ri mo mngon par bkod do/ /de nas zhu tshig me tog gi chun po snyim pa'i mthil du bzung ste gus pa bla na med pa dang bcas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar lan du mar gsol ba btab ste/ ston pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sems bskyed mchod pa sogs chos char dgung nas phab ste gdul bya sa'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa smin grol la bkod pa sogs bskal pa bzang po'i dpal las lhag pa mngon du gyur pa na/ rje nyid nas gos dar sna lngas spras pa'i chos dung cha bcas dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba btegs te maṇ+ḍal bshad pa sogs phul te thugs mchog mnyes pa'i mchod sprin dpag med spros/ byams khang rten brten par rab gnas zhus te/ bang ja lnga bcu tham pa/ sgo ra stong gnyis bcas phul/ de nas rje nyid kyi 'khrungs yul du gdan drangs te rab gnas phyag dbang stsal/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mtshon tsam du/ tshe dpag med kyi li sku byon legs cig dga' ldan dpar rnying gi lam sngags/ li ma'i mchod rten rang byon/ dngul gyi ga'u byon gtsang khru gang / sku gong ma'i 436

ba so'i ḍā ma ru dang rdo dril khru gang can / ri dwags sa le'i rwa lag khru do can/ byu ru'i phreng ba tshad ldan/ tsab phor dngul shan can/ ba so'i gsol thur/ lnga bcu ma/ bcu kho/ lnga kho/ sgor chig stong /na bza' cha tshang / gzim mal cha tshang / gsol dkar/ za 'og sogs gos rnam grangs lnga bcas kun tu bzang po'i mchod tshogs zad mi shes pa rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod par spros te snying nas dad pa'i snyim pa dpangs mtho bas nye bar btegs te gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi smon don 'grub pa'i rjes 'dzin gyi dngos grub zhus/ de nas sngar mtshungs med bla ma mchog gis bka' nan ltar bis mdo nas bsgrub bya brgya lhag bsnyen rdzogs la bkod/ han gya zir chibs bteg ste bkra shis gso sbyong dang so thar gyi mdo gsungs/ rten skal du ting 'phags bskal gsum/ lam rim dang sngags rim chen mo/ sgor brgya bcas bka' drin stsal te 'dod mos tshims par mdzad/ dgon 'go btags/ de nas g.yer gshong bsam gtan chos 'phel gling gi 'du khang rten brten pa gsar bskrun bgyis pa'i dga' ston du/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bdun la ser sbreng sogs rgya cher bsus te/ lho rgyud gru 'dzin zhing gi mgon po'i gdung 'tshob dam pa lung rtogs kyi yon tan rmad du byung ba'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur pa rje mkhas btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos gtsos/ bla sprul du ma dang grwa ba bdun brgya lhag spyan drangs te/ sri zhu 437

dang bsten bkur rgya cher spros/ rje nyid la thub sku li ma byin can/ lam rim dang sngags rim/ mchod rten/ sgor chig stong / phrug gos sogs dngos 'bul btegs/ gong sa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa yab yum dang yongs 'dzin tshang yab chen sogs la sgor nyis stong phul/ grwa ba rer sgor bcu dang ja bag re/ gdan sa'i grwa ba rnams la sgor nyi shu dang ja bag gnyis re nyin 'khyongs bcas phul/ 'du khango rten brten pa gsar bskrun gyi dga' ston gsar ba'i lang tsho ngoms med du rol ba byung /'du khang nang rten gyi rim pa ni/ jo sku/ rje sku/ mnyam med jo bo rje'i sku rnams mi tshad las 'das pa re/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs blo gros tshang gi 'dra sku/ 'od dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa sogs kyi sku lag khru gang re/ shug pa tsan dan gyi lung ston byams pa'i sku/ lha sa nas gdan drangs pa'i bka' 'gyur tshar gcigasde dge'i bka' bstan/ rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum tshar gsum/ yum dum pa bcu gnyis tshar gnyis/ gyan thang nyer lnga/ chos pa rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs/ gnas brtan rtogs brjod/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum dus 'khor/ sman bla sogs kyi dkyil 'khor bcas thang ga lnga bcu lhagachos pa rin po che nas sku phreng drug gi gdung rus rnams dngul gyi mchod rten gyan gang can che legs shig bzhengs pa la g.yu byur sogs rin chen mang bo'i 'phras brgyan pa/ sgo rgyan dbus nas dngul gyis mdzes par 438

bskrun pa'i khyad 'phags dngos gtsang bskrun/ bis mdo dgon chen gyi byams khang rten brten pa g.yer gshong gi 'du khang rten brten pa sogs la rag rtsis kyis khyon bsdoms sgor khri phrag sum cu lhag btang / zhal nas ngas gshin zas dang dad zas ci 'byor ba mtha' dag chud zas su ma btang bar dge ba'i phyogs la bkol ba ma gtogs rang sger btang ba mi dran gsungs/ de ni sems dpa' chen po'i ngang tshul mngon du gyur te dgongs gzhi zab par mngon/ rgyal zla'i tshes gsum la bsu ba ser sbreng gi bkur ste bcas dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du chibs bteg ste ser skya kun la phyag dbang bcas stsal/ de nas grwa rgan gzhon kun la chos 'dul ba'i bcas khrims sogs gang cha nas do dam gang drag sgos bslab 'doms dang sems la phan pa'i bka' mchid mang du stsal/ der sa 'brug gi gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi dgyes ston dpe med mdzad de/'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i rang bstan nam mkha' ji srid bar mi nyams dar rgyas su 'phel ba dang / dag zhing sham+bha lar rig 'dzin grags pa'i mgon po'i zab gsang chos kyi bdud rtsi'i longs la rol phyir/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten dang bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad sogs las bzo ba rnams dang ser skya yongs kyis brtson pa shugs drag sgos ma bul bar 'grub dgos kyi bka' bkod lhu things pa stsal te/ lo snga phyir sgor chig khri chig stong / gser gyi sor 439

gdub bzhi/ ja bag brgya/ gos yug sogs kyi bka' drin stsal/ de nas nyin ltar smon lam chen mo'i tshogs mgor phebs te ser skya drag zhan bar ma kun gyi yid gyi re 'dod tshims par mdzad/ der bzhugs ring phran bus chos sde de'i lo rgyus 'bri khul byed skabs dri med lha dar dang bcas rje nyid kyi rnam par thar pa gsung dgos pa'i lhag bsam gyis zhu nan dang chabs cig tu gzhan rten 'brel mi mtshan ma rang chas su 'grig par brten 'phral du brtse gzigs kyis rje btsun bla ma mchog nyid dgung lo zhe gcig me yos rgyal zlar rnam thar gyi sa bon tsam gsungs pa 'di nyid phran bus rje nyid kyi gsung sgros ltar che brjod dang sgro skur spangs te zin bris su btab bo/ /de nas tshes bcu gcig la gdan sa chen po rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling du chibs zhal bsgyur te cho 'phrul smon lam dang gsung chos chen mo'i tshogs dbur nyin lnga'i ring phebs te der 'khod kyi dad ldan kun la phyag dbang bcas stsal pas dad pa'i sa la nye bar bkod do//gzhan yang skyabs mgon rong ston phyag na pad+ma'i rgyal tshab tu bzhugs te gdan sa chen po rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen gtsos sgrub pa'i — sde rnams chos srid gnyis char gyis ji ltar bskyangs pa rnams gzhan du gsal ba dang / khyad par du reb gong gser mo ljongs pa rnams kyi lha skal gcig pu skyabs mgon skal ldan brgyad pa mchog gis/ yongs 440

rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi zhabs pad spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhes te/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul ba dang / rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis kyang skabs mgon mchog gi rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs te spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin thabs mkhas kyis bskyazus te zhabs 'degs mdzad pa rnams rnam thar du gsal bas 'dir 'jigs nas ma bris so//rab rgyan nyag ma bzhi ba lcags rta la spyi lo1990'jam dbyangs kun gzigs 'dun sa mdo sngags chos 'dzin lha khang rten dang brten pa nye bar bzhengs te/ nang rten gtso bo 'jam dbyangs kun tu gzigs pa'i sku'i mtho tshad khang brtsegs gsum can dang / de'i g.yas g.yon khri'i steng du rje btsun chos pa yab sras mi tshad las brgal ba re bzhengs pa dang / sku phreng bdun pa'i bar gyi 'dra sku mi 'greng tsam las brgal ba re bzhengs pa rnams la gser chab phul te rab tu gnas pa sogs kyi sgo nas gzi byin phab/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa lañdza sum rkang can shog nag tu phab te gser bzang pos legs par bzhengs pa la/rin chen gnyis pa'i glegs shing steng bzo bo mkhas pa'i phul byung bzo rtsal gyis mdzes ris nor 'dzin pa tra la rin thang bral ba'i rin chen sna tshogs kyi phras spud pa dang / spus legs za 'og gi na bza' rim pa lnga dang / dngul gyi gdung dar la pa tra ris brgyan pa sogs srid na 441

dkon pa'i bzo bkod phun sum tshogs shing ngo mtshar ba 'jig rten kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsi dang yid gsos dam par gyur pa la/ lta na sdug pa'i khang bzang gis brgyan te phyogs bzhir shel sgos mdzes par byas pa sogs smra bsam las 'das/ 'di'i 'gro gron rags rtsis ltar na khyon bsdoms dmangs sgor khri bco lnga lhag song ba dang / gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bcas la spyi sdom rags rtsis brgyab na 'gro song dmangs sgor khri brgya tham par nye ba dang / rin chen gser bzang bo rgya ma gang can gyi mchod rkong mdzes sdug ldan pa dang / dngul theb che legs bdun tshar dang / dngul rkong mtshan thub khri do la nye ba legs cha can rnams gtsos rin gong ldan pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ gos za 'og gi bla bre/lda ldi sogs mchod pa'i yo byad gya nom pas bar mtshams med par brgyan pa zhig go /der ma zad gtsug lag khang sum thog gi dbus su rgyu tsan dan dang shug pas dpal yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi blos bslangs khyad 'phags bzhengs pa dang / phyogs kyi gyan rnams la log ris rgya chen spyod brgyud dang / zab mo lta brgyud sogs kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams bzhengs pa dang / bar shod kyi mtha' skor du chos pa yab sras kyi 'khrungs rabs dang / rje stong sku byon legs can phul phyin bzhengs pa rnams bar shod dang / 'og shod kyi kun dga' ra ba rnams su mthar chags su bzhugs pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog sogs gsung gi rim pa rnams 442

bzhugs pa dang / nang gi kha yar 'khor gyi gyan rnams la mgon chos sogs kyi gyan thang bzhengs pa dang / phyi'i khyams kyi gyan brgyad la rgyal ba seng gengs ro'i zhing bkod dang / 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs zhing bkod sogs zhing bkod kyi rim pa rnams dang / sgo 'gram gnyis la rgyal chen bzhi rnams tshangs pa'i pir rtse yang dman par byed pa'i bzo bo pir thogs dbang bo dag gis bzos pa rnams sgyu rtsal 'bur thon byung ba mig mthong lag zin du grub pa ltar lags so/ /gan rnyo la'i yang steng rnams su g.yu yi rgya phibs dang gser gyi gañdzir/ rgyal mtshan/ ri dwags pho mo dang chos 'khor/ spen rgyan sogs kyis mdzes par spud pas sum rtsen khang bzang yang 'dir 'phos pa ltar ya mtshan pa'i gnas gcig pur gyur/ de ltar gtsug lag khang rten brten pa legs par bzhengs grub byung bar bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo rgya cher spel te/gdan sa'i bla grwa chig stong nye bar nyin 'khyongs kyis bsnyen bkur bsam kyi mi khyab pa dang / reb gong gser mo ljongs pa rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal gcig pu/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i yang sprul skal ldan brgyad pa chen po mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu bstan 'dzin 'jigs med skal ldan mchog gtsug lag khang gi dbus mi 'jigs seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin chen khri 'phang mthon por spyan drangs te/ rab tu gnas pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi byin phab pa sogs 443

bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo brgya bsgrigs/ rigs kyi bdag po rje nyid kyis sku gsung thugs rten gyi 'bul bas thog drangs te zang zing gi bdog pa yod do cog dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba btegs te/ bka' mchid dmigs phigs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don thugs la nan chen bzhes dgos tshul gyi 'bel gtam mam bshade pa bsnyel mi thub pa'i bka' drin bla lhag tu spel te bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad bzang yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad/ skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang 'gran gyi do med skyabs kyi dam par mchod de dbang lung khrid sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa gang nus kyis mnos pa'i sgo nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas thugs gang dgyes mdzad/ dgung lo zhe dgu bzhes pa'i tshe yi dam khyad par can rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzhi bsnyen chen mor thugs dam mdzad de lung rtogs kyi yon tan klong du brdol bas mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa la phan rlabs ngo mtshar ba byung ba sogs so skye rnams kyi bsam brjod las 'das pa'i bka' drin su zhig gis dpog par nus/ yin na yang re zhig rtag 'dzin can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du dang /gdul bya rnams rdzogs pa na dgung lo lnga bcu'i steng / spyi lo1995hor zla dang bo tshes bco brgyad la dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de nas nang thugs kyi sras po skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa gtsor mdzad de skal ldan gyi bu slob mang po dang / gdan sa 444

gsum gyi bla slob grwa rgan gzhon thams cad kyi thugs mdun bzhin sku gdung rin po che cha tshang gdan sa 'dir gdan drangs te/ reb gong rong 'brog gi dad ldan mang bos dngos 'byor yod dgu phul nas sku dbon dam pa bslab gsum rgyan ldan a khu nor bu'am ban+des sku gdung bzhengs pa'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di'i gtso 'gan bzhes te/ 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs mdo sngags chos 'dzin gang gi 'dun sa mchog tu mtho tshad khru tsi bco lnga dang tshun lnga can gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten gser gdung chen mo yid bzhin dbang rgyal byin rlabs gter mdzod lo snga phyir bzhengs pa la rin po che be+eḍūr+ya dang margad sogs rin thang bral ba'i phra sna tshogs kyis spud pa dang / bzo dbyibs dang tsi pa tra gdong lnga sogs kyi bzo rtsal ni gson nyams ldan zhing mdzes ris kyi khyad chas 'bur thon byung ba sogs sna sgor mo nas bla nas blar 'phags pas 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod pa'i rten gcig pur gyur/ dus tshes bzang bor gser gdung chen mo las 'od zer 'phros te byin rlabs kyi dri bsung phyogs kun tu khyab pa sogs kyis skal ldan gyi gdul bya mtha' dag dad pa'i sa la bkod nas snga na med pa'i yid gsos dam par gyur to/ /gser gdung chen mo'i gser dang dngul gyi 'gro gron khyon bsdoms dmangs sgor khri drug cu lhag btang ste bzhengs pa ni bsam brjod las 'das pa zhig yin no/ /bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad skabs su rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling 'di ru 445

yang yang zhabs bteg ste chos srid kyi mdzad sgo yangs por phye ba dang /sgos su rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan rten brten pa bcas gsar du bzhengs pa'i tshe rje nyid dngos phebs kyis bka' bkod lhu things pa stsal te gzungs 'bul sogs phyag bstar gyis byin rlabs gyi char chen phab nas brtse gzigs kyis ji ltar bskyangs pa'i bka' drin ni bsam brjod las 'das pas/ sde 'dis 'gran gyi do med bka' drin ches mchog tu brtsis te/ mtshan tsam thos pas kyang ser skya byings kyis thal mo sbyar ba'i tshod du gda' 'o//mdo sngags bstan pa'i srog shing / mkhas dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa skyabs rje kirti blo bzang 'phrin las khong tshang yang phyogs 'dir bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad skabs/ chos sde 'dir yang zhabs sor bskyod de tshogs mang la chos bka' mang du stsal pa'i bka' drin bskyangs/bka' chos skabs shig la dgyes 'dzum gyis khri thog nas khyed rnams gral mjug la ltos dang gsungs/ thams cad kyis bltas tsa na chos skyong dpal ldan ma'i gyan thang gi snyan dar du ma sa la lhung ba mthong / zhal nas de ni bstan srung dgyes pa'i mtshan ma red ces gsungs pa sogs ya mtshan pa mang ngo //grub pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes ngo mtshar ba'i skyes bu rwa rgya g.yu rngog rin chen rdo rje nyid gdan sa 'dir dngos phebs kyis 'od dpag 446

med kyi stong mchod kyi cho ga tshogs 'don du btsugs te 'don rta dbyangs gsum dang phyag len rgyas par bstan pa'i sgo nas bsod nams bsag pa'i sgo yangs por phyes/ 'dir rgyun phebs kyis bka' chos mang du stsal/grong ri dgon gyi sgos chos su klu dbang rgyal bo'i stong thang bzhengs pa dang / 'phags mchog seng ge sgra'i 'khor lo dung phyur can rje nyid kyi phyag yon gyis bzhengs/ theb tse che legs bdun tshar gcig dang mar me rgyun mchod bcas kyi thebs rtsa bzhag ste chos sde 'dir chos 'brel las 'brel ha cang che bas kun kyis bka' drin mchog tu che bar bkur/ sman tshong dpon slob yang sprul mchog gis kyang gdan sa 'di thugs la btags te chos srid gnyis char gyis bskyangs pa dang / 'jam mgon bstan pa'i gsal byed lugs gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo kha so rje blo bzang 'jigs med 'phrin las dang / grub sprul 'jigs med chos dbang nyi ma/skyabs rje dam pa rong rgan rje dge 'dun dar rgyas rgya mtsho sogs mtha' yas zhing na yang mu med rgyal ba rgya mtshos bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'thor ba'i bstan pa'i gsos gyur mi yi khyu mchog rgyal ba'i sras po rnams mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i tshul gyis gdan sa 'dir dngos phebs kyis/ spyir thub pa'i bstan pa spyi dang / sgos su 'jam mgon rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa rin po che nyams pa sor chud dang /ma nyams gong 'phel du phyag rjes bla ne+e med pas khyab par mdzad pas skye 'gro 447

yongs kyi dbugs dbyung bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang rong bo dgon chen thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi gral mtha' ba sgo dmar blo bzang dge 'dun ni/ spyir na bdag lta bu la yi ge'i ris su 'khod pa'i yon tan ni ri bong rwa'i mtshungs zlar gyur kyang ha cang phongs na yang /sde 'di'i blo ldan gzur gnas dag gis yang yang bskul bar brten/ chos sde 'dir chos ldan gyi bya ba phran bu re ram 'degs bgyis pa rnams mos 'dun bzhin dran rten du mdo tsam dgod par spro'o/ /des na ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid rtser g.yo ba sar gnas sems dpa' chen po gang gi gdan sa dam par bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag 'gro ba'i sgron me 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pur gyur pa dag rim gyis zhabs kyis bcags te byin gyis brlabs shing skal ldan gdul bya mtha' yas pa 'dod dgu'i char gyis tshims par mdzad na yang / bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis re zhig la ya nga ba'i gnas su gyur pa zhu ma dgos la/ 'on kyang bstan pa yang dar 'dir ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta'i yang sprul mchog kyang brtse bas bor zhing dwa phrug ltar shul du lus pa'i tshe/ thugs rje gter chen 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo gser ljongs bstan pa'i bdag po rnam 'dren skal ldan rgya mtsho'i rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po/ dge ldan bstan pa'i srog shing / kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal bo/ rdo rje 'chang chen mkhas 448

btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos thugs rjes gzigs pa mi dman par dngos phebs kyis chos sde 'dir chos 'dul ba'i phyag len rnams nyams pa gso ba'i bkod khyab lhu things pas bdag skyong dpe med gnang bar brten/ rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin mchog tu che zhes ser skya yongs kyis rje 'di'i mtshan tsam thos pas kyang dad pa'i pad+mo snyim par thogs te thod phyag grangs su brtsegs pas 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas mthar thug tu 'dzin/ de rjes mchog gi zhal gyi bum bzang las chos sde 'dir khyod kyis dpe khrid re byas te kun rig gi sgrub mchod la ris bris las rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor btsugs nas ram 'degs re byos dang phan thogs 'byung nges zhes lung gis bstan pa ltar/ slob bu bdag gis kyang bka' gsung dang du blangs pas lo grangs bcu gsum tsam la chos sde 'dir zhabs 'degs en tsam bgyis pa ni 'di ltar/ de nas gya dgu lo'i gsar tshes la thos bsam nor gyis ci yang phyug pa rnam dpyod can 'jigs med nor bu dang / rje blo bzang sangs rgyas kyi sku dbon lhag bsam zla ltar dkar zhing zhi dul bag yod can dge 'dun legs bshad sogs kyis bkra shis pa'i rten dang bcas bdag la nan bskul yang yang byas par brten/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga la dpyod ldan byings 'dren zur ba dge 'dun tshe ring gi bkra shis nyams dga'i grwa shag yang thog nas grwa mang la yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i khrid kyi 449

zhabs 'degs bgyis/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga la rdo rje 'chang zhi dbyings su mnal tshul bstan/ dgun thog der chos sde 'di'i slob bu rnams la snga dror lam rim bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas kyi steng nas dpe khrid dang / phyi dror sum rtags dag gsum dang lañdza wartu dbu can dbu med rnams kyi mdzub khrid zhib rgyas mdzad/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lngar bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rka sar 'phags pa rgyal gyis mang ja tsha bra dang bcas kyis bsnyen bkur mdzad de lam rim tshigs bcad bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas tshogs 'don du btsugs/ sbyin bdag gis phran bdag la yang dngos 'bul gzab/ sgar grong gi skya ser kun la sbyin bdag gis ka ra dang tshil tog sbyin pas bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ ser skya yongs kyi re 'dun ltar phran gyis 'du khang chen mo nas lam rim tshigs bcad ma'i lung bton te tshe 'di phyi gnyis las zhal ta gang shes kyis bshad pas thams cad dga' bar gyur/ de nas bzung rdo rje 'chang gi dus mchod la lam rim tshigs bcad ma btsugs te thams cad kyis lhur len mdzad/ der brten shi gson gang gi ched du'ang lam rim 'don rgyu'i rgyun tshugs pa byung / grwa btsun rnams kyis kyang lam rim rgyugs sprod dang skyor sbyang gi rgyun btsugs te lo ltar lam rim tshogs rgyugs sprad pa grwa ba du ma re byung bas da lta tshogs rgyugs sprad de blor byang ba grwa ba nyi shu lhag byung ba dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs pa'i mi skya 450

'ga' res kyang lam rim tshigs bcad blor bzung ste kha ton byed pa dang lo ltar dpe khrid ma chag par ya rabs kyi las la brtson ldan dpe legs can du ma byung ngo / /dgu bcu tham pa lo'i dgun thog chos sde 'dir skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang bla mchod khrid sogs kyi zhabs 'degs bsgrubs te dad ldan 'ga' rer gzungs mchog ma ṇi yi ge drug ma'i phan yon dang sgyung gnas la thun gtam byed mi rung ba sogs kyi sgo nas 'bel gtam gang shes mdzad/ de nas grong sde 'di'i lhag bsam yar zla'i rjes su snyegs pa'i dge ba can du mas nan bskul gyis grong sde 'di'i dpe ngan dmar bsangs phul ba 'di btsan chod byed du 'jug dgos zhes dang /de'i khar smyug thogs pa blo bzang 'od zer sogs bu slob rnams kyis kyang yang yang bskul bar brten/ sde 'di'i lha rgan la dmar bsangs gcod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas lha rdzas che legs kyis dgongs pa zhus pa dang chabs cig spyi rgan blo bzang sangs rgyas dang blo bzang 'od zer sogs dgon pa'i grwa mang dang phran bcas yul lha gzhi bdag gi lha khang du 'khod de dkar gtor dang mchod me snyan dar sogs phul te 'phrin bcol dang rab gnas gsungs pa dang / sde gzhung gi lha rgan gdugs dkar 'bum dang gza' mchog gi sku rten g.yang sgye gnyis gtsos pho gsar tshos lha bsangs phul te 'phral gyi bya don rnams 'grub dgos nges kyi gtad gnyer byas 'phral lha rgan dang sku rten zung rang 'bab kyis da 451

nas bzung bskal pa ma stongs kyi bar dmar bsangs sam gsol kha gtong mi dgos de'i tshab tu dkar gsum dang mngar gsum phul na chog ces dgongs pa khrol te sde 'di'i the tshom gyi mdud pa rang sar grol/ rjes su phyi rol mu stegs pa'i shan shugs ngan pa dang rmongs dad la zhen kha che ba glen pa u tshugs can 'ga' re srid kyang / bla ma rdo rje 'chang g.yer gshong 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtshos sgo dmar nas dus 'khor dbang chen stsal skabs 'jig rten pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag la 'phral gyi bya don phran tshags re ma gtogs tshe rabs phyi ma'i don chen nam phugs kyi bya ba rnams bcol na bslu nges yin pas blo gtad mi rung tshul dang / rang cag rnams rnam 'dren bla ma yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya yin pas bla ma dang mchog gsum la blo phugs gtad de las 'bras tshul bzhin bsrung dgos tshul las brtsams te zhal gsung brjed du phangs pa stsal bar brten/ da lta lta ba ngan pa de sun phyungs nas dkar bsangs la mngon par dad do/ /de min lo gcig la gsol kha ra ma che chung nyi shur nye ba tsam gyi srog bcad de lo rer dmar mchod byed pa yin tsa na/ phran bdag gis kyang ma bzod par dpe ngan gyi 'phro bshol ba lags so/ /spyir na dpe ngan de 'dra yul gru so sor yod srid na'ang skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi bka' bzhin phal cher gyis rgyun bcad de ya rabs la mngon par phyogs so/ /de nas lo re re bzhin dgun chos grol nas chos 452

sde 'di'i grwa bu slob drug cu yas mas la lo ltar lam rim blo sbyong gi skor dang sum rtags dag gsum sogs kyi dpe khrid dang chos sde 'di'i 'grig lam kun spyod kyi rim pa dag gang nus kyis phan ci thogs mdzad/ go gcig lo'i dge ldan lnga mchod chen mo'i tshes nyer lnga la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs bzhed dang / rtsi bzhag zur ba mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i blo bzang 'od zer sogs kyis nan bskul ltar dge bskos 'jigs med nor bu dang byings 'dren dge 'dun tshe ring / gnyer ba dge 'dun legs bshad kyis sbyin bdag mdzad de dpal ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal bo kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi rdul tshon la brten nas dkyil 'khor gsar du ngos gtsang btsugs te mthar thon mdzad/ phyi de lo nas sngar gsum pa'i nag zlar kun rig gi sgrub mchod rong bo'i dus zhabs pas ris bris kyi dkyil 'khor btsugs yod pa de rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bsgyur nas phyag len rgyun chags su gnas/ der ma zad kun rig rdul tshon gyi phyag len gyi cho ga ni rong bo dus 'khor gyi phyag len gzhi byas te/ bla brang gi kun rig rdul tshon kyi cho ga sku 'bum byams pa gling gi de'i cho ga rnams las legs cha bsdus/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa'i kun rig gi rnam bshad chen mor khungs bcol te/ kho tsho'i re 'dun ltar kha gsal don bsdus pa'i kun rig rdul tshon dkyil chog khungs ldan snying bo nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba zhig brtsams te blo bzang 453

'od zer gyis ram btegs pas rdul tshon ngos gtsang zhib tshags dag thon byung / sgrub mchod kyi bca' yig kyang brtsams te phyag len ngos gtsang btsugs/ sngon chad bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshang nas kyang rdul tshon 'dzugs pa'i thugs 'dun yod kyang rkyen dbang gis steng du ma khel par gsungs/ da lta rje bla ma'i thugs bskyed dang dad ldan slob 'khor rnams kyi lhag bsam gyis bstan 'gror sman pa'i dge mtshan yar ldan du gyur/ de rjes mkhyen rgya ha cang che zhing dge la brtson pa/ bslab gsum dpal gyis mdzes pa'i 'tsho byed gzhon nu dge 'dun dpal 'byor gang gi sems kyi 'char sgor chos sde 'dir sngon nas da lta'i bar gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yab sras kyi bka' 'bum rin po che'i bklag lung thob ma myong ba'i rkyen gyis da gzod bka' 'bum rin po che'i bklag lung cis kyang chos sde 'dir 'thob tu 'jug dgos snyam nas/ lo du ma'i bar mthun rkyen bsgrigs nas bdag la bklag lung 'don dgos tshul las brtsams te gos dang lha rdzas dri ma med pa bcas bskul ngo ma zlog par/ rab rgyan bgrang bya bdun pa bya lo'i spyi lo1993lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig bkra shis don 'grub pa'i nyin 'dus bzang chos gling gi 'du khang chen mo nas dge 'dun gyi sde drug cu lhag dang sde ba'i dad ldan pho mo bcas chos nyan pa brgya phrag lhag 454

la rje yab sras kyi legs bshad gser gyi phreng mdzes kyi bklag lung gi rgyun gyi dbu btsugs te gdugs lnga la dkar 'dzin byas/ de nas hor zla gsum pa'i dkar tshes nas 'phro bskyangs te lung rgyun dge 'dun gyi sde la legs par 'bul rgyu'i e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang po thob/ bdag ni bzhin bzang dge mtshan ldan pa'i dge 'dun dpal 'byor gyi grwa shag bkra shis lhun grub tu bcar bsdad byas/bza' btung gi rigs gang bzang dang / gdugs bdun gyi mtshams zhal zas ro brgyas ston chung re byas nas dge 'dun dpal 'byor rang ngos nas 'gro gron mi nyung ba btang bas bde blag ngang hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga la bka' chos kyi rgyun legs par grub/ de nas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dge 'dun dpal 'byor gtsos dge 'dun 'dus spyi nas tshe rabs nas tshe rabs su rje bdag nyid chen po'i dbu sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa bgyis te kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad nus pa'i skyabs 'jug smon lam dang dge bsngo mdzad/ sbyin bdag nas bdag la bka' drin che zhus kyi tshul du sku'i rten la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi li sku che legs dang / gsung gi rten yum dum pa bcu gnyis/ ting 'phags bskal gsum lam sngags/ thugs kyi rten byang chub mchod rten dang gos yug rnam grangs du ma lha dar sgor bcas thog drangs te zang zing 455

gi bdog pa sbam mtho ba btegs pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'jug rnam dag mdzad do/ /'dis mtshon pas chos sde 'di'i grwa btsun mang pos rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum dag tshar 'don pa dang thos bsam gyis bag chags 'jog pa yang mang du byung ngo / /de ltar lo ngo bcu gsum gyi ring la chos sde 'dir khrid kyi skor yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya/ bla mchod kyi khrid/ lam rim bsdus don/ lam rim chen mo/ zhwa dmar lam khrid chen mo/ ra rgya g.yu rngog tshang gi skyabs khrid chen mo/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya bslab gsum mdzes rgyan/ spyod 'jug chen mo/ lam rim bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas/ tshad ma'i skor/ brda dag phye ma leb/ dag yig mkhas pa dga' skyed/ sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos/ pra ste'i sum rtags/ thon mi'i zhal lung / snyan ngag spyi don/ snyan ngag me long / dbyangs can dgyes glu/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang kun rig sogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa sogs kyi zhabs 'degs bsgrubs/ skyabs 'gro dang smon lam rnam lnga/ sman bla/'od dpag med stong mchod zhing mchog sgo 'byed/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg lam rim gyi skor sogs dang theg chen sdom lung sogs kyi lung gi skor gyis zhabs 'degs bsgrubs/ gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo 'phags pa rgyal la byams pa mthong grol chen mo bzhengs pa'i rting bskul mdzad de rten bzhengs kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du gang nus kyis 456

'gan btegs nas bde blag tu grub par bgyis so/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i sde 'dir paṇa grub skyes chen bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i tshul gyis phebs pa mtha' dag brjod par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang 'dir dngos phebs kyis chos srid gnyis char gyis bskyangs pa mi dman par brtse ba chen pos dgyes gzigs gnang ba'i bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pa mtshungs med 'dren pa dag gi rnam par thar pa las brtsams te ngo sprod tsam bgyid pa las/ zhib par gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /lung rtogs bstan la phyag rjes rma med pa'i/ /rnam kun mkhyen gzigs pad+ma'i rtsa lag che/ /gling 'dir rtsen pa'i dge mtshan mi zad pas/ /bde skyid dga' tshal lhug par bzhad 'di rmad/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do//chos sde rang nas 'khrungs pa'i skyes chen rnams kyi rtogs pa mdo tsam gleng ba/de yang rnam 'dren bla ma yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gdan sa dpal nā len+d+ra rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gtsos bshad sgrub kyi sde ji snyed cig bzhugs pa rnams kyi ya gyal bis pa paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla ba'i gdan sa dam pa rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling 'dir/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par du dbu sngags bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi bstan pa rin po che gser gyi yang zhun lta bu 'di nyid/ 'gro ba 457

mi'i bde skyid kyi rtsa bar dgongs te bsam bzhin tha mal ba'i tshul gyis thabs mkhas thugs rjes tshul bzhin du 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyis khyab brdal du spel ba'i mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po/ 'gro ba'i sgron me gang dag gis chos srid zung 'brel gyis bskyangs pa'i bka' drin snyernams brjed tho tsam du mngon par spel ba la/gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa rje lha rams pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho ni/ rka sar mgo 'dug 'tsho bar ltas bzang dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas bzung zhi dul gyi rang bzhin ldan zhing mkhyen rab rgyas pas kun la rig bzang du grags/dgung lo bdun gyi tshe bar ma rab byung dang dge tshul dkyus gcig tu bsgrubs te rang dgon gyi tshogs gral du zhugs/ phral klog sbyar klog sogs grogs gzhan las tshegs med du mkhyen/ sngon gyi bag chags sad stobs kyis rong bo thos bsam gling du zhugs te dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten nas bsdus grwa sogs la sbyangs pas dpe khrid dang 'dzin skyor sbyang gang gi cha la'ang nan tan chen pos thos bsam gnad 'gro phul phyin mdzad/ de nas grogs dang 'phral rkyen gyis dbus su phebs bzhed gnang ste dran dbang yongs kyi gtsug rgyan lha rams pa rgya mtsho sogs bshes gnyen dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te rdo rus thug par bslab sbyang ma lhod par gzhung bka' chen po lnga la sbyangs pa mthar phyin 458

sprepar mdzad/ lha rams pa'i dam bca' bzhag nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang yang rtser 'dzegs/ khri 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims kyi zhabs la gtugs nas gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi la gsan bsam gnad 'gro mdzad pa dang dbang lung rjes gnang sogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnos/ mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung kun la thos bsam zung 'brel gyis lo ngo bcur bzhugs/ mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/ sgo dmar lha rams pa'i sku'i skye bar grags/ slar yang mdo smad du byon nas sde 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i 'gab tu mgon chos lha mo sogs kyis bskor ba'i sku brnyan rang byon can rje mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag tsha che legs gzi 'od 'bar ba da lta rgyal ba byams pa'i gzungs gzhug gi khrod du bzhugs pa de dang / sman 'dam las grub pa'i thub pa thog mtha' mar grags pa/ gong sa skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dbu ljon bubs tshang / lho rgyal sras rin po che'i dbu ljon bubs sogs rten skal khyad par can du ma gnang / rong bo dgon chen du bzhugs gnas kyi mthil mdzad de dpe khrid gnang bas kun la phan rlabs rgya cher byung ba dang / dgon chen dang la mo bde chen dgon pa'i don gnyer can mang bo'i re 'dun ltar gzhung tshad ma rnam 'grel dang thar lam gsal byed rtsa 'grel gyi bshad pa gtsor bzung nas dpe khrid gnang bas kun la blo skyed dang phan thogs ches cher byung bar brten/459

rigs pa smra ba'i bu slob bgrang las 'das pa la lo zla re rer dpe khrid kyis dus 'da' bas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don 'bad med lhun grub tu gyur/ grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gang gi khrir bzhugs nas slob gnyer gyi rting bskul dang 'chad nyan dmar/ chos srid gnyis char gyis legs par bskyangs te gser zhun cod can 'chang ba'i ring lugs gdugs dkar thabs shes dpung ba brtan pos bsnyal med du bsgrengs pas bstan 'gror sman yon bla lhag tu byung bas rka sar dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes mtshan snyan phyogs kyi bu mo'i 'gram par chags/ dgung grangs nga lnga'i steng zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal tshul bstan/ sku gdung mchod rten che tshad cig bzhengs pa re zhig gzim spyil gyi yang thog tu bzhugs par mdzad pa la/ phyis su phrag dog dang g.yo sgyus kun nas bslangs te che btsan rong bo nang so sogs kyis ngan rkyen 'dzem med du bslangs pas gzim khang dang sku gdung mchod rten gtan brlags byas pas thabs rdugs kyi bya ngan sna tshogs bsam bzhin du spel/ de nas shar gyi phyag mdzod ye shes grags pas rang gi lha rams pa'i sku gdung chos sde 'dir nye bar gdan drangs te bzhugs pa la/ phyis su rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku brnyan che legs shig bzhengs pa'i nang rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs su gsol nas sri zhu bla na med pa dang bcas mchod pa'i zhing mchog gong na med par gyur/ de dus su sku dbon ye shes grags pas 460

rang dgon du gzim spyil pa tra ris dang bcas gyan sna bzhi bcu can zhig gsar bskrun mdzad par brten/ skyes chen dam pa rim byon kyis bzhugs spyil mdzad pas dge mtshan mang du 'phel/ rjes sor sku dbon ye shes grags pa gtsos rka sar gyis nang so bgrongs pa sogs kyi lo rgyus byung rung / che btsan nang so sangs rgyas 'bum gyi sku'i ring la legs par bsdums te rtsod med kyi ngang 'grig mthun dge thon pa zhig byung bar grags so//mkhyen rab gter chen rka sar klu 'bum lha bris pa rje btsun byang chub rab gsal dpal bzang po ni/ nges pa'i don du sngon ring mo zhib/ nas dpag par dka' ba'i rgyas sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu phyin nas sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad de/ ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su sku'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol rtsed mtha' yas pas/ gang la gang 'tshams kyis gdul bya rnams smin grol la bkod pa las/ rgya gar 'phags yu la du dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed slob dpon legs ldan 'byed ces mtshan snyan nyi zla ltar gsal ba'i skyes chen du ma dang / gangs ljongs 'dir yang rang cag gdul bya'i khams dang 'tshams par ris/ mthun tha mal dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par bstan pa zhig tu nges na'ang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pas gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan mtha' dag pa ni sar spyod sems dpa'i gnas min na so skye tha mal 461

ba phran bdag lta bus brjod pa ngal ba tsam du zad pa zhu ci dgos/ 'on kyang dad ldan las 'phro can rnams kyi mos blor legs mdzad rgya mtsho lta bu las rgyus yod kyi ngag rgyun khungs thub tshad ldan 'ga' zung blo gos kyi rtswa mchog rtse mos skye dgu'i gsos su bran par spro'o/ /des na rje 'di nyid nam zhig la 'khrungs she na/ nges pa don gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu bzhi ba me yos la zhi bar gshegs pa'i phyi de lo sa mo 'brug spyi lo1808lo dpal du 'char ba'i gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i 'od snang dang 'grogs te gser ljongs rka sar zhes bya ba'i nor 'dzin gyi snyim mthil du sku'i 'od zer dang nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon gyi gur khang sogs mkhyen rab kyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i mtshan ltas dang bcas te yar skor khang gya tsho bar skye 'gro mtha' dag gi khong ba'i snying dang mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa/ ji ltar chu shel dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor shar gyi ri bo'i phrag pa las mdzes par thon pa bzhin/'jig rten mtha' dag gi sdug kun gyi rims nad rtsad nas 'byin pa'i sman gyi ljon pa chen por sku 'khrungs so/ /mdo las ji skad du/ ya rabs rigs ldan gus shing bag yod spyod/ /ngang tshul bzang la gtsang zhing des par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar tshogs gnyis gyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho zhing / lhag bsam dge ba/ bstan 'gror phan par zhugs pa'i ya rabs kyi yon tan rnams rang chas su mnga' ba'i gzhon nu de nyid ni/ ji 462

skad du/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma yi ge ste/ /de bral rnams ni dbang bo rnam bkra yang / /dud 'gro rnams dang khyad par ma mchis pas/ /yi ge 'bri klog dag la brtson par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar khyim nas khyim med par rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs te sde 'di'i tshogs gral du zhugs/ phral klog sbyar klog sogs 'don chos spyod rnams dang yi ge 'bri ba dang bzo rig la sbyangs pa sogs thun mong ba'i rig gnas dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas kun la thugs brtson chen pos sbyangs pa rgya cher gnang bas sgo gsum gyi spyod pa gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i dpal yon yar ldan du mchis shing / sngon gnas rjes dran sogs kyi mngon shes dang //brtan pa'i 'khor los dngos su byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung ba'i rtags mtshan rnams lhan skyes su mchis so/ /de ltar mkhas par bya ba'i gnas yod dgu la rnam dpyod kyi 'khri shing gzhon nu tshad du longs pa na/ legs bshad rin po che las/ mkhas pa yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa/ /de dag legs bshad rin chen sdud/ /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /yin phyir chu bo thams cad 'bab/ /gsungs pa ltar dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams su byon te dran dbang thos 'dzin dga' ba'i dus ston lung rigs sgra dbyangs dbyar rnga ltar ldir ba'i skyed tshal du/ ji ltar ngang ba'i rgyal bo pad mtsho la 'jug pa'i dpe ltar/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang klu 'bum khams tsha/na du zhugs te/lnga rig lang tshos 463

sgeg cing dar ba'i rkang 'thung gi ra bar mdzad bzang yon tan gyi snye mas mngon par dud pa'i chos grwar zhugs te mtshan ldan theg chen dge ba'i bshes sa/nyen du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor bsnyen cing / gus rtag sbyor bas tshul bzhin thos bsam la stabs gcig tu bsdus sbyor nas bzung gzhung pod lnga la sha chod rus chod kyis rdo rus thug par sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad de/ gzhung don rgya mtsho'i klong zab gzhal ba'i thugs stobs bla lhag tu bdo bas lha ldan cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba lha rams pa'i dam bca' bzhag ste/ lung rigs smra ba'i seng chen gyi nga ros log smra gnyis 'thung khyu yi klad pa 'gems pa dang lhan du ser 'bras dge gsum gyi gzhung lugs smra ba'i dbang bo mkhas mang gser ri'i phreng ba'i dbus na rab brjid lhun po ltar rab tu mtho zhing brjid pas dngos po'i gnas tshod ltar don ldan snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor g.yo ba byung / sa paṇa gyis/ blun po slob pa ngo mtshar 'dzin/ /mkhas pa mi slob ngo mtshar 'dzin/ /des na mkhas rnams rgas gyur kyang / /phyi ma'i don du rig pa slob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar chu gter chen po chu yis mi ngoms pa'i tshul ltar nges don mkhas grub dam pa mang bo'i mdun nas dbang khrid rjes gnang gi rigs sogs man ngag ga bur phye mas rdul brtsegs kyi ri dbang rang dgar du spyod pa'i bu chen g.yu ral gnam du gzengs pa'i gdong lnga'i dbang bo ltar gyur/ de nas lha 464

ldan du mkhan slob sbrags ma'i mdun dang dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs te tshul khrims rnam par dag pa g.yag rnga bzhin srung bas tshul khrims kyi dri ngad phyogs su ldang / de nas mdzad bzang gser gyi 'khor lo thabs shes zung gis bar ma chad par bskor te gdul bya mtha' dag la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu lhag med du sbyin par brten/ don gnyis bla lhag tu 'phel ba'i dge mtshan mi zad pa phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i mtha' la 'khril/ gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po rgyal dbang bcu gnyis pa rje btsun 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mtshan zhabs mkhan por mnga' gsol bas bka' pod lngas mtshon pa'i mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung don dka' gnas kyi mdud rgya grol ba dang / rigs pa'i gsang tshig rnams gdams pa sogs kyi sgo nas zhabs 'degs mtha' klas rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dgyes pa bskyed pas mchod sprin bla na med par spros/gzhan yang dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lta ba la slob dpon zla grags sogs kyis gnod byed btang ba la thugs mi rangs pa'i tshul mdzad pa dang / thos bsam la nyams bzhes mi dman par rtsod grwa'i khas len yang gzhan gyi lta ba la mi 'thad pa'i gnod byed btang nas/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed dang rang rgyud pa'i lta ba ni 'thad ldan du bzung ste gzhan du drang du mi rung ba'i sgrub byed so sor bstan nas rang rgyud pa'i lta ba ni lta ba'i 465

yang rtser khas 'che bar mdzad pas rje nyid slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyi sku skyer mkhas dgus gleng ba byung / reb gcig la khams kyi rtog ge pa mkhas pa'i yang rtser rlom pa dregs pa can zhig 'ong ste/ gong sa skyabs mgon mchog la mdo sngags kyi dka' gnas las brtsams te dri ba dris lan gyi tshul gyis rgol bar 'dod nas gsol ba na/ skyabs mgon mchog gis ma gnang bar da reb nga la rtsod long med/thog mar khyed rka sar klu 'bum lha bris pa dang rtsod pa byos dang rting mar nga dang brtsad na chog ces gsungs pa la/ lha bris bas gsol rtsam zhig bzhes te bzhugs yod tsa na/ kho bo dregs pa dang bcas 'ongs nas rgyu mtshan bsnyad ma thaga'aphral du lha ris pas 'o rgol ba ngan pa khyod 'dra zhig gis srid gsum dbang sgyur skyabs mgon mchog la cis phyir rtsod/ khyed ni nga yi rtsod ya byung na dga' bo byung gsungs nas gsol dkar zan dang bcas 'jim pa ltar brdzis te phar bzhag ste kho bo dang brtsad pas/ kho bo pham par byas nas rtsod pa'i 'phrul rdo rje rgya gram gyis ngag sgo bcad de ci yang smra rgyu med pa'i brtul zhugs la bkod pa dang / rgyud kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo log rtog ngan pa rtsad nas gzhil ba na/ rtog ge bas 'gyod bshags dang bcas zhu ba phul bar grags/'jim pa ltar brdzis pa'i dkar yol ni rjes sor bod gzhung gi rten khrod du bzhugs pas ngo mtshar bar brtsi/ de ltar mkhas grub gnyis ldan dang mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung lugs 466

rgya mtshor mnga' dbang sgyur pa'i grags snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang srid gsum khyon du ldir/ mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi legs mdzad dkar po'i rlabs phreng mkha' la 'phyo ba ni/ lha rams pa'i dam bca'i skabs chos mngon pa'i skor gyi rgyugs sprod chen mo'i dus la gtugs pa'i tshe chos grogs rnams kyis bskul ba na/ 'o nga la khom long cher ma byung bas blor byang med des na khyed rnam pas dpe char ltos dang sta gon byed gsungs nas dpe rgya khab kyis zin tshad cig la lan gnyis gsum tsam klog nas blor thogs med du gsungs pa na/ grogs po rnams kyis kyang ngodzo mtshar te a tsi 'di 'dra zhig grwa sa 'dir snga ma'i dus su'ang byung ba rna bas ma tshor phyis su'ang 'byung ba shin tu nas kyang dkon da sus kyang 'gran du med ces bstod bsngags rgya cher mdzad pa sogs grogs so skye rnams kyi spyod yul las 'das pa'i mdzad bzang snyan pa'i rdza rnga phyogs kyi bu mos brdungs/ thengs shig la se ra byes pa'i dge bshes du ma zhig khong 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' dbang sgyur ba'i snyan pas thugs rab phrogs nas gzhung gi dogs gcod rnams snyan sgron mdzad par/ ming don mi mtshungs pa'i dge bshes slob gnyer la hur 'don mi byed pa'i le lo can khyed rnams la gzhung don 'di tsam yang blos mi chun par dka' bar grags na bka' pod lnga'i gzhung don rnams ji ltar rtogs zhes bka' bkyon dang bcas phyir phyung / phyi de nyin nyid kyi sku 467

dbon a tsa ra zhes pas zhu ba phul nas 'phral mar se rar phebs bzhed gnang ste dogs slong gang yod rnams gzhi nas bsal zhing / skabs don gyi go ba lag pas bzhag 'dra lta bur mdzad de khyed rnam par bsteng tshig smra ba ni dpe gzigs gnad 'gror 'gyur ched rting bskul yin gyi phyis su thos bsam gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin bsten dgos pa sogs kyi sgo nas bslab bya brjed du phangs pa'i bka' drin stsal pa la brten nas ting mar de rnams la'ang thos bsam legs po 'ongs par grags/ phyir phebs skabs su se ra'i chos grwar lung rigs smra ba'i seng ge'i gad rgyangs sa bla 'gengs pa ltar gyur pa na/ chos rje 'di'i thugs rab dgyes te chos grwar phebs nas gsan pas rim gyis 'ur sgra je zhan du song / 'dzin grwa gong mar thal 'gyur 'ga' re 'phangs pa tsam gyis bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis ded pa bzhin gzhan rgyud kyi log par rtog pa rnams drungs phyung nas rgol ba rnams kyang mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pa sogs bsam brjod las 'das/ gzhan yang bal bza' khri btsan gyi rten skal du drangs pa'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i garjo la'i khyams kyi log ris ngos ltaspre dza:da lugs ltar 'jig rten gyi chags dbyibs ri rgyal gser ri baṭiṅge rlosrus cha tshang zhig mthar chags su bzhengs skabs/ dge bshes shig gis/ lags phyi'i 'jig rten gyi bkod pa 'di gang gi lugs ltar lags zhes zhus tsa na/ ma rangs pa'i tshul gyis 'o khyed rang gang gi lugs yin min shes gi ma red 468

ma ṇi thon gsungs nas grub 'phral gsham du bod yul khri skor bcu gsum gyi mkhas dbang rnams gzigs dang / 'di la nor dogs mchis na ban rgan nga rang ma shi'i tshun chad la shog phyis su mang po lab na don re chung zhes tshon dkar bos phyag rtsom gnang ba'ang da lta ma nyams paromachis/deng yang bya dka' ba'i phyag rjes de la phyi gling ba'i shes yon can rnams kyis brtag zhib nan cher btang nas sgyu rtsal phul byung can mi 'di 'dzam gling sa'i go lar bskor ba lan gsum brgyab myong bar nges pa gor ma chag go zhes gdeng 'jog ha cang mtho zhing / ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su mthong bas mtshan snyan bla lhag tu 'phel bar ma zad/ chung dus nas bzo rig pa'i phyogs la mos pa mi dman par bzo bo bi shwa karma gnyis pa lta bu'i slob dpon dag gi mdun sar slob 'khor rnams dang lhan rgyas bcas slob khrid gnang skabs su'ang / rje 'di bas bltas pa tsam gyis bde blag tu rtogs pa sogs kyi yon tan dpag par dka' ba'i tshod du gda'/khong ni bzo yi rig pa la mkhyen rtsal rgyas drags shing lhan skyes kyi yon tan blar 'phags pas bris 'bur gang mdzad na'ang gzhan las 'bur du thon pa'i thun min gyi legs cha phul phyin mig mthong lag zin du grub pas/thengs shig la gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi sku 'khor rnams lha bzo'i khyad par dang bzo ba'i legs nyes kyi gleng bslangs mdzad nas zhal ma mthun par gyur pa na/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i 469

bka' ltar/chol kha gsum gyi bzo bo rnams dang sgos su rje 'di ba dang khams kyi bzo bo rtser son grags can gnyis las gang bzang bar 'gran pa'i tshe/ 'di bas thang ga'i rigs gang bzhengs na'ang rje sku re bzhengs pa phyag srol yin pas/ gong sa mchog nas da reb khyed kyis rje sku ma bris na'ang chog par gsungs/ khong gis 'phags pa gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gi 'dra thang spyan shel mnabs pa zhig bzhengs te de'i cha la rje sku zhal 'dzum pa'i nyams mtshar ba can zung bzhengs par grags/ rjes nas skyabs mgon gyis spyan phab gnang skabs thugs dgyes nyams dpe med ngang da cha rje sku ma bzhengs sam zhes bka' 'dri mdzad pa na/ sku brnyan gyi spyan shel zung la bzhengs yod tshul zhus par/ gong sa mchog gis ma gzigs pa na/ khong gis zur gyis gzigs dang mthong yong zhes zhus pas/ gzigs pas thugs gang dges dang zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas sprul ba'i lha bzo zer ba 'di 'dra zhig dgos pa red ces bstod bsngags me tog man dā ra ba'i chun po gtsug gi rgyan du thob pa dang / bya dga' yang sbam mtho ba dang lha dar bcas stsal par/ de yi mod la lha'i bzo bo bi shwa karma yang skyengs te 'chi med dga' tshal gyi do rar skyabs bcol nas yibs pas dregs ldan gzhan dag nyi ma'i drung na srin bu me khyer bzhin du gyur nas phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan 'og min bar du khyab/ yang reb cig la lha bris pa rnams 'gran bsdur gyi dus la bab pa 470

na/ gong sa mchog nas khyed cag gdugs bdun gyi ring la bye'u re bzos te gang legs na de la bya dga' ster ro zhes bkas bskul ba na/ de nas bka' ltar bzo bo gzhan dag gis nyin du ma'i bar bye'u mdzes cha can re bzos nas bya dga' la re ltos 'cha' ba la/ rje 'di bas dpe gzigs dang dpe khrid kyis dus 'da' bas bye'u bsnyel bar grags/ dus la bab tshe grogs kyis bskul ba na/ rgyal ba'i gsung dran te phebs zhor la 'jim pa'i bye'u chung zhig bzos te lha bzo rnams dang chabs cig par/ skyabs mgon mchog gi mdun gyi stegs bu'i khar phul ba la/ gong sa mchog nas byi la btang bas byi las tsham tshom med par rje 'di ba'i bye'u chung steng mchong stabs gcig gis mchongs te khur nas dong bas drung 'khod pa kun ngo mtshar zhing yid rton par gyur/ gang ltar kyang dus der bzo bo rtser son pa ngo mtshar can 'di 'dra 'dzam gling na'ang dkon tshod du gda' zhes gleng na rdzun gyi nyes pa mi 'byung ngam snyam mo/ /deng yang rje 'di ba'i phyag bzo ngo mtshar can 'gangs che ba'i rigs chol kha gsum gyi phyag yul gong na med pa'i rten khrod du 'ga' re bzhugs pa yod kyang / grags tshod la 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi rten rnying dreg pa can gyi gras na 'di bas bzhengs pa'i 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi thang ga phul phyin zhig bzhugs pa la/ lo 'khor gcig la sgo mang mkhan po ma gtogs rang khas dang bstun te mchod mjal mi thob pa'i lo rgyus kyang 471

yod par grags so/ /yang res gcig la 'bras ldan gyi dus su gtsang bo che brug pas pho nya'i 'gro 'ong bkag pa na/ rje 'di bar ches cher dad pa ci gsung bka' bzhin skub pa'i sde gzhung gi pho nya ba zhig yod pa des mdun du bcar te da lo bdag la ha cang nyen che ba'i tshod du gda'/bdag gi skyid sdug legs nyes mtha' dag snga mo nas kyang rje nyid la bcol yod pas slad mar yang thugs rje lcags kyus nam yang mi 'dor bar mkhyen ces gdung ba'i mchi ma dang bcas skyabs 'jug yang yang nan chen mdzad/ khong gis rtsam ril gsum gnang ste 'di'i kha ma phyes par rim bzhin chu bo la thob dang thar 'gro bas yid ches par mdzod cig ces gsang stabs kyis dam rgya mdzad/ pho nya bas dus la gtugs nas gtsang bo cher brgal ba'i tshe bla ma'i gsung ba ltar zan ril gcig chu la btab pas gtsang chu rim bzhin je chung du song / yang gcig shos chu bo la bor bas chur brgal thub pa byung nas phar brgal te thar pas/ khos rtsam ril 'di ya mtshan ci yin snyam nas ril bu gcig lus pa de'i kha phyes nas bltas tsa na/ bdag phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa'i gang zag cig yin na chu bo 'di bri bar gyur cig ces mi bslu ba'i bden tshig brjod yod par mthong / de nas phyir bde bar 'byor te gnas tshul rnams gsong bor zhus pas/ khong gis bka' bkyon gnang zhing gzhan la mi smra ba'i bka' bsgos dam bzhag gnang bar grags/ rje 'di ba zang 472

zing 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi mgo snyoms pas/ thengs shig la rgyal ba'i che btsan sku drag zhig tshe dus byas pas shi mgor gdan zhu byas pas phebs te/ khyim mi rnams gdung yus kyis skyabs 'jug dang phyi ma'i sa lam zhus tsa na/ zhal nas bem ro gang na yod gsungs nas gzigs pas bem ror dbu rgyan sogs bskon te khri'i steng na khra lam mer shom ra dang bcas yod pa na/ nyid kyi zhal nas nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan til 'bru tsam yang med pa zhig la 'di 'dra'i tshul 'chos kyis phan pa dang dgos pa ci yong phar rdzogs zhog rul ba dri ngan bro ba 'di lta bu zhes bka' bkyon dang phyin chad 'di 'dra mi rung ba'i tshul las brtsams te bslab bya gnang mthar ljags bsngo dang smon lam gyis rgyas btab ste phyir phebs/ phyis su gdul bya rnams la phan rlabs che zhing yid ches par mngon/ lha sar phebs bzhud gnang skabs shig la lha sa'i sde gzhung nas bla chen rje btsun dam pa zhig gi yang sprul sri zhu bla na med pa dang bcas gtsang bkra shis lhun por spyan 'dren pa dang 'phrad tshe/ sku dbon a tsa ra zhes pas da cha rten 'brel bzang mchog sprul tshang la mjal du 'gro zhes zhus tsa na/ bzhin gnag pa dang bcas en tsam bzhugs te kho bo der mi 'gro gsungs nas lam btang ste phebs/ sku dbon gyis sprul skur 'jal te lha sar lhan 'dzoms kyis jo mjal gnang /phyir phebs skabs lam srang zhig tu khong rnam gnyis sku ngal bsos te 473

bzhugs pas nye gnas na re/ da reb 'dir slebs nas don chen gsum 'grub song zhes spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang lab pa na/ gang dag red ces gsungs/ nye gnas kyis gcig jo mjal blangs pa/ gnyis yang sprul mjal ba/ gsum tshogs can phor ba zhig nyos pa 'di dag red ces zhus/ gzhan dag bzang zhing legs mod/ 'on kyang bshang gci 'dor mi shes pa'i se'u bcu ba zhig la mjal nas dgos pa lhag po ci yong gsungs/ rjes nas yang sprul gyis la gor khri ma non par tshe dus byas par grags/ de lta bu'i mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyi klong brdol zhing bden tshig grub pas phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa dang / mdo sngags dkyil 'khor gyi kho lag yongs su rdzogs shing gdams pa rin chen mdzod du gyur na yang / bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rang gi yon tan sba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams bzhes la chig dril gyis bum nang gi mar me ltar sba bar mdzad de mngon shes dang grub rtags sogs kyi mtshan ma en tsam yang mthar myo/ spros par dge ldan gtsang ma'i rnam thar lhur bzhes mdzad de sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi brtul zhugs kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa sogs kyi dge mtshan bla lhag tu 'phel/ yang reb cig la a mdo pha yul re skong nas mjal skor ba tshan cig brtol bas de dag la skyabs mgon skal ldan drug pa chen po'i byad bzhin ji 'dra red ces bka' 'dri mdzad 474

par brten/ reb gong ba phal cher gyis legs tshul zhus par thugs mi rangs pa'i tshul mdzad/ de'i ya gyal smra mi mkhas pa zhig la gtam dris pas/ mchog sprul chen po'i mgo mer bsregs pa'i rma shul can zhig red ces smras pa na/ khong thugs dgyes te mjal ba 'di la bkra shis pa'i kha phye mar bro bkur snyi gyis da bzang yong a mdo reb gong ba rnams la bsod nams ha cang che/ rtags mtshan de ni sku tshe yun du brtan cing 'phrin las phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i dan rtags rang red ces gsungs/rjes sor 'di ba'i lung gis bstan pa ltar bstan 'gro'i mgon du skyabs mgon sku phreng drug pa skal ldan blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid dgung lo bcu phrag lnga lhag bzhugs te/ gser zhun cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid zhi'i rtse mor bsnyal med du btsugs pa byung /de'i phyis gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang sprul rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gis rigs kyi cod pan du bkur pas bstan 'gro'i don chen yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang chos srid kyi zhabs 'degs 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad/ skabs shig la gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo chos kyi 'khor sgyur bla na med pa'i rgyal thabs bdag gir bzhes te/ thugs dkyel che ba'i sgos dbang gis gser yig 475

dang gser tham bcas bsnams nas ma hā tsi na'i yul du sku 'khor zhabs zhu ba dang bcas zhabs sor bskyod pa dang chabs cig mdo smad bshad sgrub kyi sde chen po rnams su yang phebs bzhud gnang bas mdo rgyud gzhung lugs ma lus pa'i gnas la mkhyen rab 'jug pa bcu ba'i gom stabs kyis pha mthar bcad cing / bcu phrag rig pa'i 'od zer gyis kun nas mdzes pa'i mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug phud kyis bteg pa'i chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por dal gyis 'phags te/ mgrin pa dam chos 'khor lo las brtan pa'i 'khor lo dges pa'i thal ngag rigs pa'i 'phrul 'khor gdong lnga'i dbang bo'i rgyud du drangs nas dpal ldan chos gyi grags pa sogs kyi sgra 'dzin gyi ral ba sa la 'beb pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis legs bshad bdud rtsi'i snying bo mi pham zla shel rgyas pa'i 'dzum zer char ltar byo bas mkhas dgu'i brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog cing gzhan la dad 'dun lhod pa'i gnas la bkod/ de dus khrums stod zla ba'i dkar tshes mngon par bzhad pa la chibs kyi kha lo reb gong rig pa'i grong khyer gser ldan mar bsgyur te/ rang dgon rka sar 'dus bzang chos gling du zhabs bteg ngag rgyun la de dus sku 'khor lhan rgyas bcas dre'u zhig la chibs te sgo chen nas phebs grabs byed par/ der dbyar gnas btsugs te gang 'ardod rang shed kyis 'gro mi chog par btsun chung zhig sgo srung gi tshul du bsdad yod pas chibs ma bshol bar nang du 'jug mi rung tshul mang du 476

lab pas/ dgyes 'dzum gyis zhal nas chibs ma bshol bar nang du 'gro mi rung tshul rgya gzhung bod gzhung gang na gsungs yod pa red ces gsungs/ btsun chung na re/ ngas rgya gzhung bod gzhung ga 'dra yin pa mi shes nga tsho'i dgon pa'i pha lugs yin zhes smras pa na/ dgyes gzigs kyis 'o de 'dra lab na 'grig gi red btsun chung kha mkhas shig yin pa 'dra zhes mgo la phyag gis byugs te phebs par grags/ grong ri dgon gyi ser skya mang bor nyin du ma'i bar sgos chos mang du stsal nas lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas zhal ta brjed du phangs pa'i gsung gleng dmar/mdo smad bshad pa'i shing rta ba chen po kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gdan sa bla brang bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sder chibs bsgyur te/ rgyal mkhan po'i tshoms chen du gzhi phab zla gcig lhag bzhugs par grags/ bla sprul dang dge bshes phal cher gyis chos 'brel zhus te bka' pod lnga yis mtshon pa'i gzhung mang po'i dpe khrid gnang / de nas kun mkhyen bla mas gzim khang bla brang chen mor sri zhu bla na med pa dang bcas gdan zhu mdzad de bsnyen bkur dpe med mdzad skabs de ring chos kyi dri ba'i 'bel gtam mdzad kyi red ces zhus tsa na/'o sa 'dir dri ba byed pa'i dus byung na yag po 'dug gsungs/ gung thang tshang nas mdo sngags kyi dogs slong 'ga' zung dri ba mdzad par/lan thogs med du gsungs te 'di 'dra zhig kyang gnas 'dir dka' ba'i 477

gnas su grags sam gsungs nas bka' bkyon mdzad/ kun mkhyen bla mas gdan sa 'dir 'tsho gzhes mdzad pa'i thugs bzhed dang rjes 'dzin gyi zhal gsung dron po phebs dgos tshul dang / bla thob sogs kyi go sa'i thob thang yod tshul rnams zhus par/ zhal nas khyed kyis bla thob dang go sa nga la ster ram/ ngas khyed la ster/ rgya thob dang bod thob yod pa'i sgo mang mkhan po nga ma dgos/ dga' ldan gser khri chen mo ngas ma lon de las lhag pa zhig ster rgyu mchis sam zhes gsungs par grags/ der bzhugs ring rgyal mkhan po'i sgar ba nas gnas brtan chu ri ma'i gyan thang zhig bzhengs zer/ de nas rim gyis chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa khams gsum bla ma chos kyi rgyal bo shar tsong kha pa chen po'i lte khrag 'pho ba'i gnas 'dzam gling na rgyan du che bar chibs bsgyur te/ gser sdong chen mo'i mdun du mchod pa'i yo byad gya nom pa dngos dang yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshor dkrigs te phul/ bstan 'gror gcig tu sman pa'i sgos chos du ma stsal pa sogs kyi sgo nas don gnyis phun tshogs bla lhag tu 'phel/ mdor na mdo sngags bstan pa'i srog shing / kun gzigs rka sar klu 'bum lha ris pa byang chub rab gsal dpal bzang po zhes dus kyi mtha' na mtshungs zla ma mchis pa skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa/ sa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i sgron mer gyur pa de ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang /478

de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la tshad mar gyur pa'i 'phags bod kyi gzhung lugaṅge rgya mtsho lta bu dang / thun mong rig pa'i gtsug lag 'bum sde'i don thams cad la sbyong ba'i sgo btod pa tsam gyis mkhas par bya ba'i gnas de dag gis rang gi de nyid ston pa la rangs pa lta bus mkhyen pa'i yul du gra ma nyams par babs pa/ mang du thos pa'i don gang ji snyed pa de thams cad lam gyi lus gcig tu dril ba'i bsam pa dang sgom pa la thun dang thun mtshams su bcad nas rtse gcig tu bsgrubs pas mdo sngags kyi nyams dang rtogs pa'i rtsal nam mkha' la mdung bskor ba bzhin du gyur te grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi gral du dgyes dgur rol pa/ rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las sa chen po la rgyan du gyur pas che btsan rnam par gnon pa'i gzi ba rjid gzhan dang mi mnyam par rgyas te dregs ldan yongs kyi brtan pa 'phrog par byed pa la don yod pa'i 'phrul gyi zhags pa bzhin du spyod pa/ 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang /rtsom pa la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad nas thams cad du bral bas gsung gi 'od zer gyi dra ba phra mo tsam gyis kyang skal ba bzang po'i gdul bya ma lus pa'i blo gros kyi pad+mo legs par bzhad pa'i zil dngar gyi lcid rdzogs par byed pa la dus 'dir blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gdung 'tshob mnyam pa med par gyur pa sogs dpag par dka' ba'i yon tan gyi bang mdzod zad mi shes pa dag smra byed kyi yul las 'das so/ /de lta bu'i yon tan 479
